tracks.name: Más allá del Excel: Lo que tus hojas de cálculo no te dicen de tu contabilidad
tracks.speaker_line: Pedro del Valle (povb), BI & Data Expert at Odoo Technologies
tracks.description_text:
La forma en que analizamos los datos, los tableros de control y la Inteligencia de Negocios (BI) está evolucionando rápidamente, y el ecosistema de Odoo es parte de esta revolución. Muchas veces, las herramientas tradicionales se quedan cortas, dejándonos con reportes estáticos y desconectados cuando más necesitamos información en tiempo real.
En esta plática, descubriremos cómo dar el salto hacia el análisis de datos moderno. Aprenderemos a explotar a su más alto nivel las herramientas nativas de Odoo: desde sus potentes hojas de cálculo integradas, hasta el uso avanzado de tablas, listas dinámicas y fórmulas especializadas.
El objetivo de esta sesión es claro: enseñarte a transformar datos crudos en tableros 100% funcionales y automatizados. Únete y descubre cómo obtener una visión completa de tus finanzas para tomar decisiones estratégicas e inteligentes en tiempo récord.

speakers.name: Pedro del Valle (povb)
speakers.biography_text:
Soy Pedro del Valle, experto en Inteligencia de Negocios (BI) y Data en Odoo. Durante más de dos años, me he dedicado a explorar, aprender y reinventar mi forma de entender esta plataforma, descubriendo el verdadero impacto que tiene la inteligencia de negocios en el crecimiento de las empresas.
Mi gran pasión es el análisis de datos y el diseño de tableros estratégicos (dashboards). Disfruto el reto de transformar números complejos en información visual y clara, empoderando a los equipos para que puedan tomar decisiones ágiles, precisas y fundamentadas que impulsen el éxito del negocio.

A través de la metodología de Middle Market & Corporate (MMC), conoceremos cómo la planificación, la estructura de los equipos, la gestión de riesgos, el governance, las iteraciones y la preparación para el Go Live permiten gestionar implementaciones multinacionales de forma flexible, controlada y orientada a la adopción y generación de valor.

speakers.name: Jorge Reyes (jirg)
speakers.biography_text: Iván Reyes García es Large Account Consultant en Odoo, especializado en la gestión e implementación de proyectos para grandes organizaciones. Cuenta con experiencia en proyectos de transformación empresarial, trabajando con equipos multidisciplinarios y líderes ejecutivos para alinear procesos, tecnología y objetivos de negocio. Es Ingeniero Industrial y cuenta con una Maestría en Ciencias en Estudios Interdisciplinarios para PYMES por el IPN. Actualmente forma parte del equipo Middle Market & Corporate (MMC) de Odoo, donde participa en proyectos de alta complejidad y escala.

enables IT service providers and agencies to build a scalable business implementing and customizing Odoo ERP solutions.
Partners begin at the
Learning
level to build technical and functional expertise before ascending to
Official Partner
status to receive direct client leads and higher commission rates.
By combining certified training, target market specialization, and recurring implementation services, partners generate high-margin revenues while leveraging Odoo's global ecosystem.

speakers.name: Kathy Gitau & Mark Njau
speakers.biography_text:
Kathy Gitau
is a
Partnerships Consultant
who works with consulting firms, system integrators, and established technology companies across Africa to build successful Odoo implementation practices. She guides prospective partners through one half of the partnership journey, from activation through their first live implementation, helping teams grow into a repeatable delivery practice. Mark Njau
is a
Partnerships Consultant
who works with entrepreneurial technology companies, consulting firms, and system integrators across Africa to build successful Odoo implementation practices. He guides prospective partners through the other half of the partnership journey, from initial onboarding through certification training, helping new teams get ready for their first project. Based in Odoo's Nairobi office, Mark focuses on bringing new partners into the network as African SMEs increasingly adopt integrated, cloud-based systems.

tracks.name: Launch Your Online Business for Free in 30 Minutes
tracks.speaker_line: Chrispaix Kaze, Business Analyst / Web Designer at Odoo
tracks.description_text:
Stop waiting for the "perfect time" to launch your online store.
With Odoo, you can start today completely free, with no time limits.
Join me as I show you how to build a fully functional e-commerce website from scratch in just 30 minutes.
You’ll walk away with the exact blueprint to take your business online in record time and at zero cost.
Zero coding required. Zero prior Odoo experience needed.

speakers.name: Chrispaix Kaze
speakers.biography_text: Business Analyst, Web Designer

tracks.name: What's New in Website?
tracks.speaker_line: Innocent Mbuvi, Business Analyst at Odoo
tracks.description_text:
Most website builders force a trade-off: keep things simple and generic, or get the exact look and behavior you want and pay a developer to build it.
It's a trade-off so common most site owners stop noticing it. A shadow that doesn't quite match the brand. A form that collects the wrong data. A card that should link somewhere but doesn't  so they just live with it.
The reality? The builder was never the ceiling. The defaults were.
Join us as we walk through what's changed in Odoo's Website Builder — live, on a real site and see how far you can push it without writing a single line of cod

speakers.name: Innocent Mbuvi
speakers.biography_text:
Innocent Mbuvi
is an Odoo Functional Consultant at Odoo, turning SME implementations into systems teams actually use  not just admire in a demo. He works with businesses still running on spreadsheets and memory, bringing the structure that makes running things easier: streamlining messy manual processes, and designing websites  from online stores to brand sites  that give those businesses a face online as sharp as the operations behind them.
He's driven by a simple belief African SMEs deserve tooling built to the same standard as global enterprises, not a scaled-down version of it. At OXP26, he brings that lens to the Website Builder: a corner of Odoo most people scroll past, and one with more to offer than it gets credit for.

tracks.name: Beyond Localization: Engineering Payroll Across Africa with Odoo
tracks.speaker_line: Vivian Anyona, HR & Payroll Expert at Odoo
tracks.description_text:
Beyond Localization: Engineering Payroll for Africa
https://www.odoo.com/odoo/event.track/10648?menu_id=4965
Africa’s payroll landscape is complex, with different tax laws, statutory deductions, pension schemes, and reporting requirements across countries. But does the absence of an official localization mean Odoo cannot support payroll?
Absolutely not.
In this session, we’ll explore how local payroll expertise, compliance knowledge, and Odoo technical capability can be combined to build payroll solutions for different African markets. The session will culminate in a
live demo of building payroll from scratch in Odoo
, showing how payroll requirements can be translated into salary rules, tax logic, statutory deductions, and payslips.
Payroll is logic and logic can be engineered.

speakers.name: Vivian Anyona
speakers.biography_text:
Vivian Anyona
is a Business Analyst and Payroll Localization Specialist with experience in designing and implementing payroll solutions for African markets. She has played a key role in developing and localizing
Odoo Payroll for Kenya
, supporting a solution that has impacted more than
10,000 users over three years
.
Her work combines
payroll compliance, HR processes, business analysis, and Odoo configuration
, translating complex statutory requirements into practical and scalable payroll solutions. She has also been involved in payroll localization initiatives across
Kenya, South Africa, and Zambia
, with a focus on understanding local legislation, designing payroll rules, and documenting solutions for broader adoption.
Vivian is passionate about demonstrating that Africa’s diverse payroll requirements are not a barrier to digital transformation and that with the right expertise,
payroll can be engineered to meet local needs.

tracks.name: What's New in Inventory?
tracks.speaker_line: Sandra Odera, Business Analyst at Odoo
tracks.description_text: This talk will be about the new features coming into Odoo 20 inventory that will improve a company's warehouse management

speakers.name: Sandra Odera
speakers.biography_text: Sandra Odera is an Odoo implementation consultant based in Kenya, working with clients across multiple African countries and multiple industries and sectors. Sandra brings an analytical foundation to every implementation — digging into the why behind a client's requirements before proposing a structural solution. This approach favors sustainable, root-cause solutions over quick fixes, and end-to-end process documentation that helps clients truly own their systems.

tracks.name: Cloud One Business Phone System Integration with Odoo Phone
tracks.speaker_line: Atul Chauhan, Director at Cloud One Limited
tracks.description_text:
Cloud One & Odoo: Unified Business Phone Integration for Kenya
Transform your Odoo environment into a high-performance communication hub with Cloud One's native integration. By bridging the gap between voice calls and ERP data using local Kenyan numbers, this solution ensures every interaction is recorded, actionable, and personalized.
Key Integration Features
Local Connectivity: Utilize dedicated Kenyan SIP providers to make and receive calls using local +254 numbers.
Native WSS Integration: A high-speed, secure connection that enables seamless communication directly through the Odoo Phone (VoIP) application.
Click-to-Dial: Initiate outreach instantly by clicking any phone field within Odoo, eliminating manual dialing errors.
Real-time Call Pop-ups: Identify callers immediately with screen pops that link to their Odoo contact profile.
Why It Matters for Your Business
Enhanced Customer Context: View open orders, support history, and payment status via a Caller ID Preview before answering.
Increased Operational Speed: Rapidly move through leads with automated, sequential Call Lists and instant one-click dialing.
Ready for Remote Work: Ideal for Kenya’s evolving service sector; agents can log into queues and take calls from anywhere with an internet connection.
Total Accountability: Track performance with detailed analytics on call volumes, peak times, and durations to meet your team’s engagement KPIs.
Optimized for Your Audience
Sales-Driven SMEs: Maximize productivity by eliminating "dead time" and ensuring all lead follow-ups are automatically scheduled in the CRM.
Customer Support Centers: Empower helpdesk teams with instant access to customer history and the ability to perform briefed internal transfers.

speakers.name: Atul Chauhan
speakers.biography_text:
As a Co-Founder and Director at Cloud One Limited, Atul Chauhan is the visionary architect behind the company’s advanced communication and customer experience strategies. Based in Nairobi, Atul leverages his deep expertise in the Kenyan telecommunications sector to bridge the gap between voice technology and business intelligence.
He is currently spearheading the development of integrated VoIP solutions—specifically for Odoo—designed to empower local SMEs and support centres with streamlined, data-driven operations. Under his leadership, Cloud One continues to redefine how Kenyan businesses connect and grow.

tracks.name: Best practices of a succesfull implementation with a partner
tracks.speaker_line: Clément Dasylva, Head of Indirect Account Management at Odoo
tracks.description_text:
In our Account Management experience, the three most common non-technical reasons why ERP implementations fail with a partner are:
Assumptions
Scope creep
Radio silence
It’s rarely the technology itself. Yes, technology matters, but the biggest pitfalls are almost always human errors. The good news? Human errors can be managed.
Who is this for?
This session is designed for end customers who want to understand how to successfully manage their Odoo implementation journey with a partner and mitigate human risks, and for partners who are looking for inspiration in their implementation strategy.
What will you learn?
✅ How to successfully set up and structure your ERP implementation project
✅ Common challenges businesses face during the process
✅ How to identify and mitigate human risks throughout the project
Join this session to gain clear, actionable insights that will help you avoid common mistakes and drive a smoother, more effective Odoo rollout.

speakers.name: Clément Dasylva
speakers.biography_text: Clément has 10+ years of experience in Account Management, including 6 at Odoo. He built and now leads the Indirect Account Management team in Africa. Working closely with both customers and partners, he focuses on making the Odoo/Partner/Customer relationship work and setting implementations up for long-term success.

tracks.name: WhatsApp-Powered HRM: Building Intelligent Leave Workflows for Odoo
tracks.speaker_line: Aamir Varwani , Vibe Coder at Innovus Team
tracks.description_text:
Managing employee leave requests across distributed teams is a persistent HR challenge. Traditional leave management systems require employees to log into a web portal, navigate forms, and wait for email approvals — a friction-heavy process that often leads to delays and miscommunication.
Vibe Coding Team, a young software development team at Innovus, built an innovative solution: a WhatsApp-integrated leave application and approval system for Odoo HRM. The system allows employees to request leave, check balances, and receive real-time approvals directly through WhatsApp — the communication platform they already use daily.
Key learnings for the audience:
•	Designing conversational interfaces for HR workflows
•	Building WhatsApp integrations with Odoo HRM
•	Asynchronous approval workflows and notification patterns
•	User adoption strategies for mobile-first HR tools
•	Backend architecture for real-time leave balance queries
Value for attendees: HR technology leaders and Odoo developers will learn how to bridge the gap between modern employee expectations and legacy HR systems. The session demonstrates that powerful HR automation doesn't require complex portals — it requires meeting employees where they are.
Target audience: Odoo developers, HR technology specialists, companies with distributed workforces, and organizations seeking to improve employee experience with modern communication tools.

speakers.name: Aamir Varwani
speakers.biography_text: Aamir Varwani is a vibe coder at Innovus Team, part of the Innovus Group innovation lab. Aamir designed and built the WhatsApp-integrated leave management system for Odoo HRM, combining natural language processing, real-time database queries, and conversational UX principles. His work demonstrates how young developers can solve real business problems by rethinking traditional workflows through the lens of modern communication platforms. Aamir is passionate about making enterprise software more human-centered and accessible.

tracks.name: A Mobile-First Strategy with Odoo
tracks.speaker_line: Tricia Mwizero & Asnath Iteriteka, Customer Care Manager - Customer Success Manager at Odoo
tracks.description_text:
Business in Africa happens on the move, not behind desks. High mobile adoption, varying internet connectivity, and the expectation of instant transactions mean ERP systems must be easily accessible from smartphones to be effective. To succeed in the African market, businesses and developers must move beyond the traditional "desktop-first" ERP mindset. Africa is a mobile-first environment, and Odoo's ability to be accessed anytime, anywhere whether through the native mobile app or a web browser is key to driving adoption and operational efficiency.
We are at a tipping point. The businesses that survive the next decade in Africa won't be the ones with the biggest offices. They will be the ones that are the most agile, the most connected, and the most mobile.

speakers.name: Tricia Mwizero & Asnath Iteriteka
speakers.function: Customer Care Manager - Customer Success Manager
speakers.biography_text:
Tricia Mwizero
is an Account Manager with a background in project management and sales. Having worked across finance, construction, and the humanitarian sector, she brings a grounded understanding of different client needs by building genuine relationships, connecting the dots between short-term satisfaction and long-term retention, and making sure every customer has a great experience.
Asnath Iteriteka
is a Key Account Manager with a background in business operations and banking. She brings a combination of strategic thinking, a big-picture perspective, and practical experience in business digitalisation, with a focus on building lasting relationships and delivering value to clients.

tracks.name: What’s New in Sign?
tracks.speaker_line: Byron Odhiambo, Business Analyst at Odoo
tracks.description_text:
Odoo Sign has quietly evolved release after release and Odoo 20 ties it all together. Join this session for a practical walkthrough of what's new in Sign: Activity-triggered signature requests, non-Latin alphabet support extending Sign to 40+ countries, record updates that sync straight back to Odoo, reusable templates, and multi-signer status tracking.
We'll close with a live demo and a look at what the Sign rebuild means for teams signing across borders and languages in Africa.

speakers.name: Byron Odhiambo
speakers.biography_text: Byron is a Business Analyst driving digital transformation for African enterprises. Byron specializes in translating complex operational requirements into scalable workflows, helping businesses streamline processes, boost productivity, and maximize ROI.

tracks.name: Let's work together: an overview of our partner services
tracks.speaker_line: Antoine Huvelle, Head of Services at Odoo
tracks.description_text:
How many times have I heard partner telling me "Ho, I didn't know you offered that kind of services for your partners!". This talk aims at telling you everything about how we can help, so that you don't learn about it after you needed it.
Bootcamps, MasterClasses, support, upgrade, webdesign, specific services, we'll tell you all about how our consultant can train, teach, collaborate, in order to make your team learn faster and make your projects successful

speakers.name: Antoine Huvelle
speakers.biography_text:
Business Analyst and Head of Services at Odoo Belgium, Antoine is super fan of the technico-functional aspects in Odoo. Good generalist, he's eager to share his knowledge to whomever is eager to learn.
Don't hesitate to ask him anything about Odoo, if he doesn't know he will look the answer for you and give you information about how you could have found it yourself

tracks.name: What's New in Manufacturing?
tracks.speaker_line: Kevin Wamae, Business Analyst at Odoo
tracks.description_text: Discover the latest updates to Odoo Manufacturing, including new tools for shop floor efficiency, smarter production planning, and tighter integration with Inventory and Quality. This session walks through recent feature releases — from work order improvements to real-time tracking enhancements — and shows how manufacturers can streamline operations and boost visibility across the production process.

speakers.name: Kevin Wamae
speakers.biography_text:
Kevin Wamae
is an ERP professional specializing in driving operational efficiency and business growth for African enterprises through Odoo. He brings focused expertise in Inventory and Manufacturing, helping businesses streamline supply chains, strengthen warehouse operations, and build production processes that scale.
Kevin's strength lies in turning complex operational challenges into practical, well-configured Odoo systems — improving stock accuracy, tightening procurement cycles, and reducing waste across the manufacturing floor. His experience covers inventory control, warehouse management, bill of materials, production planning, and quality workflows, giving businesses one connected system to run their operations end to end.
He is driven by a clear purpose: equipping African enterprises with the same operational rigor and technology standards used by leading global businesses. Kevin works closely with manufacturers and distributors to design solutions that reflect local realities while enabling international-grade efficiency, helping clients cut costs, eliminate bottlenecks, and grow sustainably.
As an Odoo specialist, Kevin Wamae is a trusted partner for African businesses seeking to modernize operations and build lasting competitive advantage.

tracks.name: Full business transformation with Odoo
tracks.speaker_line: Elijah Ssebugwawo, Managing Director
tracks.description_text:
Scaling a high-demand consumer electronics and logistics business in East Africa requires a robust backend, but our early operations were holding us back. Initially relying on a fragmented tech stack built around WordPress, we faced significant growing pains: we couldn't accurately manage our inventory, manual invoicing was tedious, and tracking our financial records was a constant challenge. Furthermore, our sales team relied on ordinary mobile phones and native WhatsApp, leading to siloed, unorganized communication with our clients.
In this Customer Success Story, discover how migrating to Odoo solved these critical pain points and became the central nervous system for our business. We will explore how Odoo provided the technical foundation needed to transition from a struggling single storefront into a streamlined, three-entity corporate group—encompassing Gadget Craze, Gridlink Cargo Solutions, and Gateway Core Sourcing.
We will showcase how replacing our disconnected tools with Odoo's unified ecosystem allowed us to bridge CRM, complex multi-company inventory, and accounting. Additionally, we will highlight how upgrading from native mobile WhatsApp to a fully integrated WhatsApp solution within Odoo transformed our customer engagement, bringing all client communication into one centralized, traceable hub.
Key takeaways for attendees will include:
Overcoming the E-commerce Bottleneck: Escaping the limitations of a basic WordPress setup to achieve real-time, accurate inventory and financial tracking.
Centralizing Client Communication: Transitioning from scattered mobile phone WhatsApp chats to a streamlined, omnichannel customer engagement strategy using Odoo CRM and WhatsApp integration.
Mastering the Multi-Company Environment: Leveraging Odoo to smoothly manage distinct corporate entities (retail, logistics, and trading) without data silos or operational downtime.
Technical Stability: Practical insights into utilizing Odoo.sh and staging databases to maintain system stability and execute safe updates.

speakers.name: Elijah Ssebugwawo
speakers.biography_text:
Elijah Ssebugwawo is the Managing Director and Founder of a Kampala-based corporate group encompassing Gadget Craze, Gridlink Cargo Solutions, and Gateway Core Sourcing.
Driven by an obsession with consumer electronics and a refusal to accept the fragmented retail experiences available at the time, Elijah launched Gadget Craze in 2012 at just 20 years old. What began as a singular vision to bring premium tech to East Africa has since evolved into a dynamic e-commerce and logistics ecosystem.
A hands-on technologist with a relentless drive for operational efficiency, Elijah recognized early on that scaling a high-demand business required more than just front-end sales—it demanded a bulletproof backend. This systems-first mindset led him to champion the adoption of Odoo, successfully architecting the company's transition from a constrained, single-storefront startup into a streamlined, multi-entity powerhouse.
When he isn’t optimizing ERP architecture, managing staging databases, or executing corporate strategy, Elijah is an avid gamer and automotive enthusiast who remains deeply passionate about pushing the boundaries of the East African tech landscape.

BEAUTY CREATES, CHARACTER CONSTRUCTS.

tracks.name: Odoo Implementation Energy Solution (Oil, LPG and Lubricants) Industry
tracks.speaker_line: Ajeet Kumar Yadav, CEO at Softprime Consulting Pvt Ltd
tracks.description_text:
We Empowering Energy Companies with Intelligent, Scalable ERP Solutions.
Softprime Consulting provides tailored digital transformation solutions for the
energy sector. From LPG and fuel to depot and retail operations, our Odoo- based
platform integrates all business functions—enhancing operational
efficiency, traceability, and real-time decision-making.
Key Solutions;
End-to-end automation for fuel, LPG & depot operations.
Real-time sensor-based inventory & fleet tracking.
Centralized ERP with multi-warehouse sync.
Full Odoo module integration.

speakers.name: Ajeet Kumar Yadav
speakers.biography_text:
Ajeet Kumar Yadav is the visionary CEO of Softprime Consulting Pvt Ltd, a leading digital transformation firm specializing in Odoo ERP solutions. With over a decade of hands-on experience in ERP implementation, Python development, and business process automation, Ajeet has established himself as a certified Odoo expert and a trusted advisor to enterprises across the world.​
Under his leadership, Softprime has grown into a multi-regional powerhouse, delivering over 400 successful Odoo projects across sectors such as energy, healthcare, manufacturing, and logistics. Ajeet's strategic focus on AI-driven automation, IoT integration, and scalable ERP architecture has positioned the company as a go-to partner for complex, multi-company deployments.​
Ajeet is particularly recognized for leading the digital transformation of Horn Petroleum Group, where he oversaw the implementation of a centralized Odoo-based ERP system supporting over 100 users across multiple business units. This initiative streamlined operations, enhanced real-time visibility, and introduced predictive analytics, setting a new benchmark for ERP success in the energy sector.​
Beyond his technical acumen, Ajeet is a passionate advocate for open-source innovation and sustainable digital growth. He continues to mentor emerging tech leaders and actively contributes to the Odoo community.

tracks.name: Thriving in the Odoo Ecosystem as a Young Professional
tracks.speaker_line: Wandera Maloba, Marketing & Social Networks at Odoo
tracks.description_text: Global companies establishing local offices present so many opportunities. Odoo opened it's first Africa office in 2022 and has presented so many opportunities to young people. Let's talk about how urgency, diligence, self-drive and initative can help the current and next generation thrive and grow in Odoo's ecosystem as a young professional. This talk will be good for content creators, recruiters, accountants, HR managers, developers,IT specialists and any young people seeking to tap into the Odoo ecosystem.

speakers.name: Wandera Maloba
speakers.biography_text: Wandera Maloba has been at Odoo Kenya since 2022. A seasoned salesperson and now trailblazing marketing efforts across Africa.

tracks.name: The Discovery Analysis: Bridging the Gap Before Commitment
tracks.speaker_line: Barthélemy Destrée & Earl Spencer, Large Account Consultant & Business Analyst at Odoo
tracks.description_text:
Every great transformation starts with a crystal-clear strategy. The
Discovery Analysis
is the crucial first phase of your project—a dedicated opportunity to deeply explore your unique business needs, align your strategic objectives, and ensure Odoo is pecisely tailored for your growth goals.
In this session, Barthélemy Destrée and Earl Spencer will reveal how leveraging this initial phase bridges the gap between vision and execution, empowering you to make confident decisions, and set your Odoo implementation up for seamless long-term success.

speakers.name: Barthélemy Destrée & Earl Spencer
speakers.biography_text:
Barthélemy Destrée
brings diverse experience across the Odoo ecosystem. After two years in Presales driving ROI analyses, he served as Head of Services for Odoo Kenya. Since 2024, he has been based in Belgium as a Large Account Consultant, leading enterprise Discovery Analyses and overseeing large-scale project implementations.
Earl Spencer
is a Business Analyst at Odoo Kenya, specializing in operational workflows and digital transformation for East African businesses. He works closely with organizations to translate business requirements into efficient Odoo implementations.

tracks.name: Why Wait For Chaos? Lessons from 1000+ SMEs
tracks.speaker_line: Doris Kebati / Dorcas Mwikali, Customer Care Manager / Customer Care Manager - Team Lead at Odoo
tracks.description_text:
Most growing businesses wait until chaos becomes inevitable before adopting any management system: when operational bottlenecks, disconnected processes, and limited visibility begin to slow them down.
After supporting over 1000+ SMEs, we've consistently observed the same pattern: founders wait an average of three years before implementing proper business systems, often believing they're only necessary for large corporations.
The reality? Systems don't follow growth. Growth follows systems.
Join us for an insightful session as we share lessons learned from supporting over 1000+ SMEs and explore why building the right foundation early is key to sustainable growth. Discover how Odoo adapts to your business from day one, helping you scale with confidence instead of reacting to chaos.

speakers.name: Doris Kebati / Dorcas Mwikali
speakers.function: Customer Care Manager / Customer Care Manager - Team Lead
speakers.biography_text:
Doris Kebati
is a
Customer Success Manager
at
Odoo
with a background in innovation, entrepreneurship, and research. She has experience across sectors including finance and retail and is passionate about customer experience, building strong relationships, and creating meaningful experiences for customers.
Dorcas Mwikali
is a
Customer Success Manager, Team Lead
at
Odoo
with experience helping businesses across Africa drive growth, strengthen their operations, and get more value from their software investment. Her work spans customer success and account management giving her a practical perspective on what it takes to support businesses as they grow.

tracks.name: Beyond the Code: Rewiring Enterprise Culture for Total Odoo Adoption
tracks.speaker_line: Joshua Owusu-Ansah, Co-Founder / CEO at iSERD Ltd
tracks.description_text: The most powerful ERP system in the world is completely useless if no one wants to log into it. In the rush to configure modules and map workflows, integrators often forget the single most critical variable in digital transformation: the human being. This session shifts the spotlight from software architecture to enterprise psychology. We will explore how to deploy a 5-Pillar Digital Maturity Index (DMI) to accurately diagnose a company’s cultural readiness before writing a single line of code. Paired with the ADKAR change management framework, participants will learn a systematic, people-centric approach to transition teams from implementation anxiety to total Odoo adoption, ensuring your digital transformation actually takes root

speakers.name: Joshua Owusu-Ansah
speakers.biography_text: Joshua Owusu-Ansah is a voice in West African digital transformation and the CEO of iSERD Ltd. As an expert Odoo ERP Solution Architect, he engineers complex system implementations for high-profile organizations. His approach goes beyond code, prioritizing organizational readiness through the ADKAR change management model and his proprietary 5-pillar Digital Maturity Index (DMI). Currently, Joshua is pioneering a Compliance-as-a-Service (CaaS) model, bridging global ERP capabilities with local requirements by integrating Odoo with Ghanaian regulatory bodies like the GRA, DPC, and SSNIT. Furthermore, he champions regional developer training through the iDev Hub a campus initiative, building robust local tech ecosystems.

tracks.name: A student project turned into a live business - Journey after the Education Program.
tracks.speaker_line: Moses Mumo, Owner at Twiku Elixir
tracks.description_text:
What happens when you take what you learn in class and actually run with it?  You build a business!
In this interview, we sit down with a former student who turned classroom theory into e-commerce reality. After discovering Odoo through the Odoo Education Program, they took the plunge and launched their own online store using the platform to power everything behind the scenes.
We’ll dive into their entrepreneurial journey, exploring how they set up their store, how they use Odoo day-to-day to manage sales, inventory, and operations, and the real impact the Education Program had on giving them the confidence to launch.
Whether you’re a student dreaming of starting your own brand, a professor who wants to see the tangible impact of hands-on learning, or an institution looking to inspire the next generation of founders, this is a story you won't want to miss.
Explore the program:
https://www.odoo.com/education

speakers.name: Moses Mumo
speakers.biography_text: Moses Mumo is a Kenyan lawyer, entrepreneur, and international affairs enthusiast with a background in law, and youth leadership. He holds an LLB degree from Mount Kenya Uni Parklands and is currently a Master of Laws student at the University of East London. Moses is the owner of Twiku Elixir, a retail and wholesale liquor store in Lower Kabete. He is passionate about business, leadership, diplomacy, and creating opportunities for young people.

tracks.name: The Seamless Portfolio: End-to-End Real Estate Management with Odoo
tracks.speaker_line: Dorice Amolo, Business Analyst at Odoo
tracks.description_text:
Session Description:
Managing a growing real estate portfolio often means juggling disconnected systems for marketing, tenant requests, and finances. In this functional session, we will explore how Odoo’s integrated ecosystem transforms complex property management into a seamless, centralized operation.
Whether you are a developer, landlord, or property agency, discover how to unite your entire real estate lifecycle in a single platform.
Key Topics Covered:
Portfolio Centralization: Track all your properties in one place with real-time, birds-eye visibility into which units are occupied and which are vacant.
Marketing & Lead Capture: Learn how to advertise available units directly on your Odoo website and automatically capture incoming leads from social media platforms like Instagram straight into your CRM.
Maintenance Management: See how easily tenants can log maintenance requests, and how your team can track and resolve them without missing a beat.
Integrated Accounting: Experience the power of connected financials, featuring vibrant performance dashboards and impeccably accurate reports tied directly to your leasing data.
Key Takeaway:
Attendees will leave with a practical roadmap for eliminating manual bottlenecks, maximizing occupancy rates, and gaining complete, end-to-end financial control over their real estate business.

speakers.name: Dorice Amolo
speakers.biography_text: Dorice is a business systems architect who has spent the last three years spearheading successful ERP implementations across the African continent. With a sharp focus on eliminating manual bottlenecks,she helps organizations unify their disjointed platforms to achieve end-to-end operational control. Dorice is dedicated to empowering companies across diverse industries to maximize their tech investments, transforming complex workflows into seamless, high-performing ecosystems.

tracks.name: Whats new in POS for restaurants?
tracks.speaker_line: Cyrus Muli, Business analyst at Odoo
tracks.description_text: Join us for an in-depth exploration of the latest advancements in Odoo 20 Point of Sale specifically designed to elevate the restaurant experience. In this session, we will showcase how the newest features in Odoo POS restaurant are streamlining operations—from front-of-house efficiency to smart kitchen management.

speakers.name: Cyrus Muli
speakers.biography_text:
Cyrus Muli
is an ERP professional specializing in driving operational efficiency and business growth for African enterprises through Odoo. While versatile across the entire Odoo suite, Cyrus brings deep focus and technical mastery to Accounting, Point of Sale (POS), Manufacturing, and Inventory—helping businesses bridge real-time front-end operations with complex back-end manufacturing and financial control.
Having spearheaded implementations that streamline supply chains, optimize retail workflows, and deliver clear financial visibility, Cyrus is passionate about leveraging scalable, integrated open-source technology to tackle unique operational challenges across the continent.

tracks.name: From Spreadsheets to Smooth AGMs: End-to-End Condominium Management in Odoo
tracks.speaker_line: Tresor Mucowintore, Customer Success Manager at Odoo
tracks.description_text:
Condominium management comes with unique operational challenges, from managing properties and owners to invoicing shared services, allocating costs, and communicating with residents. Odoo provides an integrated platform that can bring these activities together in a single system.
In this session, we will explore how Odoo can be used to manage the day-to-day operations of condominium managers. Through practical examples and demonstrations, attendees will discover how to get started, onboard and manage condominiums, invoice services and allocate shared costs, and communicate effectively with owners through targeted communications and invitations to general meetings.
The talk will provide a practical overview of how Odoo can help condominium managers centralize their operations, improve efficiency, and deliver a more structured and digital management experience.

speakers.name: Tresor Mucowintore
speakers.biography_text:
Tresor Mucowintore joined Odoo two years ago as a Business Analyst, leading full-cycle implementations for clients across Francophone Africa and translating business requirements into scalable Odoo solutions.
He recently joined the Odoo Partner ecosystem as an account manager, where he supports both partners and clients in delivering successful Odoo projects while identifying opportunities for growth and expansion.

tracks.name: Customer Retention: Your Most Profitable Growth Engine
tracks.speaker_line: Astor Arakaza, Customer Success Manager at Odoo
tracks.description_text:
Session Summary
:
In today’s competitive B2B landscape, the most sustainable growth engine isn't acquiring new logos (customers), it’s retaining and expanding your existing client accounts.
In this tactical 20-minute session, Astor Arakaza breaks down why retention is significantly cheaper and smarter than acquisition in regional markets, and how to shift your mindset from a reactive vendor to a strategic business architect.
Attendees will discover how to cooperate with their Odoo Account Manager to filter out project noise, use native data monitoring tools (such as Health Scores and usage velocity) to catch "silent churn" before it happens, and implement a proactive 180-day renewal workflow that secures contract renewals long before the quote is generated.
Key Takeaways
:
Transition from a transactional vendor mindset to a strategic business architect.
Leverage Odoo analytics to identify red flags and prevent silent churn early.
Master the 180-day renewal workflow to drive long-term account growth.

speakers.name: Astor Arakaza
speakers.biography_text:
Astor Arakaza is a digital strategy and customer success professional with extensive experience in enterprise digital transformation, financial technology, and client relationship management. As an Account Manager in the Customer Success Team (Indirect) at Odoo Kenya, Astor manages a diverse portfolio of clients across partner networks, driving strategic project alignment, account expansion, and long-term customer success.
Prior to joining Odoo, Astor spent over seven years in the financial and digital services sectors. He served as Digital Services Manager at Banque de l'Habitat du Burundi and Channel Banker at KCB Bank Burundi, where he spearheaded major e-channel initiatives, agency banking growth, and digital banking implementations.
Combining analytical rigor with a pragmatic, customer-centric mindset, Astor is dedicated to helping organizations leverage digital tools to optimize their operations and achieve sustainable growth.

tracks.name: Ask Me Anything
tracks.speaker_line: Patrick Lukusa, Director for Africa at Odoo
tracks.description_text:
Join a candid open mic session with the Odoo Africa MD.
This interactive discussion is open to all attendees, with particular value for current or potential Odoo partners and clients. Bring your questions or suggestions on the company, the product, roadmaps, regional strategy, partnerships, implementation experiences, or anything in between.
Expect straightforward answers and practical insights.

speakers.name: Patrick Lukusa
speakers.biography_text: Patrick leads Odoo's efforts to make business software accessible across Africa.

tracks.name: What's New in Purchase?
tracks.speaker_line: Sybel Nyenimana, Business Analyst at Odoo
tracks.description_text: In this session, we will be walking through what's new in Odoo 20's Purchase app. From a redesigned form that brings better user experience, to a revamp of catalog and unit improvements that make ordering clearer, tax-inclusive/exclusive pricing that finally syncs itself, and smarter sections on your POs . Come see how Odoo helps you do better, faster, and more efficient purchasing with live demo and time for questions!

speakers.name: Sybel Nyenimana
speakers.biography_text: Sybel is a Business Analyst and Project Manager at Odoo Kenya, where he leads ERP implementations across anglophone and francophone Africa. Holding a Master's in Mechanical Engineering, he applies a systems-thinking approach to enterprise transformation: translating technical complexity into operational clarity for clients across multiple industries and jurisdictions. With experience spanning 15+ industries across more than five African countries, he knows that no two deployments are the same.

tracks.name: The AI-Native Business: What African Companies Get Right and Wrong About Artificial Intelligence
tracks.speaker_line: Tonee Ndungu, Founder/CEO of Kytabu Africa and Tribbe Nation at Kytabu Africa and Tribbe Nation
tracks.description_text: The talk cuts through the noise on where AI genuinely moves the needle for African businesses, and where it does not, drawing on Tonee's experience building and scaling AI across edtech and fintech. Actionable for operators, not just visionaries. Tonee will build out the full talk from here, but this gives you the direction and a title to work with.

speakers.name: Tonee Ndungu
speakers.function: Founder/CEO of Kytabu Africa and Tribbe Nation
speakers.biography_text:
Tonee Ndungu is a Kenyan entrepreneur who has spent his career helping build what many now call Kenya’s Silicon Savannah. His belief in technology’s power to transform lives runs deep, and he has dedicated his work to unlocking Africa’s social and economic potential through innovation and access.
His entrepreneurial journey is one of faith over form. Born dyslexic, he founded the NAILAB in 2009, started KYTABU in 2012 to make education more accessible, and is now building Tribbe — a fintech platform designed to digitize social finance and community credit, redefining Africa’s social capital.
He is committed to advancing Africa’s voice in the global AI conversation. His work focuses on educating and inspiring a generation of African entrepreneurs who see AI not as a threat, but as a tool to create opportunity from adversity.
“Whatever you do, don’t leave this world without building something for others.”

tracks.name: How Odoo Can Power SACCOs, Clubs and Community Lenders in Africa
tracks.speaker_line: Christian Musinguzi, CTO at Tech Things Ltd
tracks.description_text:
Across Africa, SACCOs, investment clubs, and community lenders are helping people save, borrow, invest, and build wealth together. Yet many of these institutions still depend on spreadsheets, paper files, and manual accounting processes that become difficult to control as membership grows.
This talk showcases a practical SACCO and lending solution built on Odoo. The solution manages members, savings, loans, credit workflows, interest, penalties, AGM resolutions, year-end closures, member balances, reports, and accounting transactions within one connected system.
The session will demonstrate how Odoo can be adapted to serve member-driven financial institutions while keeping operations simple for users and reliable for management. It is a real example of how Odoo can solve local African business challenges through smart customization, strong accounting integration, and user-friendly workflows.

speakers.name: Christian Musinguzi
speakers.biography_text:
I am a Ugandan telecoms engineer, Odoo certified professional, and business technology consultant with over 12 years of experience in Odoo.
I help organizations turn complex business challenges into simple, practical, and scalable Odoo solutions. My work focuses on improving sales, productivity, efficiency, profitability, and operational control through technology that truly fits the business.

tracks.name: Agric Things: Connecting Farm Operations to the Agribusiness Value Chain
tracks.speaker_line: Benjamin Kugonza, Business Development Manager at Tech Things
tracks.description_text:
Agriculture businesses manage many moving parts at once — crops, animals, farmers, inputs, feeds, production cycles, stock, purchases, sales, payments, accounting, and reporting. When these activities are handled manually or in disconnected systems, it becomes difficult to track performance, control costs, manage growth, and make timely decisions.
This talk presents Agric Things, an agriculture management platform built around Odoo to help manage both farm operations and the wider agribusiness value chain. The platform supports agriculture verticals such as cattle, poultry, piggery, aquaculture, farmer management, annual crops, perennial crops, and greenhouse production.
Agric Things handles the agriculture-specific layer, while Odoo powers the business backbone through Sales, Purchases, Inventory, Manufacturing, Accounting, reporting, and other core business applications.
The session will show how agriculture workflows can be combined with Odoo’s ERP capabilities to create a practical solution for African agribusinesses. From farm records to stock movement, from production planning to sales, and from operational activities to financial reports, Agric Things helps bring visibility, accountability, and control into agriculture operations.
Attendees will learn how Odoo can be used not only as an ERP, but as a strong foundation for building agriculture platforms that support real farm operations, value chain management, and scalable agribusiness growth.

speakers.name: Benjamin Kugonza
speakers.biography_text:
Raised with a strong passion for agriculture, I pursued studies in Business Administration and Animal Production to combine agricultural expertise with business and technology. My experience spans working with multinational poultry farming companies, including Rammit Turkey Breeder Farm (Israel), serving as a Director at Agronaire Consultancy Limited, and managing farming enterprises in piggery, poultry, produce trading, potato, and maize production.
These experiences revealed the need for an integrated digital platform to streamline commercial farm management. In 2022, I discovered Odoo, whose enterprise management capabilities aligned with my vision of transforming agribusiness through technology. After gaining hands-on experience with an Odoo technology company, I built expertise in helping organizations improve efficiency, productivity, profitability, and operational control.
Today, I am a Ugandan business consultant with over three years of experience working with CEOs, CTOs, CIOs, and business leaders to implement technology-driven solutions. Through Agri Things, I am dedicated to empowering farmers and agribusinesses across Africa with innovative digital solutions that drive sustainable growth.

tracks.speaker_line: Doreen Thuku, Partner Manager for Accounting Firms at Odoo
tracks.description_text:
Executive Summary
This 30-minute panel provides a real-world blueprint on how accounting practices can leverage automation and integrated ERP software to increase client capacity.
The Core Takeaway for Attendees: How to cut manual accounting workloads and double firm efficiency in under 15 minutes.
Featured Speakers:
Doreen - Account Manager for Accounting Firms, Odoo (Host/Moderator)
Julius Njuguna - CEO & Founder, CLOUDACC (Industry Expert/Practitioner)

speakers.name: Doreen Thuku

Doreen Thuku
is a Partnership Manager at Odoo, where she leads relationship-building with fiduciary and accounting firm partners across Africa. In this role, she works closely with accounting firms to help them get the most out of Odoo's solutions, supports the growth of their partnership with Odoo, and ensures their end clients receive the best possible experience with the platform.
Doreen brings three years of experience in partnerships and sales, with a diverse background spanning the banking, insurance, and FMCG sectors. This cross-industry exposure has given her a well-rounded understanding of client relationships, business development, and operational processes across regulated and fast-moving markets alike — a foundation that now informs her work supporting fiduciary partners navigating Odoo's accounting and localisation requirements.
She holds an MBA from Kenyatta University and a Bachelor of Commerce from the Catholic University of Eastern Africa. Doreen is known for her structured, proactive communication style and her ability to build long-term, trust-based professional relationships.

tracks.name: Solving Real Retail Challenges with a More Resilient Odoo POS
tracks.speaker_line: Christopher Mwanje, Project Manager at Tech Things Ltd
tracks.description_text:
Every retailer and restaurant wants one simple thing from a POS system: when a customer is ready to pay, the sale goes through quickly, reliably, and without fuss — whatever the conditions on the ground.
This talk showcases Bizness Duuka, a native Odoo POS application built for Android and Windows that makes selling more dependable in real-world African business environments. The solution strengthens offline handling, protects every order from being lost, keeps multiple POS tills working in sync, and stores transactions securely on the local device until they synchronise back to Odoo when connectivity returns.
The session will explore how Odoo POS can be extended to handle the practical realities faced by shops, supermarkets, restaurants, and service counters — where power and internet may be unstable, and every transaction matters.
Attendees will see how a more resilient Odoo POS experience helps businesses keep selling, protect revenue, improve accountability, and remove the daily frustrations that come with operating in low-connectivity markets.

speakers.name: Christopher Mwanje
speakers.biography_text:
Christopher Mwanje is a Ugandan Software Engineer with over eight years of experience delivering technology solutions that drive practical business results across East and Southern Africa, including Uganda, Kenya, Rwanda, Malawi, and Zambia. As Project and Operations Lead at Tech Things Limited, he has led end-to-end Odoo ERP implementations for organizations in the hospitality, retail, manufacturing, healthcare, and government sectors.
Holding a Bachelor of Science in Software Engineering, Christopher is driven by a single goal: building resilient, practical Odoo solutions engineered for African realities—empowering businesses to streamline operations, enhance productivity, and remain firmly in control of their growth.

tracks.name: Odoo's Case for Mid-Market & Corporate
tracks.speaker_line: Rahab Gichuki & Waiganjo Chege, Manager - Mid-Market & Corporate ; Project Director at Odoo
tracks.description_text:
Odoo is widely seen as a tool for small business. The reputation has stuck since Odoo's roots are in the SME space. However, the product has evolved over time to cater to Mid-market and corporate customers and the perception hasn't caught up yet.
In this session, we'll look at what growing organisations actually need from an ERP, and how Odoo's current architecture is built to meet that. We show how Odoo's all in one scalable and affordable solution meets needs directly. How it is specifically tailored for the African market including but not limited to: Multi-currency and multi entity support, localisations and a dedicated regional team to back it.

speakers.name: Rahab Gichuki & Waiganjo Chege
speakers.biography_text:
Rahab
joined Odoo in 2022, working in Direct Sales for three years from the Kenyan office, serving the African market. As a Project Manager,
Waiganjo
has led the successful implementation of dozens of projects across a wide array of industries and spanning multiple African countries. He is currently a Business Analyst Team Leader and is setting up the MMC division of the Business Services department.

Lucy is a vocal advocate for AI, technology and policy as tools for Africa's economic transformation —
guided by a belief that real innovation must move people forward, especially those the world often
overlooks.

tracks.name: What’s new in Marketing?
tracks.speaker_line: Esther Onzere, Business Analyst at Odoo
tracks.description_text: Get ready to discover the latest enhancements in Odoo Marketing! In this session, we'll introduce you to the improved marketing experience and the features that will transform how you keep your customers engaged. Expect a sneak peek into the tools that make your marketing smoother and cooler than ever before. Join us to learn how Odoo Marketing can take your business to the next level!

speakers.name: Esther Onzere
speakers.biography_text: Esther Onzere is a Business Analysts & Project Manager at Odoo Kenya, leading complex, cross-industry software implementations. Having seen firsthand how fragmented, disjointed apps slow businesses down, Esther specializes in transforming chaotic processes into unified, high-performing systems. At Odoo Experience Africa, she will draw on her deep implementation expertise to demonstrate how Odoo 20’s latest marketing tools and Agentic AI workflows can permanently close down your "marketing zoo."

tracks.name: From Years of Spreadsheets to 8 Million Voices - How Shujaaz Built the Digital Backbone for Kenya's Largest Youth Network
tracks.speaker_line: Joram Kioko, Senior Manager - Community
tracks.description_text: For many years, Shujaaz managed one of Kenya's largest youth engagement networks (5,000 superfans who reach 8 million young people) using spreadsheets and disconnected systems. As the organization grew to reach 8 million young people annually, those manual processes became a barrier to scale and innovation. Our presentation/story explores how Shujaaz transformed Odoo into the digital backbone of its operations - integrating communications, finance, data collection and mobile money payments into a single platform. The result has been greater efficiency, transparency and traceability, freeing the team from administrative work to launch new initiatives like Shujaaz Vibez and deepen their impact across Kenya.

speakers.name: Joram Kioko
speakers.biography_text: Joram Kioko is an operations and community engagement leader with over 15 years of experience designing and implementing community engagement initiatives across the commercial and international development sectors in Kenya, Tanzania and the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC). At Shujaaz Inc., he has built and scaled a nationwide network of more than 5,000 SuperFans and community researchers, helping Shujaaz reach over 8 million young people annually through research, storytelling and behaviour change initiatives focused on reproductive health, governance and entrepreneurship. He is part of the team behind Shujaaz's two International Emmy Awards, recognising the organisation's innovative approach to youth engagement and storytelling. Joram also led the adoption of Odoo as Shujaaz's digital backbone, integrating operations, communications and mobile money to improve efficiency, transparency and innovation at scale.

tracks.name: Smart Payments: ERP-Driven Banking with Built-In Fraud Detection and Decision Assurance
tracks.speaker_line: Hari Bhogaita
tracks.description_text:
This talk presents a real-world, production-grade ERP-bank integration that delivers real-time control, automated reconciliation, and built-in fraud prevention across all financial transactions. Payments are executed directly from the ERP, incoming funds are receipted instantly, and reconciliation can be completed automatically, eliminating manual intervention, reducing errors, and removing the risk of fictitious or manipulated transactions.
Unlike traditional approaches that rely on external banking platforms or third-party wallet systems, this is a direct integration with banks. There is no wallet involved, no need to preload funds, and no intermediary layer. All transactions are executed directly from and into the organisation’s actual bank accounts, ensuring full alignment with existing banking structures, controls, and compliance requirements.
The system is already fully implemented and operational, supporting a wide range of payment types including KRA iTax, RTGS, PesaLink, SWIFT, mobile money (M-Pesa), and standard bank transfers. It is currently integrated with major institutions such as I&M Bank, M-Pesa, and Equity Bank, with additional banks being onboarded, enabling organisations to operate across multiple payment rails from a single unified ERP platform.
Beyond outbound payments, the system also handles inbound transactions through instant payment notifications. When money is received into a bank account, the ERP is notified in real time and can automatically generate a payment receipt without any manual input. Combined with direct bank statement integration, whether pulled via API or uploaded, the system can automatically reconcile transactions with minimal or no human intervention.
In practice, this creates a closed-loop financial system where payments are sent, received, and reconciled seamlessly within the ERP. This removes reliance on manual processes and eliminates common risks such as human error, delayed entries, manipulation of records, or fictitious payments.
A key feature of the solution is a custom Decision Assurance Protocol. This introduces intelligent, context-aware warnings during the approval process. For example, if a supplier’s bank account details change after a history of payments to a different account, the system will automatically flag the transaction for additional scrutiny. It also performs cross-checks such as identifying when a supplier is also a customer with outstanding balances, prompting users to consider netting off payments instead of making unnecessary disbursements.
Looking ahead, this protocol is being extended into AI-driven capabilities that will analyse transaction patterns, detect anomalies, and proactively flag potential fraud risks before payments are executed.
The session focuses on demonstrating what is now possible with modern ERP-bank integrations. Attendees will see how approval workflows can be fully controlled within the ERP, how operations such as internal transfers and float top-ups can be automated, and how modern security standards including passkeys and multi-factor authentication are enforced within a fully integrated financial environment.
The value to the audience lies in seeing a fully working, market-ready solution that delivers tighter control, higher data integrity, and significantly improved operational efficiency. It also demonstrates how organisations can move away from fragmented banking interfaces and adopt a single, ERP-driven financial control layer.
This talk is targeted at finance leaders, ERP implementers, system architects, and organisations managing complex or high-volume transactions who are looking to modernise their financial infrastructure and deploy direct bank integrations rather than wallet-based solutions while achieving stronger control, reconciliation, and fraud prevention.

speakers.name: Hari Bhogaita
speakers.biography_text: Hari Bhogaita is the Managing Director for Operations and Finance at MACE Industrial Equipment and leads Deep Purple, the company’s ERP integration subsidiary. With a background in mechanical and electrical engineering, he began in the family business and quickly realised that delivering better engineering required stronger operational systems. speakers.name: Abdul Jin

tracks.name: From Transactions to Trusted Reports: Making Odoo Accounting Work for African Businesses
tracks.speaker_line: Julius Njuguna, CEO
tracks.description_text:
Category
Functional
Brief Description
Accounting is one of the most important areas in any Odoo implementation because it is where business owners, finance teams, auditors, and management expect accuracy, control, and reliable reporting. In many African businesses, finance teams are still dealing with manual Excel reconciliations, unclear chart of accounts, weak closing controls, delayed bank reconciliations, tax compliance pressure, disconnected sales and inventory processes, and historical data challenges.
This talk will share practical lessons on how to implement and use Odoo Accounting effectively in real business environments. The session will focus on key setup decisions such as chart of accounts, taxes, journals, fiscal periods, document sequences, user access rights, lock dates, opening balances, customer and vendor balances, and bank accounts. It will also show how Accounting connects with Sales, Purchase, Inventory, POS, Manufacturing, Projects, Payroll, Expenses, and local compliance processes such as tax reporting and eTIMS/KRA requirements.
Attendees will learn how to avoid common accounting implementation mistakes, improve bank reconciliation, strengthen month-end closing, improve audit readiness, and build reports that management can trust. The session is ideal for business owners, accountants, finance managers, Odoo consultants, implementation partners, and organizations planning to use Odoo Accounting as the financial control center of their business.

tracks.name: What's New in Payroll?
tracks.speaker_line: Alan Keith Lavuna, Business Analyst at Odoo
tracks.description_text:
Smarter Configuration, Simpler Workflows
From dynamic salary packages to a redesigned Payrun workflow — see how Odoo Payroll is evolving to reduce manual work, prevent errors, and give employees more control over their own benefits.
Payroll is getting smarter and more configurable. This session covers two major threads: how salary packages and employee benefits are now configured, and the deeper workflow redesign coming with Odoo 20.
We'll start with salary package configuration — walking through how rules are set up and how they flow through to the employee's Payroll tab in real time. From there, we'll show how the newly evolved Attendances app, with its advanced overtime tracking methods, now directly affects Time Off and Payroll calculations, setting up a natural bridge into the Attendance session.
Key Highlights:
Salary Packages & Employee Benefits
Dynamic allowance calculations, accurate medical insurance cost adjustments, and PF opt-in/out support for precise salary and contribution computations
Applicants can now select their preferred time-off benefits directly during the offer signing process
Streamlined setup and management of statutory compliance reports — PF, PT, LWF, ESIC, and Gratuity Calculation
Efficient Payroll Management with Odoo 20
Work Entries have been retired — Work Entry Types are now consolidated with Time Off Types
Reworked Working Schedules let you define daily working hours without fixed start/end times
A redesigned Payrun workflow guides users through every processing step, with employee inclusion now automatically managed from attendance and time-off records
Salary simulation is now available directly from the employee profile, prefilled with relevant data
New configurable payslip delivery settings — send on confirmation, on payment, or manually
Support for arrears compensation, covering underpayments from prior periods due to errors, delays, or backdated salary changes
Turn Alerts into Actions — Right from Your Payroll Dashboard
A redesigned Payroll Dashboard with smart warnings, helping users catch setup issues early and manage day-to-day payroll activity more efficiently

tracks.name: Business First: Choosing the Right Odoo Platform
tracks.speaker_line: Enock Maseru, Business Analyst at Odoo
tracks.description_text:
Choosing the right Odoo platform is more than a technical decision — it’s a business decision that can shape how easily your company grows, adapts, and manages costs over the long term. Deciding between Odoo Online, Odoo.sh, and On-Premise is one of the most important decisions in any Odoo implementation. Each platform offers different trade-offs in terms of customization, maintenance, cost, scalability, and technical requirements.
Drawing from real implementation experiences, this session provides a practical framework for selecting the right platform based on business requirements and long-term goals. We'll discuss when Odoo Online is the best fit, when Odoo.sh becomes necessary for custom developments and complex workflows, and why On-Premise should generally be reserved for organizations with strong technical capacity or strict data governance requirements.
We'll also share practical implementation insights, including why starting on Odoo Online and planning a future migration to Odoo.sh can often be the most effective approach. The goal is simple: choose the platform that fits where your business is today and where you want it to go — not the one that simply appeals to your technical team.
Outline
Understanding Odoo Online, Odoo.sh, and On-Premise
When standard Odoo is enough—and when it isn't
The hidden costs of customization and self-hosting
Real implementation lessons learned from business analysts
A practical decision framework for partners and implementers
Key Takeaways
Select the right platform based on business needs, not technical preferences
Understand the risks and benefits of each deployment model
Learn when to customize, when to stay standard, and when to migrate
Apply proven implementation practices to reduce project risk and complexity

speakers.biography_text:

After mastering the system externally, Enock joined Odoo in October 2024. Working as a Business Analyst on the Partner Services team for almost two years, he advises partners and clients on platform architecture, helping them abstract technical complexities to drive true business value.
Having managed servers himself, he knows exactly why technology alone should never dictate business goals. In this session, he will share a practical framework to help you choose the platform that fits your business' future.

tracks.name: Outgrower Management System (OMS): Digitising Smallholder Value Chains
tracks.speaker_line: Dennis, Consultant
tracks.description_text:
African agribusiness runs on thousands of smallholder farmers, often registered and transacted with in the field, frequently offline. This session presents our Outgrower Management System (OMS) – an Odoo-based product that brings farmer registration, contracting, training, offtake and input supply into one connected platform.
Field-first with Kobo Toolbox
OMS pairs Odoo with Kobo Toolbox, so field teams capture data on mobile – even offline – and submissions create the right records back in Odoo. Each survey is packaged as a reusable product, with master data (regions, communities, districts, seasons, products, farmer groups, farmers) fed from Odoo to Kobo so field choices stay consistent.
•	Farmer registration & contracts. Register farmers and groups, capture details (name, phone, MoMo, ID, gender, acreage, group role), create the farmer as verified, and generate season/crop/acreage contracts in draft for confirmation in Odoo.
•	Training attendance & interactions. Log training sessions and participants by farmer group, and record field interactions against each farmer.
•	Offtake & input orders. Crop buying creates a confirmed purchase order, goods receipt and posted bill with payment registration; input sales create a confirmed sales order, delivery and posted invoice – all from a single field submission.
The standout: Payment in Kind
OMS lets input orders given to farmers on “loan” be offset against the crop they later sell. A dedicated repayment-in-kind journal tracks outstanding farmer balances; at offtake payment, the purchase can be deducted against the outstanding loan, with optional reconciliation so finance can choose to offset or pay the farmer. Balances are tracked right through to the aged-receivable report.

tracks.name: How a Gold Partner Scales Implementation & Support
tracks.speaker_line: Ivo, Project Director
tracks.description_text:
Great functional work fails if delivery falls apart. This session shares the Advance Insight method – our Implementation Bible and Project Management & Support manual – that has let us move from small projects to six-figure programmes while keeping projects under control and customers satisfied after go-live.
The core principle
“Implement one MVP at a time.” The client signs off each element in a UAT tracking sheet before we move on. The focus is on the flow first; access rights, approvals and master data are tightened later. As we put it internally: don’t fix the plane while you’re in mid-air – and it’s better to not be billable than to waste budget.
What we cover
•	Roles & structure. A clear split between the client SPOC and our Lead Consultant, with Project Director and management as the escalation path, and a train-the-trainer approach.
•	Cadence & reporting. Daily channel, weekly alignment call and bi-weekly/monthly management report; weekly progress, decisions log and timesheet reporting on hourly elements, with budget overruns flagged early.
•	Prioritisation. A simple decision tree – master data and bugs first, engineering tasks and user mistakes next, change requests and scoping last – with response targets for each.
•	Environment discipline on Odoo.sh. Main / Client-QA / Internal-QA structure, rebuilds from Main, controlled code merges, and a deliberate “avoid Studio, raise engineering tickets” stance.
•	Change & escalation. A formal change-request procedure with written approval, and an escalation model that loops in the Project Director before issues boil over.
•	Support that scales. Support typed as bugs, user mistakes, training or change requests; bug severity SLAs (Sev 1 in ~4 business hours, Sev 2 in 1 day, Sev 3 best-effort); a 3-month warranty; and bi-annual database health checks tied to client check-ins.

tracks.name: Master Class - Odoo Web Framework
tracks.speaker_line: Mohammad Shekha, R&D Team Leader at Odoo IN
tracks.description_text:
The Masterclass training will be conducted at the Odoo Gandhinagar office, India, on 9th & 10th September from 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM.
401 & 402, Floor 4, IT Tower 3 InfoCity Gate, 1, Gandhinagar, Gujarat 382007
Prerequisites
Attendees should have intermediate knowledge of Odoo and a basic understanding of javascript.
Why attend?
This year, Owl (Odoo’s javascript UI framework), has undergone a major refactoring. Owl 3 introduces a new reactivity model based on signals and a completely new plugin system. At the same time, many features have been simplified or redesigned, significantly changing how components are written, composed, and maintained.

These changes improve correctness, performance, and long-term maintainability of UI code, but they also require non-trivial migrations for existing Owl applications. This training provides a hands-on, in-depth exploration of Owl 3, focusing on its core concepts—including signals, component lifecycle, rendering semantics, hooks, and plugins—and their practical usage within the Odoo web client.
Specifically, the training will cover:
-Owl 3.0: architecture and core concepts
-The Odoo javascript framework design principles
-Writing and organizing javascript code in the Odoo web client and website
-Migration strategies from Owl 2.x to Owl 3.x

tracks.speaker_line: Mohammad Shekha, R&D Team Leader at Odoo IN
tracks.description_text:
The Masterclass training will be conducted at the Odoo Gandhinagar office, India, on 9th & 10th September from 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM.
401 & 402, Floor 4, IT Tower 3 InfoCity Gate, 1, Gandhinagar, Gujarat 382007
Prerequisites
Attendees should have intermediate knowledge of Odoo and a basic understanding of javascript.
Why attend?
This year, Owl (Odoo’s javascript UI framework), has undergone a major refactoring. Owl 3 introduces a new reactivity model based on signals and a completely new plugin system. At the same time, many features have been simplified or redesigned, significantly changing how components are written, composed, and maintained.

These changes improve correctness, performance, and long-term maintainability of UI code, but they also require non-trivial migrations for existing Owl applications. This training provides a hands-on, in-depth exploration of Owl 3, focusing on its core concepts—including signals, component lifecycle, rendering semantics, hooks, and plugins—and their practical usage within the Odoo web client.
Specifically, the training will cover:
-Owl 3.0: architecture and core concepts
-The Odoo javascript framework design principles
-Writing and organizing javascript code in the Odoo web client and website
-Migration strategies from Owl 2.x to Owl 3.x
