tracks.name: Legacy ERP to Odoo.sh: A Manufacturing & Trading Customer Success Story
tracks.location: Seminar Hall 1A, Ground Floor, Mahatma Mandir
tracks.speaker_line: Ved Shukla, Founder at Webanix Private Limited
tracks.description_text:
At Webanix Solutions, we believe an ERP should do more than digitize processes—it should transform the way a business operates. When our client, a manufacturing and trading company, approached us, they were facing challenges in managing production, inventory, sales, dealer incentives, logistics, and accounting through disconnected processes and manual workflows.
Their objective was clear: implement a single, scalable ERP solution capable of handling both standard operations and complex business-specific requirements. After understanding their processes in detail, we recommended Odoo.sh as the ideal platform, providing the flexibility to combine Odoo's robust standard features with custom developments tailored to their business.
The Challenge
Our client required a unified system that could:
Manage the complete manufacturing cycle from raw materials to finished goods.
Track inventory accurately across manufacturing and trading operations.
Integrate purchasing, sales, invoicing, and accounting into a single workflow.
Automate complex cash discount policies.
Calculate salesperson commissions based on quarterly and annual targets.
Manage dealer incentive programs linked to performance.
Build a structured sales hierarchy with team leaders and salespersons.
Generate automated daily sales reports for dealers and sales teams.
Handle scrap inventory without impacting operational stock while maintaining correct accounting treatment.
Maintain a centralized transporter database for trading operations.
Eliminate repetitive manual tasks through automation.
Our Solution
The Webanix Solutions team implemented a fully customized Odoo solution on Odoo.sh, covering the client's complete business lifecycle.
End-to-End ERP Implementation.
We successfully integrated:
Manufacturing
Inventory Management
Purchase Management
Sales Management
Accounting
CRM and Contact Management
This enabled every department to work from a single source of truth, providing real-time visibility into operations and financial performance.
Customized Sales Performance & Dealer Incentive Management.
To address the client's unique sales structure, we developed:
Quarterly and annual salesperson target management.
Automated commission calculations.
Dealer mapping within Odoo Contacts.
Performance-based dealer incentive calculations.
Transparent incentive tracking and reporting.
These customizations eliminated manual calculations, reduced errors, and significantly improved incentive management.
Sales Team Hierarchy & Automated Reporting. We designed a structured organizational hierarchy consisting of team leaders and salespersons, allowing performance to be monitored at every level. In addition, we automated daily sales reports that are shared with dealers and their respective salespersons, giving management real-time visibility into sales performance and enabling faster business decisions.
Advanced Inventory & Scrap Management
One of the client's key operational challenges involved scrap handling. Our team customized Odoo's scrap process so that scrap inventory is maintained separately without reducing operational inventory, while still generating the appropriate accounting impact. This provided more accurate inventory reporting, improved production analysis, and stronger financial control.
Logistics Management
For the client's trading business, we developed a centralized transporter database, enabling efficient management of transporter information and improving shipment planning and operational traceability.
Business Process Automation
We also automated several time-consuming daily processes, including:
Multiple cash discount rules
Cash rounding
Three-copy invoice PDF printing
Credit control rules
Additional workflow automations
These improvements reduced manual effort, minimized errors, and standardized operations across departments.
Business Outcomes
By partnering with Webanix Solutions, the client achieved:
A fully integrated ERP platform connecting manufacturing, inventory, procurement, sales, logistics, and finance.
Reduced manual work through intelligent automation.
Faster and more accurate commission and dealer incentive calculations.
Improved inventory visibility and financial accuracy.
Automated reporting that supports faster management decisions.
Stronger financial controls with customized accounting workflows.
Better collaboration across departments through centralized business data.
A scalable ERP platform capable of supporting future growth and evolving business requirements.
The Result
The implementation has transformed the client's day-to-day operations. Instead of relying on disconnected systems and manual processes, they now operate on a unified, intelligent ERP platform tailored to their business.
At Webanix Solutions, our focus goes beyond implementing software—we deliver business transformation. By combining Odoo's powerful capabilities with deep business process expertise and custom development, we helped our client improve operational efficiency, increase productivity, strengthen financial controls, and build a scalable digital foundation for long-term growth and measurable return on investment.

He holds a Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, where his core focus was on grid optimization, power distribution, and efficient energy usage. His technical background gives him a unique perspective on the link between technology, energy efficiency, and sustainability.

tracks.description_text:
ISKCON is one of the largest NGOs in the world, with ISKCON Juhu (Mumbai) being one of its most prominent temples. Before adopting Odoo, the temple struggled with siloed systems and manual processes for managing donations, memberships, pooja bookings, e‑commerce, and accounting. In this session, I will present the end‑to‑end digital transformation we delivered for ISKCON Juhu using Odoo as the central platform. We gradually implemented Odoo across their core operations: online and offline donation management, membership programs (including more than 50,000 life patron members), event and pooja booking, e‑commerce for books such as the Bhagavad Gita, darshan scheduling and publishing on the website, and India‑specific accounting and compliance.
You’ll see how we designed a unified donor and devotee database, configured event and donation flows for specific religious occasions (such as Ekadashi, Annadana, and Go Seva), automated 80G receipt generation in one click, and integrated web, POS, and back‑office processes. The talk will focus on the functional design, implementation approach, and practical lessons learned that can be applied to NGOs, temples, and other donation‑driven organizations worldwide.

tracks.name: Odoo upgrades: Core concepts and tools
tracks.location: Seminar Hall 3B, First Floor, Mahatma Mandir
tracks.speaker_line: Hiren Gohil, Upgrade Developer at Odoo IN
tracks.description_text:
Odoo upgrades involve much more than simply moving a database from an older version to a newer one. They require careful handling of database changes, custom modules, data migrations, and code compatibility.
In this talk, we will explore the core concepts behind Odoo upgrades and the tools available to make the upgrade process more reliable and efficient. We will cover how Odoo manages data updates, why upgrade scripts are needed, and how to write effective migration scripts.
Through practical examples, we will also explore the capabilities of upgrade-util, Odoo Upgrade Code scripts, and Upgrade Test Cases. The session will demonstrate common upgrade scenarios such as merging modules, installing new modules, renaming models and fields, changing field types, migrating data, and validating upgrade results.
This talk is designed for Odoo developers who want to better understand the upgrade process and learn practical techniques for handling customizations and complex data migrations across Odoo versions.
Key Learning:
Understand the fundamentals of Odoo database upgrades.
Learn why upgrade scripts are needed and how to write them.
Explore the upgrade-util library and its essential utilities.
Understand how Upgrade Code scripts help automate source code migration.
Learn how to test upgrade logic and validate data integrity.

tracks.location: Seminar Hall 1A, Ground Floor, Mahatma Mandir
tracks.speaker_line: Om Prakash Maurya, Delivery Head at Ksolves India Ltd.
tracks.description_text:
As organizations outgrow the rigidity and rising costs of SAP HANA, Odoo is emerging as the strategic alternative, but migration is rarely straightforward.
This talk reveals how:
- AI intelligently maps SAP HANA data structures, flags field conflicts, and auto-generates assessment reports, dramatically reducing manual analysis effort.
- Agentic AI takes it further by autonomously orchestrating zero-downtime cutovers, continuously scoring migration risk, and escalating issues in real time, compressing go-live timelines to as little as weeks.
- Post-migration agents run autonomously in the background, monitoring data integrity and surfacing reconciliation gaps before they become production incidents, ensuring a smooth transition without requiring constant manual oversight.
Ideal for people and organizations that want to move away from SAP because of escalating costs but remain concerned about losing historical business data, disrupting operations, or undertaking a complex migration.
Key Learnings:
- The hidden cost of staying on SAP HANA, and the ROI case for switching.
- How AI agents compress a months-long migration into weeks without downtime.
- Real pitfalls, honest limitations, and what actually makes a go-live succeed.

tracks.name: From Farm to Factory: End-to-End Agri Operations with Odoo
tracks.location: Seminar Hall 1A, Ground Floor, Mahatma Mandir
tracks.speaker_line: Parth Ghediya, Project Delivery Head at Caret IT Solutions Pvt. Ltd.
tracks.description_text:
Agriculture businesses often focus on contract farming and procurement, but the real challenge begins after harvest. Managing farmer contracts, procurement, crop planning, quality inspections, logistics, cold storage, supply-chain,  inventory, manufacturing, settlements, and traceability across multiple stakeholders can quickly become complex and difficult to scale.
In this session, we will showcase how Odoo enterprise has used to build an end-to-end Farm-to-Factory platform for a large potato ecosystem, connecting contract farming, procurement, quality management, warehouse operations, cold storage, manufacturing, and financial processes within a single integrated system.
The talk will cover the complete business journey from farmer on-boarding and crop planning to harvest collection, quality grading, inventory management, processing, and final customer delivery. We will also demonstrate how operational challenges such as multi-parameter quality inspections, freight management, storage visibility, landed costing, and end-to-end traceability were addressed using Odoo.
Through a real-world implementation case study based on SK Group, one of India's leading potato ecosystem businesses, attendees will learn how agricultural businesses can eliminate disconnected systems, improve operational visibility, standardize processes, and create a single source of truth across the entire supply chain. We will share the business challenges faced during the digital transformation, the architectural decisions taken, and how Odoo was successfully adapted to support complex agricultural operations at enterprise scale.
What's next: We will present the future roadmap of the project as SK Group expands into food manufacturing. The next phase focuses on extending the same Odoo platform to manage manufacturing operations, enabling a seamless transition from agricultural procurement to finished food production while maintaining complete traceability, operational visibility, and financial control.
Who should attend: Agricultural enterprises, food processing and manufacturing companies, agritech startups, supply chain and manufacturing leaders, agricultural engineers, Odoo Partners, functional consultants, business analysts, ERP decision-makers, and organizations looking to build an end-to-end Farm-to-Factory solution on Odoo.
Key Takeaways
Optimize operations form farm-to-factory using odoo
Managing contract farming and procurement at scale
Implementing quality, logistics, storage, and traceability processes across the Farm-to-Factory supply chain
Single platform for Integrated operations, inventory, manufacturing, and finance
How we reduced order processing time by 40%

His expertise spans agriculture, food processing, manufacturing, supply chain, distribution, and retail, where he has successfully led large-scale ERP programs covering contract farming, procurement, quality management, warehouse operations, cold storage, manufacturing, finance, and end-to-end traceability. Parth is passionate about designing practical solutions that bridge business strategy with technology while maximizing the value of standard Odoo capabilities.

Integrate OWL in Odoo: Odoo’s JavaScript Framework
About the Session
You’ve learned the basics of
OWL
→ now it’s time to understand how OWL fits into the bigger picture of
Odoo’s JavaScript framework
.
This session will take you beyond standalone OWL concepts and show how Odoo builds its frontend architecture around OWL,
Views, Fields, Widgets, services, and the end-to-end request flow.
You’ll learn how these pieces connect and how to approach frontend development in Odoo from an application and framework perspective.
What You’ll Learn
By the end of this session, you’ll understand:
How Odoo’s JavaScript framework is structured and where
OWL fits into it
The key concepts and architecture behind Odoo’s frontend framework
Why
knowing OWL alone isn’t enough
to build and customise Odoo’s frontend effectively
How
Views, Fields, and Widgets
work within Odoo
The
end-to-end request flow
, from a user action in the browser to the backend and back
How to connect the concepts learned in OWL with real-world Odoo frontend development
Why Should You Attend?
If you already know the fundamentals of OWL, this session will help you bridge the gap between
learning a frontend framework and understanding Odoo’s frontend framework
.
You’ll gain a clearer picture of how Odoo’s JavaScript ecosystem works as a whole, making it easier to:
Develop and customise Odoo frontend features
Understand existing Odoo frontend code
Work with Views, Fields, and Widgets
Eligibility / Prerequisite
Prerequisite: Completion of the OWL session.
This session assumes that you are already familiar with the
basics of OWL
. We will not cover OWL fundamentals in detail; instead, we’ll build on that knowledge to explore how OWL is integrated into Odoo’s JavaScript framework.
Agenda
Overview
Basics of OWL Framework
Why OWL Isn’t Enough?
Odoo’s JavaScript Framework
Views
Fields & Widgets
End-to-End Request Flow
Who Should Attend?
This session is ideal for
Developers
who want to move beyond OWL fundamentals and understand how
Odoo’s frontend architecture
works in practice.
Complete the OWL session first → then join us to see how OWL comes together with the rest of Odoo’s JavaScript framework.

tracks.name: Power Your Odoo App with AI
tracks.location: Seminar Hall 2B, Ground Floor, Mahatma Mandir
tracks.speaker_line: Sanjay Sharma, Odoo AI Developer at Odoo IN

speakers.name: Sanjay Sharma
speakers.biography_text:
Sanjay Sharma is a Software Engineer with 4+ years of experience in Odoo, currently working on the R&D AI team at Odoo India, where he focuses on how artificial intelligence integrates into everyday business applications.
He specializes in building the AI framework that powers Odoo's Agents, Skills, and Tools the layer that lets a language model reason over business context and take real action inside a database, not just generate text. His work spans the agentic loop that drives autonomous task execution, the pipeline that processes a user prompt end-to-end, and the safety mechanisms that make AI-driven automation reliable enough for production use.
With over four years of hands-on experience across Odoo development including full-stack and frontend platform engineering, OWL framework development, and module engineering Sanjay brings a developer's-eye view to how AI fits into the broader Odoo ecosystem. As part of the R&D AI team, he works closely with the architecture connecting Odoo's interface, agents, sessions, and execution layers  from tool registration and schema validation to RAG-based retrieval and multi-provider LLM integration. He is passionate about demystifying how AI actually works under the hood, and about helping developers move past surface-level AI features into building genuinely useful, autonomous capabilities into their own modules.
Building an AI-powered feature into an Odoo app today is easy to demo and hard to get right. The gap between an AI that simply explains what to do and one that reliably does it comes down to a handful of concepts most developers haven't had explained clearly: what an Agent, a Skill, and a Tool actually are, how the agentic loop decides and executes, and what makes the difference between a fragile prototype and something you can ship to a client.
In this talk, we will explore the architecture behind Odoo's AI module and the mechanics of turning a single sentence into a real, working action inside your app. We will cover how the AI framework structures Agents, Skills, and Tools, why the agentic loop follows a Think-Act-Observe-Repeat pattern, and how a prompt actually travels through Odoo's pipeline  from controller entry to a streamed response in a matter of seconds.
Through practical examples, we will also explore how to build your own AI-powered tools using standard server actions, how pre-configured skills like CRUD Operations, View Builder. The session will demonstrate real scenarios such as creating records from natural language, chaining multiple tool calls in a single request, and designing skills scoped to a specific business domain.
This talk is designed for Odoo developers and partners who want to move beyond AI as a novelty feature and start building agents that create genuine business value inside their own modules.

tracks.name: From Automation to Autonomy: Building Agentic AI Workflows Inside Odoo
tracks.location: Seminar Hall 1B, Ground Floor, Mahatma Mandir
tracks.speaker_line: Prerak Mehta, Sr. Odoo Consultant at KoderXpert Technologies LLP
tracks.description_text:
Abstract
The ERP landscape is undergoing its most profound transformation in decades. Traditional automation — rule-based, trigger-driven, and brittle — is giving way to a new paradigm: Agentic AI, where intelligent systems don't just execute instructions, but sense context, reason through exceptions, and take coordinated action across modules without constant human intervention.
This session explores how Odoo partners and businesses can architect and deploy AI agents natively within the Odoo ecosystem to unlock the next level of ERP performance. We move beyond chatbots and copilots to examine real-world patterns where AI agents manage lead qualification, supplier negotiations, inventory exceptions, invoice approvals, and support ticket resolution — autonomously and measurably.
Attendees will learn how Odoo's modular architecture, role-based security, and audit framework create an ideal foundation for controlled autonomy: giving AI agents enough context and capability to eliminate repetitive decision-making, while preserving human approval for high-risk actions. We will also address the practical realities: why data hygiene is the non-negotiable prerequisite, how to avoid the common pitfall of deploying AI on top of poorly configured workflows, and how to measure ROI not by the number of prompts submitted, but by operational KPIs.
Whether you are an Odoo implementer, a business owner evaluating AI investments, or a developer building custom modules, this session will give you a concrete architectural roadmap and a go-live checklist for building autonomous, self-optimizing Odoo workflows — today.
Key Takeaways:
•	Understand the three dominant AI agent deployment patterns inside Odoo (Sidecar, Embedded, and Gateway)
•	Learn when traditional Odoo automation is better than AI agents — and when it isn't
•	See live demonstrations of agentic workflows across Sales, Inventory, Finance, and Support
•	Get a practical governance and security framework for controlled autonomy
•	Walk away with a phased implementation roadmap for your own Odoo environment
Track: AI & Innovation | Level: Intermediate–Advanced | Audience: Partners, Developers, Business Leaders

tracks.name: More Than an ERP: Building an Odoo System Your Teams Actually Use
tracks.location: Seminar Hall 3A, First Floor, Mahatma Mandir
tracks.speaker_line: Parag Agrawal, Co-founder and Chief Operating Officer at iProgrammer Solutions Private Limited
tracks.description_text:
Implementing Odoo is not only about configuring modules, migrating data, and completing a go-live. The real measure of success is whether employees use the system confidently, whether business processes become simpler, and whether management gains better control, visibility, and decision-making.
Many organizations invest in ERP systems but continue to depend on spreadsheets, manual approvals, offline communication, and duplicate data entry. In such cases, the software may be technically live, but the business has not truly adopted it.
This talk explains how organizations can move from ERP implementation to business impact. It focuses on designing Odoo around real user roles, daily activities, process challenges, and expected business outcomes. The session will cover how to simplify workflows, reduce unnecessary data entry, improve usability, involve employees during implementation, validate real-life business scenarios, and deliver role-specific training.
The talk will also introduce the outcome-ownership principles behind ORBIT, iProgrammer’s approach to ensuring that Odoo continues to deliver value after go-live. This includes reviewing system health, identifying adoption gaps, improving workflows, measuring usage, and creating a continuous improvement roadmap.
Attendees will learn how to ensure that Odoo becomes the system through which the business actually operates, rather than an application used only for recording transactions.
The session is intended for business owners, senior management, ERP sponsors, department heads, process owners, finance leaders, operations teams, and organizations planning or currently undergoing an Odoo implementation.
Key Learnings
How to define ERP success beyond technical go-live
Why employees return to spreadsheets and manual processes
How to design Odoo around real user needs and business roles
How to reduce unnecessary data entry and improve usability
How to build employee confidence and improve adoption
How to measure whether Odoo is delivering business value
How continuous improvement can protect long-term ERP investment

tracks.description_text:
Know Your Speaker
Manas Goswami
Odoo Functional Expert | Operations & Inventory Valuation Specialist
| Business Support Analyst
Manas Goswami is a proven Odoo Functional Expert with 3 years of hands-on experience across Inventory, Manufacturing, Purchase, and Inventory Valuation. He specializes in helping manufacturing businesses move past operational friction — the kind that creeps in when procurement, production, and finance don't talk to each other.
Passionate about empowering manufacturing companies to run leaner and smarter, Manas brings deep, practical expertise in designing and implementing ERP solutions across Procurement, Inventory Management, Logistics & Supply Chain, and Inventory Valuation.
About the Session: Product Costing and Manufacturing Cost Analysis
Manufacturing costs are rarely as simple as they look on paper — labour, overhead, and material costs often overlap in ways that make it hard to know your true cost per unit. This session breaks down the fundamentals of product costing and manufacturing cost analysis: what actually makes up your cost, why planned costs (like BoM) often diverge from real costs (like actual Manufacturing Orders), and where those gaps typically come from.
We'll walk through the key cost buckets, how routing and production decisions influence final costs, and how a connected ERP system, Odoo, can bring clarity to the whole process through a live demo. Whether you're in operations, finance, or manufacturing, you'll leave with a clearer framework for pricing your products with confidence.

tracks.name: From Mine to Money: Digitising a Limestone Mining Enterprise with Odoo
tracks.location: Seminar Hall 1B, Ground Floor, Mahatma Mandir
tracks.speaker_line: Saurav Kumar, CEO at Technogeo Soft Solution Pvt. Ltd
tracks.description_text:
A limestone mining enterprise is far more than a production operation. Behind every ton of finished material lies a connected journey involving production planning, extraction, fleet movement, fuel consumption, maintenance, inventory, procurement, weighbridge operations, dispatch, invoicing and finance.
Before Odoo, these activities were managed through separate records, documents and departmental processes. Although the business was operationally interconnected, its information remained fragmented. Management could see production quantities and individual transactions but lacked a continuous view of material movement, stage-wise costs, inventory value and profitability.
This session presents how Odoo became the digital backbone of the enterprise, connecting the complete journey from mine planning to customer payment. It demonstrates how production became traceable, fleet utilisation and fuel costs became measurable, maintenance shifted from breakdown response to planned reliability, inventory became visible working capital, and procurement became controlled and budget-linked. It also shows how gate entry, weighbridge, dispatch, invoicing and accounting were integrated into one commercially validated transaction trail.
Attendees will learn how an integrated Odoo implementation can connect complex industrial operations, establish cost-per-ton visibility and translate every physical movement into measurable financial performance—from mine to money.

speakers.name: Saurav Kumar
speakers.biography_text:
Saurav Kumar is a Business and Digital Transformation Consultant with nearly 22 years of experience helping organizations simplify complex operations and turn technology into measurable business value.
As the Founder and CEO of GeoTechnoSoft, he has led transformation initiatives across mining, manufacturing, government, rural development and service enterprises. His work connects every layer of a business—from operations, inventory, procurement and logistics to finance, customer management and strategic decision-making.
His transformation philosophy is simple: technology alone does not transform an organization—people, processes and purpose do. ERP, data analytics, automation and AI become powerful only when they are aligned with real business challenges.
More recently, Saurav has been helping organizations move beyond conventional digitization by integrating AI into business operations, decision-making and customer experiences.
Through the CIS “Mine to Money” transformation, he demonstrates how a traditionally operated limestone mining enterprise was connected digitally—from extraction and processing to inventory, sales, invoicing and payment—creating greater visibility, accountability and control across the organization.

tracks.location: Seminar Hall 3A, First Floor, Mahatma Mandir
tracks.speaker_line: Sanjeev Aggarwal, Business Head at AGBE Technology Solutions Private Limited
tracks.description_text:

In this session, Sanjeev Aggarwal, Founder of Agbe India and Enterprise Transformation Advisor, shares practical lessons from leading digital transformation initiatives across manufacturing, automotive, distribution, healthcare, and service organizations. Drawing from real-world Odoo implementations, the session explores why ERP success is rarely a software problem and is more often a challenge of governance, data discipline, process ownership, change management, and leadership alignment.
Attendees will learn the seven operational disciplines that separate successful ERP journeys from failed or underutilised implementations. The session will showcase practical examples of how organizations used Odoo to improve visibility, streamline operations, reduce manual effort, strengthen decision-making, and build scalable operating models.
Whether you are a business owner, CIO, COO, CFO, operations leader, or implementation partner, this session will provide actionable insights to help ensure that your ERP becomes a platform for business growth rather than just another software project.

speakers.name: Sanjeev Aggarwal
speakers.biography_text:

Before founding Agbe India, Sanjeev held leadership roles at global technology organizations, where he built and led enterprise consulting and delivery teams. Today, he advises businesses on scaling operations through ERP, process excellence, automation, analytics, and organisational discipline.
He is also the author of a book, "ERP IS NOT SOFTWARE: 7 Operational Disciplines That Separate Scalable Businesses From Chaotic Ones", which challenges conventional thinking around ERP implementations and business transformation.

tracks.name: The Most Common Security Pitfalls
tracks.location: Seminar Hall 4, First Floor, Mahatma Mandir
tracks.speaker_line: Harsh Shah, AI Developer at Odoo IN
tracks.description_text:
Security vulnerabilities don't always come from complex attacks - they often come from simple mistakes.
In this talk, we'll explore some of the most common security pitfalls developers encounter while developing and customizing Odoo, along with practical examples of how these issues can be introduced and, more importantly, how to avoid them.
We'll look at common mistakes such as trusting user-controlled data, improper access control, unsafe handling of inputs, and other security issues that can easily slip into everyday development. The goal is to help developers recognize these patterns early and build applications that are secure by design.
Whether you're a developer looking to strengthen your security fundamentals or someone who wants to understand how seemingly small implementation decisions can lead to serious vulnerabilities, this talk will give you practical takeaways you can apply to your own projects.

- Why Odoo needs an education-first sales approach
- How to define your ICP with no track record and no niche

tracks.name: Beyond the Cold Call: Building an Empathy-Aware AI Voice Agent Inside Odoo CRM
tracks.location: Seminar Hall 2B, Ground Floor, Mahatma Mandir
tracks.speaker_line: Srikanthbalaji NM, CEO at GSUS Star Software Solutions Private Limited
tracks.description_text:
Most outbound sales calling still runs on scripted IVRs or whichever BDE has bandwidth that hour — leads go cold waiting for a human to dial. This talk walks through a solution architecture that puts an AI voice agent directly inside Odoo CRM's lead lifecycle: the agent places the first outbound call over VoIP, holds a natural conversation shaped by real-time emotion detection, qualifies the lead against a configurable framework, and automatically creates a task and assigns a human Business Development Executive the moment a lead is demo-ready.
The talk covers the practical build: triggering calls from CRM lead states, integrating a VoIP provider with Odoo's activity and task models, structuring an empathy-and-emotion scoring layer, and closing the loop by recording, transcribing, and grounding every call — AI-led and human-led — so both the agent and the sales team keep improving from real conversations.
Attendees will leave with a reusable pattern for combining Odoo CRM automation with voice AI, a framework for scoring conversational quality beyond simple call-outcome tracking, and lessons on where AI should qualify versus where a human should close. Aimed at Odoo partners, functional consultants, and sales-ops leaders exploring AI-augmented CRM workflows.

tracks.location: Seminar Hall 2B, Ground Floor, Mahatma Mandir

tracks.description_text:
𝐘𝐨𝐮'𝐯𝐞 𝐬𝐞𝐠𝐦𝐞𝐧𝐭𝐞𝐝 𝐲𝐨𝐮𝐫 𝐜𝐮𝐬𝐭𝐨𝐦𝐞𝐫𝐬. 𝐍𝐨𝐰 𝐢𝐭'𝐬 𝐭𝐢𝐦𝐞 𝐭𝐨 𝐠𝐫𝐨𝐰 𝐭𝐡𝐞𝐦.
Every business using Odoo's RFM Analysis knows who its Champions, Loyal Customers, Promising Customers, At-Risk Customers, and Sleeping Customers are.
But segmentation is only the starting point.
The real opportunity lies in answering the questions every business leader asks:
- 𝐖𝐡𝐚𝐭 𝐚𝐜𝐭𝐢𝐨𝐧𝐬 𝐰𝐢𝐥𝐥 𝐜𝐫𝐞𝐚𝐭𝐞 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐛𝐢𝐠𝐠𝐞𝐬𝐭 𝐛𝐮𝐬𝐢𝐧𝐞𝐬𝐬 𝐢𝐦𝐩𝐚𝐜𝐭?
- 𝐖𝐡𝐢𝐜𝐡 𝐜𝐮𝐬𝐭𝐨𝐦𝐞𝐫𝐬 𝐝𝐞𝐬𝐞𝐫𝐯𝐞 𝐢𝐦𝐦𝐞𝐝𝐢𝐚𝐭𝐞 𝐚𝐭𝐭𝐞𝐧𝐭𝐢𝐨𝐧?
- 𝐖𝐡𝐞𝐫𝐞 𝐢𝐬 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐧𝐞𝐱𝐭 𝐫𝐞𝐯𝐞𝐧𝐮𝐞 𝐨𝐩𝐩𝐨𝐫𝐭𝐮𝐧𝐢𝐭𝐲?
- 𝐖𝐡𝐢𝐜𝐡 𝐫𝐞𝐥𝐚𝐭𝐢𝐨𝐧𝐬𝐡𝐢𝐩𝐬 𝐬𝐡𝐨𝐮𝐥𝐝 𝐛𝐞 𝐩𝐫𝐨𝐭𝐞𝐜𝐭𝐞𝐝 𝐛𝐞𝐟𝐨𝐫𝐞 𝐫𝐞𝐯𝐞𝐧𝐮𝐞 𝐢𝐬 𝐥𝐨𝐬𝐭?
- 𝐖𝐡𝐢𝐜𝐡 𝐜𝐮𝐬𝐭𝐨𝐦𝐞𝐫𝐬 𝐚𝐫𝐞 𝐫𝐞𝐚𝐝𝐲 𝐟𝐨𝐫 𝐜𝐫𝐨𝐬𝐬-𝐬𝐞𝐥𝐥 𝐨𝐫 𝐮𝐩𝐬𝐞𝐥𝐥?
This session introduces AI-Driven RFM—an intelligent evolution of  RFM Analysis that transforms customer segments into actionable growth opportunities.
Instead of stopping at customer classification, AI-Driven RFM continuously analyzes customer behavior, purchasing patterns, sales history, and revenue trends to surface the opportunities that matter most. From revenue forecasting and churn prevention to personalized customer recommendations and opportunity prioritization, discover how businesses can shift from understanding customer segments to driving measurable business growth.
More importantly, this isn't a session about AI features—it's about business outcomes. Learn how organizations can empower sales, marketing, and leadership teams with intelligent recommendations that improve customer retention, increase Customer Lifetime Value, uncover untapped revenue opportunities, and help every decision contribute to sustainable growth.
𝐊𝐞𝐲 𝐋𝐞𝐚𝐫𝐧𝐢𝐧𝐠𝐬 :
- Learn how to turn customer segments into revenue-generating action plans.
- Discover how AI can recommend the next best action for every customer segment.
- Explore strategies that transform customer intelligence into measurable business growth.
- See how AI-powered recommendations help teams act faster, prioritize smarter, and grow revenue with confidence.
𝐕𝐚𝐥𝐮𝐞 𝐟𝐨𝐫 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐀𝐮𝐝𝐢𝐞𝐧𝐜𝐞 :
- Attendees won't just leave with new ideas—they'll leave with a new way of thinking about customer growth.
- They will discover how to:
- Move beyond customer segmentation and start building a predictable growth strategy.
- Recognize revenue opportunities that are often hidden within existing customer relationships.
- Shift from reactive sales execution to proactive customer engagement powered by intelligent recommendations.
- Prioritize the customers, opportunities, and actions that deliver the highest business impact.
- Improve customer retention, increase repeat business, and maximize Customer Lifetime Value using the data they already have.
- Enable sales and leadership teams to spend less time interpreting reports and more time acting on meaningful opportunities.
- Transform customer data into a competitive advantage that drives measurable business growth.
𝐓𝐚𝐫𝐠𝐞𝐭 𝐀𝐮𝐝𝐢𝐞𝐧𝐜𝐞 :
- This session is designed for organizations looking to unlock greater business value from their customer data, including:

tracks.name: Hands-Free Finance: End-to-End Banking Automation in Odoo
tracks.location: Seminar Hall 1B, Ground Floor, Mahatma Mandir
tracks.speaker_line: Megha Rughani, Co-Founder at Deep Purple
tracks.description_text:
What if your finance team no longer had to spend hours uploading payment files, checking bank accounts, posting receipts, and reconciling statements?
In this session, we explore how we transformed Odoo into a highly automated banking platform built around four key pillars:
Automated Payments – Approved vendor payments are transmitted directly from Odoo to the bank, eliminating manual exports, uploads, and duplicate data entry.
Beneficiary Verification – Before money is released, Odoo validates beneficiary banking details, helping prevent payment errors and strengthening financial controls.
Live Bank Visibility – Bank balances and statements are retrieved directly into Odoo, giving finance teams a single source of truth without constantly switching between banking portals and the ERP.
Live Demo: The session includes a real-world client demonstration videos showcasing these banking workflows in action within a production environment.
Automatic Receipts & Reconciliation – Incoming funds automatically generate customer receipts, while statement lines, receipts, and payments are matched and reconciled with minimal human intervention.
Rather than focusing on APIs and technical architecture, this session focuses on the functional business outcomes: reduced administration, stronger controls, lower operational risk, faster month-end close, and a finance function that can scale without increasing headcount. Ultimately, it is a story about moving towards a self-driving finance department where people manage exceptions and Odoo handles the routine work.

tracks.description_text: What does a Germany-based engineering consultancy and a large-scale solar energy company operating across Karnataka and Maharashtra have in common? Both were running on fragmented systems that couldn't keep pace with their growth — and both found their answer in Odoo. In this session, Swapnil Roy from Timus Consulting Services takes the audience through two real-world customer success stories that demonstrate the true breadth and flexibility of Odoo as a business platform. The first story is GKW Consult GmbH, a German engineering and consulting firm that struggled with siloed financial data, manual project tracking, and reports that were outdated before they reached the boardroom. Timus implemented Odoo's Accounting and Finance and Project Management modules, and integrated them with Power BI to deliver live dashboards that gave leadership real-time visibility into project profitability, cash flow, and resource utilisation — all in one place. The second story is ECE India, a large-scale solar energy company with operations spread across two states. Managing field teams, tracking equipment issues, and resolving customer and operational complaints at scale was a growing challenge. Timus deployed Odoo's Helpdesk module to bring structure, traceability, and speed to their support and issue resolution workflows — enabling ECE India to manage operations more efficiently as they continue to scale. Together, these two stories show how Odoo serves as a single, adaptable platform across vastly different industries — from professional services to renewable energy. Attendees will walk away with practical insights on ERP implementation strategy, module selection, cross-tool integration, and how to build Odoo solutions that actually get used by the teams they're built for. tracks.name: Manufacturing Automation with IoT in Odoo
tracks.location: Seminar Hall 1B, Ground Floor, Mahatma Mandir
tracks.speaker_line: Brijesh Vadodariya, CTO & Co-Founder at MICRA DIGITAL LLP
tracks.description_text:
Our project shows how we are replacing manual work in manufacturing with smart, automated systems using IoT devices connected to Odoo.
1. Automated Product Counting
Earlier, counting products on the production line was done manually, which took time and was prone to errors. We built an automated counting system that counts products in real-time and also detects rejected/defective pieces automatically. The system shows exactly how many pieces were rejected and how many more need to be produced or added to complete the order, removing the need for manual tracking and calculation.
2. Smart Weighing Scale for Packaging
We developed an IoT-based weighing scale that helps during the packaging process. Instead of manually counting pieces before packing, the scale calculates the number of pieces directly from the weight of the bag. It checks the weight against a set target and tolerance, confirms if it's correct, and automatically registers the bag count - making packaging faster and more accurate.
3. Custom Odoo Manufacturing Modules
We have also built our own advanced manufacturing modules in Odoo and integrated our IoT devices directly with it. This means all the data from counting and weighing flows straight into Odoo - connected to invoices, packing lists, and lot tracking. These modules are already helping multiple industries manage their manufacturing and packaging operations more efficiently.
In short: Our system connects physical devices (counting sensors, weighing scales) with Odoo software, so manufacturing data is captured automatically, accurately, and in real-time - reducing manual work and human error on the shop floor.

tracks.name: Masterclass - Scaling Odoo x Odoo.sh
tracks.description_text:
This Masterclass will be held before the Odoo Experience Event, over two days, Tuesday, September 22nd and Wednesday, September 23rd, from 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM. Entrance to the Masterclass includes breakfast, lunch, and drinks during both days.
This course is divided in two parts : One about Scaling Odoo & Performance and the second part about Odoo.Sh
Prerequisites
A laptop running any Linux flavor, with an up-to-date Python and PostgreSQL.
Familiarity with Odoo’s development environment is recommended, but not mandatory.
For performance: basic knowledge of Python, SQL and command line.
For deployment: basic knowledge of networking and Linux sysadmin.
Who should attend?
This Masterclass is ideal for developers, testers, and QA engineers working with Odoo, or anyone interested in gaining expertise in testing methodologies tailored to Odoo’s architecture & Odoo.sh.
The class will blend theory and hands-on exercises, ensuring you leave with actionable insights to improve the quality of your Odoo applications.
Architecture and performance:
This part is designed to give you the guidelines to deploy an Odoo instance.
From the smallest one to bigger ones, and covering subjects like horizontal scaling, vertical scaling, multi-tenant infrastructure, as well as the various layers involved in an Odoo infrastructure.
Once deployed, you’ll be taught various methodologies to handle performance issues in an Odoo instance, from good practices during coding to issues root cause identifications.
Odoo.Sh :
This part provides the technical foundation for managing Odoo.sh projects. You’ll learn how to set up projects and understand how Odoo.sh differs from traditional deployments. We’ll dive into the development lifecycle: integrating custom apps, testing, debugging and upgrading from one version of odoo to the next, while teaching you how to use built-in platform tools to resolve issues.

tracks.name: Masterclass - Odoo Web Framework
tracks.description_text:
This Masterclass will be held before the Odoo Experience Event, over two days, Tuesday, September 22nd and Wednesday, September 23rd, from 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM. Entrance to the Masterclass includes breakfast, lunch, and drinks during both days.
Prerequisites
Attendees should have intermediate knowledge of Odoo and a basic understanding of javascript.
Why attend?
This year, Owl (Odoo’s javascript UI framework), has undergone a major refactoring. Owl 3 introduces a new reactivity model based on signals and a completely new plugin system. At the same time, many features have been simplified or redesigned, significantly changing how components are written, composed, and maintained.

These changes improve correctness, performance, and long-term maintainability of UI code, but they also require non-trivial migrations for existing Owl applications. This training provides a hands-on, in-depth exploration of Owl 3, focusing on its core concepts—including signals, component lifecycle, rendering semantics, hooks, and plugins—and their practical usage within the Odoo web client.
Specifically, the training will cover:
-Owl 3.0: architecture and core concepts
-The Odoo javascript framework design principles
-Writing and organizing javascript code in the Odoo web client and website
-Migration strategies from Owl 2.x to Owl 3.x
