tracks.name: From POS to Pocket: Extending Odoo to Your Customers
tracks.speaker_line: Eric Friedlingstein, Founder & Odoo Solution Architect at Synapsis-Group
tracks.description_text:
Short description
Discover how a Belgian bar transformed Odoo into a complete customer engagement platform through a native mobile application featuring daily specials, loyalty rewards, push notifications, and customer feedback.
Abstract
For many restaurants, Odoo starts with the Point of Sale. But what if it could also become the platform that keeps customers coming back?
This talk presents the real-life implementation of a customer-facing mobile application developed for Le Caberdouche, a famous Belgian bar that recently migrated its operations to Odoo.
Instead of relying on multiple third-party services for customer communication, loyalty management, and customer feedback, everything is managed natively inside Odoo.
The mobile application allows customers to:
•	Receive weekly and daily specials through push notifications
•	Collect loyalty points and redeem rewards
•	Review and provide instant feedback
•	Stay connected through a simple and intuitive mobile experience
Behind the scenes, Odoo becomes the single source of truth for both restaurant operations and customer engagement.
During this 20-minute session, we will demonstrate:
•	How Odoo powers a modern native mobile application
•	How push notifications increase customer engagement and repeat visits
•	How loyalty programs can be fully integrated without external services
•	How customer reviews collected directly inside Odoo provide valuable business insights
•	Lessons learned while designing a mobile experience that customers actually enjoy using
•	How a single Odoo backend powers both business operations and customer engagement
This session demonstrates how Odoo can evolve from an ERP into a complete customer engagement platform, helping hospitality businesses strengthen customer relationships, increase customer loyalty, and deliver a seamless digital experience.

speakers.name: Eric Friedlingstein
speakers.biography_text: Eric Friedlingstein is a Senior Software Architect, Team Leader, and Odoo Certified expert with an M.Sc. in Computer Science. As the founder of Synapsis-Group (est. 1989), he has been leading digital transformation initiatives for over three decades. An official Odoo Partner since 2024, Eric combines deep technical expertise with extensive experience in web and mobile solutions. His talks showcase real-world customer projects and demonstrate how Odoo can be extended beyond traditional ERP boundaries to solve everyday business challenges through practical, user-centered innovation.

tracks.name: How to prepare and distribute food with Odoo
tracks.speaker_line: Louise Cobut, Business Analyst at Odoo
tracks.description_text: Is it actually possible to manage shelf life, get ingredient orders right, and meeting every production deadline from one screen? Food production is complex, which is why having an integrated system isn't just nice to have. We're going to walk through an industry package that ties manufacturing, inventory, and quality control together. Whether you operate on a small scale or a massive industrial level, this session is about making your daily production manageable.

tracks.name: Zero-Click Gmail Integration for Odoo CRM: Fully Automated Email Logging
tracks.speaker_line: Simon Stappen, Managing Partner at Much. Consulting
tracks.description_text:
This talk will unveil a powerful Gmail integration for Odoo that revolutionizes how businesses handle email communication in their CRM and beyond. Unlike the standard Gmail-to-Odoo sync, which relies on manual user intervention and unpredictable behaviors, this integration is designed for complete automation. It operates silently in the background, continuously scanning relevant Gmail accounts, intelligently matching emails with Odoo records (e.g., leads, opportunities, partners, tasks), and logging communication threads without requiring any clicks or user confirmation. The result: sales teams, project managers, and customer support agents can work entirely in Odoo, confident that every client interaction is tracked, centralized, and accessible — without the usual overhead.
We'll dive into the technical architecture, show the smart matching logic (e.g., by email address, subject tokens, thread detection), and cover real-world implementation tips. This approach is ideal for organizations aiming to enhance CRM transparency, streamline workflows, and reduce manual data entry.
Key Points:
- Why the standard Gmail sync isn’t good enough: gaps, manual steps, and risks
- Designing a true zero-click email integration for CRM, Helpdesk, Projects
- How matching logic works: intelligent threading, fallback strategies, contact recognition
- Architecture overview: Google APIs, cron jobs, Odoo models, and custom logic
- Deployment insights: access security, scalability, and performance tips
- Real-world results: reduced time-to-update, full conversation visibility, user adoption gains
Key Learnings:
- How to architect a background sync that is reliable, scalable, and fully automated
- Best practices for linking emails to Odoo objects with high accuracy
- How to handle edge cases like shared inboxes, aliases, and partial matches
- The hidden costs of manual CRM email management (and how to eliminate them)
- Boosting user satisfaction and CRM hygiene through invisible automation
Target Audience:
- CRM Managers and Admins seeking better user adoption and data accuracy
- Sales and Customer Support Leaders wanting full communication visibility
- Odoo Developers and Integrators looking to build or improve external email connectors
- Business Owners and Decision Makers evaluating CRM usability and ROI

speakers.name: Simon Stappen
speakers.biography_text: Simon Stappen is the Managing Partner and Founder of much. Consulting, an Odoo Gold Partner. With a background in process automation and digital strategy, Simon has led dozens of complex Odoo implementations focused on maximizing usability and efficiency. He specializes in integrating third-party tools like Gmail to create seamless, user-friendly ERP ecosystems that drive real business value.

tracks.name: What's new in Projects?
tracks.speaker_line: Barbara Arias from Odoo
tracks.description_text: Join us for a tour of the new features in Odoo 20 Projects. Learn how the latest improvements simplify project management, increase team productivity, and provide greater visibility into project progress, workload, and profitability.

speakers.name: Barbara Arias
speakers.biography_text:
Bárbara Arias
works at Odoo as a Business Analyst. She is responsible for managing Odoo implementations with several clients across multiple industries. She is also part of the Services Expertise Team, whose main missions are implementing the Service applications in high-complex projects, providing internal support to the team of Business Analysts, and sharing knowledge both internally and externally for Partners and the whole Odoo community.

tracks.name: What's new with accounting reports?
tracks.speaker_line: Olivier Colson from Odoo
tracks.description_text: This talk will quickly go through the most important changes made in accounting reports for Odoo 20.0.

tracks.name: What's new in Helpdesk?
tracks.speaker_line: André Pirovano, AI and Services Expert at Odoo
tracks.description_text:
This talk will show the latest features of Odoo Helpdesk.
This includes automatisation, better handled SLAs, AI powered ticket search, and many more!

speakers.name: André Pirovano
speakers.biography_text:
André
has been successfully implementing projects at Odoo for around 4 years. His diverse educational background includes studies in Computer Science, Communication Technologies, and Linguistics. This extensive knowledge, combined with his motivation to learn about various businesses, has enabled him to manage projects effectively in the quickstart team, before joining the
Service Expertise Team
, specializing in the services industry.
His favourite subjects within Odoo are linked to support through the use of Helpdesk strategies, as well as a good Livechat and Chatbot management. In the last year he switched his focus on AI in Odoo in general and Support operations through the help of AI.

tracks.name: €600 Billion Black Hole: The Keys to Modeling an Invisible Market
tracks.speaker_line: Amaury Marescaux, CEO at Gondola Foodservice
tracks.description_text: Out-of-home food and beverage consumption (Restaurants, cafés & bars, corporate canteens, fuel station stores) is worth more than €600 billion a year in Europe, and almost none of it is measured. Gondola Foodservice's mission is to model that black hole. Amaury, founder and CEO, looks back at why they succeeded early on, and what you can take away from it.

tracks.name: Rethinking the Energy Transition
tracks.speaker_line: Stefan Grosjean, Founder & CEO of Smappee/ Snowball at Smappee/ Snowball
tracks.description_text:
The energy transition is changing how we generate, store and use energy. But unlocking its full potential requires more than renewable energy alone. It requires intelligence.
In this keynote,
Stefan Grosjean, Founder & CEO of Smappee
, shares his vision for a smarter energy future, shaped by more than three decades of entrepreneurship and innovation. Through personal insights and lessons learned, he explores how intelligent energy management can help create a more flexible, connected and sustainable energy system.
An inspiring perspective on energy, technology and the power of thinking differently combined with a clear view on the future.

speakers.name: Stefan Grosjean
speakers.biography_text:
Stefan Grosjean (°1963) grew up in Flanders, Belgium, and earned a Master of Science in Industrial Engineering, specializing in Computer Science and Electronics. In 1991, Stefan founded EnergyICT, a pioneering company in energy solutions for commercial and industrial businesses. Over the next two decades, EnergyICT became a global leader in energy management technologies, laying the foundation for Stefan’s reputation as a visionary in the clean-tech industry. He sold the company in 2009.
Building on this success, in 2012 Stefan founded Smappee, an innovative company that focuses on optimizing energy consumption and accelerating the transition to renewable energy. Smappee is internationally recognized for its intelligent EV chargers and smart energy management solutions, which blend functionality with sleek design. Under his leadership, Smappee has won numerous prestigious awards, including the Henry Van De Velde Award, the Red Dot Award, and the iF Design Award. As of October 2024, Stefan transitioned to the role of CEO of Smappee Group, the umbrella body over the various Smappee ventures. In this new role, he remains closely involved in Smappee's management but with a sharpened focus on the visionary innovation and strategy of the Group to ensure Smappee's accelerated growth and leading position in the industry.
In addition to his role at Smappee, Stefan founded  Snowball in 2018, a cutting-edge Cleantech Hub in Harelbeke. Snowball serves as the headquarters of Smappee and acts as a collaborative space and living lab for clean-tech innovation, bringing together companies and experts focused on sustainable energy and environmental solutions.
With over 30 years of experience, Stefan is a recognized leader in the global energy transition, consistently striving to blend cutting-edge technology with high-functioning design and sustainable growth strategies. His passion for innovation and commitment to positive societal and environmental impact continue to drive his entrepreneurial ventures.

tracks.name: Building Your Business in the Age of AI
tracks.speaker_line: Lorenz Bogaert
tracks.description_text: AI is not just another technology trend. It’s changing how companies sell, hire, develop software, serve customers and organize work. In this session, serial entrepreneur and startup builder Lorenz Bogaert shares practical lessons from building AI-native companies and explains what every SME can do today to become faster, leaner and more competitive.

speakers.name: Lorenz Bogaert
speakers.biography_text: Lorenz has co-founded dozens of technology companies, investment funds and entrepreneurial ecosystems and is widely regarded as one of the pioneers of the Ghent startup ecosystem.

tracks.name: Ditching the Patchwork: A Biotech Startup's Bet on Odoo
tracks.speaker_line: Béla Surányi & Balázs Boga, Principal Consultant & Co-Founder (COO) at FF Advisors & Microbiom Center
tracks.description_text:
Microbiom Center in Târgu Mureș is the first clinic in Romania dedicated exclusively to the human microbiome, founded by a second generation Romanian entrepreneurial family.
Like many young firms in the region, the team started with a patchwork of tools: a WordPress site, a medical booking plugin, and several disconnected applications. Every change depended on an outside developer, which made the operation slow and costly.
This talk tells the story of the move to Odoo and what changed once a single platform replaced that patchwork.
The clinic now runs CRM, online booking with a book and pay later option, the website connected to a patient portal, a detailed patient database, full inventory linked to sales, invoicing with Romanian E-Factura, vendor bills, financial reconciliation, leave management, and email marketing inside one system. Invoicing and reminders are automated, and every test is traceable through the inventory module. The owners and team now make changes on their own and gain value from each new Odoo release.
The session also frames a wider pattern: many Eastern European firms founded in the 1990s face a triple transition at once: real operational digitalization, a generational handover of ownership, and a shift toward an AI driven economy.
Drawing on the speaker’s work as a family business advisor, the talk shows how an integrated ERP can carry a company through all three.
Key learnings: why unifying the stack beats stitching together point solutions, ⁠how to move a team from developer dependency to self sufficiency, and ⁠how integrated modules compound in value for a biotech operation.
Target audience: founders, ⁠family business owners, ⁠operators, ⁠advisors, and ⁠Odoo partners working with companies in transition.

speakers.name: Béla Surányi & Balázs Boga
speakers.biography_text: Béla Surányi is a family business advisor who works with companies across Eastern Europe as they navigate ownership succession and digital transformation. He helps founders and next gen leaders modernize operations, replace fragmented tools with integrated systems, and prepare their firms for an AI driven economy. He advised Microbiom Center, Romania’s first clinic dedicated exclusively to the microbiome, on its move to Odoo. His focus is on practical, lasting change that teams can own themselves, rather than depending on an external developer for every adjustment.

tracks.name: Changer de dimension sans perdre sa trajectoire
tracks.speaker_line: Kévin Petit, Pilote automobile professionnel
tracks.description_text:
À plus de 200 km/h, la moindre prise de décision se joue à la milliseconde. Passer un cap, monter de catégorie ou viser plus haut demande de se réinventer sans jamais concéder sur ce qui fait sa force.
Au travers d’un récit captivant au cœur du sport automobile de haut niveau, Kévin Petit partage sa vision du dépassement de soi. Comment garder le cap face aux virages imprévus ? Comment accélérer son développement personnel et professionnel sans sacrifier ses valeurs fondamentales ?
Une conférence inspirante, riche en parallèles poignants entre la piste et l’entreprenariat, qui vous donnera les clés pour accepter le changement, performer sous pression et tracer votre propre voie vers l’excellence

tracks.name: What's new in Rental?
tracks.speaker_line: Lucie Allard from Odoo
tracks.description_text: Odoo 20 brings powerful improvements to the Rental app, making it more flexible and easier to use. In this talk, we’ll explore new features that simplify pricing, scheduling, and integration with other apps. Whether you're managing equipment, spaces, or services, you'll discover how Rental can better support your business needs.

tracks.name: Optimize your pricing with Rental
tracks.speaker_line: Tumay Yavuz, Customer Support Analyst at Odoo
tracks.description_text: Ready to maximize your rental revenue without the manual hassle of changing rates? Discover how the new Odoo 20 Advanced Seasonal Pricelist transforms your pricing strategy through a practical, real-world business scenario.

speakers.name: Tumay Yavuz
speakers.biography_text: Tümay Yavuz joined Odoo 3.5 years ago as a Functional Support Agent and is now the Main Expert for the Sales, Subscription, and Rental apps. Handling everything from daily tickets to live support, he acts as the bridge between customers and the development team, working closely with Product Owners to continuously improve the product.

tracks.name: Odoo Accounting: The ultimate hidden gems
tracks.speaker_line: Loïc De Greef from Odoo
tracks.description_text:
Think you know everything about Odoo Accounting? Think again! While features like bank synchronization, standard invoicing, and basic reporting are well-known, Odoo’s Accounting app is packed with secret shortcuts, underutilized automations, and clever workflows that can save accountants hours of manual work.
In this fast-paced session, we will dive deep into the lesser-known features of Odoo Accounting. Say goodbye to tedious manual entries and hello to maximum efficiency!

speakers.name: Loïc De Greef
speakers.biography_text:
Loïc
started his career at a big four firm in Luxembourg as an accountant, at which he worked for about 5 years. After 2 other years in Belgium as an accountant he joined Odoo almost 5 years ago as a Finance Business Analyst. He is used to help accounting firms in their training and daily use cases.

tracks.name: From Startup to International Retail: Scaling 50+ POS with Odoo at GoodNews
tracks.speaker_line: Matias Righi, Functional Consultant at QubiQ 2010, S.L
tracks.description_text:
How do you scale a fast-growing retail startup from a handful of stores to an international operation, without losing operational control, speed at checkout, or visibility over your business?
In this session, we will share the GoodNews journey: a modern food & beverage retail brand that expanded rapidly across Spain, France, Amsterdam, and now the UK all powered by Odoo. What started as a startup with ambitious growth plans quickly became a complex multi-store operation running 50+ Point of Sale sessions simultaneously, requiring real-time stock control, seamless integrations, and a checkout experience designed for high-volume environments.
We will walk through how Odoo became the operational backbone of GoodNews, covering key challenges such as scaling POS performance, handling peak-hour concurrency, improving order preparation flows, and integrating external systems without breaking store operations. You’ll also see how process redesign and smart POS customizations helped reduce friction for store staff while increasing transaction speed and reliability.
Key takeaways include:
1) How to prepare Odoo POS for high-concurrency, multi-store retail environments
2) Lessons learned when scaling operations across multiple countries
3) How operational efficiency at POS directly impacts growth and customer experience
4) The importance of combining standard Odoo features with targeted custom development

speakers.name: Matias Righi
speakers.biography_text: Matias Enzo Righi is an Industrial Engineer and Odoo consultant specialized in large-scale ERP implementations for retail and fast-growing companies. Based in Barcelona, he has led complex international projects involving POS, logistics, and multi-store operations, helping businesses scale while maintaining operational efficiency. At Qubiq, he works closely with high-growth brands like GoodNews, optimizing Odoo to support real-time retail environments with dozens of simultaneous POS sessions. With a background in project management and agile methodologies, Matias focuses on turning business challenges into scalable digital solutions that connect technology, operations, and growth.

tracks.name: Warranty Repairs Done Right: Managing Vendor Repairs with Odoo Helpdesk & Repairs
tracks.speaker_line: Nadja Planic, Head of Manufacturing ERP Consulting at much. Consulting
tracks.description_text:
Many service providers and B2B resellers manage repair processes under warranty not for themselves, but for the original vendors. When a product fails, customers submit helpdesk tickets—but what happens next? Without structured flows, companies struggle to track repairs, returns, and vendor chargebacks.
This talk shows how to create a seamless repair flow in Odoo. We’ll focus on how to handle third-party repairs, using Odoo's Repair, Helpdesk, Inventory, and Project apps.
You’ll leave with a complete framework to manage warranty repairs, ensure traceability, and provide service transparency—while keeping vendor relations and SLAs under control.
Key Points:
- The challenge: Coordinating repairs on behalf of OEMs (Original Equipment Manufacturers) or vendors
- Helpdesk as the entry point: Ticketing with product & warranty tracking
- Creating a structured repair intake: RMA (Return Merchandise Authorisation), stock intake, and repair order
- Using Odoo Repair and Project apps to track repair work and approvals
- Charging vendors post-repair: Purchase/Sales workflows for B2B warranties
- Case study examples from real repair service operations
Key Learnings:
- Understand how to build a repair process linked to helpdesk tickets in Odoo
- Learn how to manage repairs performed on behalf of third-party vendors
- Gain practical tips for handling returns, parts usage, and documentation
- See how to charge vendors transparently after completed repair work
- Avoid common pitfalls in repair-service traceability and SLA compliance
Target Audience:
- Service operations managers and repair coordinators
- ERP consultants working with after-sales or technical support providers
- Companies providing repairs under vendor warranty or service contracts
- Helpdesk administrators and process designers in B2B service companies

speakers.name: Nadja Planic
speakers.biography_text: Nadja Planic is the Head of Manufacturing ERP Consulting at much. Consulting. She leads the team focusing on the conception, implementation, and optimization of ERP projects. Nadja has extensive expertise with compliance and quality topics in Odoo, leading projects for manufacturing-heavy companies with highly compliance-sensitive processes, ensuring they meet stringent industry standards.

tracks.name: Future-Proofing Teams in Odoo: Skills Matrix Mapping for Continuity, Coverage & Growth
tracks.speaker_line: Shenade Chetty, Operations Team Lead at True Cloud ERP (Pty) Ltd
tracks.description_text:
In this talk, I’ll share how we’re building a practical skills matrix to get clear, reliable visibility into capability across the business - who holds certain skills and capabilities, at what level, and where our most critical shortfalls and single points of failure exist. We’ll look at how the matrix strengthens business continuity by enabling smoother handovers, clarifying ownership, and ensuring there are trained backups for key roles and processes, reducing risk when people are away or when staff churn happens.
I’ll also cover how we use structured skills assessments to evaluate current proficiency levels consistently, so the matrix is based on evidence rather than assumption. Beyond continuity planning, I’ll explain how we’re using the same framework to drive focused upskilling and development plans, ensuring training is aligned to real operational needs.
Finally, we’ll explore how the insights directly inform recruitment and hiring decisions - highlighting which skills should be developed internally, which require external hiring, and where future roles or capacity gaps are emerging. Attendees will leave with a clear, actionable approach for implementing a skills matrix that improves resilience, accelerates team growth, and supports smarter workforce planning.

speakers.name: Shenade Chetty
speakers.biography_text:
Shenade Chetty is an Operations Team Leader with experience across Odoo implementation, project management, development coordination, customer success, team management, and operations. She specialises in translating complex business requirements into practical, scalable Odoo solutions that improve processes and drive efficiency.
With experience spanning the full implementation lifecycle, Shenade brings together people, processes, and technology to deliver successful projects and meaningful customer outcomes. She is passionate about simplifying operations, building high-performing teams, and using Odoo to create solutions that support sustainable business growth.

tracks.name: What's new in Sales?
tracks.speaker_line: Jean Boonen from Odoo
tracks.description_text: This talk will cover all the new features of the Sales scopes.

tracks.name: Modern Transport Management for road transportation with Odoo: From CRM to Delivery
tracks.speaker_line: Robert Förster, CEO at SUPPLiot GmbH
tracks.description_text:
The logistics industry demands much more than accounting and inventory. Transport companies need to manage quotations, dispatching, vehicles, drivers, deliveries, invoicing, and customer communication—all while keeping operations efficient.
In this session, we’ll show how Odoo serves as the foundation for a complete Transport Management System (TMS). Starting with standard Odoo applications such as CRM, Sales, Fleet, Purchase, Accounting, we’ll demonstrate how an integrated ERP eliminates data silos and streamlines day-to-day logistics operations.
We’ll then explore how industry-specific workflows can be added on top of Odoo to support transport planning, dispatching, proof of delivery, driver operations, telematics integration and logistics-specific processes—all while remaining fully integrated with the Odoo ecosystem.
Whether you’re an Odoo partner looking to enter the logistics industry or a transport company evaluating Odoo, this session demonstrates how a modern logistics platform can be built by combining Odoo’s powerful standard features with targeted industry expertise.

speakers.name: Robert Förster
speakers.biography_text: Robert Förster is the Managing Director of SUPPLiot GmbH and Co-Managing Director of Förster Transporte, a fourth-generation family-owned transport company. Combining software engineering with hands-on logistics experience, he develops industry-specific ERP solutions built on Odoo. His work on Odoo 4 Logistics demonstrates how Odoo’s standard applications can be extended to support the complex workflows of modern transport companies while maintaining a fully integrated business platform.

tracks.name: Untangling Excise Duties: Managing Bonded Wine & Spirits Warehousing in Odoo Standard
tracks.speaker_line: Julien Brunin & Samy Brahimi, CEO et Business Analyst at Acsone
tracks.description_text:
With over a century of history, Les Vins Brunin-Guiller is a major actor in wine and spirits retail, import, and export across Belgium and France. But behind every fine bottle lies a complex web of customs regulations, bonded warehouses (hors douane), and excise duties.
Unlike standard taxes like VAT, excise taxes in the alcohol sector are triggered at a very specific and critical moment: when the product leaves the tax-suspended customs regime (hors douane) and is cleared for domestic market distribution. Managing this dual-status inventory and ensuring tax compliance across purchases, internal transfers, and sales is a notorious nightmare for wine merchants.
In this talk, we will reveal how we successfully implemented a fully compliant, integrated flow for Vins Brunin-Guiller. You will discover how we leveraged Odoo Standard—using multi-warehouses, specific route configurations, and native inventory features—to automate excise tax calculations and track every stock movement from purchase to final delivery.
What you will learn (Key Takeaways):
- Bonded vs. Duty-Paid Flows: How to design a seamless multi-warehouse and location structure in Odoo to manage tax-suspended (hors douane) and tax-paid stocks.
- Automating Excise Triggers: How to capture the exact moment excise duties must be applied during stock moves, minimizing human error and audit risks.
- The Power of Standard: Practical tips and tricks to solve complex regulatory and localization issues using Odoo’s native features, avoiding heavy custom developments.
- Real-world Feedback: Lessons learned from a century-old business transitioning to a modern, integrated ERP.

speakers.name: Julien Brunin & Samy Brahimi
speakers.biography_text: Sera fournir à la confirmation du talk.

tracks.name: What's new in Odoo Phone?
tracks.speaker_line: Fabrice Henrion, R&D at Odoo
tracks.description_text: This talk will showcase the new features in Odoo Phone.

tracks.name: From POS data to profit: The KPIs behind real retail growth
tracks.speaker_line: Sara Carusio from Odoo
tracks.description_text:
What if your POS data already holds the answers to growing your profit and you just don't know where to look?
Every retailer has a goal: growing sales, protecting margins, or simply staying consistent over time. But goals without visibility are just wishes. To move forward, you need to track your progress, understand what's working and what's not, and act fast.
In this session, you'll get the foundations you need: which KPIs actually matter, how to read them, and how to turn data into concrete actions and measurable results.

speakers.name: Sara Carusio
speakers.biography_text: Before joining Odoo, I spent a few years working in retail, first as a Store Manager and then overseeing several stores. Today, I help retailers improve their Point of Sale and everyday operations as a Retail Business Analyst.

tracks.name: What's new in Odoo Sign?
tracks.speaker_line: Jonathan Bertholet from Odoo
tracks.description_text:
With Odoo 20, Sign has made enormous strides on becoming the most seamless digital signing experience on the market.
Join the talk to find out all the ways in which we've made Odoo Sign more secure, trusted, powerful, integrated and convenient for everyday use.

tracks.name: Introduction to AI framework of odoo for developpers + Developing Odoo modules using AI: a practical guide
tracks.speaker_line: Joseph Caburnay (jcb) from Odoo

tracks.name: Zippsafe: Scaling a startup with Odoo
tracks.speaker_line: Janos Regele, Maximilian Bernhard from Odoo
tracks.description_text:
Zippsafe AG
is an innovative Swiss technology scale-up that has revolutionized the traditional employee locker room.
Originating from ETH Zurich in 2016, the company replaces rigid metal or wooden lockers with an intelligent, IoT-connected "Smart Soft Locker" system. By utilizing flexible, durable textile bags instead of hard materials, Zippsafe's solutions
save up to 70% of floor space
while increasing storage capacity up to threefold.
Engineered with advanced RFID locking, integrated ventilation, and antimicrobial fabrics, their systems bridge the gap between physical space-efficiency and digital workflow optimization. Today, Zippsafe operates across three continents with a growing team of over 90 employees across Switzerland, Germany, Hungary, and the USA, providing smarter, highly hygienic storage solutions to major healthcare facilities, pharmaceutical sites, and industrial sectors globally.
Janos Regele, Head of Product Development and ICT will speaking about his experience introducing Odoo and using its modular and open source design to scale from just a few people to almost 100 employees across the world.
Janos is also currently leading one of the most well organised and executed upgrade projects we have seen.
Stop by to hear about the journey, its guranteed to be interesting for companies at all stages of their development and also for clients who are planning or undergoing an upgrade!
Website:
https://www.zippsafe.com/en

tracks.name: What's new in JavaScript?
tracks.speaker_line: Géry Debongnie (ged) & Thiry Cédric (cth) from Odoo
tracks.description_text: As Odoo continues to expand, its codebase must adapt to meet an increasing range of requirements. Consequently, the JavaScript framework, the foundational layer upon which the rest of Odoo UI is built, has also undergone significant evolution. In this talk, we will explore some of the most interesting changes.

speakers.name: Géry Debongnie (ged) & Thiry Cédric (cth)
speakers.biography_text:
Gery
is an accomplished software developer with extensive expertise in JavaScript. He has played a pivotal role in Odoo codebase, starting even before it was called Odoo. Géry is not only known for his contributions to projects like the Owl UI framework, the Odoo web client, and the Odoo Spreadsheets application but also for his leadership as the head of the JavaScript framework team.
Cédric
joined Odoo in 2019 as a Business Analyst. After years of project implementations from various sizes and sectors, he moved to the R&D department to endorse the role of Product Owner. Since 2024, he is responsible for the functional aspects of the technical features produced by the Framework JS and ORM teams.

tracks.name: The Growing Importance of Entrepreneurial Education in Higher Education
tracks.speaker_line: Annelien Suenaert & Mohamed Taamouti, Business Coach Education & Entrepreneurship at Onderwijs & Ondernemen UNIZO
tracks.description_text: What does entrepreneurial education mean today? In this session, we will explore how you, as an education professional, can make your classes more entrepreneurial in an efficient and practical way. We will also take a closer look at why entrepreneurial skills are becoming increasingly important for students in today’s society.

speakers.name: Annelien Suenaert & Mohamed Taamouti
speakers.biography_text:
Mohamed Taamouti and Annelien Suenaert are
Education & Entrepreneurship Advisors at UNIZO
, where they help students, teachers and educational institutions develop entrepreneurial skills and turn ideas into action.
Through coaching, workshops and collaborations with schools and higher education, they connect the world of education with real entrepreneurship. Together, they bring a practical perspective on entrepreneurial mindset, talent development and the journey from first idea to concrete business opportunity.

tracks.name: Lunch break
Quoi de neuf dans Comptabilité ?
tracks.speaker_line: Claire Goudeseune & Thomas Bourlet, Business analyst accounting expert - Business analyst accounting firm expert at Odoo
tracks.description_text: Cette conférence présentera l’ensemble des nouveautés en matière de comptabilité.

speakers.name: Claire Goudeseune & Thomas Bourlet
speakers.function: Business analyst accounting expert - Business analyst accounting firm expert
speakers.biography_text:
Claire
a travaillé pendant 10 ans en tant que controleur de gestion pour un important retailer belge, avant de rejoindre l'équipe d'expert comptabilité des Business Analyst chez Odoo en 2024. Grâce  à son expérience à sa formation en ingénieur de gestion et, elle est à même d'accompagner les entreprises de toute taille, avec un focus sur les solutions comptables.
Thomas
a 5 ans d’expérience en comptabilité : 3 ans dans des fiduciaires et 2 ans comme comptable en entreprise.
Aujourd’hui, il travaille chez Odoo, dans l’équipe dédiée aux fiduciaires. Il aide les comptables à utiliser Odoo pour simplifier leur travail, gagner du temps et être plus efficaces.

tracks.name: Entrepreneurship in higher education: from classroom to student business
tracks.speaker_line: Hilde Gekiere & Julie van der Hooft & Margot van Den Bossche, entrepreneurship coaches at Artevelde University College of Applied Sciences and connected as coach with Gentrepreneur
tracks.description_text:
In this session, we explore how higher education can move beyond traditional teaching to actively cultivate the next generation of entrepreneurs. Building on insights from our book “Je bent jong en je wilt ondernemen” and our work within entrepreneurial education, we highlight how universities and colleges can integrate entrepreneurial thinking into the classroom, support student‑led ventures, and create an ecosystem where young founders can thrive.
We will share practical strategies, real cases from our own experience, and a framework for guiding students from early idea exploration to fully launching their business while studying.

speakers.name: Hilde Gekiere & Julie van der Hooft & Margot van Den Bossche
speakers.company: Artevelde University College of Applied Sciences and connected as coach with Gentrepreneur
speakers.biography_text:
Hilde Gekiere, Julie van der Hooft and Margot Vanden Bossche are
entrepreneurship coaches and lecturers at Artevelde University of Applied Sciences
, where they support students in developing their entrepreneurial skills and ambitions.
Through hands-on coaching, business planning and initiatives such as Gentrepreneur, they help students turn ideas into concrete projects and sustainable businesses, while building a strong bridge between education and entrepreneurship.

tracks.name: Tap, Eat, Repeat: Boost your sales with our intuitive self orderings tools
tracks.speaker_line: Bo Vlerick (bovle), Business Analyst Horeca at Odoo

This session covers everything you need to boost your average ticket size and elevate customer satisfaction. Learn how to keep operations smooth with the new product snooze feature, integration with cash machines and even accepting orders while the POS is closed. tracks.name: Building Drone Engines with Odoo: From Complexity to Clarity
tracks.speaker_line: Callum Grimes, Li Malone & Gery Rupelska, Account Manager, Digital Transformation Manager & Financial Controller at Odoo & Orbital
tracks.description_text:
This will be a live Q & A session that explores how Odoo can be leveraged to create a single source of truth for financial and operational decision-making, addressing the common challenge where organisations implement ERP systems yet still rely on disconnected spreadsheets, manual approvals, and fragmented reporting.
Using practical examples from a growing technology and manufacturing environment, the presentation will demonstrate how connecting approval workflows, CRM opportunities, quotations, purchasing, inventory, project accounting, and executive dashboards within Odoo can significantly improve governance, accountability, and reporting accuracy.
Attendees will gain actionable insights on designing approval frameworks that balance control with efficiency, establishing clear decision ownership, and creating real-time performance dashboards, while also discovering practical strategies to overcome typical implementation hurdles like user adoption, process standardisation, and data quality.

speakers.name: Callum Grimes, Li Malone & Gery Rupelska
speakers.function: Account Manager, Digital Transformation Manager & Financial Controller

tracks.name: From Paperwork to People: How Odoo Reimagined HR
tracks.speaker_line: Kim Buehler, Head of People & Culture at Braintec
tracks.description_text:
How do you transform HR from a cost center into a streamlined, digital powerhouse? It starts with the Odoo Standard suite—leveraging Recruitment, Payroll, and Expenses to build a central source of truth.
In this session, we explore how to take that foundation even further. We will demonstrate how braintec extends the Odoo ecosystem to tackle high-impact HR challenges. Learn how to automate the "paperwork headache" with our Document Generator including training agreements, foster growth with the Feedback Tool "Letterbox", and provide a world-class experience through the Advanced Employee Portal.
Join us to see a live blueprint of a fully integrated HR lifecycle that saves time for admins and delights employees.

speakers.name: Kim Buehler
speakers.biography_text: Kim is the Head of P&C at braintec and a true believer that HR software should be as vibrant as the people using it. With 4.5 years of experience deep in the Odoo ecosystem, Kim has mastered the art of blending Odoo’s robust core with braintec’s specialized apps to create a frictionless workplace. Whether it’s automating tedious document generation or crafting a world-class employee portal, Kim knows how to turn "standard" processes into a competitive advantage. Join Kim to discover how to stop pushing paper and start building a culture that shines.

tracks.name: Mastering project profitability in Odoo
tracks.speaker_line: Dries Van Doninck, Business Analyst at Odoo
tracks.description_text: Tracking the true profitability of a project can be challenging when timesheets, vendor bills, and expenses are managed across different teams. Without a centralized system, it’s easy to lose the overview of what costs are actually made, and which profits you are actually creating. In this session, we will map a project's financial lifecycle to see exactly how margins are calculated in real-time in Odoo 20. We first configure baseline data, like employee hourly rates, service products, and material costs. These will  be used to demonstrate how analytic accounts can be set up to automatically capture daily operations like timesheets, expenses, purchase orders, and vendor bills of the project. We will conclude by going over the standard reporting capabilities of Odoo 20, by integrating Odoo Spreadsheets to build functional budgets and identify financial variances before they impact your bottom line.

tracks.name: What's new in Timesheets?
tracks.speaker_line: Lucie Allard, Business Analyst - Service Expert at Odoo
tracks.description_text: Discover the new features of the Timesheets application: from Timesheet Assistant to the revamp of the timesheets systray, this talk will recap everything you should know!

tracks.speaker_line: Lionel Willems (Odoo) & Gaelle Houvenaeghel (Partena Professional) from Odoo
tracks.description_text: Discover how the Partena Professional × Odoo collaboration continues to evolve. This session combines a recap of today's integrations with a preview of what's ahead, showing how we aim to simplify payroll collaboration for accountants and their clients.

speakers.name: Lionel Willems (Odoo) & Gaelle Houvenaeghel (Partena Professional)

speakers.name: Sarah Wittmann

tracks.name: Odoo for Aerospace: Enforcing No-Fly Zones in the Warehouse
tracks.speaker_line: Bernhard Hilfer, ERP Consultant at much. Consulting
tracks.description_text:
In aerospace manufacturing, storing a standard prototype in a restricted "Flight-Critical" zone is not merely an operational error; it is a severe compliance breach that jeopardizes safety certifications and audit status. Managing this across complex bills of materials requires infallible, automated segregation of physical inventory based on strict component compliance levels.
To solve this, we expanded the Odoo Enterprise Inventory and Barcode apps to engineer a rigid "Compliance Flag" setup. By binding specific compliance attributes directly to Serial Numbers and Stock Locations, the system enforces a strict key-lock matching rule during every internal stock move. If a warehouse operator attempts to scan a non-compliant part into a restricted zone, it instantly triggers a hard stop within the Odoo Barcode interface, preventing the transaction.
As a result, zone mistakes dropped to absolute zero. Automating these checks during scanning also cut manual quality assurance time by 40%, keeping warehouse operations fast without sacrificing safety. Attendees will discover the exact data model changes, the barcode logic setup, and practical lessons for enforcing strict compliance in a busy warehouse environment.
Key Points of this Talk:
- Data Model Extension: Extending standard Odoo Serial Number and Stock Location models to support unique compliance attributes.
- Key-Lock Matching Logic: Engineering strict validation rules that pair component safety flags directly with destination zone restrictions.
- Real-Time Barcode Enforcement: Configuring automated hard stops inside the Odoo Barcode UI to block incorrect physical scans instantly.
- Preventing Segregation Breaches: How the system physically keeps non-compliant aerospace parts out of secure storage areas.
- Fallback Handling: Executing smart routing logic to guide standard inventory to regular shelves without breaking warehouse workflows.
Key Learnings:
- How to enforce strict Serial-to-Location validation in Odoo Enterprise Inventory.
- How to trigger hard validation stops in the Enterprise Barcode UI.
- How to architect scalable compliance rules for highly regulated industries.
Target Audience:
Supply Chain Directors, QA Managers, and Technical Consultants using Odoo Enterprise.

speakers.name: Bernhard Hilfer
speakers.biography_text: Bernhard Hilfer is a manufacturing-focused ERP Consultant at much. Consulting, dedicated to helping mid-sized companies optimize their production inside Odoo Enterprise.

tracks.name: Meet Lisa, Billie, Leon & Lex: Four AI Agents That Go Live in Your Odoo — No Tech Team Required
tracks.speaker_line: Marc Bogaerts, CEO at Coreflow Technology
tracks.description_text:
What if your Odoo could reorder stock before you run out, flag a risky contract close before you sign, chase late invoices without anyone touching a keyboard, and surface the deals most likely to close this week — all without a single developer on your payroll?
That's exactly what Coreflow built. Four AI agents that plug directly into an existing Odoo environment. Billie handles procurement and inventory — calculating safety stock, reorder points and EOQ from three years of your own sales data. Leon monitors budgets, runs a 13-week rolling cashflow forecast, and triggers dunning below a configurable threshold. Lisa qualifies leads, tracks pipeline health, and drafts outreach without leaving Odoo. And Lex — the newest addition — automates legal groundwork: drafting NDAs, reviewing incoming contracts for risk clauses, and running GDPR and compliance checks, live within hours.
No custom data infrastructure. No data science team. No six-month implementation.
This session is for Odoo partners and operations managers who are tired of AI theory and want to see what autonomous agents actually look like inside a live SME environment — and how fast you can get there.

tracks.name: Choosing Odoo Over SAP: The 10-Year Transformation Journey of a Global Pharmaceutical Group
tracks.speaker_line: Amit Parik, Managing Partner at BrowseInfo
tracks.description_text:
In 2014, Sasmar Pharmaceuticals faced a critical strategic decision.
Operating across multiple countries with growing manufacturing, distribution, and eCommerce operations, the company evaluated traditional enterprise ERP platforms, including SAP, to support its next phase of international growth. Instead, Sasmar selected Odoo (formerly OpenERP), a decision that would shape the next decade of its business transformation.
Today, Sasmar operates 22 companies across Europe, Asia-Pacific, North America, and Latin America, with Odoo serving as the digital backbone of its global operations.
This session is not a software implementation story. It is a business transformation case study.
We will explore how Sasmar evolved from a group of 6 companies into a globally integrated pharmaceutical organization while maintaining a single ERP strategy, standardized operating model, and unified data architecture. Attendees will gain insight into the governance, scalability, and architectural decisions that enabled rapid international expansion without the complexity and fragmentation commonly associated with multinational growth.
The session will cover:
* The ERP evaluation process and why Sasmar selected Odoo over traditional enterprise alternatives.
* Designing an ERP architecture for future expansion rather than current requirements.
* Building a centralized multi-company, multi-currency, and multi-warehouse operating model.
* Supporting manufacturing, supply chain, finance, and commercial operations across multiple countries.
* Managing more than 25 Shopify stores, Amazon channels, websites, and digital commerce operations through a unified platform.
* The evolution from Odoo 7 to Odoo 19 and lessons learned from a decade of continuous innovation and upgrades.
* Governance frameworks, customization strategies, and scalability principles that enabled long-term success.
More importantly, we will share what worked, what failed, what we would do differently today, and the practical lessons organizations can apply when building a long-term ERP roadmap.
For CEOs, CFOs, COOs, CIOs, ERP leaders, and growing international businesses, this session demonstrates how Odoo can move beyond departmental automation to become a strategic platform for global expansion.
Ten years ago, Sasmar chose Odoo as an ERP system.
A decade later, it has become the foundation that supports 22 companies, multiple continents, global manufacturing, digital commerce, and continued growth.
This is the story of how an ERP decision became a business transformation journey.
⸻
Why This Session Matters
Most ERP discussions focus on software features.
This session focuses on what business leaders truly care about:
How do you build an ERP foundation that can support international growth, acquisitions, new markets, digital commerce, and operational complexity for more than a decade without replacing the platform every few years?
Using Sasmar Pharmaceuticals’ real-world journey, attendees will see how strategic ERP decisions, governance, and scalable architecture can enable sustainable global growth while avoiding the costs, disruption, and complexity often associated with large-scale ERP transformations.
⸻
Speaker Perspective
Delivered jointly by the leadership teams of Sasmar Pharmaceuticals and BrowseInfo, sharing over ten years of practical experience scaling one of Odoo’s longest-running global pharmaceutical implementations.

speakers.name: Amit Parik
speakers.biography_text:
My name is Amit Parik, and I am the Managing Partner at BrowseInfo, an Odoo Gold Partner that has been providing Odoo services since 2013. Before starting BrowseInfo, I worked at Odoo (formerly OpenERP), which gave me deep insight into the product, roadmap, and best practices for successful implementations.
At BrowseInfo, we focus on business consulting and end‑to‑end Odoo implementation, not just development. As a long‑standing Gold Partner, we help customers with process analysis, solution design, configuration, customisation, integrations, training, support, and continuous improvement on Odoo. Over the years, I have led and overseen 100+ Odoo implementations across India and around the world in industries such as pharma, manufacturing, trading, services, retail, NGOs, education, and temples.
BrowseInfo is also known in the Odoo ecosystem for its large portfolio of ready‑to‑use Odoo apps and vertical solutions on the Odoo Apps store, which partners and end customers use to accelerate their projects and reduce custom development.
One of my flagship projects is with Sasmar Pharmaceuticals, a global pharma group that has been on Odoo for more than a decade. Starting from Odoo 7 and now on Odoo 19 Enterprise, we supported Sasmar’s growth from 6 to 22 companies across multiple countries, with Odoo as the backbone for ERP, eCommerce, multi‑website, and marketplace integrations. This long‑term journey has given me strong experience in multi‑company, multi‑currency architectures, complex rollouts, and multi‑version upgrades, turning Odoo into a true core system for international businesses.

tracks.name: Raising AI Pentesters - from Toddler to Teenager
tracks.speaker_line: Robbe Verwilghen
tracks.description_text:
Robbe is an experienced bug bounty hunter, ex-triager and ex-penetration tester. Last year, he joined Aikido Security's AI pentest team to use their agents in security research and help improve the product.
In this presentation Robbe will talk about how he experienced the launch of Aikido's AI pentest agents and how he has seen the agents evolve. You’ll learn that there's much more to AI Pentesting than just high benchmark scores. While a tool might ace a controlled test, it’s useless if it can’t navigate a live more complex application flow. Robbe will share the practical, real-world capabilities that benchmarks often miss, such as handling SMS and email magic links and working with exotic authentication mechanisms, a standard set of AI pentest agents might not be able to navigate.

A practical guide to balancing innovation, control and resilience

tracks.name: How to build a project agreement framework in Odoo for complex wholesale distribution
tracks.speaker_line: Tânia Manco, ERP Consultant at much. Consulting
tracks.description_text:
Construction wholesale is built on long-term, multi-partner B2B projects. Standard Odoo handles sales and procurement well, but the specific demands of such complex supply chains require a more tailored approach. Managing project-level pricing, dual delivery methods (dropship vs. warehouse), and contracts across dozens of subcontractors requires stepping outside the standard setup. This talk explores how to build an "Agreement Framework" that connects these moving parts into one unified process.
Key Points of the Talk:
- Find the Gap: Identifying where out-of-the-box Odoo features like blanket orders and pricelists reach their limits in complex distribution scenarios.
- The Agreement Framework: Designing a central model that links sales and purchasing, tracks quantities in real time, and automates price inheritance.
- Live Demo: A walkthrough of creating an agreement, comparing margins between delivery routes, and watching child orders automatically update project balances.
- Architecture & Logic: The reasoning behind our technical choices, specifically how we handled unit of measure conversions and automated margin calculations.
- The Future: A brief look at upcoming Odoo features and why a dedicated orchestration layer will still matter for specialized industries.
Key Learnings:
- Why building a dedicated "Agreement" model is more stable than extending standard sales or purchase orders.
- How to store "Dropship vs. Warehouse" prices for the same agreement to enable easy comparisons.
- Lessons learned from aggregating real-time data across various stages of the supply chain.
- The importance of allowing agreements to apply to product groups, not just individual SKUs, to handle substitutions.
- Why secondary units of measure and custom order states must be part of the initial architecture, not an afterthought.
Target Audience:
- Functional Consultants & Developers looking for ways to extend Odoo for complex trading and distribution.
- IT Leads & Project Managers at companies dealing with multi-partner agreements or intricate B2B pricing.

speakers.name: Tânia Manco
speakers.biography_text: Tânia Manco is a Consultant at much. Consulting, specializing in Odoo implementations for the commerce sectors across the DACH region. With a deep understanding of the Odoo stack Tânia excels at bridging the gap between complex business requirements and scalable technical architecture.

tracks.name: When Intelligence Becomes Free: Lessons from Letting AI Operate Odoo Across 60+ Modules
tracks.speaker_line: Miguel Martín, CEO at Aikit
tracks.description_text:
Odoo 19 brought AI into the ERP: Ask AI, AI fields, agents that help the people using Odoo. This talk is about the step after that — software built to be operated by AI, not by people.
The reason matters. For 300,000 years, progress was capped by one scarce resource: intelligence. As that scarcity ends, "AI inside the ERP" is only the first move; the deeper shift is software designed for an AI operator.
AiKit is a Spanish AI lab whose product runs natively on Odoo for 2,000+ SMBs. With live, working examples, we'll show how we built an AI layer that reads, decides and writes across 60+ Odoo modules and 200+ external systems via MCP and the Odoo API — an operator, not a chatbot or a copilot.
Attendees will leave with a concrete architecture for AI that operates Odoo end-to-end; the guardrails that keep it safe on real ERP data; the failure modes we hit at scale and the fixes; and a clear view of how this extends — rather than replaces — Odoo's native AI.
For Odoo partners, developers and functional consultants building AI into real client deployments.

speakers.name: Miguel Martín
speakers.biography_text: Miguel Martín Lacoma is CEO of AiKit Research, a Spanish AI lab building the software layer that lets AI operate inside a company. AiKit runs natively on Odoo and serves 2,000+ SMBs, making it the most widely used AI software among Spanish small businesses. Miguel leads product, execution and operations, and writes a regular column on technology and the economics of intelligence for El Economista. At Odoo Experience he focuses on one question: what business software looks like when it is built to be run by machines, not people

tracks.name: Aerospace Compliance in Odoo: The EHP & Idealis Production & Traceability Success Story
tracks.speaker_line: Benoit Dassy, Business Analyst at Idealis Consulting
tracks.description_text:
In the aerospace industry, there is absolutely zero room for error. A single defective component or a lapse in documentation can jeopardize a multi-million-dollar satellite mission. To operate in this elite sector, manufacturers must comply with draconian quality standards (such as ECSS and AS9100). How can a modern, agile ERP like Odoo meet such rigid, high-stakes requirements?
Discover the real-world success story of EHP (Euro Heat Pipes), a prominent aerospace manufacturer that overhauled its production ecosystem by implementing Odoo with the strategic support of Idealis.
This talk will deep dive into how Odoo MRP, Quality, PLM, and Inventory modules were leveraged to enforce strict manufacturing flow, bidirectional lot/serial traceability from raw material to orbit, and robust non-conformity management. We will explain how we bridged the gap between Odoo’s natural flexibility and the extreme compliance required by space agencies.
Key takeaways from this session:
- Space-Grade MRP & Quality: How to configure and enhance Odoo to meet strict international aerospace compliance without losing operational agility.
- Bulletproof Traceability: Best practices for setting up end-to-end lot tracking and mandatory quality checkpoints across complex, high-precision production lines.
- Industrial Scaling: How Idealis and EHP successfully transitioned operators from legacy, paper-heavy workflows to a digitized, integrated ERP.
Target Audience: Manufacturing Managers (in the Space Industry or similar needs about traceability), Quality Assurance (QA) Experts,.

speakers.name: Benoit Dassy
speakers.biography_text: Benoit Dassy is a Business Analyst and Project Manager at Idealis Consulting. Certified in Odoo V18 , Benoit excels at bridging communication between business stakeholders and development teams. He leverages key soft skills—such as analytical thinking, problem-solving, and team coordination —to streamline intricate manufacturing, rigorous quality, and strict inventory workflows. His collaborative approach ensures seamless change management and successful digital tool adoption across organizations.

tracks.name: What if AI could help us see how a student really reads?
tracks.speaker_line: Siem Buseyne & David Gijbels, Education at Universiteit Antwerpen 🎓
tracks.description_text: In this session, Siem Buseyne and David Gijbels explore the potential of AI to make learning processes that usually remain invisible more visible and understandable. They introduce EYE-TEACH, a research project investigating how eye-tracking and AI can help teachers understand how students read, where they struggle, and when they may need support. The session also considers the importance of meaningful interpretation, responsible use, and keeping teachers in the loop.

speakers.name: Siem Buseyne & David Gijbels
speakers.biography_text:
Siem Buseyne and David Gijbels are
researchers in learning, educational technology and innovation at the University of Antwerp
. Their work explores how technology can help us better understand and support the way students learn.
Through the
EYE-TEACH project
, they investigate how AI and eye-tracking can provide teachers with new insights into students’ reading and learning processes, translating cutting-edge research into practical applications for the classroom.

tracks.name: Best practices for a successful Odoo implementation with a partner
tracks.speaker_line: Cedrick Junior, Key Account Manager at Odoo
tracks.description_text:
Is your ERP implementation set up for success—or already heading toward avoidable problems?
Most ERP implementation failures are not caused by the software itself. They result from common project risks that, if left unmanaged, can lead to delays, budget overruns, and poor user adoption.
In this session, you'll learn the most common risks organizations face when implementing Odoo with a partner and, more importantly, how to mitigate them before they become costly issues. We'll cover practical approaches to project governance, working effectively with your implementation partner, and recognizing the right moment to involve Odoo if your project starts going off track.
Whether you're about to begin your implementation or are already in the middle of one, you'll leave with actionable insights to help you reduce risk, make better project decisions, and increase the likelihood of a successful implementation.
You'll learn how to:
Identify the most common implementation risks.
Apply practical strategies to mitigate them.
Manage your implementation effectively from day one.
Establish the right governance and project expectations.
Know when and how to involve Odoo before an implementation derails.
If you're planning an implementation with an Odoo Partner and want to maximize your chances of success, this session is for you.

speakers.name: Cedrick Junior
speakers.biography_text: With a strong background in digital transformation and international business, Cedrick Junior is a driving force behind the strategic growth of Odoo’s key customers in Belgium and the Netherlands. As a Key Account Manager, he bridges the gap between business needs, implementation best practices, and smart ERP solutions. Join Cedrick as he brings the best practices for a successful Odoo implementation with a Partner.

tracks.name: What's new in POS for restaurants?
tracks.speaker_line: Hermine Karetzopoulos & Lieselot Nauwelaers from Odoo
tracks.description_text: Let's dive into the newest releases in Odoo POS for Restaurants! We are excited to show the new Floor Plan editor, improved UX/UI, auto conversion of products into combo and optimized course management. But that's not all, we are taking the communication between waiter & kitchen even further and include the customers by informing them through SMS alerts, Whatsapp updates & digital kiosk receipts. Discover how these powerful enhancements (and more) elevate workflows whether you manage a cozy cafe, a fast-paced food truck, a lively pub or a fine dining establishment!

speakers.name: Hermine Karetzopoulos & Lieselot Nauwelaers
speakers.biography_text:
Hermine
is a business analyst, her day-to-day activity is to carry out Odoo project implementations. Having collaborated with two major POS clients, she has channeled her focus into this domain, aiding businesses in their digital transformation journey. Indeed, her journey led her to specialize in the POS industry and at last, join the expertise team. Her passion lies in optimizing processes, enhancing user experiences, and driving improved business outcomes for clients, propelling her forward with unwavering motivation each day.
Lieslelot
joined Odoo in 2023 as a business analyst. For the past two years, she has worked within the Horeca team where she collaborates with restaurants to help them digitalise their business processes and the practical improvement of their day-to-day operational flows.

tracks.name: Batir le futur des métiers à l'heure de l'IA générative
tracks.speaker_line: Isabelle Rouhan from Colibri Talent
tracks.description_text:
Lors de ses interventions, Isabelle Rouhan invite chacun à découvrir une série de métiers du futur, et notamment à toucher du doigt l’impact concret que
l’intelligence artificielle générative a sur le travail. Elle en est convaincue, les nouvelles technologies libéreront des tâches répétitives et sans valeur ajoutée pour permettre d’investir ce temps additionnel dans plus de formation et de relation. Ce sera notamment le cas dans les services d’aide à la personne et les métiers de la relation client. En effet, l’accélération de la collecte et du traitement des data sera un formidable moteur de création d’emplois et de nouvelles opportunités professionnelles. De l’artiste numérique, à l’éducateur de robots, en
passant par le neuro-manager ou encore le médecin numérique, Isabelle partage a vision d’un monde plus humain et plus riche où l’Intelligence Artificielle se met
au service de l’Homme, quand l’agilité permet à chacun de devenir acteur de son employabilité. En s’appuyant sur les témoignages d’artistes, d’entrepreneurs, d’enseignants, d’agents du service publics, loin de tous partis pris ou de stéréotypes, elle compose une galerie de portraits des métiers de demain, dont le dénominateur commun est qu’ils soient tous connectés.

speakers.name: Isabelle Rouhan
speakers.biography_text:
Entrepreneure, Isabelle Rouhan dirige Colibri Talent, cabinet de conseil pour dirigeants (recrutement, outplacement, exec personal branding…) qui
accompagne la transformation des organisations depuis 2017. Elle intervient principalement dans les domaines de l’IA, de la data science et des systèmes
d’informations. Passionnée par l’éducation et le futur du travail, elle a cofondé et préside l’Observatoire des Métiers du Futur, think-tank qui vise à impacter
positivement les entreprises et le débat public sur ce thème. Elle est lieutenante-colonelle et réserviste citoyenne auprès de l’Armée de Terre, et a été
ambassadrice numérique auprès de la Commission Européenne. Elle a publié Les métiers du Futur aux éditions FIRST en 2019, et Emploi 4.0 aux éditions
Atlande en 2021. Enfin, elle est l’hôtesse du podcast Les métiers du Futur depuis 2021, qui dépasse désormais les 110 000 écoutes et totalise plus de 140
épisodes. Sa parfaite connaissance de l’univers de la Tech et sa vision prospective des métiers et de l’emploi l’amènent aujourd’hui à siéger au conseil
d’administration de la Villa Numéris (think-tank digital européen) et de la Conférence des Grandes Ecoles (CGE). Isabelle est aussi business angel,
investissant dans des start-ups en amorçage dans le domaine du digital et de l’impact, en particulier via 50 Partners et GENERATIONS powered by EDHEC.

tracks.name: Building Heat Treatment Plants in Odoo: Automating ETO Manufacturing with 20,000 BoMs
tracks.speaker_line: Nadja Planic, Head of Manufacturing ERP Consulting at much. Consulting
tracks.description_text:
In Engineering-to-Order (ETO) manufacturing, the transition from design to production often breaks down when teams rely on disconnected spreadsheets. Kohnle, a manufacturer of industrial heat treatment plants, experienced this firsthand. They managed a large catalog of 45,000 products and 20,000 Bills of Materials (BoMs) using manual cost calculations in Excel and static quotes in Word. These media breaks forced the team into time-consuming data re-entry, causing procurement errors that directly threatened project timelines.
To resolve this, we consolidated their entire engineering and manufacturing logic into Odoo Enterprise, utilizing Analytical Accounting and PLM to enforce a rigid "Release-to-Manufacture" process and cost control.
Additionally, with automatic task creation and bidirectional data synchronization from Manufacturing Orders into the Project App, we transformed static manufacturing data into dynamic project milestones. This architecture allows Kohnle to manage dependencies and resource planning within the Odoo Gantt view, providing a real-time overview of their complex engineering projects.
Key Points of the Talk:
- Leaving Spreadsheets Behind: How Kohnle moved 45,000 products and 20,000 BoMs from fragmented media into one unified system.
- Structuring the Engineering Handover: How we implemented Odoo BoM releases to create a clear process for sending designs to production.
- Connecting Production to Planning: Automatically creating Project Tasks from Manufacturing Orders to keep long-term schedules up to date.
- Building Digital Guardrails: Enforcing data integrity via granular access rights during cross-department handovers.
- Closing the Gaps: Eliminating manual media breaks between cost calculation, quoting, and production execution.
Key Learnings:
- How to bridge the functional gap between PLM engineering and MRP production.
- How to automate project-based manufacturing using Odoo’s native task-sync logic.
- How to manage large-scale data migrations without losing BoM hierarchy.
- How to configure Odoo Enterprise to handle complex ETO timeline dependencies.
Target Audience:
- Operations Managers and CTOs in Engineering/Manufacturing.
- Project Leads managing complex ETO cycles in Odoo Enterprise.
- Functional Consultants specialized in PLM and MRP integrations.

speakers.name: Nadja Planic
speakers.biography_text: Nadja Planic is the Head of Manufacturing ERP Consulting at much. Consulting. She leads the team focusing on the conception, implementation, and optimization of ERP projects. Nadja has extensive expertise with compliance and quality topics in Odoo, leading projects for manufacturing-heavy companies with highly compliance-sensitive processes, ensuring they meet stringent industry standards.

tracks.name: Effortless shift scheduling

tracks.description_text: From creating schedules in seconds to adapting to last-minute changes, Odoo Planning makes workforce management effortless. Join us to explore shift templates, auto-planning, smart communication tools, shift swapping, and powerful reporting that helps you optimize staffing, control costs, and keep your teams aligned.

tracks.name: Quoi de neuf dans PdV pour les restaurants ?
tracks.speaker_line: Roch de Vidts (rodv), Guillaume Staumont (gust) from Odoo
tracks.description_text:
Découvrons ensemble les dernières nouveautés d’Odoo Point de Vente pour les restaurants !
Nous sommes ravis de vous présenter le tout nouvel éditeur de plan de salle, une interface POS entièrement repensée, la conversion automatique des menus combinés ainsi qu’une gestion des services optimisée. Découvrez comment ces améliorations majeures, et bien d’autres encore, permettent d’optimiser les opérations, que vous gériez un café convivial, un food truck à fort débit, un pub animé ou un restaurant gastronomique.

tracks.speaker_line: Alina Lisnenko, Business Analyst at ERP Ukraine LLC

tracks.name: Meet your new accounting assistant powered by AI
tracks.speaker_line: Yannis Chaouch from Odoo
tracks.description_text:
Meet your new Accounting Assistant powered by AI
Accounting data is only valuable when you can access it, understand it, and act on it quickly. In this talk, we will introduce the new Odoo Accounting Assistant powered by AI: a smart companion that helps you search, summarize, structure, and analyze the information stored in your database.
From finding the right figures in seconds to creating graphs, highlighting trends, preparing clear summaries, and suggesting next steps, the assistant turns accounting data into actionable insights. The goal is simple: less time spent digging through records, more visibility on your business, and better decisions with confidence.

tracks.name: From Salesforce to Odoo: Rebuilding a Healthcare Platform for Scale and Cost Efficiency
tracks.speaker_line: Faisal Basar, CEO at Bista Solutions
tracks.description_text:
This talk explores how MenMD, a U.S.-based digital healthcare platform, successfully transitioned from Salesforce to a fully customized Odoo ERP solution, implemented by Bista Solutions Inc.. Facing rising software costs, fragmented systems, and an urgent contract renewal deadline, MenMD needed to replace Salesforce while improving scalability, operational control, and compliance. The result was a unified platform that reduced overall software costs by approximately 75% while supporting continued growth.
Attendees will gain insight into how Odoo was tailored to support complex healthcare workflows, including HIPAA-compliant architecture, patient and doctor portals, prescription management, appointment scheduling, and subscription-based services. The session will also highlight key challenges such as securely migrating sensitive patient data, handling edge cases in prescription workflows, and building custom payment and access control processes.
Key learnings include how to replace a costly CRM with a full ERP, strategies for managing compliance and data security in healthcare environments, and how to execute a large-scale implementation under strict time constraints. This talk is ideal for healthcare providers, digital health platforms, and operations and IT leaders looking to reduce costs, unify systems, and scale efficiently with Odoo.

speakers.name: Faisal Basar
speakers.biography_text:
Faisal Basar is the CEO and co-founder of Bista Solutions Inc. An innovative and approachable leader, he is passionate about leveraging technology to solve complex, real-world business challenges.
With over 25 years of experience, Faisal combines a strong educational foundation with hands-on expertise to design and deliver impactful solutions. He has a proven track record of building innovative systems across the consumer health and enterprise sectors, helping organizations modernize operations and scale effectively.
As a subject-matter expert in ERP software solutions, Faisal brings expertise in artificial intelligence and machine learning, enabling businesses to adopt forward-looking technologies that drive efficiency and growth.

tracks.name: How to streamline the unavoidable in E-Commerce: fully integrated and highly automated returns processing with Odoo
tracks.speaker_line: Iva Shtembari, Full Stack Consultant at bobco GmbH
tracks.description_text:
Most e-commerce teams think of returns as a warehouse process. A product comes back, a return transfer is validated, and inventory is updated.
But at scale, that is only a small part of the story.
A real return touches customer service, warehouse operations, accounting, payments, eCom, helpdesk, inventory valuation, refund rules, restocking fees, scrapping, and exception handling. If those steps are spread across multiple screens and manual decisions, returns become slow, error-prone, and frustrating for both customers and internal teams.
In this talk, I’ll show how we designed a scalable return workflow in Odoo for high-volume e-commerce operations. The pattern starts with a simple idea: use return categories as the operational decision point. From there, Odoo can decide whether to create a normal return, scrap products immediately, auto-create credit memos, apply restocking fees, trigger Shopify refunds, or route exceptions to the right team.
This talk is about designing the full after-sales loop in Odoo: return intake, warehouse processing, refund accounting, payment execution, and exception management.
What you’ll learn:
- Why returns should be modeled as an end-to-end after-sales workflow, not just a reverse picking.
- How return categories can drive automation across warehouse, accounting, and customer service.
- How to reduce manual return handling without removing operational control.
- How to design credit memo automation safely, including exclusions, restocking fees, and draft/auto-confirm logic.
- How Shopify refund automation can be connected to posted credit memos.
- Where to use activities, Helpdesk tickets, chatter, and operational views for return exceptions.

speakers.name: Iva Shtembari
speakers.biography_text: Iva is a Full Stack Consultant at bobco GmbH, a Berlin-based ERP agency specializing in Odoo implementations for high-growth e-commerce and operationally complex companies. Iva's work focuses on turning messy real-world operations into clean, maintainable Odoo workflows.

tracks.name: Support unlocked: Discover the Odoo way
tracks.speaker_line: Aurore Lesage, Head of Business Support at Odoo
tracks.description_text:
This session takes a behind-the-scenes look at Odoo Support, explaining how our teams operate and how we deliver assistance to both customers and partners. We will explore what makes Odoo Support different from traditional customer service organizations, considering both the employee perspective and the customer experience.
The presentation will begin with a brief overview of Odoo’s service offering and where Support fits within the broader organization. It will then clarify the distinction between Success Packs and Support, before explaining how the Support team works on a daily basis, including the scale of our global organization and the number of support engineers across Odoo offices. We will also cover the scope of our coverage, available 21.5 hours a day, six days a week, and walk through the different ways users can reach us, including phone, live support, and ticketing. Finally, the session will highlight Odoo’s preventive support approach and how it helps customers avoid issues before they impact their business.
By the end of the session, attendees will have a clear understanding of how Odoo Support is organized, how we collaborate internally, and how we provide a responsive and proactive support experience to our customers and partners worldwide.

speakers.name: Aurore Lesage
speakers.biography_text:
Aurore began her journey at Odoo 14 years ago as an Office Officer, where she collaborated closely with all departments - Accounting, HR, Sales, Consulting, and R&D. This role gave her a deep understanding of the company and its people. She later transitioned into a Business Analyst position, implementing Odoo solutions for clients both in Belgium and internationally.
At the time, customer support was more of a concept than an established function, so Aurore took on the challenge of creating, shaping and improving Odoo’s Customer Service. Through years of dedication and hard work, she now leads Odoo’s Worldwide Support, overseeing operations across 8 countries.

tracks.name: Boostez vos ventes grâce à nos outils intuitifs de commande en libre-service
