tracks.name: How do we know Odoo AI workflows still work?
tracks.speaker_line: Andrzej Pietrusiak, Software developer at Odoo
tracks.description_text:
You shipped an AI feature. It works today. But what happens when the prompt changes, the model evolves, the business logic moves, or user expectations become clearer? Are you supposed to manually open every flow and check whether the AI still behaves correctly?
This talk presents a practical approach to evaluating AI workflows in Odoo through repeatable scenarios and lightweight benchmarks. We will look at how to run AI flows automatically, compare results over time, catch regressions faster, all that helps developers improve AI features with more confidence.
The goal is simple: make AI features easier to maintain.

tracks.name: From Odoo to Everywhere : Selling Across Marketplaces with Shoppingfeed
tracks.speaker_line: Arnaud Percy, CEO at tsc - The Service Company SRL
tracks.description_text:
Many companies using Odoo want to expand their online sales beyond their own webshop and start selling on marketplaces such as la fnac, Bol.com, décathlon or eBay. However, managing multiple sales channels can quickly become complex without the right tools and integrations.
In this talk, Matthieu De Clercq from The Service Company will present how Odoo can be connected to Shoppingfeed to create a powerful multichannel commerce setup. The session will explain how Odoo acts as the central ERP to manage products, prices, stock and orders, while Shoppingfeed distributes product data to hundreds of marketplaces and marketing channels.
Through a real implementation example, we will demonstrate how this integration simplifies catalog management, synchronizes inventory across channels, and automatically brings marketplace orders back into Odoo. Attendees will gain insights into the architecture of the integration, the business benefits for merchants, and best practices for scaling marketplace operations with Odoo.
This talk is aimed at Odoo partners, integrators, and merchants who want to develop an efficient omnichannel strategy while keeping Odoo as the central source of truth.
(More info :
https://shoppingfeed.com/fr/migrer-vers-shoppingfeed)

speakers.name: Arnaud Percy
speakers.biography_text: Arnaud Percy is a Belgian entrepreneur and the founder and CEO of The Service Company, a firm specialized in digital transformation and the implementation of business management solutions such as Odoo ERP. With a strong interest in technology and entrepreneurship, he has over a decade of experience launching and developing innovative projects. After creating several businesses in Belgium, including a virtual reality entertainment center, he recognized the challenges many SMEs face when adopting digital tools. tracks.name: Setting Up Odoo for Long-Term Rental: Products, Contracts & Automated recurring Billing
tracks.speaker_line: Tom Sandinha, Odoo Senior Functionnal Consultant at Scalizer
tracks.description_text:
Long-term rental (LTR) is a specific business model that requires precise configuration in Odoo to handle recurring contracts and automated monthly invoicing reliably. Yet many implementations struggle with the same recurring issues: incorrect billing cycles, manual workarounds, and a product setup that doesn't reflect the rental reality.
This session walks through the full functional setup of Odoo for a long-term rental activity, based on a real implementation. Participants will learn how to structure rental products correctly, configure contracts with defined durations and pricing terms, and leverage Odoo's invoicing features to automate recurring monthly billing — without custom development.
Key takeaways include: how to configure products specifically for LTR use cases, which invoicing settings have the biggest impact on billing accuracy, and how to handle common edge cases such as contract renewals, early terminations, and prorated periods.
The value for the audience lies in understanding the full functional chain — not just isolated settings — and walking away with a clear, battle-tested configuration blueprint ready to apply in real projects.
This talk is aimed at Odoo functional consultants, IT managers, and operations teams working in or with companies offering vehicle or equipment rental on long-term contracts.

speakers.name: Tom Sandinha
speakers.biography_text: Tom Sandinha is a Senior Functional Consultant at Scalizer, a French consulting firm specializing in ERP and CRM implementations. With 3 years of Odoo experience, Tom built his expertise around no-code client onboarding on Odoo Online — a discipline that demands a deep mastery of standard mechanisms to translate real business needs without a single line of custom code. That same philosophy drives his work on long-term rental: at Odoo Experience 2026, he shares how a well-configured Odoo out-of-the-box can fully support LTR contracts and automated monthly billing.

tracks.name: Stop Writing AI Prompts by Hand: Building a Self-Fixing Native AI Loop in Odoo 19
tracks.speaker_line: Mike Schulz, Senior Expert ERP Consultant at much. Consulting
tracks.description_text:
Static AI prompts lose accuracy quickly as new business edge cases pop up, forcing admins to constantly rewrite them. When routing Helpdesk tickets or scoring CRM leads, the AI often guesses wrong. Users fix these mistakes daily, but the system forgets the corrections, forcing people to fix the same errors over and over.
To solve this, we built a two-agent system that learns from its mistakes, using only standard Odoo Enterprise v19 AI features. We set this up entirely using Odoo Studio and server actions—no custom Python code required. When a user changes an AI-generated field—like fixing a wrong ticket priority—a second background AI immediately notices the change. This second AI looks at why the user made the change and automatically rewrites the first AI's instructions so it gets it right the next time.
By feeding human corrections directly back into the system, we completely stopped writing AI prompts by hand in our testing environment. This setup matches AI outputs directly to real human actions, allowing CRM and Helpdesk automation to run without constant admin upkeep.
Key Points of this Talk:
- Set up two-part AI loops using built-in Odoo Enterprise v19 AI functions.
- Record manual field changes to trigger background AI updates.
- Use Odoo Studio to automate AI prompt changes without custom Python code.
- Build server actions to update AI prompts automatically on the fly.
- Apply self-correcting loops to CRM lead scoring and Helpdesk ticket routing.
Key Learnings:
- How to build an AI loop that fixes itself using Odoo Enterprise v19 features.
- How to use manual field edits to train a background AI assistant.
- How to stop writing AI prompts by hand using Odoo server actions.
- How to use Odoo Studio to manage multi-step AI setups.
Target Audience:
Business Leaders, System Administrators, and Implementation Managers using Odoo Enterprise v19+

speakers.name: Mike Schulz
speakers.biography_text: Mike Schulz is a Senior Expert ERP Consultant at much. Consulting, an Odoo Gold Partner, with offices in Germany, Portugal, and the UK. He helps companies of all sizes to drive growth and improve business processes with innovative Odoo Solutions. Mike is an expert in process automation and digital strategy, having successfully implemented countless Odoo projects to streamline operations and enhance efficiency.

tracks.name: Découvrez votre nouvel assistant comptable propulsé par l'IA
tracks.speaker_line: Grégory Bellemont from Odoo
tracks.description_text:
Préparez-vous à découvrir l'avenir de la finance grâce au framework d'IA profondément intégré d'Odoo 20, conçu pour être votre assistant stratégique par excellence.
En accédant aux données structurées de l'ensemble de votre ERP, nos nouveaux agents d'IA s'appuient sur un contexte métier approfondi pour vous aider à interpréter des données complexes, à automatiser les clôtures de fin de mois et à vérifier sans effort les tâches de conformité telles que les déclarations de TVA.

tracks.name: Manage your restaurant straight from your pocket
tracks.speaker_line: Corentin Neirynck from Odoo
tracks.description_text:
What if your waiters could run the entire restaurant from a single device in their pocket?
In this session, we'll explore how a mobile-first PoS transforms restaurant operations by giving staff everything they need directly on their smartphone. From taking orders and sending them instantly to the kitchen, to processing payments on the spot through integrated payment providers. Every step becomes faster and more efficient.
We'll demonstrate how this approach reduces unnecessary trips, speeds up table turnover, minimizes errors and improves the customer experience. Discover how empowering waiters with a fully integrated mobile PoS helps restaurants save time, increase productivity and focus on what matters most: delivering exceptional service.

tracks.name: Odoo for energy suppliers - How Ecopower replaced SAP with a connected Odoo platform
tracks.speaker_line: Evelien Coomans with Ecopower, Project manager at Dynapps
tracks.description_text:
Ecopower, a Belgian renewable energy cooperative, replaced SAP with Odoo for its full back office: finance, CRM, helpdesk and a custom share register. Odoo is connected to Nimbu (member-facing website) and Haugazel (Haulogy energy billing and contracts). Ecopower joins on stage to share what the migration meant for their teams.
What we  will cover
Why an energy supplier moves off SAP, and what an ERP needs to deliver in this sector.
The architecture: Odoo at the core, connected to Nimbu and Haugazel via FastAPI and webhooks.
The cooperative-specific build: share register inside Odoo.
The customer perspective: Ecopower on the migration journey.

tracks.speaker_line: Raphaël Moreau from Odoo

La facturation électronique change la donne et Odoo 20 passe à la vitesse supérieure en combinant les données structurées à l'IA pour traiter les factures en un clin d'œil.

Dites adieu aux documents manquants et aux fraudes à la facturation, car vos factures arrivent désormais directement dans une boîte de réception virtuelle sécurisée où l'identité des expéditeurs est strictement vérifiée. Découvrez comment ce format standardisé et sécurisé garantit non seulement l'exactitude des données, mais ouvre également la voie à des cycles de paiement beaucoup plus rapides.

tracks.name: Empowering customers in Helpdesk operations
tracks.speaker_line: Edmond De Ruyter, Business Analyst at Odoo

Discover how Odoo Helpdesk helps customers find answers instantly through the Help Center, AI-powered Live Chat, self-service tools, and the My Account portal, delivering faster support while reducing the workload on your team.

tracks.name: The Global Myth: Why one-size-fits-all doesn’t work in Europe
tracks.speaker_line: Rogier Schoute, Chief Product Officer and Board Member at Mollie at Mollie
tracks.description_text:
The playbook for scaling a technology company sounds simple: build one great product, standardise it, and take it everywhere. Mollie’s journey across Europe tells a different story.
What started as one entrepreneur solving a local payments problem has grown into a European technology company by confronting a fundamental challenge: how do you scale without becoming generic?
Drawing on Mollie’s own growth story, CPO and Board Member Rogier Schoute explores how leaders can decide what to standardise, what needs to stay local, and how to absorb complexity inside the business rather than pass it on to customers. From hyper-localisation across European markets to connecting online and in-person commerce, he shares the product principles behind growing across a fragmented continent while staying close to the people and businesses you serve.
Because in Europe, scale isn’t about making every market the same. It’s about knowing which differences matter.

tracks.speaker_line: Dawid Adamski from Odoo

tracks.name: E-Invoicing unleashed: Compliance meets automation
tracks.speaker_line: Jérôme Adnet (jea) from Odoo
tracks.description_text: Mandatory e-Invoicing is coming everywhere — but there’s no need to stress. With Odoo and Peppol, compliance is 100% free, automatic, and seamless. In this talk, we’ll explain what Peppol is, why it matters, and show you step-by-step how to get everything set up in Odoo.

speakers.name: Jérôme Adnet (jea)
speakers.biography_text:
Jérôme
began his career at a consultancy firm, first in Luxembourg and then in Belgium, before joining the Business Analysts team at Odoo, where he has been working for over six years. Drawing on his background in accounting and his practical experience, he tackles complex financial issues as part of MMC projects. This expertise also enables him to work closely with the R&D teams to contribute to the continuous improvement of the product.

tracks.name: One Patented Onboarding, 28 AI Colleagues, Zero Spreadsheets: Odoo as the Backbone of the Self-Driving SMB
tracks.speaker_line: Daniel Heinen, CEO at HEINI IP GmbH
tracks.description_text:
What if an entire mid-sized company — purchasing, sales, accounting, fulfillment, compliance, marketing — could be run by a team of 28 AI colleagues, with Odoo as the single source of truth underneath?
In this session we show how we turned Odoo's data layer and AI capabilities into the backbone of a fully agentic system. Each colleague perceives, proposes, and acts — but never without a human "yes" (patented human-in-the-loop governance). Onboarding a new tenant takes minutes, not months, thanks to a patented onboarding flow that provisions a complete Odoo stack automatically.
And it's more than agents: an Enterprise PIM ships in the box, and EU Digital Product Passports (ESPR) are generated automatically from your product data — compliance without extra work. Patent protected.
Odoo partners will leave knowing why an agentic layer is the next migration magnet — and how to position it. Live demo included.

speakers.name: Daniel Heinen
speakers.biography_text: Daniel Heinen has served on the board of Bundesblock (German Blockchain Association) since 2022 and sits on the supervisory board of Blockchain Europe, the joint venture of Fraunhofer and TU Dortmund University. A trained business economist and serial entrepreneur, he is the inventor and founder of HEINI — a patent-protected, agentic AI platform that turns Odoo into the backbone of a self-running company. He combines deep blockchain governance experience with a hands-on builder's mindset, translating emerging technology into practical tools for the German Mittelstand. Daniel is also a proud father of five.

tracks.name: Best Practices for Successful Odoo Implementations in Manufacturing
tracks.speaker_line: Melody Fetterly, Solutions Architect at QOC Innovations
tracks.description_text:
Implementing an ERP in a manufacturing environment is about far more than configuring software; it's about aligning people, processes, and technology to improve how your business operates.
Drawing on over 400 years of combined manufacturing experience and hundreds of successful Odoo projects, the QOC Innovations team will share the best practices we've seen consistently lead to successful manufacturing implementations. From discovery and process design to production planning, inventory management, change management, and go-live, this session focuses on the decisions that have the biggest impact on long-term success.
You'll learn where manufacturers commonly struggle, how to avoid costly implementation mistakes, and why understanding shop floor operations is just as important as understanding the ERP itself. We'll also share practical lessons from real customer engagements that have helped manufacturers streamline operations, improve visibility, and build a stronger foundation for growth.
Whether you're evaluating Odoo, preparing for an implementation, or looking to optimize an existing system, you'll leave with actionable strategies to reduce project risk, improve adoption, and maximize the value of your ERP investment. This session is designed for manufacturers, operations leaders, project managers, and executives responsible for digital transformation.

speakers.name: Melody Fetterly
speakers.biography_text: As a Solutions Architect at QOC Innovations, Melody partners directly with clients to assess operational challenges, design scalable solutions, and guide digital transformation initiatives that drive measurable results with Odoo. With a focus on efficiency, alignment, and execution, she ensures every engagement delivers tangible business value and a foundation for sustainable growth.

tracks.name: Pilotez votre restaurant depuis votre smartphone
tracks.speaker_line: Léopold Cantraine from Odoo
tracks.description_text:
What if your waiters could run the entire restaurant from a single device in their pocket?
In this session, we'll explore how a mobile-first PoS transforms restaurant operations by giving staff everything they need directly on their smartphone. From taking orders and sending them instantly to the kitchen, to processing payments on the spot through integrated payment providers. Every step becomes faster and more efficient.
We'll demonstrate how this approach reduces unnecessary trips, speeds up table turnover, minimizes errors and improves the customer experience. Discover how empowering waiters with a fully integrated mobile PoS helps restaurants save time, increase productivity and focus on what matters most: delivering exceptional service.

tracks.name: Turning Complex Science into Videos People Actually Understand
tracks.speaker_line: Kurzgesagt
tracks.description_text: KG has turned complex scientific topics into some of the most-watched educational videos on the internet. This talk reveals the creative process behind it, from choosing a topic and writing a script non-experts can follow to the studio’s distinctive visual style, and what it takes to produce trustworthy, engaging science content.

tracks.name: Help your students level up with the Take Off textbook
tracks.speaker_line: Claire Liétaert & Marianne de Saint Moulain, Odoo Education Officer at Odoo
tracks.description_text:
Note: This talk will be held in French.
Discover the new Take Off textbook, a 9-chapter teaching resource that combines theory with practice. 

Thanks to its numerous practical applications and self-study exercises, secondary school students not only learn business management practices, but also how to manage tasks independently on Odoo.

In this presentation, we’ll show you what you can expect from Take Off and demonstrate how to use it. All you’ll need to do is download it to incorporate it into your lessons right away.

speakers.name: Claire Liétaert & Marianne de Saint Moulain
speakers.biography_text:
Marianne de Saint Moulin and Claire Liétaert are part of the
Odoo Education team
, where they work with schools, teachers and students to make business software more accessible, practical and engaging.
Through initiatives such as
LabOdoo, educational workshops and the Odoo Student Bootcamp
, they help students discover how real business processes come together in Odoo through hands-on experiences. Their work focuses on connecting education with the skills and tools students will encounter in the professional world.

tracks.name: Driving efficiency in complex, custom manufacturing workflows : the Bedimo and Idealis success story
tracks.speaker_line: Florian Dreyfus, Business Analyst at Idealis Consulting
tracks.description_text:
Bedimo is a Belgian company specialized in designing, furnishing and implementing engaging and sustainable work environments. This demanding business requires agile tools to manage a huge catalog of (custom-made) furnishings, their always-in-motion inventory as well the manufacturing and delivery of those products. All the while, these implementation projects often lasting several months need to be monitored and their profitability accounted for.
Discover how Odoo tends to those specific needs, as well as how the switch from the legacy software to Odoo was made without loss of data on ongoing projects.
Key takeaways from this session :
- Fully integrated business workflow : from the salesperson to the manufacturing crew, to the warehouse crew, to the delivery crew, to the accounting department.
- Migrating data from ongoing, long-lasting projects from legacy software to Odoo
Target Audience : Manufacturing and Inventory managers (in the furnishing industry or with similar custom-made, long-lasting projects).

speakers.name: Florian Dreyfus
speakers.biography_text: Florian Dreyfus is an experienced ERP Project Manager and Business Analyst at Idealis Consulting. With over eight years of expertise navigating complex, long-lasting enterprise implementations, he excels at challenging and bridging intricate business needs with functional ERP solutions. Leveraging soft skills such as his ability to deeply understand and connect with his clients and their needs, Florian manages project scopes, tracks risks, and aligns multi-department workflows, ensuring successful and truly impactful ERP implementations.

tracks.name: Ask Me Anything about Accounting
tracks.speaker_line: Benjamin Stienon & Wynand Tastenhoye from Odoo
tracks.description_text:
Got burning questions about Odoo Accounting?
Join us for an interactive, unscripted Q&A session. Bring your real-world scenarios, feature requests, and tough edge cases—no slides, just direct answers from the product and business perspectives.

tracks.name: Agentic AI-Driven SAP HANA to Odoo Migration at Scale with Zero-Downtime
tracks.speaker_line: Om Prakash Maurya, Delivery Head - CRM & ERP at Ksolves IT USA Inc.
tracks.description_text:
As organizations outgrow the rigidity and rising costs of SAP HANA, Odoo is emerging as the strategic alternative, but migration is rarely straightforward.
This talk reveals how:
- AI intelligently maps SAP HANA data structures, flags field conflicts, and auto-generates assessment reports, dramatically reducing manual analysis effort.
- Agentic AI takes it further by autonomously orchestrating zero-downtime cutovers, continuously scoring migration risk, and escalating issues in real time, compressing go-live timelines to as little as weeks.
- Post-migration agents run autonomously in the background, monitoring data integrity and surfacing reconciliation gaps before they become production incidents, ensuring a smooth transition without requiring constant manual oversight.
Ideal for people and organizations that want to move away from SAP because of escalating costs but remain concerned about losing historical business data, disrupting operations, or undertaking a complex migration.
Key Learnings:
- The hidden cost of staying on SAP HANA, and the ROI case for switching.
- How AI agents compress a months-long migration into weeks without downtime.
- Real pitfalls, honest limitations, and what actually makes a go-live succeed.

speakers.name: Om Prakash Maurya
speakers.biography_text:
Om Prakash Maurya is the Delivery Head - CRM and ERP at Ksolves India Limited, leading a team of 150+ Odoo professionals to ensure successful, high-quality project delivery. With a deep understanding of Odoo, he drives end-to-end execution across diverse industries.
Om specializes in aligning technology with business goals, overseeing solution architecture, resource management, and client satisfaction. His expertise also extends to Kubernetes, DevOps, and server configuration, enabling scalable, efficient deployments. Passionate about innovation and operational excellence, he plays a key role in driving digital transformation for global clients through Odoo and cutting-edge open-source technologies.

tracks.name: Outperform 95% of Bankers with Passive Investing
tracks.speaker_line: Grégory Guilmin, Founder at La Bourse: Make it Easy
tracks.description_text:
In this 30-minute talk, you will discover why most investors underperform, the key differences between active and passive investing, and a clear 5-step plan to build a robust portfolio using low-cost ETFs.
Grégory will also share his biggest investing mistakes, practical tools to get started, and—if time allows—even invest live with you.

speakers.name: Grégory Guilmin
speakers.biography_text: Grégory Guilmin, former fund manager and PhD in Finance, shares a simple yet powerful approach to take control of your investments. In a world where high fees quietly erode your returns and pension systems are under pressure, learning how to invest efficiently has never been more important.

tracks.name: Log time in seconds thanks to the Timesheet Assistant
tracks.speaker_line: Lucas Spasky from Odoo
tracks.description_text:
Discover the
new Timesheet Assistant
and learn how it can simplify time tracking through automatic activity tracking and smart suggestions, reducing the burden of manual timesheet encoding.
We’ll explore how to install,configure and use the feature. We'll highlight its key benefits and investigate the security side of it.

speakers.name: Lucas Spasky
speakers.biography_text: With two and a half year at Odoo under het belt as a Business Analyst, Lucas Spasky is now a proud member of the Service Expertise team. As a business analyst, Lucas is responsible for managing Odoo implementations with several clients accross multiple industries. As an expert, Lucas is managing more complex project, provides internal support to the team of business analysts and shares knowledge both internally and externally for partners and the whole Odoo community.

tracks.name: "Simplifying the Heavy“ – Odoo for Specialized Rental Workflows
tracks.speaker_line: Tim Freudenthal from HLR Group B.V.
tracks.description_text:
HLR GmbH, a young company based in Hamburg, has been focusing on the rental of highly specialized lifting and hoisting technology such as hydraulic cylinders, chain hoists and slings since 2023. With just 13 employees but in-depth industry expertise, HLR is pursuing ambitious growth plans - supported by a digital infrastructure that needs to be as flexible as its products. In this talk, Tim Freudenthal (HLR GmbH) and Reiner Hannaske (Intero Technologies GmbH) provide practical insights into the introduction of Odoo as a central company platform. They will show how Odoo has become the mainstay of day-to-day business with individually customizable rental periods, complex serial number and warehouse management and the documentation of test certificates.
Special attention is paid to the step-by-step approach: from the requirements workshop to MVP implementation and continuous further development - all with one clear goal: efficient, scalable processes in one system. An inspiring experience report for anyone who wants to master industry-specific complexity with digital ease.

speakers.name: Tim Freudenthal
speakers.biography_text: Tim Freudenthal is co-founder and Managing Director of HLR GmbH, a dynamic company from Hamburg that specializes in the rental of highly specialized lifting and hoisting technology. With a clear focus on quality, safety and flexibility, he has made it his mission to combine proven technical solutions with digital innovation. As an engineer with many years of experience in the industry, Tim knows the challenges of the operational business just as well as the need for efficient processes. Together with his team, he has actively shaped the digital transformation at HLR - and established Odoo, a platform that combines all central processes in one system. In his talk, he provides authentic insights into the practical side of things: from individual rental processes and the management of technical documentation to multi-level warehouse logistics. He will show how digitalization not only improves internal processes, but also enhances the customer experience.

tracks.name: J'ai gagné 10h par semaine avec Odoo
tracks.speaker_line: Fatima Molina, CEO at The Repere
tracks.description_text:
Jongler entre plusieurs activités, c’est souvent faire face à un casse-tête quotidien : comment déléguer efficacement sans perdre le contrôle, et surtout, comment former ses équipes lorsque les outils informatiques se multiplient ?
Dans ce talk, Fatima s'appuiera sur son expérience de terrain pour exposer les freins et la complexité opérationnelle auxquels elle a été confrontée. Elle détaillera ensuite le virage stratégique opéré grâce à la centralisation de ses processus avec Odoo.
Un retour d'expérience concret et inspirant, pensé pour tous ceux qui cherchent à harmoniser leurs outils, simplifier le travail de leurs équipes et, in fine, réinventer leur gestion du temps.

tracks.name: Fluidifiez les commandes de votre point de vente grâce aux nouveaux Préréglages
tracks.speaker_line: Méline Praile (mepra) from Odoo
tracks.description_text: This Odoo Experience presentation will highlight the new Point of Sale presets in version 20, specifically designed to optimize dine-in, take-out, and delivery management. The objective is to demonstrate how this feature simplifies daily operations for retailers and restaurateurs by instantly automating changes to fiscal positions and pricelists with a single click. Particular emphasis will be placed on the new delivery features, which now offer a much more advanced and precise configuration to perfectly match logistical constraints.

speakers.name: Méline Praile (mepra)
speakers.biography_text:
Hi everyone, I’m Méline!
I launched my professional career directly at Odoo as a Business Analyst, where I am now dedicated to helping the HORECA sector thrive. Eager to learn and grow within the company, I love leveraging both my academic background and my practical experience from working in an Italian restaurant, which gave me a firsthand understanding of the hospitality industry.

tracks.name: Streamline your POS orders thanks to the rebranded Presets
tracks.speaker_line: Lieselot Nauwelaers (lina) from Odoo
tracks.description_text: This Odoo Experience presentation will highlight the new Point of Sale presets in version 20, specifically designed to optimize dine-in, take-out, and delivery management. The objective is to demonstrate how this feature simplifies daily operations for retailers and restaurateurs by instantly automating changes to fiscal positions and pricelists with a single click. Particular emphasis will be placed on the new delivery features, which now offer a much more advanced and precise configuration to perfectly match logistical constraints.

tracks.name: Advanced sales commission plans
tracks.speaker_line: Fabrice Henrion, R&D at Odoo
tracks.description_text:
This talk will go over multiple advanced sales commissions scenarios and demonstrate the new features of the sales commission module.
Set up tiered plans with varying accelerators and thresholds.
Commission managers based on their team's performance.
Commission multiple salespeople differently for one common sale.
Ensure you won't pay a salesperson twice for the same sale.

tracks.name: Bankable Business - What the Best Entrepreneurs Do Differently When Dealing with Banks and Investment Funds.
tracks.speaker_line: Solenne Niedercorn-Desouches
tracks.description_text: Profitability alone doesn't make a company investable. In this session, Solenne Niedercorn-Desouches, founder of Finscale and lecturer at HEC Paris, opens the black box of how banks and investment funds actually read a company's file. Drawing on years of conversations with GPs, bankers and CFOs, she walks entrepreneurs through what financiers really look for beyond the numbers: how investor expectations differ from banking logic, which financial structuring choices signal maturity, which metrics actually matter, and why trust and narrative can outweigh a strong balance sheet. A practical, myth-busting session for founders who want to stop pitching blind and start speaking the language their financiers already use.

tracks.name: Comptabilité : vos questions, nos réponses
tracks.speaker_line: Olivier Maessen & Raphaël Moreau, Product Owner Accounting at Odoo

tracks.name: Odoo Security 101: The basics every developer pay attention to
tracks.speaker_line: Bram Van Gaal (brvg) from Odoo

tracks.name: Odoo Studio: Best practices for customization made easy
tracks.speaker_line: Jade Spineux, Business Analyst at Odoo
tracks.description_text: Master the art of customizing your Odoo database without creating an upgrade nightmare! We will explore best practices for Odoo Studio, efficient automated actions, and the new 20.0 access rights, giving you a clear roadmap to keep your system scalable, performant, and easy to maintain.

tracks.name: Automating the Impossible: Heuristic MRP Scheduling for Mid-Sized Companies inside the Odoo Core
tracks.speaker_line: Bernhard Hilfer, ERP Consultant at much. Consulting
tracks.description_text:
In mid-sized manufacturing, successfully processing deep Bills of Materials depends on flawless dependency scheduling. However, manually scheduling thousands of interdependent Work Orders is practically impossible. The inevitable consequences are a cluttered shop floor overflowing with Work-in-Progress (WIP), hidden bottlenecks, and constantly missed delivery dates. While many companies attempt to solve this chaos through costly integrations with external planning tools, this talk will explore a smarter alternative: building lightweight, highly practical scheduling logic directly into the Odoo Enterprise MRP core.
We will demonstrate how leveraging standard priority flags and deadline fields can automatically schedule operations against actual machine capacity. Running these high-volume calculations takes seconds and immediately populates standard Odoo Gantt views with accurate forecasts.
Attendees will walk away with a deep understanding of how to eliminate friction between the sales desk and the factory floor, easily accommodate rush orders, and guarantee verifiable delivery dates - all without ever leaving their primary ERP system.
Key Points of This Talk:
- The operational impact of deep Bills of Materials on manual scheduling workflows
- Why external third-party planning tools often result in expensive data silos
- Architecture overview: embedding custom heuristic MRP logic directly into Odoo
- Aligning material allocation with machine capacity to drastically reduce physical WIP
- Visualizing high-speed capacity calculations within built-in Odoo Gantt views
- Bridging the gap: achieving operational transparency between sales and production
Key Learnings:
- Understand the technical approach to building custom scheduling logic natively in Odoo
- Learn how to utilize standard MO priority flags and deadlines to drive automated sequencing
- Discover actionable strategies to dynamically manage and schedule high-volume rush orders
- Gain the ability to translate complex production data into clear bottleneck forecasts
- Walk away with a blueprint for securing verifiable sales delivery dates based on realistic machine capacity
Target Audience:
- Manufacturing Consultants and Odoo Integrators expanding their MRP capabilities
- Production Managers targeting Mittelstand operations
- Sales Teams requiring realistic, verifiable delivery forecasting

speakers.name: Bernhard Hilfer
speakers.biography_text: Bernhard Hilfer is a manufacturing-focused ERP Consultant at much. Consulting, dedicated to helping mid-sized companies optimize their production inside Odoo Enterprise.

tracks.name: Using Odoo as the Backbone of a Long-Term Strategic Vision
tracks.speaker_line: Olivier Lambert, Directeur Général de Cefora at Squareflow S.A.
tracks.description_text:
Cefora is not a typical organization. As the training and development partner of Belgium’s largest joint committee (CP200), its mission is to help hundreds of thousands of employees continuously develop their skills and remain employable in a rapidly changing economy.
To deliver on that mission at scale, Cefora needed more than an ERP. It needed a platform capable of connecting people, services, processes, and data across an increasingly complex ecosystem.
Together with Odoo and Squareflow, Cefora embarked on a long-term digital transformation journey. What started as a modernization initiative has evolved into the foundation of a sector-wide training ecosystem, supporting everything from course management and learner engagement to operational workflows and service delivery.
Today, Odoo serves as the central platform behind Cefora's mission, integrating a growing network of digital services and enabling the organization to operate more efficiently, respond faster to changing needs, and continuously expand its impact.
And this journey is far from over. With a new CRM platform, expanded service offerings, ambassador lifecycle management, and data-driven decision-making on the roadmap, Cefora is now entering the next phase of its transformation: leveraging Odoo not only as an operational backbone, but as a platform for growth, innovation, and long-term mission activation.

speakers.name: Olivier Lambert
speakers.biography_text: Olivier Lambert est Directeur Général de Cefora depuis 2017 et ambassadeur Digital Wallonia Champion. Expert en formation, développement des compétences et transformation digitale, il cumule près de 30 ans d’expérience dans le management, le développement commercial et la conduite du changement, tant dans le secteur privé que public. Il œuvre aujourd’hui à renforcer l’employabilité et l’adaptation des entreprises aux évolutions du marché du travail.

tracks.name: Your accounting on autopilot with Odoo 20
tracks.speaker_line: Arnaud Binet from Odoo
tracks.description_text:
Say goodbye to manual input and hello to a fully automated financial workflow!
This talk will demonstrate how Odoo 20 puts your accounting on autopilot by effortlessly managing deferred entries, loans, and fixed assets with zero friction. We’ll also showcase how advanced AI predictions for accounts and analytics drastically speed up your reconciliations.
Come see how these smart automations will save your team countless hours every single month.

speakers.name: Arnaud Binet
speakers.biography_text:
Business Analyst dans l'expertise Comptabilité/Finance chez Odoo depuis 2,5 ans, Arnaud aide les clients à optimiser leurs processus financiers et à mettre en œuvre des solutions financières innovantes dans Odoo.
Avant cela, il a travaillé pendant 6 ans comme analyste financier et contrôleur de gestion dans une entreprise de consultance et de services de prestations extra-légales aux salariés.

tracks.name: Le doute comme moteur
tracks.speaker_line: GuiHome, Entrepreneur & Humoriste
tracks.description_text: GuiHome est connu pour son parcours dans l’humour. Vidéaste, comédien, humoriste sur scène, chroniqueur chez Quotidien, sociétaire aux Grosses Têtes… il jongle avec toutes ces casquettes depuis des années. Mais derrière l’humoriste se cache aussi un jeune entrepreneur passionné. Producteur de plusieurs humoristes et d’émissions de télévision, organisateur d’un festival d’humour, propriétaire de son restaurant-comedy club… GuiHome n’arrête jamais. Sur le papier, tout ressemble à une belle success story. Mais si tous ces projets n’avaient justement pas vu le jour sans ses angoisses, ses doutes, ses peurs, ses erreurs et son manque de confiance en lui ? Dans ce talk, GuiHome raconte l’envers du décor : comment ce que l’on considère souvent comme des faiblesses peut aussi devenir un moteur pour entreprendre, créer et avancer.

tracks.name: Fabriquer des satellites en Belgique : le pari d'Aerospacelab
tracks.speaker_line: Benoît Deper from Aerospacelab & Fabien Pinckaers from Odoo

speakers.name: Benoît Deper from Aerospacelab & Fabien Pinckaers from Odoo

tracks.name: From timer to assistant: How Odoo stopped asking you to press start
tracks.speaker_line: Abderraouf Ghrissi from Odoo
tracks.description_text:
For years, the Odoo timesheet meant one thing: remember to hit start on a timer, or rebuild your day from memory on Friday afternoon. We replaced that model with the Timesheet Assistant, a passive layer that watches what you actually worked on and lets you confirm it in one click instead of tracking it in real time.
This talk walks through how it's built: a local-first companion app that observes windows, browser tabs, and IDE activity on your machine, a rule engine that turns that raw activity into project and task suggestions, and an on-device learning loop that gets better at guessing without any data ever leaving your computer.

tracks.name: Votre comptabilité en pilote automatique avec Odoo 20
tracks.speaker_line: Maïko Veneziano from Odoo
tracks.description_text:
Dites adieu à la saisie manuelle et bonjour à un flux de travail financier entièrement automatisé !
Cette présentation vous montrera comment Odoo 20 met votre comptabilité sur pilote automatique en gérant sans effort et sans aucune friction les écritures différées, les prêts et les immobilisations. Nous vous montrerons également comment les prédictions avancées de l'IA pour les comptes et l'analytique accélèrent considérablement vos rapprochements.
Venez découvrir comment ces automatisations intelligentes feront gagner d'innombrables heures à votre équipe chaque mois.

tracks.name: From Inventory to True WMS: Elevating ODOO with Talk’nPick
tracks.speaker_line: Leo Hämäläinen, CEO / Devoca Oy at Devoca Oy
tracks.description_text:
Many growing companies reach a point where standard ODOO Inventory is no longer enough to support fast, accurate, and scalable warehouse operations. In this session, we will show how Talkn'Pick transforms ODOO Inventory into a true WMS-level solution — without replacing your ERP.
Talkn'Pick adds process-driven mobile workflows, real-time barcode operations, guided picking, and warehouse floor optimization directly on top of ODOO. Instead of transaction-based screens, users get operationally designed flows that reduce errors, speed up handling, and improve traceability.
We will share practical use cases, performance improvements, and architectural principles that allow companies to scale warehouse efficiency while staying fully inside the ODOO ecosystem.
If you want WMS-level performance without leaving ODOO, this session is for you.

speakers.name: Leo Hämäläinen
speakers.biography_text: With over 10 years of experience in internal logistics and warehouse process optimization, he has helped companies improve operational efficiency, accuracy, and scalability in demanding environments. His expertise spans warehouse workflows, voice picking, barcode-driven operations, and system-supported process development. For the past seven years, he has worked extensively with ODOO, focusing on enhancing its Inventory capabilities and integrating advanced mobile solutions. His work bridges practical warehouse operations with smart system design, helping organizations move from basic ERP transactions to fully optimized WMS-level performance.

tracks.name: From Shopify to Odoo: Practical migration guide
tracks.speaker_line: Clément Watthez from Odoo
tracks.description_text:
Thinking about moving your website from Shopify to Odoo? In this talk, we’ll look at how to approach the transition step by step and what to consider before getting started.
We’ll cover the main areas to think about, from your website structure and eCommerce setup to products, content, SEO, and design. We’ll also look at some of the key differences between Shopify and Odoo and how they can impact the way you approach the project.
The goal is to give you a clear and practical roadmap for planning your move to Odoo, with useful tips on what to consider, what to prepare, and what to watch out for along the way.

tracks.name: Agentic workflows: From Concept to App in 30 minutes with AI
tracks.speaker_line: Jonathan Bertholet from Odoo
tracks.description_text:
This talk explores the principles and practical realities of agentic programming: using AI agents not simply to generate code, but to plan, build, test, debug, and iterate on software.
Rather than relying on slides alone, Jonathan will demonstrate these workflows through one or more concrete projects built live on stage, showing how an idea can move from concept to working software with the help of modern coding agents.
Along the way, he will cover the tools, techniques, and best practices that make agentic development effective, as well as recent trends that are changing how software is built.

speakers.name: Jonathan Bertholet
speakers.biography_text:
Jonathan is a Product Owner at Odoo, where he is responsible for several products, including Sign, Calendar, Appointments, Activities, and Odoo Industries.
He began working with large language models since before the launch of ChatGPT and has closely followed and actively experimented with the field’s leading models ever since.
His first steps into the world of programming were made through small and simple Chrome extensions, which grew to thousands of active users, before moving on to increasingly complex projects. Jonathan now has a portfolio of more than 15 apps, websites and extensions on multiple platforms.

tracks.name: Mastering the Payroll Journal Entry with Swiss Compliance
tracks.speaker_line: Monteiro Da Silva from Sodexis Sàrl
tracks.description_text:
Are you struggling to keep your financial accounting fully aligned with Switzerland's strict, multi-layered payroll regulations? Navigating the complex ledger requirements for Swiss social security (AVS/AI/APG), occupational pensions (LPP), accidents (AANP), and canton-specific withholding taxes (impôt à la source) presents an ongoing compliance and operational challenge for financial and HR teams alike.
Enter the power of a localized ERP solution! Generating a compliant monthly payroll journal entry no longer requires manual cross-referencing, external spreadsheets, or high-risk manual accounting entries. By establishing a robust, automated bridge between HR payroll structures and the general ledger, businesses operating in Switzerland can seamlessly translate complex salary distributions into perfectly balanced, regulation-compliant financial data.
Over the past few years, numerous organizations operating across Switzerland have partnered with Sodexis to continuously improve their Odoo implementation, streamlining operations to ensure smooth, compliant, and scalable financial growth. Sodexis has successfully implemented customized accounting and payroll configurations to enable the seamless tracking, splitting, and posting of localized social deductions directly within the core operational workflow.
Join this session to discover how to achieve complete accounting peace of mind with Swiss payroll compliance—and learn how the collaborative partnership between your operational teams and Sodexis can deliver an efficient, future-proof roadmap for your financial workflows.
Representing the implementation success will be key members of our finance integration team, alongside Noémie (Nemo) Keller, Director of Operations for Sodexis.
Since 2012, Sodexis has been a full-service Odoo Implementation Partner, with a Consulting and Development team focused on maximizing customers’ ROI and user experience. Sodexis is one of the longest-tenured implementation Odoo Partners in the US and has offices also in Switzerland, France, and Austria. Sodexis brings a wealth of experience and valuable expertise to its clients, having successfully implemented over 175 projects and built hundreds of custom applications.
More info:
https://sodexis.com/

tracks.name: Odoo Game Show
tracks.speaker_line: Laurence & Ysaline, Education Officer at Odoo
tracks.description_text:
Time to play! 🎮
How well do you know Odoo? Put your knowledge to the test in the
Odoo Game Show
! Answer challenging questions, avoid mistakes, and make it through the rounds to reach the ultimate
knockout round
.
Think you have what it takes to win?
Join the game, compete for the title, and take home an amazing prize!

speakers.name: Laurence & Ysaline
speakers.biography_text:
Laurence and Ysaline are usually busy helping schools, teachers and students discover everything Odoo Education has to offer. But this time, they’re swapping education programs for
buzzers, challenges and a little friendly competition
.
As your hosts of the
Odoo Gameshow
, they’ll guide you through the questions, keep the energy high and, most importantly, make sure nobody takes the competition
too
seriously.
Expect laughs, surprises and plenty of Odoo knowledge along the way.

tracks.name: How to contribute to Odoo's code base
tracks.speaker_line: Arnaud Joset (arj) from Odoo
tracks.description_text:
You have an idea, you want Odoo to behave a different way to adapt to your need. A simple configuration change is not enough, you have to ding into the code. Maybe your favorite AI assistant can help but it won't get your change merged.
Contributing to large open-source projects is not easy. There are many traps and conventions to follow. This presentation will explain the best practices to have your contribution merged.

speakers.name: Arnaud Joset (arj)
speakers.biography_text: After a career in Chemistry, Arnaud decided that he preferred programming. He has been a developer at Odoo since 2019. He leads the team working on the Subscription Application, the Sale Commission module and the Sign module. He enjoys fine-tuning RD code to ensure it runs smoothly on production environments.

tracks.name: DirectPaie – The French payslip. Directly in Odoo.
tracks.speaker_line: Fabrice Lucien, Directeur at Yes We Doo
tracks.description_text:
DirectPaie – Et si la paie française devenait enfin un atout dans Odoo ?
Description détaillée
---------------------
La paie française fait peur. Complexe, risquée, chronophage.
Résultat : dans la majorité des projets Odoo, elle reste externalisée, mal intégrée… ou évitée.
Et si c’était une erreur stratégique ?
Dans cette conférence, nous allons challenger cette idée reçue et montrer comment reprendre le contrôle de la paie, sans complexifier vos projets.
Avec DirectPaie, nous avons conçu un moteur de paie pensé dès le départ pour la France et pour Odoo :
- conforme à la réglementation française
- connecté à Odoo
- conçu pour être industrialisable et maintenable dans le temps
Vous verrez concrètement comment intégrer la paie dans votre offre Odoo sans prendre de risque, sans être expert paie, tout en créant une nouvelle source de revenus récurrents.
Nous partagerons également les coulisses du projet :
- comment structurer un moteur de paie fiable (règles, DSN, mises à jour légales)
- et surtout, comment rendre la paie exploitable par des intégrateurs, pas uniquement par des experts paie
L’objectif est simple : faire passer la paie de problème à éviter... à opportunité à saisir !
Points clés à retenir
--------------------
- La paie n’est plus un sujet à contourner dans Odoo
- Il est possible d’être conforme sans être dépendant d’une usine à gaz
- Une architecture moderne permet de sécuriser la paie dans la durée
- Les intégrateurs peuvent reprendre la main sans devenir experts paie
- La paie peut devenir un levier de croissance rentable
Valeur apportée au public
--------------------------
- Une vision claire, concrète et décomplexée de la paie française
- Des clés pour intégrer la paie dans vos projets sans augmenter le risque
- Un nouveau modèle de revenus récurrents à forte valeur
- Une meilleure maîtrise d’un sujet souvent subi
Public cible
------------
- Intégrateurs Odoo (dirigeants, commerciaux, consultants)
- Décideurs (DAF, RAF, dirigeants de PME/ETI)
- Partenaires souhaitant enrichir leur offre avec la paie

speakers.name: Fabrice Lucien
speakers.biography_text:
Fabrice était un utilisateur expert d'Odoo qu'il a implémenté dans plusieurs de ses entreprises.
Lilian, expert Odoo indépendant, était son consultant.
En 2024, ils décident de s'associer pour créer YesWedoo.
Succès immédiat ! Aujourd'hui, ils ont déjà une cinquantaine de clients réguliers et développent des projets innovants dans l'écosystème Odoo.
Une demande récurrente de leurs clients français concerne la paie. C'est justement cette solution qu'ils décident de développer

tracks.name: Stop Building Connectors: A Configuration-Driven Integration Framework for Odoo
tracks.speaker_line: Sebastien Didelot, CEO at akolio
tracks.description_text:
Every Odoo integrator knows the pattern: a new marketplace, a new carrier, a new platform — and yet another bespoke connector to build, test, and maintain. Multiply that across clients and Odoo versions, and  integration becomes the single largest source of technical debt and migration pain in an ERP project.
This session presents a different approach: a universal, configuration-driven integration layer, native to Odoo. Instead of one Python module per external system, a multi-protocol API engine (REST, JSON-RPC,   SOAP and GraphQL, with Basic / token / OAuth 2.0 authentication), a declarative connector (external system → resources → actions) and a mapping tool let you connect a new source by  configuring it — not by  launching a development project. When you hit a gap, you extend the framework once and every future integration benefits.
We show this live: connecting a real GraphQL API end-to-end — connection, request body, pagination, and field mapping — in minutes, without writing a new module. Then we share what running this in production teaches you, on a multi-tenant, Kubernetes-hosted Odoo platform where integrations must scale across dozens of instances and survive version upgrades.
Key takeaways: why one-off connectors don't scale and their hidden migration cost; how a config-driven, multi-protocol integration layer works in practice; a no-code example connecting an external API; and  production lessons from a multi-tenant Odoo deployment.
Value for the audience: a reusable architectural pattern — not a product — that cuts integration time, lowers long-term maintenance, and stays resilient across Odoo upgrades.
Target audience: Odoo partners, integrators, technical consultants and developers, and functional decision-makers in retail, e-commerce and distribution who manage multiple sales channels and logistics  providers.

speakers.name: Sebastien Didelot
speakers.biography_text: Sébastien Didelot is the founder of Axup Business Solutions (axup.business  => akol.io), where he designs and operates a multi-tenant, Kubernetes-hosted Odoo platform for SMEs and integration partners. Combining functional consulting with software architecture, he created Mosaic Tools — a configuration-driven integration framework that connects Odoo to external systems without bespoke code. He has delivered Odoo projects across retail, distribution, e-commerce and biomethane logistics, with a focus on integration patterns that scale across many instances and stay resilient through Odoo version upgrades.

tracks.name: Autonomous Unit Test Generation with an AI Agent Loop: From Untested Code to Reliable Odoo Modules at Scale
tracks.speaker_line: Sebastian Kühnel Bozzo, Developer at twio.tech AG
tracks.description_text:
Maintaining reliable unit tests across customized Odoo modules is one of the most time-consuming and neglected parts of development, especially when working across multiple clients, each with their own business logic and edge cases. The result is often fragile codebases, hidden regressions, and costly debugging cycles in production. In this talk, we present a practical approach to tackling this problem using an AI agent loop that assists developers in generating, validating, and refining unit tests directly from real module code. Rather than relying on one-shot AI prompts, we introduce a structured loop that analyzes the module, proposes test coverage, executes tests, and iteratively improves them based on execution feedback until they become more reliable, meaningful, and executable.
In this talk, we will look at:
- How the AI agent loop works in practice
- Why naive AI-generated tests fail in real Odoo environments, and how iterative execution loops solve this problem
- The role of human-in-the-loop validation to ensure the generated tests actually cover meaningful business logic and real-world edge cases
- Common failure cases we encountered, including tests that pass without testing real logic, missing Odoo context and data dependencies, and tests exposing real bugs in production code
- How to integrate this approach into a real development workflow without disrupting existing practices
Key Learnings:
- How to design an AI agent loop that goes beyond simple prompt-based test generation and produces executable, meaningful tests
- Why execution feedback is critical to avoid false positives and useless test coverage
- How to detect and fix common issues in AI-generated tests, including missing context, weak assertions, and misleading “green” tests
- Why human validation remains critical when generating tests for complex business logic and custom Odoo implementations
Intended Target Audience:
- Odoo developers, technical leads, and consultants who work with custom modules and want to improve code reliability without dramatically increasing development overhead.
It is particularly relevant to:
- Developers working on custom Odoo implementations where test coverage is limited or inconsistent
- Technical leads looking for scalable ways to standardize testing across multiple clients
- Teams interested in applying AI not as a gimmick, but as a structured tool integrated into real development workflows

speakers.name: Sebastian Kühnel Bozzo
speakers.biography_text: Sebastian is developer at twio.tech. In his role, he architects and develops robust and scalable Odoo solutions.

tracks.name: La consolidation multi-sociétés sans effort
tracks.speaker_line: Benoit Koener from Odoo
tracks.description_text:
Découvrez comment Odoo 20 transforme la complexité de la gestion financière des groupes en un processus fluide, intuitif et entièrement automatisé. Finies les tâches chronophages !
Au cours de cette présentation, vous découvrirez comment tirer parti des fonctionnalités clés,telles que les structures multi-grands livres (Multi-ledgers), les transferts automatiques, les éliminations inter-sociétés et le calcul optimisé des écarts de conversion afin de fluidifier vos processus et de libérer un temps précieux au quotidien.

speakers.name: Benoit Koener
speakers.biography_text: Après une expérience en audit financier, Benoît a rejoint l'équipe de Business Analysts d'Odoo il y a neuf ans. Aujourd'hui, il se consacre pleinement aux problématiques comptables : il anime des formations, analyse les cahiers des charges, étudie les cas clients et contribue à l'amélioration du produit. Son objectif est d'accompagner les partenaires et les clients pour optimiser au mieux leur utilisation des fonctionnalités comptables d'Odoo.

tracks.name: Piloter plutôt que deviner : Le potentiel de l'analyse des données du point de vente
tracks.speaker_line: Corentin Neirynck (conei), Business Analyst - HORECA Specialist at Odoo
tracks.description_text:
Votre point de vente est bien plus qu’une simple caisse enregistreuse : c’est une véritable mine d’or de données.
Rejoignez-nous pour découvrir comment transformer les données brutes de votre point de vente Odoo en informations commerciales exploitables. Au cours de cette session, vous apprendrez à suivre vos ventes en temps réel d’un seul coup d’œil, à simplifier l'accès aux factures directement depuis le point de vente et à rapidement comparer le chiffre d’affaires entre différents sites et types de commandes (sur place par rapport à l'emporter). Nous nous pencherons également sur l’application Dashboard pour explorer des KPI révolutionnaires, tels que le chiffre d’affaires moyen par client et le nombre total de clients par service, optimisés par nos toutes dernières fonctionnalités d’IA.

speakers.name: Corentin Neirynck (conei)
speakers.biography_text: I am a Business Analyst specializing in the Food & Hospitality sector at Odoo, with a diverse background in education and the brewing industry. I joined Odoo’s Business Development team this year, where I now focus on improving our Food & Beverage offering. Leveraging my firsthand industry experience, my role involves analyzing the needs of restaurants and hospitality businesses, defining product improvements, and collaborating with development teams to deliver solutions that address real challenges.

tracks.name: Ask Me Anything (AMA) - Antony Lesuisse
tracks.speaker_line: Antony Lesuisse from Odoo

tracks.name: Multi-company consolidation made effortless
tracks.speaker_line: Jérôme Vandamme, Business Analyst - Finance & Accounting Expert at Odoo
tracks.description_text:
Discover how Odoo 20 transforms the complexity of group financial management into a seamless, intuitive, and fully automated process. Say goodbye to time-consuming tasks!
During this presentation, you will learn how to leverage key features, such as multi-ledger structures, automatic transfers, intercompany eliminations, and the optimized calculation of exchange rate differences, in order to streamline your processes and free up valuable time every day.

speakers.name: Jérôme Vandamme
speakers.biography_text: Jérôme is a Business Analyst & Accounting Expert at Odoo, with nearly ten years of experience in accounting, controlling, and operational management. Today, he helps clients and partners make the most of Odoo's accounting features, combining technical expertise and business insight to optimize their financial processes.

tracks.name: Stop guessing, Start growing: The power of POS analytics
tracks.speaker_line: Guillaume Staumont, Business Analyst - Horeca Expert at Odoo
tracks.description_text:
Discover how to turn your Odoo POS data into actionable business insights. Learn how to analyze sales margins, compare performance across locations, identify your best-selling product categories, and uncover trends through graphs, pivot tables, and reporting tools.
We’ll also showcase our Dashboard application, featuring ready-to-use KPIs and reports for hospitality businesses, with the flexibility to create custom dashboards tailored to your needs.

speakers.name: Guillaume Staumont
speakers.biography_text: After two years of experience at Deloitte Belgium, Guillaume joined Odoo in Louvain-la-Neuve in January 2024. He began his career at Odoo as a business analyst within the Quickstart team before joining the Horeca expertise team, which focuses on digitalizing establishments by providing an all-in-one, user-friendly solution.

tracks.name: The People Layer: The human voyage of Flamant's ERP migration
tracks.speaker_line: Pieter Jan Van Wettere, COO at Odoo
tracks.description_text:
An ERP migration is usually scoped as an IT project.
In practice it is the rare opportunity to look at your organisation honestly: where does it stall, where do you lose time, and which habits survive simply because it has always been that way.
Part one — the road to go-live.
Flamant's migration to Odoo told through the people who had to carry it: the Project Owner connecting business and technology, the Challenger questioning the status quo, the Data Guru making sure no rubbish gets in, and the Key Users who move colleagues from doubt to confidence.
Plus, the choices behind it — a hybrid model of standard Odoo, implementation partner and in-house development, the role AI played, and why a phased rollout beat a big bang.
Part two — where we are now.
The reality on the other side of go-live: which convictions held, which did not, what the organisation actually looks like today, and what we would do differently.

speakers.name: Pieter Jan Van Wettere
speakers.biography_text:
Pieter-Jan Van Wettere holds an MSc in Strategic Marketing from Coventry University, earned while a student job at Colruyt Group was quietly turning into a ten-year retail career.
Those ten years taught him the fundamentals: how a store runs, and how to lead the people running it.
From there he moved into retail operations at Lidl, then joined furniture group Beliving as regional sales manager.
He worked his way through buying into category leadership, ending as Category Director for the Exterioo format — nearly ten years of learning how a retail organisation holds together from the stores upward.
In 2025 he became COO of
Flamant
, the Belgian interiors and lifestyle brand, leading the operational organisation across four retail stores, e-commerce, and a wholesale network.
Shortly after, he took on the migration to Odoo — from the business side rather than the IT side, which is exactly what this talk is about.

tracks.name: From Legacy ERP to Intelligent Operations: How GKW Consult GmbH Transformed Finance, Projects, and Reporting with Odoo
tracks.speaker_line: Swapnil Roy, Senior Business Development Manager at TIMUS CONSULTING SERVICES (OPC) PRIVATE LIMITED
tracks.description_text: GKW Consult GmbH, a Germany-based engineering and consulting firm, was running on a fragmented legacy ERP system that could no longer keep pace with their project-driven business model. Financial data lived in silos, project tracking was manual and error-prone, and reporting meant spending hours stitching together spreadsheets — leaving management without the real-time visibility they needed to make confident decisions. In partnership with Timus, GKW made the move to Odoo — and the transformation went far beyond a simple software switch. This talk walks you through the full journey: from discovery and migration planning, through the implementation of Accounting and Finance, Project Management, and a powerful reporting layer built on a combination of Odoo's native reporting modules and Power BI dashboards. Attendees will learn how Timus structured the migration to minimise disruption to an active consulting business, how Odoo's unified data model made cross-functional reporting possible for the first time, and how the Power BI integration gave GKW's leadership a live command centre for project profitability, cash flow, and resource utilisation. Key learnings for the audience include: how to approach ERP migration for professional services firms, best practices for combining Odoo's built-in reporting with external BI tools, and how to build dashboards that finance and operations teams actually use. This session is ideal for Odoo partners, implementation consultants, CFOs, and operations leaders in consulting or engineering firms looking to modernise their business management stack without losing months of productivity in the process.

speakers.name: Swapnil Roy
speakers.biography_text: Swapnil Roy is Senior Business Development Manager at Timus Consulting Services, bringing over 11 years of experience in IT sales, enterprise solutions, and business consulting. Based in Bengaluru, he specialises in ERP and GRC sales, RFP management, and building strategic client relationships across India, Europe, and Southeast Asia. At Timus, Swapnil leads B2B sales for digital transformation engagements, including Odoo implementations, and has represented the company at key industry events. He holds a B.Tech in Electronics and Instrumentation and is passionate about helping organisations unlock real business value through technology.

tracks.name: Automatic website migration to Odoo with AI
tracks.speaker_line: Ivan Klapka, AI Engineer at Odoo
tracks.description_text:
What if you could take any existing website and turn it into an Odoo website automatically?
In this talk, we’ll present an AI-powered tool that imports websites into Odoo in just a few clicks — including pages, product catalogs, and blog posts.
This talk will mostly be a live demo of the website import tool and it's capabilities.
We will show different websites being imported to showcase the tool's ability to:
Recreate Odoo website pages with recovered content
Import products with variants and options for Shopify, Wordpress or Prestashop shops
Recover blogs from Wordpress and Ghost platforms

speakers.name: Ivan Klapka
speakers.biography_text:
Ivan Klapka
is a young Belgian AI engineer with a special interest in solving complex problems.
He has always enjoyed the process of building things and does his best to have a large positive impact.
He is curious and learning new things is a true passion for him, so feel free to reach out as he will be eager to listen to your story!

tracks.name: Why European Sovereignty Can't Wait
tracks.speaker_line: Maarten Roelfs, Tech Entrepreneur | Investor | Founder @ Office EU at Office EU
tracks.description_text: European businesses have outsourced their digital infrastructure to US Big Tech for decades. Export controls and extraterritorial data laws are exposing the cost, most starkly when Microsoft cut off the International Criminal Court's own chief prosecutor from his email under US sanctions, proof that the "kill switch" isn't hypothetical. This talk covers what's driving the urgency now, and what switching to a real sovereign alternative, from ERP to office tools, actually takes.

speakers.name: Maarten Roelfs
speakers.function: Tech Entrepreneur | Investor | Founder @ Office EU

tracks.name: Smart Manufacturing in Action: Zerynth’s Odoo Connector
tracks.speaker_line: Fabio Cacciapuoti, Chief Operational Officer at Zerynth
tracks.description_text:
Zerynth’s Odoo Connector empowers manufacturers by seamlessly integrating IoT and AI with both modern and legacy industrial machinery. This integration enables real-time production optimization, cost and energy consumption reduction, and supports a sustainable Industry 5.0 transformation.
In this session, we will present a compelling customer success story from a manufacturing company that digitalized traditionally hard-to-integrate production assets. By using the Zerynth Connector, the company was able to extract valuable data—such as production performance, energy usage, and anomalous machine behavior—and integrate it directly into Odoo. This not only streamlined data collection and automated the Odoo production module but also enhanced operational efficiency and promoted energy savings.
The Zerynth Connector allows for fast, non-invasive connectivity to industrial equipment, accelerating the digital transformation of shop floors. Additionally, it features Smart Report, an AI-powered tool that simplifies the creation of detailed sustainability reports and supports ESG certification efforts. This functionality helps manufacturers meet regulatory requirements while strengthening their commitment to environmental responsibility.

speakers.name: Fabio Cacciapuoti
speakers.biography_text:
Fabio Cacciapuoti is a Management Engineer with a strong passion for technology, lean thinking, and agile methodologies. Specializing in industrial manufacturing, he drives organizational improvement through Digital Transformation and Industry 4.0 strategies. Fabio began his career as Plant Director at Fidia Srl before joining Zerynth in 2019. Since then, he has advanced through roles including Head of Operations and Business Control Manager, and currently serves as Chief Operating Officer. With a solid academic background in Electronics and Industrial Engineering from Università di Pisa, Fabio combines technical expertise with strategic vision to lead innovation in smart manufacturing.
Outside of work, Fabio enjoys traveling, sports, and exploring new ideas.
https://www.linkedin.com/in/fabio-cacciapuoti/

tracks.name: dooLex - Transforming Odoo into a legal practice system
tracks.speaker_line: Suzanne Mulier, Change & Project Manager at Cloudware NV
tracks.description_text:
Law firms, notaries and bailiffs run on deadlines, confidentiality and billable time; yet most still juggle separate tools for intake, case management, time tracking and accounting. This session shows how we turned standard Odoo into dooLex, a fully integrated practice-management system (PMS) built specifically for legal professionals in Belgium.
We'll show how the core of a legal practice; from the first client intake all the way through to billing and accounting; comes together in one connected environment, with Odoo acting as the central PMS and integrating with a dedicated high-end document-management system (DMS) such as NetDocuments or iManage. Expect a live look at the platform in action and a sense of how Odoo's building blocks can be shaped to fit a regulated, document-heavy profession.
Attendees will walk away with the criteria for solid verticalization - how to recognise which opportunities are worth turning into genuine excellence and expertise - along with the design choices that mattered most and the lessons we took from crafting dooLex.

speakers.name: Suzanne Mulier
speakers.biography_text: Suzanne Mulier is Change & Project Manager at Cloudware, where she leads digital transformation projects and the implementation of dooLex, Cloudware's Odoo-based platform for legal professionals. She brings years of client-side experience to the table: at Danone she drove change management for large-scale transformation programmes as well as leading the Alpro brand in Benelux as Marketing Director. That mix of business leadership and hands-on change expertise shapes her approach -keeping people, not just technology, at the centre of every project. At Odoo Experience she shares lessons on adapting Odoo to specialised, regulated industries and making new tools genuinely stick.

tracks.name: Integration Ardis & Odoo
tracks.speaker_line: Carolien Van Eyck, Project manager at Dynapps
tracks.description_text: Norm is a Belgian manufacturer of custom kitchen and bathroom furniture that implemented Odoo as its central ERP, with a bidirectional integration with Ardis — their CNC cutting optimization software — as a hard requirement for go-live. From Odoo, confirmed manufacturing orders are written to a SQL database on Norm's internal network, where Ardis picks them up, groups them into production batches, and optimizes the cutting plans. Ardis then feeds back production status updates, actual plate consumption, and pallet numbers after packing to Odoo via an API. The main technical challenges were unit conversion from mm² to m², barcode matching (Ardis uses a "W" prefix that had to be stripped), decoupling the production batch number from the MO status update, and the decision to exclude remainder plates from automatic stock deduction. Norm went live on 24 November 2025, seven months after kick-off, with a smooth go-live.

speakers.name: Carolien Van Eyck
speakers.biography_text: Project manager at Dynapps, leading mid-size Odoo implementations in the Belgian and Dutch markets.

tracks.name: Optimisez le parcours restaurant : De la réservation en ligne à la gestion de table
tracks.speaker_line: Méline Praile (mepra) from Odoo
tracks.description_text:
From Click to Table: Mastering Restaurant Reservations & POS
A guest’s dining experience begins long before they walk through your doors, it starts online. But how do you seamlessly connect a Google search to a physical table without missing a beat?
Join us for an interactive session exploring Odoo’s Point of Sale for the restaurant industry. We will showcase an smooth workflow that bridges the gap between online booking and in-person table service. Discover how to leverage Odoo’s Website app and Google Reservations to effortlessly capture bookings, and watch them synchronize with your POS table management system.

tracks.name: Initiation de paiement : Payez plus intelligemment vos fournisseurs
tracks.speaker_line: Benjamin Vandeputte, Business Analyst - Accounting Firms Expert at Odoo
tracks.description_text:
Dites adieu au casse-tête de l'exportation des fichiers de paiement et de leur téléchargement manuel sur votre portail bancaire !
Dans cette session, nous dévoilerons la nouvelle fonctionnalité d'initiation de paiement d'Odoo 20, vous permettant de payer vos factures fournisseurs directement depuis Odoo en quelques clics seulement. Découvrez comment cette intégration bancaire fluide réduit les erreurs humaines, renforce la sécurité et accélère l'ensemble de votre processus de comptabilité fournisseurs.
Rejoignez-nous pour découvrir comment vous pouvez gagner un temps précieux et commencer à payer plus intelligemment dès aujourd'hui !

speakers.name: Benjamin Vandeputte
speakers.biography_text:
Après cinq années d'expérience en fiduciaire, où il gérait un portefeuille diversifié de clients de A à Z,
Benjamin
a rejoint Odoo pour intégrer l'équipe dédiée aux cabinets comptables. Il accompagne et forme aujourd'hui une clientèle variée, tout en contribuant à l'évolution des applications liées à la comptabilité d'Odoo pour différents pays.

tracks.name: Unlocking payment initiation: The smarter way to pay your suppliers
tracks.speaker_line: Laurent Jeanty from Odoo
tracks.description_text:
Say goodbye to the hassle of exporting payment files and manually uploading them to your banking portal!
In this session, we will unveil Odoo 20’s new payment initiation feature, allowing you to pay your supplier bills directly from Odoo in just a few clicks. Learn how this seamless bank integration reduces human error, tightens security and speeds up your entire accounts payable workflow.
Join us to find out how you can save valuable time and start paying smarter today!

speakers.name: Laurent Jeanty
speakers.biography_text:
After a Master's Degree in Business Administration,
Laurent
started his career as an auditor at a Big Four in Luxembourg. After becoming a Chartered Accountant with the ACCA, he worked for several years in an accounting firm. He later joined the automotive industry in Belgium in business development. Laurent is now a Business Analyst and Team Leader in the Business Development team at Odoo.

tracks.name: Dare to fail
tracks.speaker_line: Average Rob
tracks.description_text: This keynote tells the story of Average Rob: from his childhood to becoming a bold content creator and entrepreneur. It highlights his mindset of embracing failure, showing that mistakes and setbacks are essential stepping stones to success. Rob constantly pushes his limits, taking on challenges that others say are impossible. His journey inspires the audience to take risks, step out of their comfort zones, and turn obstacles into opportunities. He proves that growth comes from daring to try the unexpected.

speakers.name: Average Rob
speakers.biography_text:
Average Rob is a Belgian
content creator
known for combining
humor, adventure, and authenticity
