tracks.name: Escaping the Inventory Freeze: Just-in-Time Procurement in Odoo Enterprise
tracks.speaker_line: Tânia Manco, ERP Consultant at much. Consulting
tracks.description_text:
Why does stock sit dead on warehouse shelves? In standard Odoo, procurement counts forward. When a customer places an order for a future date, the system looks at the vendor lead time and triggers a purchase order immediately. If a supplier takes five days to deliver an item needed in a month, Odoo buys it now. The goods arrive weeks too early, locking up cash and taking up warehouse space. Meanwhile, standard reservation rules block that stock, preventing other active orders from using it.
To prevent such an inventory freeze, especially for high-volume warehouses, we built a backward-scheduling engine for Odoo Enterprise.
Instead of counting forward from the purchase date, the engine starts at the customer’s requested delivery date and counts backward. It determines the exact day to place the purchase order and the precise window to reserve warehouse stock. To match real-world supply chains, the calculation uses only weekdays (Monday to Friday).
The engine also isolates buying requirements for special project agreements from routine warehouse restocking, ensuring contract pricing applies correctly. When vendor lead times change, Odoo automatically updates open purchase orders and internal warehouse transfers. This automation keeps stock moving, frees up working capital, and cuts out manual scheduling work for procurement teams.
Key Points of This Talk:
- Optimising Odoo standard stock reservations with an automatically calculated  backward-scheduled reservation window.
- Calculating purchasing deadlines backward from the sales delivery date using only weekdays.
- Separating specific project agreement purchases from standard restocking to maintain correct pricing.
- Automatically recalculating warehouse transfers and open orders when vendor lead times change.
Key Learnings:
- How to use Just-In-Time reservation windows to keep inventory available longer and free up capital.
- How to set up backward scheduling to tell your purchasing team exactly when to order based on customer requests.
- How to keep project-specific supply chains separate to protect special vendor pricing.
- How to handle vendor delays by having the system automatically adjust warehouse schedules.
Target Audience:
- Warehouse Managers and Operations Directors handling complex supply chains in Odoo
- Procurement Specialists managing complex vendor agreements
- Odoo Consultants and Architects looking for maintainable customization strategies

speakers.name: Tânia Manco
speakers.biography_text: Tânia Manco is a Consultant at much. Consulting, specializing in Odoo implementations for the commerce sectors across the DACH region. tracks.name: Multi-Agent Swarms for High-Performance ERP Migration in Odoo
tracks.speaker_line: Serena Palazzo, AI Team Leader at Rapsodoo
tracks.description_text:
Enterprise ERP migrations toward Odoo are increasingly constrained by transformation complexity, heterogeneous schemas, and the need for near-zero downtime execution.
In this talk, we introduce a multi-agent swarm architecture designed to accelerate and parallelize data migration workflows through autonomous specialization and distributed decision-making. The system decomposes migration tasks into atomic responsibilities handled by coordinated AI agents, including schema decomposition agents, mapping inference agents, validation swarms, and conflict resolution agents.
We present a coordination layer inspired by swarm intelligence principles, where agents dynamically negotiate transformation strategies based on confidence scoring, constraint satisfaction signals, and historical migration performance metrics. This enables parallel exploration of multiple migration strategies while converging on optimal transformation paths.
The framework—internally referred to as the “AI Migration Syndicate”—is implemented on top of cloud-native execution environments with event-driven orchestration, allowing scalable execution of migration tasks across distributed workers. Special focus is given to deterministic fallback mechanisms, auditability, and reconciliation guarantees required in enterprise ERP contexts.
We conclude with real-world benchmarks demonstrating significant improvements in migration throughput, reduced manual intervention, and improved consistency in large-scale migrations into Odoo.

tracks.name: When Your Odoo Database Explodes: Understanding PG TOAST and How We Reduced 500GB to 60GB
tracks.speaker_line: Cristhian Ampudia, Asistente de Infraestructura at TRESCLOUD
tracks.description_text:
As Odoo databases grow, hidden inefficiencies can silently increase storage usage and severely impact performance. One of the most overlooked causes is PostgreSQL TOAST (The Oversized-Attribute Storage Technique), especially when large binary data—such as base64-encoded images—is improperly stored in database fields.
In this talk, we present a real-world case where a client's Odoo database grew to over 500GB due to excessive storage of base64 images inside PostgreSQL tables. This led to performance degradation, slow backups, and increased infrastructure costs.
We will explain how TOAST works in PostgreSQL, how it affects Odoo installations, and how to identify when your database is suffering from TOAST-related bloat. We will also walk through the diagnostic process, including SQL queries and tools used to analyze table size, TOAST usage, and data patterns.
Most importantly, we will demonstrate the solution that reduced the database size from 500GB to 60GB, including data cleanup strategies, architectural improvements, and best practices to prevent this issue in future implementations.
Attendees will leave with practical techniques to audit their own databases, optimize storage, and significantly improve Odoo performance.
This session is ideal for Odoo developers, DevOps engineers, and technical consultants managing large-scale Odoo deployments.

speakers.name: Cristhian Ampudia

tracks.name: Stop Answering the Same Tickets: Building a Self-Teaching Helpdesk with AI in Odoo 19
tracks.speaker_line: Mike Schulz, Senior Expert ERP Consulting at much. Consulting
tracks.description_text:
Service companies lose thousands of hours when their support teams are trapped answering the same Level-1 questions every single day. Without an automated system to record and share answers, agents constantly retype known solutions, which causes massive ticket backlogs and outdated knowledge bases.
To fix this structural bottleneck, we built a low-code, self-teaching loop completely inside the Odoo Enterprise v19 user interface.
We put a pipeline together by configuring three distinct native AI agents, linked with simple Automated Actions and basic Python UI snippets: an “initial responder” utilizing RAG, to answer clients using approved data, an “auditor” to check how tickets were closed, and a “writer” drafting new Knowledge Base articles By plugging in your own OpenAI or Gemini key directly into the frontend, this setup completely skips the need to build or maintain complex custom code modules. This working model proves that businesses can automatically turn daily ticket answers into permanent company documentation, cutting down future support volume and making advanced AI setups a practical reality.
Key Points of this Talk:
- Automating the Hand-Off: Configure Odoo Enterprise Helpdesk to trigger native ai.agents via Automated Actions.
- Forcing Factual Answers: Deploy native RAG parameters to restrict AI responses to approved Knowledge Base data.
- Skipping Custom Code: Evaluate how agents solved tickets using basic frontend Python snippets without custom module development.
- Self-Writing Documentation: Chain AI agents to automatically draft Odoo v19 Knowledge articles from closed tickets.
- Staying in the UI: Build this entire self-improving AI loop without ever leaving the native Odoo frontend.
Key Learnings:
- How to turn complex AI concepts into accessible, low-code Odoo v19 workflows.
- How to launch native AI agents using Automated Actions and simple screen logic.
- How to automatically turn human-resolved tickets into standard Knowledge Base articles.
- How to build a self-improving support system without heavy developer resources.
- How to set strict RAG boundaries to maintain data accuracy and prevent hallucinations.
Target Audience:
Business Leaders, Executives, and Functional Consultants using Odoo Enterprise v19+

speakers.name: Mike Schulz

tracks.name: How to handle 250,000 Dropshipping Products in Odoo
tracks.speaker_line: Benjamin Seeßle, ERP Consultant at much. Consulting
tracks.description_text:

Managing hundreds of thousands of products across a fragmented software landscape disrupts vendor relationships and leaves businesses unable to react to rapid market price shifts.
This talk explores how we resolved this issue by consolidating operations, transforming Odoo 19 Enterprise into a "One-Stop" hub that harmonizes a large Shopware frontend with a lean, automated backend.
We will walk you through the journey of building a robust, step-based synchronization framework capable of handling extreme variant complexity - exceeding 400 options per product - while enabling real-time dropshipping automation.
From centralizing the product master to executing bulk vendor price updates across a quarter-million SKUs, this talk demonstrates how to scale a large catalog.
Key Points of this Talk:
- Infrastructure challenges of managing 250,000 dropshipping SKUs
- Overcoming the variant bottleneck: functional setup for products with 400+ options
- Designing a step-based synchronization framework between Shopware and Odoo 19
- Automating backend procurement triggers directly from frontend retail sales
- Centralizing vendor data to execute rapid bulk price updates
- Technical choices for balancing extreme data volumes with long-term Odoo stability
Key Learnings:
- How to replace fragmented legacy IT software landscapes with a single Odoo Enterprise core
- Methods to transition the operational "Source of Truth" in complex, multi-variant retail environments
- Strategies to architect automated dropshipping pipelines that eliminate manual intervention
- How to manage large-scale vendor data updates without causing database performance drops
- Project insights on balancing immediate business logic requirements with ERP maintainability
Target Audience:
- CEOs, COOs, and Operations Managers in Wholesale or Dropshipping

- IT Directors managing multi-system e-commerce environments

tracks.speaker_line: Johan Wouters
tracks.description_text: The world’s most influential brands didn’t become iconic because of their logos. They became leaders because they built absolute clarity around who they are, why they exist, and what they stand for. “The Secret of the World’s Leading Brands” explores how purpose, meaning, alignment, and consistency create brands that people trust, remember, and choose. Discover the principles behind the world’s most inspiring brands—and why a logo is only the visible result of a much deeper strategy.

tracks.name: The Two Hats of Odoo Python: Powering Core Logic vs. Driving User Experience
tracks.speaker_line: Gary Dolorfino, Engineering Expert at much. Consulting
tracks.description_text:
This talk differentiates "Client-Facing Python" (UI events, dynamic views, computed fields) from "Core Backend Python" (business rules, data integrity, scheduled tasks, wizards) in Odoo development. Understanding this separation is crucial for building responsive, maintainable, and robust applications. The session will provide a framework for structuring Python code, optimizing performance and being intentional about UX implementation.
Key Points:
- Defining "Client-Facing" Python: onchange methods, button actions, dynamic UI Python (e.g., domains, field attributes), and UI-reflected computed fields.
- Defining "Core Backend" Python: ORM overrides (create(), write(), unlink()), scheduled actions, server actions, and complex wizard/data processing logic.
- Interaction & Data Flow: Examining how client-facing Python often acts as a gateway or pre/post-processor for core backend logic, and the pivotal role of the ORM as the bridge.
- Architectural Patterns & Best Practices: Strategies for keeping client-facing Python lean and responsive, isolating heavy logic in core backend Python (including considerations for asynchronous processing where applicable), ensuring security through input validation, and enhancing the testability of both code types.
- Practical Case Studies: Illustrating concepts with real-world examples, such as refactoring a performance-degrading onchange method and designing a button action that orchestrates multiple backend operations efficiently.
- Optimizing for Responsiveness: Actionable techniques to ensure client-facing Python supports, rather than hinders, a fluid and fast user interface.
Key Learnings:
- Attendees will be able to architect Odoo modules by clearly distinguishing the roles of their server-side Python code, separating UI-centric logic from core business operations.
- Attendees will learn to implement strategies to optimize Python code for responsive user interfaces, identifying and mitigating common performance bottlenecks associated with client-facing scripts.
- Attendees will understand how to design robust and efficient interactions and data flows between client-facing and core backend Python layers.
- Attendees will take away best practices for security (especially input validation from UI interactions) and testability tailored to the distinct characteristics of each type of Python code.
- Attendees will be equipped to refactor existing Odoo customizations for improved performance, maintainability, and scalability by applying these architectural principles.
Target Audience:
- Odoo Python Developers (Beginner and Intermediate)
- Odoo Technical Architects
- Technical Consultants involved in designing and implementing Odoo customizations
- Software Engineers working with the Odoo framework

speakers.name: Gary Dolorfino

tracks.name: Transforming LPG Cylinder Lifecycle Management with Odoo at Puma Energy
tracks.speaker_line: Chintan Shah, CEO, Brainvire at Brainvire
tracks.description_text:
Managing LPG cylinders at scale is not just an inventory challenge. It is a moving lifecycle of filled, empty, damaged, returned, and refilled cylinders passing through plants, warehouses, dealers, customers, and intercompany networks. For Puma Energy, limited visibility across these movements created risk around cylinder losses, deposit tracking, return accuracy, and logistics control.
In this session, Brainvire cuts through that complexity. We will show how Odoo was used to bring the entire LPG cylinder lifecycle into one connected operating system across Inventory, Sales, Purchase, and Accounting. With lot and serial number tracking, every cylinder became uniquely traceable from dispatch to refill to return.
We will dive into custom workflows for refill, dispatch, return, intercompany transfers, virtual locations, barcode tracking, and RFID visibility.
The result is complete lifecycle control, reduced losses, faster logistics execution, and accurate financial tracking of cylinder deposits through one scalable Odoo foundation.

tracks.name: Scaling Support Excellence: Managing 100+ Daily Tickets Across Multiple Helpdesk Teams at GCU with Odoo
tracks.speaker_line: Anas Ouasmi, Business Analyst at Sodexis
tracks.description_text:
Are you struggling to keep up with an ever-increasing volume of customer support requests? Do tickets get lost in transit, or delayed due to manual routing inefficiencies across different internal departments? Managing multi-tier or departmental service desks presents a classic operational challenge: maintaining rapid response times without compromising service quality.
Enter GCU's modern support infrastructure! By leveraging Odoo Helpdesk, GCU transformed its support ecosystem to efficiently handle a heavy load of more than 100 tickets daily. This digital transformation replaced disjointed communication channels with a single, cohesive ticketing framework tailored for diverse operational and technical helpdesk teams.
With an intelligent automation layer, incoming inquiries are dynamically classified and assigned to specialized teams according to expertise, priority, and SLA metrics. Over the past year, this system has allowed GCU to process thousands of incoming issues, dramatically reducing resolution times and boosting user satisfaction across the organization. Service managers now gain real-time visibility through comprehensive analytical dashboards that track team performance and ticket bottlenecks.
Join this session to discover how GCU mapped its complex multi-team workflows to Odoo's native architecture, engineered robust automated workflows, and successfully scaled its operations to ensure a smooth, sustainable support journey.

tracks.description_text:
Picture a typical day at the office: Sales teams are sending quotations, consultants are logging timesheets, accountants are validating invoices... everything is running smoothly.
Then, without warning, the lights go out. The internet is gone. A complete power outage brings the entire office to a halt.
Or does it?
Not if you're running Odoo.
Join us for a live demonstration of
Offline Mode in Odoo 20
and discover how Odoo keeps your business moving, even without an internet connection.
During this session, you'll learn:
The prerequisites for working offline
How the interface adapts with a dedicated offline UI
How to browse, search, create, and edit records offline
How to archive and unarchive records
How to delete records
How synchronization works, including the queue and the tools available to monitor and manage it
Because business doesn't stop when the connection does.

The Odoo Experience is THE chance to spread knowledge and discuss our common passion all together. Don't hesitate to reach out!

tracks.name: How a €30M+ Supplement Manufacturer Is Moving from Legacy Tools to Odoo
tracks.speaker_line: Ferry Kluger, Founder at bobco GmbH
tracks.description_text:
TISSO is a German nutritional supplement company founded in 1999. More than 20 years later, the company has grown into a €30M+ business with 159 employees and a complex operating model across own-brand B2C sales, subscriptions, B2B therapist and export business, and contract manufacturing.
From the outside, this looks like a modern supplement brand and manufacturer. Behind the scenes, the operational reality was more fragmented: Magento for eCommerce, bespoke ERP as a legacy order backbone, DATEV for accounting execution, Wrike and Google Sheets for coordination, and many manual handoffs between teams.
TISSO did not need “another tool.” It needed a real operating backbone.
In this session, TISSO and bob will share how the company approached Odoo as a phased business transformation: first stabilizing the commercial and finance backbone, then expanding toward Shopify, therapist portal improvements, procurement, inventory, and production.
The key decision was not to force a risky big-bang transformation. Instead, the first live scope focused on the narrowest slice that could create measurable business value: Order-to-Cash, subscriptions, therapist logic, fulfillment execution, invoicing, accounting operations, and reconciliation. This allowed the team to deprecate major legacy anchors while avoiding unnecessary go-live risk around full inventory, production, and valuation.
The long-term vision is broader: Odoo as the central system connecting multi-channel sales, finance, procurement, inventory, and production. But the implementation strategy was deliberately disciplined: prove the backbone first, simplify where possible, challenge unnecessary customizations, and only expand once the business has a stable operational baseline.
This talk is for companies and Odoo partners dealing with real mid-market complexity: legacy systems, partial previous implementations, custom code, multiple revenue streams, manufacturing requirements, finance dependencies, and teams that still rely heavily on spreadsheets and key-person knowledge.
What you’ll learn:
- How to scope an Odoo transformation for a mature company without creating big-bang go-live risk.
- Why the first ERP phase should focus on operational backbone, not maximum system replacement.
- How to decide what belongs in V1 and what must be delayed, even when the long-term ambition is much bigger.
- How TISSO approached Order-to-Cash, subscriptions, therapist business logic, fulfillment, finance handoffs, and reconciliation in Odoo.
- Why inventory, production, and procurement often need to be phased carefully rather than forced into the first go-live.
- How to use Odoo as the foundation for future transformation: Shopify migration, Odoo 19 upgrade, therapist portal expansion, inventory rollout, procurement, and production light.
- How customer and partner teams can work together during discovery, scope design, cutover, go-live, and hypercare.
- What other growing manufacturers can learn from TISSO’s journey from fragmented tools to one operating backbone.

Ferry's work focuses on turning messy real-world operations into clean, maintainable Odoo workflows.

tracks.name: One Distillery's Problem Becomes an Industry's Platform
tracks.speaker_line: Sebastian Navarro, Growth Lead & Technical Associate at MasterDistiller
tracks.description_text:
MasterDistiller began with a single distillery and a problem the market could not solve. When a young whisky distillery set out to grow, it faced the same two options as everyone else: a sea of disconnected spreadsheets and paper records, or bulky generic ERP software that did not understand a distillery business. This talk tells the story of what came next, how the answer came from an industry-specific system built on the Odoo platform, and where it is heading.
Whisky demands full traceability, accurate maturation costing, and a single source of truth connecting production to finance, sales and planning across decades. The MasterDistiller team will show how Odoo's breadth becomes the foundation for a solution this specific, and why a vertical built on an open platform serves the spirits industry better than any of the old alternatives. MasterDistiller now supports distilleries across the UK, US, Canada and Australia, and every feature built for one client becomes a capability all of them can use.
Looking towards the future, because the platform is open source, extendible and easy to connect into, MasterDistiller is continually developing, including plugging emerging technologies like AI into the system to solve real business problems. The team will share the framework behind this, what the company calls Intelligent Distilling, as the next step in its journey.
Attendees will leave with a clear, practical view of how Odoo partners use platform breadth combined with industry depth to generate real value for their clients.

speakers.name: Sebastian Navarro
speakers.biography_text: Sebastian Navarro has spent over seven years in the spirits industry and knows the challenges spirits businesses face. Now at MasterDistiller, he pairs that industry knowledge with a technical programming background - bringing together Odoo's breadth and MasterDistiller's industry depth to deliver impactful solutions.

tracks.name: Streamlining Sustainability: A Step-by-Step Guide to Odoo's ESG Configuration and Environmental Reporting
tracks.speaker_line: Anas Ouasmi, Business Analyst at Sodexis
tracks.description_text:
As regulatory bodies worldwide tighten disclosure requirements, Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) reporting has shifted from a corporate social responsibility checkbox to a critical compliance necessity. However, aggregating fragmented data from supply chains, energy bills, manufacturing outputs, and corporate travel often leaves sustainability officers buried under manual spreadsheets. How can businesses establish a single source of truth for their sustainability metrics without adding immense administrative overhead?
This session offers a comprehensive guide to navigating Odoo's newly enhanced sustainability architecture. We will explore how to model your company's environmental footprint directly within your ERP ecosystem. By connecting Odoo's core modules  such as Purchase, Fleet, Manufacturing, and Accounting  with native carbon accounting engines, organizations can capture resource consumption metrics automatically at the point of transaction.
Attendees will learn how to configure emission factors, map energy consumption metrics (Scope 1, 2, and 3 emissions), and establish tracking parameters for waste management and sustainable sourcing. We will also address how to customize data input criteria using Odoo Studio to meet specific local or international frameworks (such as CSRD or GRI), optimize calculation templates, and build dynamic sustainability dashboards. This ensures management teams have real-time visibility into their carbon intensity and green targets.
Join this practical session to transform compliance data tracking from a reactive annual burden into a proactive, automated workflow built entirely inside Odoo.

speakers.name: Anas Ouasmi

tracks.name: The Last Unfakeable Thing - What our failed virtual exhibition taught us about digitising the wrong half of the business

Five years on, physical gathering is thriving. Who actually comes through the door, why, and what happens next, a question venues have never been able to answer.
An honest account of a failure, a bubble, and what a 1935 building is doing about it now: white-label ticketing, on-site data, and why the most analogue business in the world is becoming a data business.

speakers.name: Denis Delforge

tracks.name: From 5 tools to 1 platform: how our client in the energy market runs its entire solar installation business in Odoo, from lead to EcoCare subscription
tracks.speaker_line: Jochem Bauwmans and Cindy Singh, Project manager at Dynapps
tracks.description_text: Our client installs solar panels, batteries, heat pumps and charging stations for B2C and B2B customers across Belgium. Before Odoo they ran on Teamleader for CRM, Simple-Simon for technician scheduling, AppSheet for on-site checklists, Google Drive for the customer file, SolarEdge for design and monitoring, and ClearFacts for accounting —  five disconnected tools with constant copy-paste between them and no single view of a deal, a job or a customer. In this session we show how Dynapps consolidated that entire stack into one Odoo platform covering the full lifecycle: lead capture across web/portal/socials, a three-pipeline CRM (B2B, particulier, EcoCare), commissioning models per salesperson, quote duplication and PDF templating, automated Google Drive folder creation per opportunity, a SolarEdge Designer deep-link directly on the lead, mobile-friendly site-visit and installation checklists with sketches, photos and conditional fields, employee scheduling and work-order e-signature for the field technician, inspection registration and single-line-diagram handover, helpdesk with SLAs and multiple teams, tickets auto-created from SolarEdge alerts, recurring EcoCare maintenance subscriptions with SEPA direct debit, and an accountant-friendly handover to ACS. We share how a service installer with 35 internal users runs the whole company end-to-end without leaving Odoo for its day-to-day core business processes.

Jochem Bauwmans
is Project manager at Dynapps, leading mid-size Odoo implementations in the Belgian and Dutch markets.

tracks.name: Odoo Tours: The easy way to test workflows and onboard users
tracks.speaker_line: Jens Boons from Odoo
tracks.description_text:
As an Odoo functional consultant or project manager, you know the pain: you spend hours configuring the perfect workflow, only for a minor configuration change or an app update to quietly disrupt it. Testing everything manually before go-live is a massive time sink. What if you could build a dynamic system that handles both user onboarding and automated business flow testing—without writing a single line of code?
Enter
Odoo Tours
.
In this presentation, we will explore the immense functional power of the Tour framework. We'll show you how to map out your real-world business use cases into interactive walkthroughs that train your users, and how to instantly repurpose those exact same walkthroughs to validate your configurations. If you want to automate your day-to-day testing, reduce manual QA effort, and guarantee smooth user adoption, this session is for you.
What we will cover:
The Functional Blueprint of a Tour:
What is an Odoo tour from a business perspective, and how does it map to your standard operational workflows?
Onboarding vs. Quality Assurance:
How the exact same tool can actively guide a new salesperson through a CRM pipeline, or run automated in the background to verify a multi-step delivery process.
Mastering the Tour Recorder:
A completely non-technical, step-by-step look at using Odoo’s built-in visual recorder to map clicks, inputs, and button presses simply by clicking through the system.
Live Fail Demo:
We will visually record a standard business flow and execute it. Then, we will make a realistic functional configuration change (like making a field required or hiding a button) to show exactly how the tour catches the failure and flags the broken workflow.

tracks.name: From CAD to ERP: Creating a Single Source of Truth with SolidWorks, Onshape and Odoo
tracks.speaker_line: Eduardo Magdalena García, Founder & CEO at C2i Change 2 improve Optimización de procesos, S.L.
tracks.description_text:
When information does not flow, companies lose time, money and competitiveness.
In many manufacturing companies, engineering teams create products, assemblies, bills of materials and technical documentation in CAD systems such as SolidWorks or Onshape. However, much of this information never reaches the ERP because manually transferring and maintaining it is too time-consuming and error-prone.
As designs evolve, data quickly becomes outdated, duplicated or inconsistent across departments. As a result, many companies are unable to fully leverage the capabilities of Odoo Manufacturing, Inventory, Purchasing, Projects and other business applications because critical product information is either incomplete or disconnected from the engineering source.
This session explores how a Single Source of Truth approach can bridge the gap between engineering and business operations. Based on real-world CAD-ERP integration projects currently used in manufacturing environments, attendees will discover how SolidWorks, Onshape and Odoo can work together to create a connected digital workflow where product data, bills of materials, design changes, documentation and images remain synchronized throughout the entire product lifecycle.
A live demonstration based on real customer implementations will show how engineering information can flow automatically from CAD into Odoo, reducing manual work, improving traceability and enabling more reliable decision-making across engineering, purchasing, manufacturing and inventory teams.
Attendees will learn:
• Why critical engineering information often never reaches the ERP.
• How disconnected systems create inefficiencies, errors and hidden costs.
• How a Single Source of Truth approach improves consistency, collaboration and traceability.
• How SolidWorks, Onshape and Odoo can work together in real manufacturing environments.
This session is intended for manufacturing companies, engineering teams, operations managers, Odoo partners and anyone interested in improving industrial processes through better information management and system integration.

speakers.name: Eduardo Magdalena García
speakers.company: C2i Change 2 improve Optimización de procesos, S.L.
speakers.biography_text: Eduardo Magdalena is a mechanical engineer and founder of C2i - Change 2 improve, an Odoo and Onshape partner specialized in process optimization and CAD-ERP integration. He holds a Master's Degree in ICT Business Management and has more than 25 years of experience helping engineering and manufacturing companies improve their processes through technology. Former Technical Director of a SolidWorks reseller in Spain, he currently develops integration solutions that connect CAD systems such as SolidWorks and Onshape with Odoo, creating a unified digital workflow across engineering, manufacturing and business operations.

tracks.name: Quality Control process
tracks.speaker_line: CRETU Victor, Business Analyst at Sodexis SAS
tracks.description_text:
For Amel, maintaining high product standards while keeping warehouse operations efficient is a top priority. However, manual tracking of arriving shipments and disconnected quality check processes were creating bottlenecks.
By implementing a tailored Quality Control and Inventory solution using Odoo, Amel transformed its inbound logistics. The new system automatically alerts operators when products arrive and intelligently routes specific items through a rigorous quality check process, saving valuable time and drastically reducing manual errors.
The Challenge: Bottlenecks in the Receiving Process
Before the Odoo implementation, Amel's warehouse team faced three primary operational hurdles:
1) Communication Gaps: Operators on the floor were not immediately aware when new shipments arrived at the loading dock, leading to delays in unloading, putaway, and processing.
2) Inconsistent Quality Routing: Identifying which incoming products required a quality inspection was a manual, error-prone process. This occasionally led to items bypassing quality checks and moving directly into available stock.
3) Wasted Time: Warehouse staff spent excessive time physically tracking down paperwork, communicating arrivals via radio or in-person, and manually updating spreadsheets to coordinate quality control tasks.
The Odoo Solution
To solve these challenges, Amel utilized a combination of Odoo's Inventory, Quality, and Discuss/Automation applications. The solution was designed to create a seamless, automated flow from the moment a truck arrives to the moment a product hits the shelves.
1. Real-Time Operator Notifications
To solve the communication gap, Odoo was configured to act as the central nervous system for the warehouse floor.
- Automated Chatter & Discuss Alerts: Whenever a shipment is scanned and marked as "Received" in the Odoo Inventory app, an automated action instantly pings the designated warehouse channel in Odoo Discuss.
- Complete Visibility: All operators receive a real-time notification on their devices (tablets or workstations) detailing the receipt number, the supplier, and the items that have just arrived. Everyone is instantly on the same page, eliminating idle time.
2. Smart Quality Control Routing
Instead of relying on human memory or paper checklists to decide what needs testing, Amel leveraged Odoo's Quality Control Points (QCP).
- Targeted Inspections: Quality Control Points were configured for specific products, product categories, or specific vendors that have historically required closer monitoring.
- Automated Intervention: When a receipt containing these specific products is processed, Odoo automatically generates a "Quality Check" task. The inventory move is effectively paused; the system prevents the products from being moved into general stock until the Quality team logs in, performs the required checks (e.g., measuring dimensions, taking photos, or simple Pass/Fail tests), and validates the operation.
Key Benefits and Results
The integration of Odoo's Inventory and Quality modules delivered immediate, measurable impact for Amel:
- Massive Time Savings: By eliminating manual data entry, paper trails, and unnecessary communication delays, the warehouse team reallocated their time toward processing shipments faster.
- Zero-Defect Receiving: Because Odoo physically restricts the movement of flagged items until a Quality Check is passed, the risk of defective products entering the supply chain has been completely neutralized.
- Empowered Operators: Warehouse staff no longer have to guess or ask around about incoming shipments. The automated notification system ensures complete transparency, allowing operators to prioritize their tasks dynamically based on real-time arrivals.
Conclusion
By standardizing its receiving and quality control processes within Odoo, Amel has achieved a highly transparent, efficient, and reliable inbound supply chain. The solution guarantees that operators are always informed and that every critical product is thoroughly vetted before it ever reaches the shelves—safeguarding Amel's reputation for quality without sacrificing speed.

tracks.name: Automating Bank Reconciliation in Odoo with EBICS: A Real-World Integration
tracks.speaker_line: Raphael Ritter, Managing Partner at 2BIT Digital GmbH
tracks.description_text:
In this session, we present a real-world customer implementation of an EBICS-based banking integration in Odoo, enabling fully automated payment processing and bank reconciliation.
Many companies struggle with fragmented banking processes, manual payment uploads, and delayed reconciliation. This often results in inefficiencies, errors, and a lack of real-time financial visibility.
We will demonstrate how these challenges were solved by integrating Odoo with multiple banks using the EBICS standard. The session includes a live demonstration of our EBICS module, showing how payment files are transmitted directly to banks and how bank statements are automatically retrieved and processed in Odoo.
Participants will learn how companies can eliminate manual steps, increase accuracy, and ensure secure communication with their banking partners. The solution supports integration with any bank that provides EBICS, making it highly flexible and scalable.
Key takeaways:
- How EBICS enables secure and standardized bank integration
- How to automate payment processing directly from Odoo
- How to streamline bank reconciliation and reduce manual work
- Lessons learned from real customer implementations
Target audience:
This session is aimed at CFOs, finance managers, and Odoo partners who want to improve financial processes and automate their banking operations using industry standards like EBICS.

speakers.name: Raphael Ritter
speakers.biography_text:

Raphael has led multiple projects in the banking and public sectors, focusing on modern web technologies and cloud-based platforms. With strong expertise in Microsoft and .NET technologies as well as software architecture, he designs and implements robust integrations between Odoo and external systems, including banking interfaces based on EBICS.

The '0 to 100' talk is Scheek's firsthand account of what it really takes to bring an idea from concept to acquisition. From prototyping through the night to navigating investor politics and macroeconomic headwinds, this talk captures the raw, unfiltered reality of building a company.
Listeners will learn how to:
- Turn resource constraints into competitive advantages
- Negotiate with investors, partners, and acquirers at every stage

tracks.name: How to unify and scale multi-channel business operations at a 50m+ E-Commerce brand
tracks.speaker_line: Ferry Kluger, Co-founder at bobco GmbH
tracks.description_text:
Fast-growing eCommerce companies often look very modern from the outside. Strong brand, high order volume, advanced marketing, automated fulfillment, and a polished customer experience.
But behind the scenes, the operational backbone often tells a different story: product master data in several sheets, supply chain planning in spreadsheets, purchasing outside the ERP, inventory valuation patched manually, B2B sales managed through inboxes, and finance teams trying to reconcile numbers that were never generated from one coherent process.
That was the starting point for Rosental. The obvious mistake would have been to “replace everything” in one giant ERP project. That is how many ERP implementations drag on forever, lose focus, and create unnecessary operational risk.
Instead, we used a stricter playbook: protect what already works, identify where the business urgently needs a single source of truth, and implement Odoo first where it creates the highest operational leverage.
In this talk, Rosental and bob will walk through the Odoo implementation strategy from A to Z: discovery, pain quantification, scope design, phased rollout, master data cleanup, procurement, inventory valuation, B2B order-to-cash, fulfillment integration, financial control, and post-go-live improvement.
The main lesson: for high-growth eCommerce brands, Odoo does not need to replace the entire commerce stack on day one. It needs to become the operational backbone that connects product data, purchasing, inventory, valuation, B2B sales, and finance.
What you’ll learn:
- How to scope an Odoo implementation for a high-growth eCommerce company without creating unnecessary go-live risk.
- Why the first ERP phase should focus on operational truth, not maximum system replacement.
- How to identify the “hero work” that signals broken processes and fragmented data.
- How to decide what belongs in Odoo first: master data, purchasing, inventory, valuation, B2B sales, finance, and integrations.
- How to phase an implementation so the business gets value quickly while leaving room for continuous improvement.
- Why clean product and supplier data is the foundation for COGS, inventory valuation, supply chain visibility, and finance.
- How customer and partner teams can work together during discovery, migration, go-live, and stabilization.

speakers.name: Ferry Kluger
speakers.biography_text: Ferry is the founder and managing director of bobco GmbH, a Berlin-based ERP agency specializing in Odoo implementations for operationally complex and high-growth companies. In this session, Ferry will co-present with Rosental, sharing how a fast-growing eCommerce brand approached Odoo not as a full replatforming project, but as the foundation for scalable operations, clean data, better financial control, and a stronger B2B business.

tracks.name: De timide à connecteur mondial : comment créer un réseau qui ouvre toutes les portes
tracks.speaker_line: Jérémie Vanopdenbosch, CEO de Business Entourage, conférencier TEDx et auteur
tracks.description_text:
Votre réseau n'est plus un carnet d'adresses. C'est votre avantage concurrentiel.
Et si votre prochaine opportunité à plusieurs millions d'euros se trouvait à une seule conversation de vous ?
Jérémie Vanopdenbosch a longtemps cru que les compétences suffisaient pour réussir. Ingénieur de formation, il a conduit des analyses décisionnelles pour des entreprises du CAC 40 sur des enjeux à plusieurs milliards d'euros. Il y a découvert une réalité qui change tout : les décisions les plus importantes ne se prennent pas dans les salles de réunion, mais dans les relations de confiance qui y mènent.
Ancien grand timide confronté à plus de 5 000 refus, il a bâti l'un des réseaux les plus influents de la francophonie, connectant CEO du Fortune 500, investisseurs, entrepreneurs à forte croissance et personnalités publiques. CEO de Business Entourage, speaker TEDx et auteur du bestseller 15 règles d'or pour créer un réseau influent (Eyrolles), il partagera les stratégies qui lui ont permis cette transformation.
Au cours de cette conférence, vous découvrirez :
Comment créer instantanément une connexion authentique avec n'importe quelle personne, quel que soit son niveau d'influence.
Les techniques pour approcher dirigeants, investisseurs ou clients stratégiques sans jamais paraître opportuniste.
Les erreurs qui empêchent la majorité des entrepreneurs de développer un réseau réellement influent.
Les principes utilisés par les meilleurs connecteurs au monde pour accélérer leur croissance et leur impact.

The window to build competitive advantage, to reshape your operating model, to reimagine what's possible, it's measured in months, not years. Those who move now will own the next decade.

tracks.speaker_line: Richard Nguyen, Business Analyst & Expertise at Odoo
tracks.description_text:
Do massive data volumes automatically mean slow, unusable reporting? Whether you are evaluating Odoo's scalability, or a seasoned user wrestling with a heavy "dinosaur" database burdened by centuries of technical baggage, this talk is for you.

You will walk away with actionable best practices for data management and reporting design architecture, ready to build performance-optimised dashboards. Let's get the analysis rolling !

speakers.name: Richard Nguyen
speakers.biography_text:
A dedicated data enthusiast,
Richard
blends technical skills with strategic business analysis. Since joining Odoo in 2021, he has evolved from a Business Analyst & Implementation Manager into a driving force within the Expertise Team, where he is currently building out Odoo's Business Intelligence Service. Armed with an Engineering degree and a complementary Master in BI, Richard thrives on solving complex data puzzles. Looking for guidance on your next big data project? Let's connect, come say hi!

tracks.name: Reclaiming the AI narrative: From dystopia to wisdom
tracks.speaker_line: Caroline Lair
tracks.description_text: AI is a mirror of our fears, our hunger for transcendence, and an exhausted system of extraction and control. What if we asked not just what intelligence we need, but what wisdom we're missing? This conference explores AI as a tool for regeneration, bridging Solarpunk's ecological vision with Lunarpunk's introspective, sacred depth. The tools for conscious innovation already exist — open-source models, frugal AI, biomimicry, privacy-preserving tech. What's missing are the dreamers and builders willing to design technology that heals rather than numbs and controls.

speakers.name: Caroline Lair
speakers.biography_text: Caroline Lair sits at the intersection of technology, social sciences, and spirituality, bringing a rare perspective to one of the most consequential questions of our time: what kind of AI do we want to build, and for what future? With a background spanning startups, investment, and entrepreneurship, she founded The Good AI and co-founded Women in AI — a global community of 15,000+ members across 100 countries. Today, as an investor and speaker, she works with organizations navigating the tension between technological acceleration and the values they claim to hold. Inspired by Solarpunk thinking, she champions a pragmatic and intentional vision for AI, one that serves regeneration, inclusion, and the future we actually want to build.

tracks.name: Opening a Café with Odoo: How Café Hoch³ Built a Digital Business Setup from Day One
tracks.speaker_line: David Goerke, Managing Director at Café Hoch³
tracks.description_text:
How can a newly opened café build a digital, integrated and pragmatic business setup from day one? This session presents the story of Café Hoch³ in Stralsund, where Odoo was introduced as the central business platform right from the opening. The café uses Odoo for point of sale, website, accounting, loyalty and discount programs, and WhatsApp-based customer communication. A particularly interesting aspect is that Managing Director David Goerke implemented most of the Odoo setup himself, while Intero supported him selectively with app selection, hardware-related questions and setup guidance.  This makes the talk more than a standard implementation story. It becomes a practical example of enabled self-implementation: a model in which the customer takes ownership of large parts of the rollout while still benefiting from expert guidance where needed. It illustrates how Odoo can be an excellent fit for smaller and fast-moving hospitality businesses that value standardization, usability and speed of execution.
The session will cover how to choose the right Odoo apps for gastronomy, how to connect front-office and back-office processes in one system, and what matters when selecting a modern point-of-sale setup for café operations. The original story especially highlights Odoo’s intuitive interface, modular scalability, mobile usability and seamless integration across apps.  Attendees will gain practical insights into launching a hospitality business with Odoo, structuring a digital operating model from the beginning, and balancing self-service implementation with targeted partner support.

speakers.name: David Goerke
speakers.biography_text: David Goerke is Managing Director of Café Hoch³ in Stralsund and combines entrepreneurial hands-on execution with experience in digital transformation. Alongside his role in the café business, he is active in nonprofit leadership and business development. Earlier in his career, he also worked in software engineering and operational social-impact environments. For the opening of Café Hoch³, he chose a strongly digital operating model from day one and established Odoo as the central platform for key business processes.

tracks.name: The day Biometrics met real users: an Odoo case study
tracks.speaker_line: Antony Kisleyko, Senior Business Analyst at Ventor Tech
tracks.description_text:
This is a real Odoo case showing how to make biometric attendance resilient to real-world user behavior.
The client deployed biometric attendance expecting accurate and fully automated time tracking. In practice, everyday user behavior exposed process gaps that resulted in attendance inconsistencies, payroll issues, and manual corrections.
KEY LEARNINGS
- Biometric identification alone does not guarantee accurate attendance
- Common user workarounds: incorrect punch types, forgotten check-outs, badge sharing, and mixed entry/exit points
- Inconsistent biometric events can be detected and classified automatically
- A single incorrect punch can trigger multiple attendance errors if not properly handled
- Guided correction workflows improve payroll accuracy while reducing HR effort
- Attendance and payroll can be safely reprocessed after schedule changes
VALUES FOR THE AUDIENCE
Practical techniques for making attendance processes in Odoo more reliable, reducing manual HR effort, and improving the quality of attendance data used for payroll and overtime control.
TARGET AUDIENCE
- Business Owners
- Manufacturing Managers
- Warehouse Managers
- HR Managers
- Payroll Specialists
- System Administrators
- Security Specialists
- Solution Architects

speakers.name: Antony Kisleyko
speakers.biography_text: With extensive experience in Odoo solution architecture and business process automation, he helps companies design scalable ERP solutions for complex operational and financial workflows. His expertise includes finance, enterprise integrations, and system architecture, with a strong focus on building reliable, maintainable solutions for real-world business challenges.

tracks.name: Debug Your CV!
tracks.speaker_line: Kaat Goiris & Elise Derclaye, Campus Coordinator at Odoo
tracks.description_text:
Ready to crack the code to landing your dream job? Getting hired isn’t about pretending to be a "perfect" candidate, it’s about knowing exactly how to make your true value shine in just a few seconds!
In this session, we are pulling back the curtain on the recruitment process. We’ll put you in the recruiter’s seat to reveal exactly what grabs our attention, how to instantly stand out from the crowd, and what it really takes to turn a great CV into a successful first interview.
Stop guessing what companies are looking for and start walking into your interviews feeling completely unstoppable. Join us to decode the hiring process, unlock your confidence, and let's get you noticed!

speakers.name: Kaat Goiris & Elise Derclaye
speakers.biography_text:
Kaat Goiris and Elise Derclaye are
Campus Coordinators at Odoo
, where they connect students and young talent with the professional world through campus events, job fairs, internships and employer-branding initiatives.
With a strong focus on
Gen Z recruitment and engagement
, they explore how companies can attract and connect with young talent in a way that feels authentic, relevant and anything but corporate.

tracks.name: When UX meets functional: Building a Web project
tracks.speaker_line: Sylwia Siemieniuk & Samuel Buccheri from Odoo
tracks.description_text:
Join this dual-led session featuring a Website Expert and a Web Designer, as they take you behind the scenes of building a complete eCommerce site — from visual design to technical implementation.
Through a real-world case study, building an online store for a flower shop, you'll discover how to blend aesthetics and functionality to craft a smooth, engaging shopping experience.

tracks.name: Mastering Enterprise Accounting: Architecting Complex Intercompany Flows in Odoo
tracks.speaker_line: Serkan Özcan, Principal Project Leader + Consultant at braintec
tracks.description_text:
Moving beyond standard bookkeeping, large-scale corporate portfolios require a level of financial orchestration that often seems at odds with "out-of-the-box" ERP logic. This session presents a success story of a major group implementation—initially pitched against SAP/Haufe—where a full functional go-live was achieved in just two months. The challenge? A centralized "In-House Bank" model where subsidiaries operate without independent cash outflows, requiring complex transversal settlements and automated month-end netting.
The core value of this talk lies in demonstrating that Odoo’s framework is powerful enough to handle non-standard accounting processes, provided one possesses a deep architectural understanding of its engine. We will explore how a "Standard-First" philosophy, supplemented by surgical SQL-based data extraction and lightweight core extensions, can solve even the most rigid corporate requirements.
Key Learnings for the Audience:
The "Engine-First" Approach: Why deep framework knowledge is the prerequisite for solving complex, non-standard accounting workflows through configuration.
Transversal Settlement Architecture: A technical breakdown of how to manage a "Parent-as-Bank" model, using Odoo’s internal mechanisms to bridge subsidiary payables and parent cash.
Surgical Data Extraction: How to use targeted SQL queries to pull high-performance reporting data out of Odoo when standard UI views reach their limits.
Balancing Core & Custom: Identifying the thin line between "good configuration" and "necessary extension" to keep the system upgradeable and audit-ready.
Value for the Audience:
Attendees will see a transparent look at a high-level integration that goes beyond basic tutorials. You will learn how to architect Odoo for a multi-entity portfolio by leaning on its native strengths while using expert-level technical maneuvers (SQL and slight core adaptations) to fill the gaps. This talk serves as a blueprint for consultants and CFOs who need to deliver enterprise-grade financial results in record time.
Target Audience:
Senior Functional Consultants, Odoo Architects, CFOs, and Financial Controllers who deal with multi-company environments and high-complexity accounting.

speakers.name: Serkan Özcan
speakers.biography_text:
Serkan Özcan is a Principal Project Leader & Consultant at braintec with over seven years of experience implementing Odoo ERP. With a degree in Business Information Technology and a background in IT audit and business analysis at PwC, Serkan brings a structured, risk-aware view of business processes to every project.
He has led dozens of implementations for companies of nearly every size, from one-person businesses to international groups, across trade, events and professional services. That range taught him how much Odoo's standard already covers, and that the craft lies in fitting it precisely to the business.

tracks.description_text: This talk aims at demonstrating barcode usefulness, at providing barcode best practices, and at presenting new features related to barcode and labels.

tracks.name: Building High-Performance Odoo eCommerce with S3 and Google Merchant Center.
tracks.speaker_line: Benjamin Seeßle, ERP Consultant at much. Consulting
tracks.description_text:
Launching an Odoo eCommerce site from scratch with a large catalog requires more than just a beautiful theme; it demands a "Performance-First" infrastructure, so your system doesn't slow down. This talk breaks down a real-world implementation strategy for businesses launching with over 1,000 SKUs and 500+ daily visitors, where technical scalability is the primary constraint. We move past the standard Odoo Website builder to show how offloading heavy media - such as high-resolution product videos and images - to AWS S3 and a Global CDN preserves Odoo worker capacity for critical backend tasks.
We will also tackle the tricky parts of multi-channel scaling by deep-diving into Google Merchant Center integration. You will learn how to resolve technical "mismatches" in Odoo’s standard product feeds, specifically focusing on how to map your categories and sync product attributes so Google doesn't penalize your indexing. Finally, we'll address the importance of project timeline to make sure your pricing and sales channels are fully planned out before any coding starts, bridging the gap between your marketing goals and technical reality in Odoo Enterprise.
Key Points of the Talk:
- Speed Optimization: Offloading media rendering to S3/CDN to keep workers free so Odoo runs faster.
- Better Product Feeds: Matching Odoo product variants to Google Merchant Center’s rigid categories.
- Infrastructure Scaffolding: Setting up your technical foundation so it is ready for future product configurators and marketing automation.
- UX via Data: Using Odoo Product Tags and filters so customers can easily browse large catalogs.
- Global Latency: Using CDNs to ensure the site loads quickly for shoppers anywhere in the world.
- Timeline Alignment: Managing implementation milestones to ensure data-ready "Day One" launches.
Key Learnings:
- How to offload heavy website files to external clouds so your Odoo’s performance doesn't degrade.
- How to reconcile Odoo’s flexible product categories with Google’s mandatory taxonomy for Merchant Center.
- How to avoid common SEO/Google penalties caused by poor-quality product feed data.
- How to build a flexible B2C/B2B theme that easily handles large catalogs using Odoo’s built-in filters.
Target Audience:
- Project Managers & Consultants overseeing complex eCommerce migrations.
- E-commerce Managers scaling catalogs beyond 1k SKUs on Odoo Enterprise.

speakers.name: Benjamin Seeßle
speakers.biography_text: Benjamin Seeßle is an ERP Consultant at much. Consulting, specializing in digital transformation, master-data restructuring, and enterprise process design. He has a proven track record of re-architecting complex product and master-data frameworks within the retail sector, where he digitalized inventory workflows and built synchronized workflows across ERP, POS, and e-commerce channels.

tracks.name: The ultimate guide to run your sport club on Odoo
tracks.speaker_line: Emile Gillieaux, Account Manager at Odoo
tracks.description_text:
Managing a sports club in Odoo creates a seamless, automated workflow by connecting your website, membership management, bookings, and events into a single ecosystem.
It all begins on your Odoo Website, where prospective members browse subscription plans, court availabilities, and upcoming events. When a user selects a membership and pays online, Odoo instantly creates their profile in the CRM, generates a recurring contract, and issues the first invoice. Behind the scenes, the Subscriptions module takes over the membership lifecycle, securely storing member data, tracking payment statuses, and automating future billings.
For daily operations, members use the Appointments module on the website to book real-time slots for court rentals, choosing their preferred sport, terrain, and time. This booking tool syncs with the club's schedule to prevent double bookings, issues confirmation emails, and can process rental fees on the spot for non-members.
Finally, larger activities like classes, tournaments, or high-stakes championship games are managed through the Events module, which automatically publishes them to the website. To handle premier matches with limited seating, you can define maximum capacity limits for the venue and configure multiple ticket tiers. This allows you to set tiered pricing based on the seats such as VIP courtside, premium stands, or standard general admission. Members register online, select their tier, and receive a confirmation email featuring a unique QR code. On game day, staff scan these codes at the gate via their phones to securely check participants in, validate seat categories, and instantly update the club's attendance and revenue records.

tracks.name: Product Demonstration for Mid-Market & Corporate
tracks.speaker_line: Claire Devogele from Odoo
tracks.description_text:
Description:
Claire Devogele
is a Business Advisor in the Mid-Market & Corporate team at Odoo, where she helps growing and enterprise organizations evaluate how Odoo can support complex business operations and digital transformation initiatives.
In this session, Claire will showcase a live demonstration of Odoo focused on the most common challenges faced by mid-market and corporate companies. Through practical business scenarios, attendees will discover how Odoo streamlines cross-functional processes, improves operational efficiency, and provides a scalable platform to support business growth.

tracks.name: Beyond blocks: Mastering the Website Builder
tracks.speaker_line: Augustin Dupin from Odoo
tracks.description_text: Creating a custom website block is only the beginning. In this session, we will go behind the sidebar to explore the Website Builder’s plugin architecture, resource system, and extension points. Along the way, we will see how custom behavior integrate with core mechanisms such as previews, undo/redo, and saving.

tracks.speaker_line: Thomas Vanavermaete from Odoo
tracks.description_text: The goal of this talk is to cover all the new features like 3 way matching, as well as other improvements and changes to the Purchase app and replenishment (reordering rules, MPS, etc.).

tracks.name: Odoo Discuss: your integrated communication platform
tracks.speaker_line: Fabrice Henrion, R&D at Odoo
tracks.description_text: This talk will showcase how your organization can use Odoo Discuss to improve internal and external communications.

tracks.name: B2B lead gen: Combining Odoo Live Chat, CRM & automations with AI
tracks.speaker_line: Elisabeth Saint-Paul, Business Analyst & Marketing Expert at Odoo
tracks.description_text: Discover how AI and automation can turn anonymous website visitors into qualified sales opportunities. Through a use case, we will follow the complete journey of a prospect, from their first website visit to a sales meeting, showing how AI enriches leads, automates qualification, and helps sales teams sell more efficiently.

tracks.name: Work like a real business with Odoo
tracks.speaker_line: Christophe KYDTS, economics and business management teacher at GROUPE EPID-VAUBAN
tracks.description_text:
Discover how Odoo can be integrated into teaching through a combination of
practical classroom experience, ready-to-use learning materials and student feedback
.
In the first part of the session, you’ll get the teacher’s perspective: why this approach was chosen, how it was implemented, and what has been learned from working with students over the past year. You’ll also get a look at the resources available through
monespaceco.odoo.com
, including newly developed scenarios organised by business process.
In the second part, students will take the stage to present what they worked on and share their own perspective on using Odoo. They’ll discuss how it influenced their learning, helped them better understand real business processes, and supported them during their internships.
A practical session combining
the teacher’s approach with the students’ real experience
.

speakers.name: Christophe KYDTS
speakers.biography_text:
Christophe Kydts is an
economics and business management teacher and teacher trainer
with a strong focus on digital learning and practical business education. He has extensive experience using
Odoo in BTS GPME
, where he creates realistic business scenarios that allow students to learn by managing customers, suppliers, sales, accounting and eCommerce processes themselves.
Alongside his teaching, Christophe develops and shares
Odoo tutorials, practical learning resources and ready-to-use scenarios
for teachers and students, with a strong focus on autonomy, active learning and connecting classroom theory with real professional practice.

tracks.name: How Odoo Runs the most Luxury Resort on the Albanian Riviera
tracks.speaker_line: Arnold Kadiu, Ceo at Zero l Odoo Partner
tracks.description_text:
Kep Merli is not a typical hotel. It's a 28-acre private peninsula on the Albanian Riviera — a luxury eco-resort with award-winning villas. It sits next to UNESCO-protected Butrint and has become the destination of choice for international celebrities like Dua Lipa or Mira Murati and high-net-worth visitors seeking privacy on the Mediterranean.
Behind the scenes, every single operation — from a cocktail served at the bar to a guest checking into a sea-view villa — runs on Odoo.
This talk tells the story of how Zero, implemented and scaled Odoo to manage a resort where operational excellence isn't optional — it's the entire brand promise. When your guests include global icons who expect perfection, your back-office has zero room for error.
What we'll cover:
How we unified every operation under one Odoo instance — restaurants, bars, beach service, spa, marina, retail, conference facilities, and villa management — each with its own POS terminal posting to a centralized accounting ledger in real time. How we configured multi-entity operations with shared products, unified reporting, and independent fiscalization under Albanian tax law.
Key learnings for the audience:
- How to architect Odoo for a multi-venue hospitality operation where POS, Inventory, Purchasing, and Accounting must work as one seamless system across 20+ physical touchpoints
- Real-world challenges of running Odoo POS in a luxury resort environment — outdoor terminals, seasonal staff turnover, and the pressure of serving guests who expect instant, flawless service.
- Multi-company configuration for hospitality groups that mix real estate development with hotel operations under different legal entities.
- Albanian fiscalization setup and compliance for complex multi-revenue resort businesses — applicable to any country with e-invoicing requirements.
- Lessons from migrating a live hospitality operation from Odoo v16 to v18 without interrupting daily service
Target audience: Odoo partners looking to break into the hospitality and tourism vertical, resort and hotel operators evaluating Odoo as an alternative to legacy PMS/POS systems, and anyone interested in multi-venue, multi-company Odoo architectures for complex service businesses.

speakers.name: Arnold Kadiu
speakers.biography_text: Arnold Kadiu is the CEO and founder of Zero Group, one of the first Odoo Partners in the Balkans and an Odoo Gold Partner since 2020. He has led Odoo implementations across hospitality, banking, manufacturing, real estate, and e-governance for clients in Albania, Kosovo, Malta, and Italy. Zero Group has expanded its hospitality solution to cover channel management, IoT integrations, and multi-property operations, establishing Odoo as a viable all-in-one alternative to legacy hotel management systems.

tracks.name: SEO Is Not Dead — Your Traffic Strategy Is
tracks.speaker_line: Mikael da Costa, Founder & CEO at Mikael da Costa
tracks.description_text:
People are still searching for your products and services — but they are no longer discovering your website for the answer.
Google AI Overviews, ChatGPT, Perplexity, and other AI-driven search systems are rapidly changing how users find information, compare vendors, and make buying decisions. More than 60% of Google searches now end without a click, leaving many companies wondering why traffic is dropping even when demand still exists. In this session, Mikael da Costa (Founder & CEO of WP SEO AI) explains how modern businesses can adapt their visibility strategy for the era of AI-powered discovery.
The talk explores how SEO is evolving from keyword rankings into a broader visibility framework that combines:
- Search intent optimization
- AI search visibility (GEO)
- Strategic SEA integration
- Long-tail content architecture
- Brand recommendation signals inside generative systems
Attendees will learn:
- Why traditional SEO metrics are becoming misleading
- How AI-generated answers impact organic traffic and CTR
- How to structure content for both search engines and AI systems
- Why smaller businesses can outperform larger competitors through intent-driven visibility
- How SEO and paid acquisition can work together instead of competing
The session is especially relevant for eCommerce brands, agencies, marketers, and Odoo users looking to future-proof customer acquisition as search behavior continues to shift toward AI-driven experiences.
Rather than focusing on theory, this talk provides practical frameworks businesses can immediately apply to remain visible where modern buying decisions actually happen.

speakers.name: Mikael da Costa
speakers.biography_text: Mikael da Costa is an entrepreneur and AI search strategist specializing in the future of digital visibility. As Founder & CEO of WP SEO AI, he helps companies adapt from traditional SEO only toward wha the calls full search visibility. His work focuses on combining SEO, GEO, and paid acquisition into scalable visibility systems that help businesses grow despite declining organic clicks and rapidly changing search behavior.

tracks.name: When the World Becomes the Interface
tracks.speaker_line: Soraya Jaber, Tech Entrepreneur, Strategic Advisor and Speaker. Co-founder, Studio Meije
tracks.description_text: For decades, digital work has been confined to screens, windows, and keyboards. Based on her entrepreneurial journey and her work at Studio Meije, Soraya Jaber explores how AI and spatial computing are bringing digital information into physical environments. She examines how these technologies are transforming the way companies sell and communicate, as well as how people learn, collaborate, make decisions, and interact with businesses. Through concrete use cases and the realities of building with emerging technologies without an established playbook, she shows how companies can move beyond impressive demonstrations to create meaningful business value.

speakers.name: Soraya Jaber
speakers.function: Tech Entrepreneur, Strategic Advisor and Speaker. Co-founder, Studio Meije

tracks.name: Mindful Financial Flow & Ethical Wealth Creation
tracks.speaker_line: Elangovan Subramaniam, Operational Director at Sodexis
tracks.description_text:
True wealth creation is not merely about capital accumulation; it is about fostering a prosperous equilibrium between your business, stakeholders, and the broader community. Every financial transaction creates a ripple effect. How can modern enterprises balance ambitious revenue goals with societal well-being?
This session provides a practical blueprint for operationalising "mindful financial flow" using Odoo’s integrated ecosystem. We will demonstrate how to architect an ERP environment where financial health naturally fuels both internal stability and community upliftment.
Key Session Takeaways:
Absolute Transparency: Utilising Odoo Accounting to maintain crystal-clear visibility into revenue streams and ethical allocations.
Impact Tracking: Measuring the tangible ROI of sustainable investments and responsible resource management.
Supply Chain Fairness: Configuring smart workflows to ensure equitable transactions and automate the distribution of surplus resources.
Discover how your business can thrive financially while simultaneously elevating the society it serves, all powered by Odoo's seamless automation.

speakers.name: Elangovan Subramaniam
speakers.biography_text:
Elangovan Subramaniam is Operational Director - India Operations & Consultant at Sodexis, an official Odoo partner since 2012. With deep expertise in Odoo ERP implementations, he drives efficient digital transformations for manufacturing and distribution businesses, delivering high-ROI solutions through streamlined operations and strategic consulting.
A graduate of Kumaraguru College of Technology, Elangovan combines technical proficiency with mindful leadership. He is also a committed long-term activist promoting moral education and community harmony.

tracks.name: Marketing Automation: Let's build advanced marketing flows
tracks.speaker_line: Charline Vanderschelde from Odoo
tracks.description_text:
Odoo's new Marketing Automation is not an upgrade, it's a reinvention. In this session, we'll live-build five real-world campaigns that go far beyond "send an email, wait 3 days, send another."
You'll see how to combine behavioral triggers (emails opened, links clicked, pages visited, forms submitted) with conditional branching, lead scoring, AI-generated personalization, and automated coupon generation : all in one visual flow.
From a lead scoring machine that hands off hot prospects to sales at exactly the right moment, to a birthday campaign where AI writes a unique message and generates a personalized discount code.
No theory. Just flows.
What you'll take away:
- How to design multi-branch flows that react to customer behavior in real time
- How to use the new AI step for dynamic personalization at scale
- How to chain campaigns together with Go To and cross-flow logic
- How to handle exceptions gracefully (bounces, unresponsive contacts)

tracks.name: Multi-database synchronization: Technical challenges and design patterns
tracks.speaker_line: Stanislas Gueniffey, Customisations Architect at Odoo
tracks.description_text:
Multi-DB Synchronization: Technical Challenges and Design Patterns
Multi-database integrations offer massive functional value, but synchronizing complex data across independent systems is notoriously risky. When standard multi-company configurations are no longer viable, custom synchronization architectures become essential. In this technical talk, we will explore advanced design patterns for building robust, transport-agnostic synchronization engines. Attendees will learn how to safely resolve cross-database relational dependencies using idempotent payload ingestion and "heal-in-place" stub records. We will also tackle performance bottlenecks by designing an O(1) bulk data loader, leveraging 3-pass imports and deferred post-commits to prevent worker crashes during massive data syncs. Finally, we will cover modern strategies for exchanging large binary files without crippling database performance. This talk equips developers and architects with a concrete toolkit of design patterns to turn complex multi-database integrations into stable, predictable successes.
Disclaimer
: The patterns discussed in this talk are not part of the Odoo standard nor any future roadmap. They represent generic architectural guidelines and best-practice design patterns for building synchronization engines

tracks.name: Multi-Company accounting across 27 companies in France
tracks.speaker_line: Toussaint Delacroix, Functional Architect at White Pass
tracks.description_text:
Titre :
Multi-Company accounting across 27 companies in France
Client représenté :
Centurion
Présentateur :
Client

The presentation will explore the challenges of maintaining consistent accounting practices while addressing the specific needs of each entity. Topics include intercompany transactions, financial controls, reporting standardization, consolidation, and regulatory compliance in a multi-company environment.

speakers.name: Toussaint Delacroix
speakers.biography_text: Toussaint Delacroix is an Odoo Functional Architect and Project Manager with extensive expertise in accounting and financial process optimization. Through his consultancy, White Pass SRL, he currently supports Centurion in designing and improving Odoo-based financial operations. Combining a background in business engineering with hands-on ERP expertise, he specializes in helping organizations standardize processes, improve governance, and gain greater visibility across complex multi-company environments.

tracks.name: Ease your inter-company and inter-branches stock flow in V20
tracks.speaker_line: Antoine Caron, Business Analyst at Odoo
tracks.description_text:
You didn’t scale your business to spend your days chasing ghost inventory between companies or manually cross-checking sales and purchase orders. In this talk, discover how Odoo strips away the complexity of inter-company logistics, allowing you to set up and run automated flows in just a few clicks
We will walk through the step-by-step setup of a complete Interco flow and demonstrate just how easy it is to automate purchasing, sales, and inventory tracking between your entities. No complex workarounds, no manual double-entry.
Discover how to bridge your companies seamlessly and bring 100% automated efficiency to your entire business ecosystem.

speakers.name: Antoine Caron
speakers.biography_text: Antoine knows the reality of the field: he is a former Industrial Supply Chain Manager who has spent the last two years as a Business Analyst at Odoo Luxembourg. Whether driving Quickstart projects or supporting partners on high-stakes logistics, he has successfully implemented solutions ranging from a small Scottish firm to an aerospace leader.

tracks.name: Scaling an Artisan Bakery Business with Odoo
tracks.speaker_line: Mohamad Kreidly, Founder at Sourdough
tracks.description_text:
Growth creates complexity. What works for a single store often breaks when multiple branches, centralized production, and financial visibility become critical.
In this presentation, Sourdough Bakery shares its journey from a small artisan bakery to a growing multi-location operation powered by Odoo Enterprise. We will explore how we built dashboards, tracked operational KPIs, controlled food costs, managed inventory and procurement, and created visibility across the organization. The session will focus on practical business outcomes rather than software features, demonstrating how Odoo became the operational backbone that enabled informed decisions, process standardization, and scalable growth.
Attendees will leave with actionable ideas for using Odoo to improve profitability, accountability, and performance management in their own organizations.
