tracks.name: Why International Companies with a German Entity Don't Need DATEV — Audit-Ready Accounting in Odoo
tracks.speaker_line: Florian Pichl, CFO at syscoon GmbH
tracks.description_text:
"If you operate in Germany, you need DATEV." For decades, international groups expanding into Germany have heard this from their local tax advisor — and accepted it as a fact. The result: a parallel German accounting silo, an interface to maintain, additional licenses, and a German entity that only becomes visible to headquarters at month-end.
This talk challenges that belief and shows why DATEV is no longer a requirement for most international companies running a German entity in Odoo.
We walk through, function by function, how Odoo covers the full scope of German accounting inside a multi-company, multi-currency group setup: GoBD-compliant bookkeeping, complete audit trails, SKR03/SKR04 charts of accounts, the German VAT statement (Umsatzsteuervoranmeldung), e-invoicing for Germany, and direct collaboration with external tax advisors — with a clean DATEV export available when it is genuinely needed.
The real value is integration. With Odoo, the German entity reports into the same system as the rest of the group: one chart of accounts mapping, one source of truth from sales order to consolidated P&L, no end-of-month import from a separate accounting island. That eliminates reconciliation work, double tooling, and interface costs — and gives headquarters real-time visibility into the German operation.
Attendees will leave with a clear framework for when DATEV is truly required, when it is not, and how to position Odoo confidently with international finance teams and their German tax advisors. The session is built for CFOs and Heads of Finance of international groups operating in Germany — and for Odoo partners serving them.

tracks.name: Odoo HR for 3,000 Plantation Workers: Attendance, Daily Wages, and Labor Law Compliance Across 12 Remote Sites
tracks.speaker_line: Akhmad Daniel Sembiring, CEO at Vitraining
tracks.description_text:
How VITRAINING built a mobile-first Odoo HR system for a geographically dispersed plantation workforce in Riau, Kalimantan, and Jambi — where internet is spotty and labor regulations are strict.
Abstract
Managing HR for a large plantation workforce is fundamentally different from managing HR in an office environment. Workers are distributed across 12 remote sites spanning three Indonesian provinces. Internet connectivity is unreliable. Daily wage calculations depend on harvest output (Fresh Fruit Bunch kilograms per worker per day), not fixed salaries. And Indonesian labor law (UU Ketenagakerjaan) mandates specific overtime, religious holiday allowances, and BPJS Ketenagakerjaan social security contributions for every worker — even casual daily laborers.
In this talk, VITRAINING presents how we configured and extended Odoo 17 HR and Payroll modules to handle this exact scenario: a mobile-first attendance system using QR codes that syncs to Odoo in batch when connectivity is available; a dynamic daily wage calculation engine tied to actual harvest output recorded in the Inventory module; automated BPJS contribution calculations and government report generation; and a multi-site leave management system that respects 6 different regional public holiday calendars.
We will also cover how we handled the edge cases: workers who split time across multiple sites in a single day, harvest bonus pooling at the team level, and retroactive payroll corrections when harvest weight data is revised after mill processing.
This is a practical, field-tested HR configuration story with direct applicability for any Odoo partner working with plantation, mining, construction, or distributed workforce clients globally.
Key Takeaways for Attendees
●	Offline-capable QR attendance system architecture that batch-syncs to Odoo HR when connectivity is restored
●	Output-based daily wage calculation: linking Odoo Inventory (harvest kg) to Payroll computation rules
●	Indonesian BPJS Ketenagakerjaan and BPJS Kesehatan automated contribution calculation and reporting
●	Multi-site, multi-calendar leave management across 12 locations with different regional holidays
●	Retroactive payroll correction workflow for plantation harvest weight revisions post mill-processing
Target Audience
HR managers, Odoo payroll consultants, partners serving agriculture/plantation/mining/construction verticals, distributed workforce operations
Odoo Modules Featured
HR, Payroll, Attendance, Leave Management, Inventory (harvest integration), custom BPJS module

tracks.name: The Embedded CFO: Why finance is not just a function, but a decision-making capability
tracks.speaker_line: Bright Obeng, Managing Director at CFO Studios
tracks.description_text:
Finance is often described as a function: reporting, budgeting, controlling, compliance, risk and cash management.
All of that remains essential. But it is no longer enough.
In this keynote, Bright Obeng introduces the central idea behind his upcoming book: the modern CFO should not be understood merely as the owner of numbers, but as a critical force in the quality of decisions an organisation makes.
The embedded CFO is close enough to the business to understand where value is created, where it leaks away and where decisions really take shape. But at the same time, the embedded CFO remains independent enough to challenge assumptions, expose trade-offs and protect the organisation from decisions that look attractive on paper but destroy value in practice.
Bright explores why finance must move beyond reporting what happened and become more actively involved in how decisions are sensed, framed, chosen, committed to and protected. In that sense, finance is not just a function. It is a decision-making capability.
This keynote is a sharp and practical reflection on the future of finance, the changing role of the CFO and the importance of embedding finance deeper into the business without losing its independence. It invites leaders to rethink one fundamental question: is finance in your organisation mainly producing reports, or is it helping the business make better decisions?
The keynote is linked to Bright's upcoming book, the first CFO book written in Belgium (for now, in the Dutch version). This book will be launched in November 2026.

speakers.name: Bright Obeng
speakers.biography_text:
Bright Obeng is an entrepreneur, founder of CFO Studios and host of De CFO Podcast, one of Belgium’s leading platforms for CFOs and finance leaders.
With a background in finance, controlling, executive search and media, Bright has built a unique perspective on how the CFO role is evolving. Through De CFO Podcast, he has interviewed CFOs, entrepreneurs, board members and thought leaders on value creation, leadership, technology, growth, risk and decision-making.
These conversations, combined with his own experience in finance and entrepreneurship, form the foundation of his first book, published by Pelckmans. His work focuses on the evolution of finance from a reporting and control function into a strategic capability that helps organisations make better decisions and create more sustainable value.

At the same time, a wave of AI-native startups is going after specific workflows—AI bookkeeping, AI sales development reps, AI customer support agents—betting that a purpose-built agent can outperform a bolted-on feature. And a third category is emerging: "vertical AI" tools built for very specific industries (law firms, dental practices, HVAC contractors) that combine domain expertise with automation in a way horizontal SaaS never could.

tracks.description_text:

In this talk, we will introduce the Digital History Record (DHR), a unified product view that aggregates manufacturing, quality controls, purchases, sales, support tickets, inventory movements, lots, and related documentation into a single interface.
We will explain how the DHR has been designed to leverage existing Odoo data without duplicating information, providing users with immediate access to the complete lifecycle of every product.

tracks.description_text: As all the inventory valuation has been revamped last year, it's important to explain again how it works. A specific focus should be done on the perpetual accounting because many fixes have been done to answer the need of the Anglosaxon accounting.

speakers.name: Richard Shall
speakers.biography_text:
Richard Shall
is a Consultant on the Partner Services team. With 12 years of experience at Odoo, split between implementing and selling Odoo projects, managing teams, and training employees and Partners alike, Richard has a wealth of experience in advising SME's on how to best use Odoo to manage and improve their business operations.

tracks.name: Your best marketing starts after the sales in POS
tracks.speaker_line: Charline Vanderschelde from Odoo
tracks.description_text:
Most retailers think the sale is the finish line. It's not, it's the starting gun.
In this session, we'll show how Odoo's POS becomes the trigger for a fully automated post-purchase marketing engine, combining Marketing Automation, Email, WhatsApp, and Loyalty into flows that run while you focus on your customers.
We'll live-build four real-world flows: a post-purchase thank you sequence that turns a receipt into a relationship, a loyalty tier upgrade that celebrates your best customers at exactly the right moment, an AI-powered win-back campaign that recommends the right product to the right dormant customer, and an ambassador flow that automatically identifies your top buyers and turns them into referral machines.
No generic newsletters. No manual segmentation. No third-party tools.
What you'll take away:
- How to trigger automated flows directly from a POS purchase
- How to combine Email, WhatsApp, and Coupons in a single coordinated flow
- How AI personalizes product recommendations based on individual purchase history
- How to build a referral program entirely within Odoo Loyalty
You will get 4 ready-to-use templates you can deploy in your store this week

tracks.name: Take total control of production planning with the new UX-driven Kanban tools
tracks.speaker_line: Elisabeth Bertholet, Business Analyst at Odoo
tracks.description_text:
Managing short-term manufacturing schedules can easily turn into a chaotic juggling act. In this talk, we’ll share best practices to eliminate bottlenecks using Odoo's newly revamped manufacturing planning.
The real game-changer? Our powerful new Kanban view, equipped with auto-replanning to allow flexibility and avoid planning conflicts. We will also dive into the new employee planning view and a fully optimized Gantt view for Work Orders. Planning has never been easier, allowing you to save time so you can concentrate on your production quality!

speakers.name: Elisabeth Bertholet
speakers.biography_text: Elisabeth is a Business Analyst in Odoo’s Manufacturing Experts Team. With experience in industrial implementations and a strong interest in manufacturing flows, she helps clients and colleagues make the most of Odoo’s MRP apps through a pragmatic and collaborative approach.

tracks.name: One year, four countries: The Kamera Express Odoo journey
tracks.speaker_line: Quentin Allyn from Odoo
tracks.description_text:
In less than a year, we successfully implemented Odoo across 4 countries with Kamera Express, a leading omnichannel photography and electronics retailer with 30+ stores and a strong e-commerce presence.
In this session, we’ll share the key milestones, challenges, and lessons learned from the project, from the legacy architecture and Shopify integration to the rollout across 4 countries.
Agenda:
Introducing Kamera Express
Why Odoo?
From legacy architecture to Odoo
Key project milestones & highlights
Lessons for a successful Odoo implementation
Q&A

tracks.name: How to become an Odoo Partner (and why)
tracks.speaker_line: Greta Beqiraj from Odoo
tracks.description_text:
How to Become an Odoo Partner
The ERP market is broken. Clients are locked in, overcharged, and underserved and they know it. That frustration is your opening.
In this session, we break down what the Odoo partner model actually looks like: how the channel works, how we collaborate together, what the revenue structure is, and what it takes to get started.
You'll hear from partners who made the move: different sizes, different countries, and what it changed for their business.
If you run an IT firm, you already have the clients, the implementation muscle, and the software relationships. Odoo is a product line you can add without rebuilding your business.
The path from today to first deal is shorter than you think.
Come find out or talk to us at the booth.

tracks.name: Agents IA : entre promesses spectaculaires et gains réels
tracks.speaker_line: Micode, Créateur de contenu Cybersecurité / Investigation / IA
tracks.description_text: Les agents IA comme Claude Code ou Codex peuvent vraiment changer notre façon de créer des produits, mais pas toujours comme on l'imagine. Après un an à les utiliser intensément, Micode partagera ce qui marche vraiment, ce qui marche moins, et surtout les méthodes qui lui ont permis d'aller beaucoup plus vite sans sacrifier la qualité. Un retour d'expérience concret, accessible aussi bien aux profils techniques qu'aux curieux.

speakers.name: Micode
speakers.function: Créateur de contenu Cybersecurité / Investigation / IA

tracks.name: Gegolac: How a Family Business Achieved a Successful Transformation
tracks.speaker_line: Frédéric Neus, CEO & Founder at Oxalyo
tracks.description_text:
Gegolac is a family-run industrial company with over 30 years of expertise in aluminum surface treatment. After a bold €7 million investment in its production facilities, Mirko Morici, Managing Director of Gegolac, set out to bring the same level of ambition to the company's processes and management tools, starting with Odoo, which was already in place but only partially leveraged.
In this talk, Frédéric Neus, CEO of OXALYO, will share how his team partnered with Mirko and the Gegolac team to unlock the full potential of Odoo: restructuring internal processes, strengthening financial steering and transforming the ERP into a genuine management and decision-making tool.
The audience will discover how concrete improvements (automated sales flows, electronic delivery note signatures on tablet, better inventory management, tighter monthly closings, budgeting and forecasting, and real-time margin visibility) translated into measurable business results: +25% revenue growth, a €400,000 EBITDA improvement, and +50% growth in Q1 2026 vs. Q1 2025.
Beyond the numbers, this session will explore what it truly means to align ERP optimization with the operational reality of an industrial SME, and how a well-structured Odoo project can become a source of clarity and confidence for leadership.
This session is especially relevant for SME leaders, operations managers, CFOs, Odoo partners, and industrial companies looking to understand how Odoo can support not only digitalization, but also operational, financial and human transformation.

speakers.name: Frédéric Neus
speakers.biography_text: Frédéric Neus is the CEO and Founder of OXALYO, an Odoo implementation and strategic advisory partner for industrial SMEs. He built his expertise over 25 years in senior financial and operational roles at Kodak (13 years, from accounting to business unit CFO) and Puratos (10 years, as CFO Europe, CFO & COO Brazil, and CFO Middle East). This hands-on international experience across complex, fast-changing environments shaped his conviction that SME leaders deserve the same financial clarity and operational structure as large corporations, which led him to found OXALYO.

tracks.name: Odoo vs. Oracle Opera: Why One of Albania's Top Resorts Chose Odoo to Run Its Entire Hotel Operation
tracks.speaker_line: Arnold Kadiu, Ceo at Zero l Odoo Partner
tracks.description_text:
When Kaiser Resort — a luxury beachfront property on the Albanian Riviera — needed to digitize its hotel operations, they evaluated Oracle Opera, the global industry standard used by Hilton, Marriott, and Accor. They chose Odoo instead. This talk explains exactly why, and what happened next.
Oracle Opera is the undisputed king of hotel property management systems, powering over 40,000 hotels worldwide. Every hospitality CTO knows it. So when a resort operator looks at both platforms side by side and picks Odoo, the "why" matters — not just for this hotel, but for every Odoo partner considering whether to pursue the hospitality vertical.
What we'll cover:
The real evaluation criteria that drove Kaiser's decision. Oracle Opera is a powerful PMS — but it is a PMS only. It doesn't do accounting. It doesn't do purchasing. It doesn't do inventory. It doesn't manage your restaurant POS natively. For a resort that needs front desk, restaurant, beach bar, pool bar, housekeeping, procurement, and accounting to talk to each other in real time, Opera means buying five systems and hoping the integrations hold. Odoo means one login, one database, one truth.
We'll walk through how Kaiser Resort runs today on Odoo: reservations flowing into the front desk, guests checking in, POS charges from the beach bar and restaurant posting to guest folios, housekeeping tracked in real time, purchasing and inventory managing everything from linens to the kitchen, and every transaction ending in the accounting module — automatically, without reconciliation.
We'll share the channel manager integrations for connecting Kaiser to Booking.com and other OTAs, how reservations sync into Odoo in real time, and how cancellations are handled automatically.
Key learnings for the audience:
- A transparent, honest comparison of Odoo vs. Oracle Opera from the operator's perspective — where Odoo wins, where Opera has advantages, and why the "all-in-one" argument is the decisive factor for independent resorts.
- How to implement a full hotel operation on Odoo: PMS (reservations, check-in/out, folios), POS (restaurant, bar, beach), Purchasing, Inventory, and Accounting — working as one integrated system
- Channel Manager integration architecture: Real-time sync for reservations, availability, rates, and cancellations.
- The business case for Odoo in hospitality: what it costs vs. Oracle Opera, what the operator gains, and what Odoo partners should know before selling into this vertical
Target audience: Odoo partners evaluating the hospitality market, hotel and resort operators comparing Odoo to legacy PMS solutions like Oracle Opera or Protel, and anyone curious about what it takes to compete with enterprise hospitality software using Odoo.

speakers.name: Arnold Kadiu
speakers.biography_text: Arnold Kadiu is the CEO and founder of Zero Group, one of the first Odoo Partners in the Balkans and an Odoo Gold Partner since 2022. He has led Odoo implementations across hospitality, banking, manufacturing, real estate, and e-governance for clients in Albania, Kosovo, Malta. Zero has expanded its hospitality solution to cover channel management, IoT integrations, and multi-property operations, establishing Odoo as a viable all-in-one alternative to legacy hotel management systems.

tracks.name: Odoo vision for Mid-Market and Corporate segments
tracks.speaker_line: Sébastien Bruyr from Odoo

tracks.name: The roadmap of successful Odoo Partners
tracks.speaker_line: Thomas De Troyer & Olivier Simon, Partner Manager - Wallonia Team at Odoo
tracks.description_text:
Are you a new Odoo Partner or planning to become one?
How many partners truly maximize the potential of their Odoo partnership? The real challenge in your first 12 months isn’t just achieving Gold status—it’s ensuring immediate profitability and operational success. Yet, too many new partners move forward without a clear, actionable strategy.
Designed for prospective and early-stage partners, this session reveals the exact step-by-step roadmap used by top-performing partners to outperform the market from day one.

speakers.name: Thomas De Troyer & Olivier Simon
speakers.biography_text:
Thomas De Troyer is a Partner Manager at Odoo, dedicated to driving partner growth and success across the Belgian market. He specializes in helping new and prospective partners build solid operational, sales, and marketing foundations to help them achieve profitability.
Olivier Simon works as a Key Partner Manager at Odoo. Over the past year in this role, he also had the opportunity to work in Direct Sales, where he gained extensive experience with the product and mastered the sales process. His primary responsibility is to support Odoo partners as a representative of the editor, ensuring their success and alignment with Odoo’s vision.

tracks.name: We built it for our Team. 14,000 people showed up. How Odoo helped us scale an unexpected EdTech Platform
tracks.speaker_line: Eddy BRUART from Heureia
tracks.description_text:
It started with a simple idea between two co-founders: build a short AI training to get our own Agoraz team up to speed. No business plan. No revenue target. Just a practical need.
We built it on Odoo because that's what we already had. Website, eLearning module, user accounts, certifications. It was live in days. Then we decided to make it available publicly. For free. Still with no objective beyond "this might be useful to others."
One year later, Heure IA (www.heureia.com) has reached over 14,000 users across more than 100 countries. A Technical Operation Manager in Switzerland. A Financial Director in Algeria. A student in Burkina Faso. A professional in Cameroon who says she now uses AI every day at work. None of them paid a cent. None of them were in our plan. Because there was no plan.
What we want to share at Odoo Experience is an honest account of what two people with no dev team and no infrastructure budget actually built. From idea to live platform: four weeks. Website, eLearning module, user accounts, certification flows, CRM, Email Marketing. No custom development. No external tools. No agency. Just Odoo.
That time-to-market changed everything. It meant we could launch before the doubt set in, iterate in real time as users arrived from multiples countries, and focus entirely on the content because the platform never asked for our attention.
And now, one year in, the foundation Odoo gave us isn't just holding. It's the reason we can think about the next chapter without anxiety. Monetization, new modules, automated learner journeys, scaled content delivery: everything is already there, waiting to be activated. No re-platforming. No migration risk. No "we'll deal with that when we get there."
The lesson: Odoo didn't just help us launch. It gave a two-person team the architecture of a serious company, on day one.
Target audience: Odoo users, partners, startupers and entrepreneurs building on Odoo for content, education, or community platforms.
Key takeaway: What scaling without friction actually looks like. From 5 colleagues to 14,000 learners, on one Odoo instance.

speakers.name: Eddy BRUART
speakers.biography_text: Eddy Bruart is a Belgian digital entrepreneur and co-founder of Heure IA, a free AI certification platform that grew from an internal team training into a global initiative reaching 14,000+ users across 100+ countries in its first year. Built entirely on Odoo Online, Heure IA is aligned with the UNESCO AI Competency Framework. Eddy is the founder of Smartera, a digital growth agency, and co-founded Heure IA alongside Amra Zidani, founder of Agoraz, a certified Odoo Partner and his closest collaborator since 2020. Heure IA exhibited at the Odoo Experience Startup Village in 2025.

tracks.name: Goodbye Scattered Data: Total Member, Donor & Financial Control for non-profits.
tracks.speaker_line: Dominique Peters, Founder at Software Buro
tracks.description_text:
Managing members, donors, and complex funding streams often leads to scattered data and administrative friction. This presentation demonstrates how Odoo serves as the ultimate all-in-one solution to transform non-profit operations into a streamlined, automated ecosystem.
Attendees will learn how to leverage Odoo to centralize communication, automate workflows, and gain real-time financial control. We will analyze three real-world success stories showcasing Odoo's versatility:
A) De Vlaamse Sportfederatie: Discover how they use the Odoo Portal to seamlessly register, track, and support over 18,500 local sports clubs, drastically reducing manual administration.
B) Regional Nature Preserves: See how 9 regional organizations utilize Odoo for budgeting and complex project financing. This provides project leaders with a real-time view of budgets while significantly reducing the finance team's workload.
C) Africa Relief: Learn how this NGO consolidated fragmented donation streams into a single system, using advanced reporting to deeply understand donor behavior and optimize fundraising.
Whether you manage a local sports network, an environmental initiative, or a global NGO, this session provides practical strategies to eliminate data silos and increase operational efficiency.

speakers.name: Dominique Peters
speakers.biography_text:
Dominique has extensive experience at the intersection of IT and non-profits.
Previously, he developed software solutions for major occupational health providers in Belgium. He also lived in San Francisco for five years, where he started a software company. As an Odoo partner, he now assists non-profits in implementing Odoo to streamline their operations.

tracks.name: Simplified complexity: Mastering pickings and production with Odoo
tracks.speaker_line: Julian Bogusch from Odoo
tracks.description_text:
While complex warehouse and factory workflows often pose significant operational challenges, they also offer a great opportunity for optimization.
In this session, we will look at how to simplify this complexity and master your daily operations with Odoo. We will cover how to set up smart, connected pickings and production steps to apply lean concepts, and how to speed up execution using the Odoo Barcode app, wave picking, and batch picking. Attendees will leave with practical, actionable ways to optimize their entire manufacturing and delivery flow.

speakers.name: Julian Bogusch
speakers.biography_text:
Julian Bogusch
, born in Garmisch-Partenkirchen in southern Germany, has built a robust career in the digital transformation of businesses. With extensive experience in various ERP systems, he has developed a solid foundation in streamlining and optimizing business processes through technology.

tracks.name: Separate without duplicating: Manage B2B and B2C on one single eCommerce
tracks.speaker_line: Jules Barthelmé from Odoo
tracks.description_text:
Can a single Odoo eCommerce platform seamlessly serve B2B clients and everyday B2C consumers?
Yes, it can.
Too often, businesses fall into the trap of launching two separate websites and duplicating product catalogs, which dramatically increases your maintenance work. Instead of doubling your admin workload with separate designs, SEO setups, and configurations, this session will show you how to master a unified, single-website approach that keeps your data clean and your workflows efficient.

tracks.name: Moving Millions: How to Scale Technology, Products and Innovation
tracks.speaker_line: Philippe Thiran, Director of the Digital Factory at SNCF Connect & Tech at SNCF
tracks.description_text:
Building digital products for sustainable mobility means operating services used every day by millions of travellers, while continuously improving reliability, user experience, delivery speed and innovation.
In this talk, I will explore how large technology organisations can move from a project-driven model to a product- and platform-oriented approach. I will discuss how autonomous teams, modern engineering practices, scalable platforms and AI-assisted development can help accelerate delivery without compromising operational excellence.
Drawing on my experience scaling a Belgian SaaS company and on my new role leading the Digital Factory at SNCF Connect & Tech, I will share practical perspectives on transforming technology organisations, reducing legacy constraints and creating the conditions for sustainable innovation.
The central question is simple: how can a large organisation move faster while remaining reliable, responsible and focused on real user value?

speakers.name: Philippe Thiran
speakers.function: Director of the Digital Factory at SNCF Connect & Tech

tracks.name: Flawless by design: Master Quality Control in Odoo 20
tracks.speaker_line: Mikail Cicekciler from Odoo
tracks.description_text: Manufacturing excellence relies on the perfect balance between rigorous control and operational speed. Discover how Odoo 20 redefines quality management by weaving automated checks directly into your logistics lifecycle. Explore how to build a flexible, adaptive quality framework that scales with your unique processes from raw material receipt to final assembly. Whether you are refining existing workflows or building new ones, learn to implement a quality strategy that improves efficiency and empowers your teams.

tracks.name: Continuous manufacturing in Odoo: Make your flows faster, more agile, and more intuitive
tracks.speaker_line: Anna Pontalti, Business Analyst & Manufacturing Expert at Odoo
tracks.description_text:
Discover how Odoo's powerful new
Continuous Manufacturing
capabilities are transforming high-volume production processes. In this session, we’ll show you how these latest improvements bridge the gap in continuous production by delivering real-time visibility into Work in Progress (WIP) and sharp reporting on yields and production costs. Packed with actionable best practices, you'll learn how to make your operations faster, more agile, and highly intuitive, allowing you to minimize waste, maximize throughput, and gain total control over your manufacturing margins.

speakers.name: Anna Pontalti
speakers.biography_text: Anna works at Odoo as a Business Analyst and is responsible for end-to-end implementation projects, from project management to functional configuration. As part of the Manufacturing Experts Team, she contributes to Odoo’s roadmap and helps shape the services offered to partners. Her focus on manufacturing projects allows her to learn from different industries and translate this knowledge into functional workarounds, practical tips, and clear guidelines. In addition to leading manufacturing implementations, she also brings her expertise to ROI and MMC projects in the manufacturing sector, supporting larger-scale and strategic initiatives. Anna actively shares her insights with internal colleagues, certified partners, and the broader community, embracing Odoo’s open and collaborative culture.

tracks.name: Accounting Is Not a Phase — Why Finance should Be Involved from Day One
tracks.speaker_line: Stefanie Worm , Manager at KPMG Tax, Legal & Accountancy BV
tracks.description_text:
An Odoo implementation is never just about processes. Behind every sales order, purchase, inventory movement, or project lies an accounting impact that can shape the success of the entire implementation.
Every configuration choice, national or international, in Odoo has financial implications. When accounting requirements are overlooked during analysis and design, projects can face unexpected rework, reporting issues, delayed go-lives, and frustrated stakeholders.
In this session, we'll explore why accounting should be part of the conversation from the very beginning. Through practical examples and lessons learned, we'll discuss how close collaboration between business, implementation, and finance teams helps avoid surprises and creates a stronger foundation for success.
Whether you're a consultant, project manager, or accountant, you'll gain a fresh perspective on the role accounting plays throughout an Odoo project—and why its influence extends far beyond the Accounting app itself.

speakers.name: Stefanie Worm
speakers.biography_text: Stefanie Worm is a seasoned professional at KPMG Tax, Legal & Accountancy, boasting over 25 years of expertise in accounting and tax assistance. Stefanie was part of the initial team that successfully implemented Odoo for all our clients and is also currently part of the digital transformation team, driving innovation and efficiency, both within the organization and for our clients.

tracks.name: Managing the energy transition: Insights from Elia Group
tracks.speaker_line: James Matthys-Donnadieu from Elia Transmission Belgium
tracks.description_text:
Europe is entering a new phase where energy security, economic competitiveness and digital sovereignty are increasingly interconnected. The rapid growth of electrification, AI, data centres and strategic industries is creating unprecedented demand for critical infrastructure.
As one of Europe's key electricity transmission companies, Elia Group is at the centre of this transformation. Meeting these new demands requires more than building infrastructure. It requires new ways of planning, prioritising resources, coordinating stakeholders and managing complexity at scale.
In this keynote, James Matthys-Donnadieu, Chief Customers, Markets & System Officer at Elia Transmission Belgium, will share how Elia navigates these challenges, how flexible solutions can accelerate growth before infrastructure is fully available, and what business leaders can learn from managing one of Europe's most complex operational transformations.

speakers.name: James Matthys-Donnadieu
speakers.biography_text:
James Matthys-Donnadieu is currently Chief Customers, Markets and System Officer at Elia
Transmission Belgium. He is also a supervisory board member of HGRT, of EPEX SPOT, of Coreso and
of NemoLink Ltd. He previously was head of the Markets department at Elia.
Before joining Elia, he held positions as COO of the APX Group and CEO of its subsidiary Belpex. He
also was a member of the Management Board of APX-Endex.
James holds a Master in Business Economics from the University of Antwerp and a Master in
Business Administration from the Vlerick Management School.

tracks.name: From long analysis to a 3-month Proof of Concept: How to maximize ROI with Odoo
tracks.speaker_line: Gregory Dethier & Lionel Willems from Odoo
tracks.description_text:
How do we generate more value from ROI Analysis by building a PoC in three months that covers 80% of their functionalities ?
Endorse more responsibilities, make decisions without the client and showcase that Odoo can support any business super quickly.

speakers.name: Gregory Dethier & Lionel Willems
speakers.biography_text:
Gregory
is Odoo's head of mid-market & corporate business services.
Lionel
entered the Odoo-sphere in January 2018 as a Project Manager for an Odoo partner in Asia. He joined Odoo's Hong Kong office in 2019 as a project leader, then opened the Odoo's Australian office as Head of Services in 2023. Late 2025, he joined Odoo Belgium's MMC team as a large account consultant, working mostly on the partnership between Odoo and Partena.

tracks.name: Inventory valuation: A practical live upgrade walkthrough
tracks.speaker_line: Ismael Portales Molina, Business Support Analyst at Odoo
tracks.description_text:
Upgrading Inventory Valuation from Version 18 to Version 20: A Practical Walkthrough
This session provides a practical overview of the Inventory Valuation upgrade process, focusing on the migration from Version 18 to Version 20. Through a live upgrade demonstration, we will explore the key steps involved in the migration and discuss the most common challenges encountered along the way. The session will cover how to handle delivered purchase and sales orders with pending vendor bills or customer invoices, manage manufacturing orders during the upgrade, identify and reconcile inventory valuation discrepancies, and use the built-in server action to detect and resolve inconsistencies. We will also share practical tips and alternative approaches for cases where the server action is not applicable. By the end of the session, attendees will have a fully migrated Version 20 database and a clear understanding of the best practices for successfully upgrading Inventory Valuation.

tracks.name: Beyond the Like: Real results with Odoo Social Marketing
tracks.speaker_line: Manon Marchal, Business Analyst & Marketing Expert at Odoo
tracks.description_text:
Likes are easy. Proving business impact is harder.
In this talk, you'll discover how Odoo Social Marketing helps you move beyond engagement metrics and turn social media into a measurable part of your marketing strategy.
Through a practical campaign example, we'll explore the latest features of the app, show how it connects with the rest of Odoo, and uncover how social activities can contribute to real business outcomes.
Because social media success isn't about getting more likes, it's about generating measurable results.

speakers.name: Manon Marchal
speakers.biography_text:
Manon
worked five years in the saas industry as a customer journey expert, helping company build a strong and data-driven marketing journey for their clients.
She joined Odoo as a business analyst, with an expertise on marketing to help Odoo's customers make the most of their marketing actions

tracks.name: Scaling eCommerce operations with Odoo
tracks.speaker_line: Simon Salembier & Benoît Balza from Odoo

tracks.name: How a US Tobacco Distributor Replaced MS Dynamics and QuickBooks with One Odoo System
tracks.speaker_line: Jainesh Shah, Co-founder and Director at Aktiv Software Inc
tracks.description_text:
About Mega Wholesale:
- Mega Wholesale is a tobacco and cigarette distribution company in the United States.
- It ran on MS Dynamics, QuickBooks, and several other disconnected tools that did not talk to each other.
- The hardest parts of the trade were slow and error-prone: state tax-stamp compliance, multi-location stock, and tax reporting.
- The goal was to replace the entire legacy stack with a single ERP.
What this session covers:
- Mega Wholesale's move from MS Dynamics and QuickBooks to Odoo, and the distribution solution Aktiv built around the strict compliance rules of the tobacco trade.
- Discovery and solution blueprinting, and replacing several disconnected systems with one connected platform.
- A custom tax-stamp engine tightly integrated with Sales and Inventory.
- The result: the correct state tax stamp is detected and applied automatically on the sales order, the right quantity is calculated from the product's pack data, and stamp stock is deducted on delivery, removing the manual work and compliance risk of handling stamps outside the ERP.
- Location-aware stock that keeps cigarettes and tobacco in separate locations.
- Automatic stock allocation with safeguards against misallocation.
- Permit tracking for every distributor.
- Shelf-life management by expiration date.
- State-wise tax and VAT reporting.
Who should attend:
- Teams in regulated distribution.
- Anyone replacing a patchwork of multiple disconnected tools and spreadsheets with one ERP.
What attendees will learn
- How to replace MS Dynamics, QuickBooks, and other legacy tools with a single Odoo system without losing compliance control.
- How to automate state-wise tax-stamp detection, quantity calculation, and stock deduction directly on the sales order.
- How location-aware stock and automatic allocation rules prevent misplaced inventory across separate cigarette and tobacco locations.
- How permit tracking, shelf-life management, and delivery restrictions keep a regulated distribution business audit-ready.

speakers.name: Jainesh Shah
speakers.biography_text: As a Co-founder & Director at Aktiv Software, Jainesh Shah turns client requirements into Odoo solutions built to last and to scale. He is at his strongest where the requirement is not a standard feature but a set of strict, real-world rules that have to be encoded correctly, which is exactly what the tobacco trade demands.

tracks.name: How the new PLM features are transforming product versioning and reporting into a game changer
tracks.speaker_line: Charlotte Dendoncker from Odoo
tracks.description_text: Managing product revisions doesn't have to mean spreadsheet chaos. In this talk, discover PLM best practices and explore the latest Odoo 20 features designed to keep your manufacturing agile. Through a concrete demonstration, see how to execute mass component updates across multiple BOMs, master product vs. BOM revision controls, launch NPIs directly from ECOs, and gain instant visibility into cost variations with clear reporting.

speakers.name: Charlotte Dendoncker
speakers.biography_text:
Charlotte
embarked on her journey at Odoo six years ago in the Sales department. However, her interest in the functional aspects of the product led her to transition into the Business Analyst team. Developing an interest in the Manufacturing modules after several implementations and sales demonstrations, she joined the MRP Expertise team three years ago where she is able to contribute to product knowledge within the team and among the community.

tracks.name: Smart Inventory management with AI
tracks.speaker_line: Antoine Lemaigre from Odoo
tracks.description_text:
AI is redefining warehouse efficiency. Discover how Odoo 20 leverages intelligent agents to automate manual tasks, eliminate human error, and optimize operations.
We will highlight:
Smart Data & Quality:
Automatic product setup, ABC classification, and AI-generated non-conformity reports.
Smart Sales Routing:
AI-driven route decision based on live availability.
Predictive Logistics:
Advanced safety stock forecasting and vendor reliability analysis.
Optimized Execution:
AI-driven operator assignment and dynamic batch/wave picking.
... and much more!

speakers.name: Antoine Lemaigre
speakers.biography_text: Antoine holds a Master's in Supply Chain Management and has spent the last four years as an Inventory Expert at Odoo. Co-creator of Odoo’s Supply Chain Audit service, he audits complex warehouses and designs advanced logistics workflows on-site. Driven by a passion for stock optimization, Antoine actively explores how to leverage AI to make inventory management smarter, faster, and truly predictive.

tracks.name: Seamless transitions: From recruitment to onboarding
tracks.speaker_line: Matthieu Weyemberg, Business Analyst at Odoo
tracks.description_text: Join Matthieu as he demonstrates how Odoo simplifies every step of the employee journey, from recruitment and hiring to onboarding. Discover how Odoo's integrated HR applications help companies deliver a smooth and efficient onboarding experience while empowering HR teams to focus on what matters most.

speakers.name: Matthieu Weyemberg
speakers.biography_text:
Matthieu has been  with Odoo since 2018, starting as a Consultant before taking on several roles, including Team Leader and Head of Service at the Milan office. Since September 2025, he has been leading the HR Expertise Team, specializing in the implementation of Odoo projects with a focus on Human Resources.
Together with his team, he is dedicated to improving Odoo's HR applications by leveraging customer feedback and insights gained from implementations across a wide range of industries.

tracks.name: INEX Group: Hundreds of Analytics - One Source of Truth
tracks.speaker_line: Islam Izatullayev, Senior Business Analyst at VentorTech at Ventor Tech
tracks.description_text:
INEX Group, a multi-company real estate and development business, relied on detailed managerial accounting across projects, properties, business units, and legal entities. As the organization grew, maintaining consistent analytics became increasingly difficult. Incorrect analytic selections, inconsistent data entry, and limited reporting capabilities made managerial reports harder to trust.
This session explores how INEX redesigned its analytic accounting in Odoo to build a disciplined, rule-based management accounting system. The result was consistent data entry, precise multi-dimensional reporting, and a consolidated management view across the entire group.
KEY LEARNINGS
- Why flexible analytics alone are not enough for reliable managerial accounting
- Best practices for designing scalable analytic structures across multiple companies
- How guided analytic selection improves data quality and reporting accuracy
- Building precise multi-dimensional management reports in Odoo
- Creating a single source of truth across projects, business units, and legal entities
- Lessons learned from implementing advanced managerial accounting in a real multi-company organization
VALUE FOR THE AUDIENCE
Participants will gain practical insights into:
- Building reliable managerial accounting in Odoo for multi-company organizations
- Designing analytic structures that remain scalable as the business grows
- Improving the accuracy and trustworthiness of management reporting
- Common implementation pitfalls and how to avoid them
- Best practices for collaboration between business teams and Odoo consultants
TARGET AUDIENCE
This talk is ideal for:
- Owners and executives of large groups of companies
- IT Managers overseeing enterprise platforms
- CFOs and finance leaders assessing ERP transitions
- Project Managers from client and vendor sides
- Odoo Partners working with international and enterprise clients

speakers.name: Islam Izatullayev
speakers.biography_text: Odoo Finance Consultant at VentorTech with a strong background in finance controlling, budgeting, and ERP implementation. Interned at Siemens and worked at SAP as a solutions architect. Focused on translating complex financial requirements into working Odoo solutions - with an emphasis on financial architecture, integrations, and scalability that support transparent reporting and business control.

tracks.name: Scaling Your Business with Odoo: A premium beverage industry trading Case Study
tracks.speaker_line: Daniel Göppner, Principal Project Leader + Consultant at braintec
tracks.description_text:
Can Odoo handle the specialized needs of the premium beverage industry?
Fine wine trading is a business of passion, but the back-office reality is one of extreme complexity. When dealing with rare bottles, "Differenzbesteuerung" (margin scheme taxation), and multi-company inventory, spreadsheets quickly become a liability.
In this session, we walk through the digital transformation of Trinkreif. We will explore how we moved from fragmented processes to a unified Odoo ecosystem that manages the entire lifecycle of a bottle—from global procurement and automated Anglo-Saxon accounting to CRM-driven sales.
We will deep-dive into the technical and financial hurdles we overcame:
- The Tax Puzzle: Mastering "Differenzbesteuerung" and complex VAT requirements.
- Precision Inventory: Why automated inventory valuation and Anglo-Saxon accounting are non-negotiable for high-value stock.
- The Multi-Company Flow: Seamlessly scaling operations without losing financial clarity.
- The Accountant’s Dream: How we collaborated with an Odoo-certified tax firm to ensure 100% compliance.
Whether you are a consultant or a business owner, you’ll leave with a blueprint for digitizing a traditional industry without losing its soul.

speakers.name: Daniel Göppner
speakers.biography_text:
Daniel Göppner is a Principal Project Leader and Digital Advisor at braintec, and a seasoned Odoo expert with over 15 years of experience architecting complex ERP solutions. With a dual background in computer science and mathematics, Daniel approaches digital transformation from a deeply analytical perspective, seamlessly bridging the gap between high-level business strategy and deep-dive technical execution.
Throughout 8 years dedicated to the Odoo ecosystem, Daniel has guided 50+ successful implementations and holds certifications across 9+ Odoo versions. A seasoned veteran of the Odoo Experience stage (2019, 2024, 2025), he is recognized for his ability to translate intricate technical architectures into actionable business growth. Beyond Odoo, his expertise spans Python programming, Machine Learning, SEO optimization, and cybersecurity—reinforced by his credentials as a Harvard-certified Cybersecurity Risk Manager.
A true "multilingual" professional, Daniel navigates five human languages and five machine languages, ensuring that stakeholders and technology always speak the same language. Driven by his "J.A.D.G." philosophy—Journey, Acceleration, Digital Integrity, and Growth—his mission is to help the community build secure, innovative, and future-proof systems that turn Odoo from a software solution into a strategic engine for innovation.

tracks.name: Stop guessing: Know your best marketing channels in Odoo
tracks.speaker_line: Elisabeth Saint-Paul, Business Analyst & Marketing Expert at Odoo
tracks.description_text:
Most marketing teams invest time and budget without truly knowing what drives real business results. Clicks and leads are useful, but they don’t always show the full picture of what actually converts into revenue.
In this talk, we’ll show how Odoo helps you move from guesswork to full attribution across your entire customer journey. You’ll learn how to track every lead back to its source using link trackers, UTM parameters, and built-in analytics across Odoo apps.
More importantly, you’ll see how marketing efforts translate into real business outcomes from the first click all the way to CRM opportunities and confirmed sales orders. This helps you clearly identify which channels generate not just traffic or leads, but real revenue.
We’ll also explore how AI can help you analyze performance faster, detect patterns, and make better decisions based on real data instead of assumptions.
Through a live demo, we’ll break down a real marketing setup and show how Odoo connects marketing activity to sales results in one unified system.
Because better marketing decisions start with knowing what actually works.

tracks.name: From Excel to Odoo 19: Advancing ERP & CRM Maturity for a Multi-Entity Group.
tracks.speaker_line: Thomas Deville, Chief Financial Officer at Alteo Group
tracks.description_text:
Deplasse & Associés, a consultancy specialising in building technology and environmental advice, began its digital transformation in 2018 by moving away from Excel spreadsheets in favour of Odoo.
Since then, the ALTEO Group — now comprising eight entities active in environmental transition and offering a wide range of services throughout a building’s life cycle — has gradually integrated all its activities into a single Odoo instance, hosted in-house thanks to the technical expertise of AISET, a group member that develops a SaaS solution for managing the technical, legal and energy-related aspects of buildings.
This presentation traces this journey: the successes, but also the mistakes made in the implementation and management of an ERP-CRM system — notably an excessive reliance on custom developments that compromised maintenance and version upgrades, which began with our launch in 2018 using the ‘community’ version. The major turning point: the return to the standard Odoo version in August 2025, accompanied by in-depth work carried out in collaboration with Odoo on documenting and simplifying processes. The result: increasingly comprehensive and user-friendly use of the system (accounting in January 2026, followed gradually by the fleet, websites, leave and other modules), an in-house update to v19 in February 2026, accounting in January 2026, and significantly improved stability.
Key takeaways: why the standard Odoo architecture is often the best long-term solution; why it is important to document, communicate and adapt processes internally; how to strike the right balance between internal resources, an integrator and direct Odoo support.
Value for the audience: concrete, unfiltered insights from eight years of deployment — the choices made and their operational consequences.
Target audience: executives and IT managers at multi-entity SMEs, Odoo users wishing to move away from technical customisation debt, and any organisation in the process of upgrading.
Timeline:
- Before 2018 — 100% decentralised Excel-based management
- 2018 — Odoo deployment in v11 Community (Deplasse & Associés), on-premises hosting
- 2022 — Upgrade to v15 with an external integrator (relatively painful); introduction of A+ Concept (implemented in-house – also relatively difficult due to technical legacy issues)
- 2023 — Integration of CUB3 (starting from scratch – simplicity)
- 2024 — Expansion to AISET, FANDO, Freestone and ForABetterCapital (carried out in-house, learning experience, some drawbacks but generally successful)
- Spring 2025 — Odoo support (Matthieu Tans) to return to the standard; documentation and simplification of internal processes
- August 2025 — In-house migration to v18 (no custom development; lightweight modules only); server and security management taken over by AISET
- January 2026 — Odoo accounting for all entities; return of an external integrator as backup (Agitech) + Introduction of Peppol (opportunity for 100% invoice management on Odoo)
- February 2026 — Migration to v19
- Spring 2026 — Ongoing work to standardise practices: products, contacts, filters, email templates, field names, etc.
- April 2026 — Integration of BRAFT. A team of AI experts

tracks.name: Scaling beyond borders: International partner expansion
tracks.speaker_line: Timo Huyskens, Partner Account Manager EMEA at Odoo
tracks.description_text:
Expanding into new markets is a major milestone for any successful partner, but when is the right time to make the move, and what is the best approach?
This session is designed for experienced Odoo partners looking to accelerate their international growth. Through practical insights and real-world experience, the speakers will explore the key decisions and strategies involved in expanding beyond your home market.
Topics will include identifying the right moment to scale internationally, evaluating different expansion models, such as greenfield operations, franchising, and acquisitions, and selecting the markets that best align with your business objectives. The session will also cover the critical priorities for the first year of expansion and highlight how Odoo supports partners throughout their international growth journey.
Whether you are considering your first international office or planning your next market entry, this session will provide actionable guidance to help you build a successful and sustainable global presence.

tracks.name: How to boost the productivity of my implementations and scale up my business?
tracks.speaker_line: Arnaud Vancampenhout & Marie Dieuzeide from Odoo
tracks.description_text:
What if the fastest way to increase your profitability as an Odoo partner is not to sell more—but to
deliver projects faster, solve problems more efficiently, and become autonomous sooner
?
In this 30-minute talk, we’ll demystify why Odoo offers services to partners, what the real business logic behind them is, and—most importantly—
what’s in it for you
.
We’ll take a concrete look at the Partner Success Pack: how expert support, dedicated help and coaching can save hours of research, accelerate your go-lives and help your team build expertise faster. We’ll also break down the investment and show you how to think about its
ROI
, rather than simply seeing it as an additional cost.
Through real partner success stories and concrete data, discover why some of Odoo’s most successful partners continuously use these services—and how the right support can help you
turn expertise into profitability
.
Come with questions. Leave with a clear strategy to get more value from Odoo Partner Services.

Custom Manufacturing: Driving Performance with Odoo
tracks.speaker_line: Mélanie Delfosse from Metrum
tracks.description_text:
Manufacturers producing highly customized products face unique operational challenges. Every order can introduce new specifications, production constraints and planning complexities, making standard manufacturing processes difficult to apply.
In this live demonstration, we will showcase how Odoo can become the operational backbone of a custom manufacturing company. From quotation to delivery, attendees will discover how standard Odoo, targeted custom developments and AI-powered capabilities work together to streamline operations while preserving the flexibility required for engineer-to-order and make-to-order businesses.
The session will cover the complete manufacturing lifecycle, including:
Configuring complex products and capturing customer requirements
Engineering and production preparation
Procurement and material availability
Production planning and shop floor execution
Inventory and traceability
Quality management
Real-time operational monitoring and decision support
Beyond demonstrating features, we will explain the functional decisions behind a successful implementation: when to rely on standard Odoo, where customization creates real business value, and how AI can automate repetitive tasks, support decision-making and improve operational performance.
Attendees will leave with practical implementation patterns and actionable insights to build scalable, high-performance manufacturing operations while maintaining the flexibility that custom production demands.

Her expertise includes business process analysis, solution design, change management, and the implementation of ERP-driven improvements to enhance efficiency across production and supply chain operations.

tracks.name: Boosting Quality Control with Odoo: Migrating from Asana to Odoo for integrated quality management workflow
tracks.speaker_line: Kushal Darji, Manager, Customer Success at Surekha Technologies Pvt. Ltd.
tracks.description_text:
A space-tech company was managing quality processes and task tracking across Asana and other disconnected tools, resulting in poor data visibility, manual coordination, and limited traceability between customer issues and production. To address this, a fully integrated solution was developed in Odoo, connecting Helpdesk, Quality, and Manufacturing into a unified workflow. Quality Alerts are automatically triggered from Helpdesk tickets and Quality Checks, ensuring real-time synchronization of data across modules.
We helped in providing the source and context of each alert, enabling more accurate and structured data capture for quality checks. We also introduced the structured root cause analysis through an interactive Fishbone diagram and enforced production control by automatically locking Manufacturing and Work Orders when quality issues are detected.
Additionally, dynamic COC documents are generated using configurable templates, allowing users to complete and sign them within Odoo. An audit logging mechanism tracks user actions such as deletion and archiving with mandatory reasons, ensuring accountability.
Based on client feedback, this implementation reduced manual effort by approximately 70% and improved issue resolution time by around 60%, delivering a fully automated, traceable, and compliance-ready system.

speakers.name: Kushal Darji
speakers.biography_text:
As a Manager of Customer Success, I work closely with clients to ensure they are able to use Odoo effectively in their day-to-day operations. My role involves guiding customers through implementation, supporting them as they grow, and helping them solve challenges along the way.
I believe in keeping things simple and practical, focusing on what truly works for the customer. Through my experience, I’ve seen how the right approach to customer success can make a big difference. At Odoo Expo, I’m excited to share a few real examples and insights that others can easily relate to and apply.

tracks.name: Odoo Spreadsheet performance: The nitty-gritty details
tracks.speaker_line: Schippefilt Vincent from Odoo
tracks.description_text:
As your spreadsheets and dashboards become bigger, it is important to understand the design and decisions we took to make things grow efficiently.
In is a technical talk we will look at the details of some parts of the o-spreadsheet engine. You will learn the new best practices in V20 and how they differ from previous versions.

tracks.name: Predict, prevent, perfect: Next-gen maintenance with Odoo 20
tracks.speaker_line: Bruno Stadler from Odoo
tracks.description_text:
Running a smooth manufacturing operation is nearly impossible when unexpected equipment failures constantly disrupt your schedule. Odoo 20 addresses this head-on, transforming asset management from a reactive struggle into a streamlined, predictive system. In this session, we will break down the essential synergy between Shop Floor and Maintenance teams, demonstrating how to apply lean concepts to your daily operations. You'll walk away with best practices to align production goals with upkeep schedules, keeping your operations frictionless and your machinery running at peak performance.
The core of this evolution is a suite of next-generation features designed to optimize your daily workflow. We’ll showcase how new UX features deliver a frictionless user experience, working hand-in-hand with an interactive Gantt view that makes your resource planning completely intuitive. You will also get a first look at the new fleet and maintenance integration, unifying your vehicles and factory assets under one roof, and an advanced AI agent that assists operators with real-time troubleshooting suggestions right on the floor. Whether you want to minimize downtime or experience the cutting edge of AI-driven operations, this session provides the perfect blueprint for modern maintenance management.

Bruno Stadler
is an Odoo expert with a passion for the comprehensive suite of business applications the platform provides. He currently serves as

Odoo Brazil
, where he leads a team of approximately 35 professionals focused on delivering high-quality Odoo implementation projects. His mission is to help customers unlock the full potential of the platform and inspire the same passion for Odoo that his team shares.

tracks.name: Odoo for everyone: A focus on accessibility
tracks.speaker_line: Hélène Hardy, Designer at Odoo
tracks.description_text: Did you know that in the 1970s, a single wheelchair ramp cut into a sidewalk curb ended up helping everyone and eventually became a standard? That's the whole idea behind accessibility: design for the edges, and everyone in the middle ends up benefiting too. Together we'll experience Odoo through the accessibility lens, discover that everyone can be disabled in some way, and see what Odoo is doing about it: on a backend and frontend perspective.

speakers.name: Hélène Hardy
speakers.biography_text: Hélène Hardy is a designer with 11 years of experience in the digital industry, driven by a passion for enhancing peopleʼs lives. To her, design is a mindset of constant improvement combined with a strong sense of empathy. She believes that real design happens in the doing, the testing, the tweaking, the learning !

tracks.name: Managing Manufacturing Costing and Financial Control with Odoo Across Quality and Multi Currency Operations
tracks.speaker_line: Maulik Raval, Odoo ERP Solution Architect at Brainvire
tracks.description_text:
Manufacturing control breaks down when costing, quality, inventory, depreciation, and finance operate in separate lanes. For manufacturers working in cost sensitive and regulated environments, every production variance, consignment movement, currency exchange, and quality checkpoint can impact profitability, compliance, and decision making.
This session shows how Brainvire uses Odoo to bring manufacturing, accounting, and quality control into one connected operating system. With Odoo at the center, businesses can compare planned and actual production costs in real time, track consignment inventory with structure, and connect machinery depreciation directly to product costing.
The solution also covers multi currency operations, dual exchange rate handling, automated quality inspections, and standardized financial reporting across regional requirements.
The result is stronger cost transparency, cleaner financial accuracy, better compliance control, and a scalable manufacturing foundation where production, quality, and finance move together with confidence.

speakers.name: Maulik Raval
speakers.function: Odoo ERP Solution Architect at Brainvire
speakers.biography_text:
Maulik Raval is a certified Odoo ERP Solution Architect and Project Manager at Brainvire with over 11 years of techno-functional experience spanning Odoo versions v6 to v19 Enterprise.
He specializes in solution architecture, end-to-end ERP implementations, and scalable system design across diverse industries, including manufacturing, retail, supply chain, and logistics.
Having led on-site discovery workshops, UAT, and successful multi-country rollouts across regions such as Canada, Singapore, the UAE, and Thailand, he is dedicated to driving digital transformation and helping global enterprises scale efficiently with Odoo.

tracks.name: Turning Belgian HR Obligations into Practical Odoo Workflows: A Guide for Integrators
tracks.speaker_line: Muytjens Laurent, Founder at Orelus
tracks.description_text:
Belgian HR projects in Odoo often look simple: employee records, time off, documents, approvals and onboarding.
But in Belgium, they quickly touch payroll, working time, employment contracts, social documents, internal policies and legal obligations.
This talk is designed for Odoo integrators implementing HR processes for Belgian companies. It provides a practical framework to better scope HR projects, identify payroll-sensitive areas, ask the right questions and avoid risky promises.
Through concrete examples such as onboarding, absence management, HR document signature, internal approvals and payroll preparation, we will show how Belgian HR obligations can become simple, useful and scalable Odoo workflows.

speakers.name: Muytjens Laurent
speakers.biography_text:
Laurent Muytjens is the founder of Orelus, a Belgian HR and payroll advisory firm helping SMEs structure, secure and digitalize their HR processes.
He is growing Orelus with the ambition to build a modern, proactive and technology-driven HR partner for Belgian SMEs. His work combines Belgian social law, payroll coordination, employment documentation and operational HR processes.
Through Orelus, Laurent helps companies and Odoo integrators turn Belgian HR complexity into practical workflows that are useful, compliant and ready for real-life implementation.
