tracks.name: Partner Awards (Auditorium 2000 A, B & C)
From SME to Enterprise: How We Pushed Odoo Security Beyond the Defaults (and What Broke Along the Way)
tracks.speaker_line: Rutger Hofste, CTO at Pantalytics B.V.
tracks.description_text:
As Odoo increasingly moves upmarket, security expectations rise sharply. In this talk we share a real world journey with an SME+ client (€25-100m revenue) operating in a strategically sensitive industry. For them, the default Odoo Enterprise and Odoo.sh security setup was not sufficient to meet internal and external requirements.
Starting from concrete client feedback, we systematically strengthened Odoo’s security. We enhanced outgoing and incoming email security, implemented robust SSO and automated user provisioning, and aligned identity and access management with enterprise standards. This work resulted in a reusable set of custom security modules that elevate Odoo.sh (Enterprise) to a level suitable for larger and more security conscious customers.
Along the way we identified a critical security flaw, followed Odoo’s Responsible Disclosure Policy, and collaborated on a fix that benefits the wider ecosystem.
This session is practical, transparent, and forward looking, showing how Odoo can confidently win larger clients without compromising on security or openness.

speakers.name: Rutger Hofste
speakers.biography_text:
Rutger Hofste is a data scientist and entrepreneur focused on secure, AI powered business systems built on Odoo. He works with SME+ and enterprise clients in strategically sensitive industries, helping them scale Odoo to meet higher security and identity management requirements. As founder of Pantalytics, he develops advanced solutions around Odoo, AI, and security, including email hardening, SSO, automated user provisioning, and enterprise grade access control on Odoo.sh and Odoo Enterprise.
Rutger combines a strong analytical background from TU Delft and the National University of Singapore with hands on experience building production ready systems. His work bridges real client demands with responsible security practices, including responsible disclosure and upstream contributions to the Odoo ecosystem.

tracks.name: Inside the Box or Best of Breed: Architecting eCommerce on Odoo
tracks.speaker_line: Nico Ziemski from ruhrdot GmbH
tracks.description_text: Odoo's eCommerce vision is beautifully integrated: build the storefront in Odoo Website, sell on marketplaces through native connectors, ship with built-in carrier integrations, and keep the books in the same system. For many businesses that all-in-one path is exactly right. But a large share of mid-market merchants arrive with a different reality: a high-converting storefront already running on Shopify, Shopware or WooCommerce; sales spread across Amazon, Otto, Kaufland and eBay. Money landing through PayPal, Stripe, Klarna. Fulfillment outsourced to a third-party logistics provider and non-negotiable accounting rules. This talk is a neutral field playbook drawn from ruhrdot. projects that process up to 100,000 invoices and 35,000 shipments on a peak day. For each building block we contrast how Odoo intends it to work with the architecture you actually build when the storefront and channels live outside Odoo: connecting external shops, orchestrating marketplaces through middleware, matching payouts back to orders and invoices when money flow does not equal order flow, integrating shipping carriers like DHL and GLS plus a third-party logistics provider, and producing clean, preparatory accounting with period locks, document hashing and the correct chart of accounts. We also show the per-channel logging modules that keep every shop auditable. Attendees leave with a decision framework for what belongs natively in Odoo versus an integration, where to place the seams, and how to keep accounting audit-proof no matter how many shops and marketplaces feed the system.

tracks.name: Can you recreate that design in Odoo? Let’s try
tracks.speaker_line: Carlos Valverde from Odoo
tracks.description_text:
The goal of this talk is simple: explore how closely we can reproduce any website design using only Odoo Website Builder tools.
We will start by analyzing a live website including layout structure, visual hierarchy, spacing, and key design elements.
Then, step by step, we will attempt to rebuild it inside Odoo, relying only on native features and no external code.
This hands-on exercise is designed to test the flexibility of Odoo’s design capabilities and to better understand how far we can push it for realistic, production-ready websites.

tracks.name: Implementing Odoo for 4,000+ users: lessons learned from one of Odoo's largest HR deployments
tracks.speaker_line: Jean-François Noel & Ewa Deka, Assistant Head Advisory of the Internal Control Capability Unit (JF Noel) & Business Manager (Ewa) at tsc - The Service Company SRL
tracks.description_text:
Abstract
How do you successfully implement Odoo for more than 4,000 users across 14 European Schools while ensuring a consistent user experience and standardized business processes?
This talk focuses on the challenges that begin once the project kicks off.
The European Schools project is one of the largest Odoo implementations in terms of user count. The initial scope covers the deployment of the complete Odoo HR suite to support the management of teachers across all schools, with the goal of harmonizing HR processes at an international level.
Through this real-life case study, we will share the key decisions and lessons learned from the early stages of the project, including:
Structuring a project designed for more than 4,000 users.
Managing an international deployment involving 14 schools.
Supporting the customer in standardizing business processes across organizations with different historical ways of working.
Designing an effective governance model, including user roles and access rights.
Helping end users embrace a solution they had never used before.
Making key architectural decisions, such as choosing between a single shared database and one database per school, and why we ultimately selected a single database.
Organizing the implementation with a pilot phase followed by a structured roll-out across all schools.
The functional scope already delivered includes the Odoo HR suite:
Employees
Recruitment
Appraisals
Attendances
Overtime management
Onboarding & Offboarding
Requests
Payroll preparation
Today, more than 1,000 users are actively using the solution.
This session will present the key lessons learned from the first phase of the project, the challenges we faced, the mistakes to avoid, and the best practices for successfully delivering an Odoo implementation at this scale.
As the project is still ongoing, this talk will be the first chapter of our journey. We plan to return at Odoo Experience 2027 to present the complete deployment across all 14 European Schools, share user feedback, and discuss the lessons learned from the full rollout.

speakers.name: Jean-François Noel & Ewa Deka
speakers.function: Assistant Head Advisory of the Internal Control Capability Unit (JF Noel) & Business Manager (Ewa)
speakers.biography_text: Formation en comptabilité et obtenu une licence en gestion d’entreprise. J’ai ensuite travaillé depuis quinze ans dans divers secteurs, principalement la consultance et le secteur financier. Je travaille à présent pour les Écoles Européennes.

tracks.name: How AI transforms ERP into a proactive sales tool: the Jacques Remy case study.
tracks.speaker_line: Louis Berwart, Data Manager at Idealis Consulting
tracks.description_text:
In the fresh food distribution industry, demand uncertainty is the primary driver of margin loss. How can you guarantee maximum product availability without the constant risk of overstocking? The answer lies in the intelligent exploitation of data.
Discover the real-world success story of Jacques Remy, a leading wholesaler that integrated Artificial Intelligence into the core of its Odoo ERP with the strategic support of Idealis. By processing over 400,000 historical sales records, we co-developed a system capable of modeling supermarket purchasing behavior to anticipate their actual needs before they even place an order.
This talk will deep dive into the implementation of a hybrid AI engine. Moving beyond theoretical hype, we will explain how we correlated Odoo transactional data with critical external variables—such as local weather, seasonality, and public calendars—to automatically generate draft orders with unprecedented accuracy.
Key takeaways from this session:
- Data Engineering: How to extract high-value insights from Odoo history using BigQuery.
- "Stock-Aware" Logic: How the AI adjusts its predictions based on real-time warehouse availability and suggests intelligent substitutions ("Star Products").
- Operational Impact: Shifting from reactive logistics to a proactive "push-flow" strategy, backed by Jacques Remy’s real KPIs.
Join us to see how Idealis is pushing the boundaries of Odoo, transforming it into a predictive performance engine for supply chain leaders. A session focused on ROI, scalability, and technical feasibility.

speakers.name: Louis Berwart
speakers.biography_text: Dedicated to driving data-driven success, Louis combines strategic vision with hands-on analytical expertise. His focus on making advanced data insights accessible empowers clients to make informed decisions.

tracks.name: Traffic to Revenue: Unlock SEO Growth with Odoo Website & eCommerce
tracks.speaker_line: Kamlesh Devaliya, VP, Sales & Marketing at Uncannycs
tracks.description_text:
Many businesses still rely on multiple platforms such as WordPress for content, Shopify for eCommerce, and third-party tools for SEO management. This fragmented approach often creates operational complexity, inconsistent user experiences, and missed growth opportunities.
In this session, we will explore how Odoo Website and eCommerce can serve as a unified platform for content management, lead generation, and online sales while supporting modern SEO best practices.
Attendees will learn:
• How Odoo CMS can be used to build SEO-friendly websites without technical complexity.
• SEO capabilities available natively within Odoo Website and eCommerce.
• Best practices for site architecture, metadata, schema, internal linking, and content optimization.
• Strategies for improving organic visibility and conversion rates using a single platform.
• Real-world examples of businesses leveraging Odoo Website and eCommerce to increase traffic, leads, and online revenue.
• Common SEO mistakes that limit performance and how to avoid them in Odoo.
The session will provide practical insights for business owners, marketers, and Odoo partners looking to maximize the ROI of their digital presence while reducing dependency on multiple systems.

speakers.name: Kamlesh Devaliya
speakers.biography_text: Kamlesh Devaliya is a digital commerce strategist and technology consultant with over 15 years of experience helping businesses scale through eCommerce, SEO, conversion rate optimization (CRO), and ERP-driven digital transformation. As a leader at Uncanny Consulting Services, an Odoo Silver Partner in the UAE, he has worked with brands across retail, manufacturing, fashion, beauty, and B2B commerce. Kamlesh specializes in integrating Odoo with eCommerce platforms, building omnichannel customer experiences, and leveraging SEO to drive sustainable organic growth. He regularly advises businesses on maximizing the potential of Odoo Website, eCommerce, and CMS capabilities to achieve measurable business results.

tracks.name: Unified Commerce with Odoo Enterprise: E-Commerce, PoS & Marketplace - All in One
tracks.speaker_line: Mi Dinh, Head of Commerce ERP at much. Consulting
tracks.description_text:
Retail has changed. Customers now expect a seamless experience across every sales channel. Whether they're browsing online, walking into a physical store, or shopping on a marketplace, the brand experience should remain consistent, fast, and efficient. This talk showcases how Odoo empowers businesses to unify their sales channels using E-Commerce, Point of Sale, and marketplace integrations within one single ERP system. We will demonstrate how out-of-the-box functionalities and ready integrations reduce time to market, lower operational complexity, and significantly cut costs. From first click to final sale, discover how Odoo can support a true omnichannel commerce strategy.
Key Points:
- How E-Commerce & PoS work seamlessly out of the box in Odoo Enterprise
- Leveraging Odoo to provide a unified customer experience across digital and physical channels
- Integrating with marketplaces like Amazon, eBay, and others using native and third-party apps
- Reducing operational complexity by centralizing products, inventory, and order processing
- Case examples from retail clients who went live faster and scaled smarter with Odoo
Key Learnings:
- Understanding the architectural advantages of Odoo's unified backend for omnichannel retail
- Strategies to reduce cost and time-to-go-live using standard Odoo features
- Best practices for managing inventory and fulfillment across multiple channels
- Insights into integrating marketplaces and automating order flows
Target Audience:
- Retail and E-Commerce Managers
- Digital Transformation Leads
- Business Owners planning omnichannel strategies

speakers.name: Mi Dinh
speakers.biography_text: Mi Dinh is the Head of Commerce ERP at much. Consulting, where she leads digital transformation initiatives for retailers and e-commerce businesses. With deep expertise in omnichannel commerce and ERP strategy, Mi has implemented Odoo solutions that harmonize webshops, brick-and-mortar stores, and marketplaces into one efficient ecosystem. Her hands-on approach and strategic insights make her a trusted advisor for companies seeking to simplify complexity and scale smartly

tracks.name: How Odoo 20 put you in command of production costs and traceability
tracks.speaker_line: Margaux Gontier from Odoo
tracks.description_text:
In manufacturing, having full visibility over your products throughout their journey is essential. In this session, we will explore how Odoo 20 makes it easier to track products, lots, and serial numbers across the entire supply chain.We will look at how better traceability can help manufacturers maintain control, meet their requirements, and have the right information at the right time, when it matters most.
Discover how Odoo 20 can bring traceability to the next level, so you can focus on building incredible products rather than digging through menus.

tracks.name: Meet Odoo Language Server: Static analysis and navigation for Odoo in VS Code
tracks.speaker_line: Rodolpho Cammarosano de Lima (rcdl) from Odoo
tracks.description_text:
Have you ever felt the need for an IDE that is more aware of the Odoo environment?
Do you want to be notified when you are using the wrong methods, or mixing up modules?
OdooLS is a language server that powers extensions and plugins for various IDEs. It supports Python, XML, CSV, and JavaScript (OWL3) files!
In this talk, we will show you how to use it efficiently in your day-to-day development, revealing some hidden features and tricks along the way.

tracks.name: Partena Professional × Odoo: the story behind a groundbreaking partnership
tracks.speaker_line: Roeland Van Dessel from Partena & Fabien Pinckaers from Odoo
tracks.description_text: In one of the world's most complex payroll markets, Partena Professional and Odoo joined forces with one ambition: to simplify payroll and HR like never before. This is one of the most significant collaborations ever signed by both companies. Discover the story behind Partena Professional and Odoo's historic & exclusive partnership that brings expertise and technology together in a perfect symbiosis. A unique Belgian innovation story.

tracks.name: „From Readiness to Rollout: How Hinz&Kunzt Prepared a Complex ERP Transformation with Odoo“
tracks.speaker_line: Christiane Grothus, Managing Director at Opalis
tracks.description_text: Implementing a new ERP system is never just about software — especially not when long-established processes, specific organizational requirements and a complex operating model come together. In this session, Hinz&Kunzt, Opalis Consulting and Intero will jointly share how an Odoo project can be successfully prepared and launched when clarity, readiness and stakeholder alignment are just as important as the technical solution itself. The talk focuses on how an organization with a unique operating model can move towards a future-proof ERP platform. It highlights key thematic areas such as mapping core business processes in Odoo, addressing specific functional requirements, integrating relevant interfaces, preparing data migration, and setting up structured testing, training and project governance. These areas reflect the main functional project topics identified during the preparation phase.  A particularly valuable angle of this story is the preparation phase before implementation: Opalis supported Hinz&Kunzt in shaping the transformation, moderating the selection process, preparing the organization from a change-management perspective and, after an unsuccessful first attempt with another Odoo partner, connecting the organization with Intero. This makes the session more than a software success story — it becomes a practical case about readiness, partner selection and the conditions required for successful ERP transformation. Attendees will gain actionable insights into the success factors of a more complex Odoo rollout, the interaction between organizational readiness and implementation, and the importance of setting up the right project foundations from the very beginning.

speakers.name: Christiane Grothus
speakers.biography_text: Christiane Grothues is Managing Director of Opalis Consulting GmbH and brings many years of experience in organizational transformation, governance, process management and change enablement. Throughout her career, she has held leadership roles as consultant, partner, authorized signatory and managing director. Before starting at and ultimately leading Opalis, she worked in senior governance and data protection roles at companies like Logwin AG (then Thiel Logistik) and DNV (then Germanischer Lloyd and DNV GL). In transformation projects, she helps organizations build clarity, readiness and sustainable decision-making structures before implementation starts.

tracks.name: Re-Commerce at Scale With Odoo - Real-Time Retail Across 18 Stores and One Unified E-Commerce Experience
tracks.speaker_line: Kristian Gram Krogh & Diogo Duarte, CTO & CTO, Founder at Greenmind
tracks.description_text:
Re-commerce is booming, but it doesn’t play by traditional e-commerce rules. When every product is unique and inventory exists only once, availability becomes the biggest challenge. In this session, Martin Roulund from GreenMind and Diogo Duarte from ERPGAP share how GreenMind, Denmark’s leading retailer within Refurbished Electronics with 18 physical stores, successfully built a scalable re-commerce operation where online and offline work as one.
Discover how real-time stock synchronization across all stores enables GreenMind to sell confidently online and creates a seamless omnichannel experience, how intelligent order orchestration decides the best fulfillment location based on value and availability, and how Alokai powers a seamless e-commerce experience on top of a highly dynamic inventory model.
If you’re exploring circular economy, re-commerce, or complex omnichannel setups, this session will give you practical insights into turning operational complexity into a competitive advantage.

speakers.name: Kristian Gram Krogh & Diogo Duarte
speakers.biography_text:
Kristian Korgaard is a CTO and technology leader with nearly 25 years of experience working with ERP systems, business processes, and enterprise IT.
For the past five years, he has worked extensively with Odoo, starting with Odoo 14 and following the platform through its continued evolution. His experience spans ERP architecture, integrations, finance, retail, logistics, e-commerce, and the practical implementation of business processes in Odoo.
In his current role as CTO at GreenMind, Kristian combines technology leadership with a hands-on approach to architecture and development, using Odoo as a central part of the company’s business platform.
Diogo Duarte is the CTO and Founder of ERPGap, a company specializing in delivering tailored ERP solutions to clients worldwide. As a certified Odoo Partner operating in both the UK and the United States, ERPGAP supports organizations across the globe in optimizing their business processes and digital infrastructure.
Before founding ERPGAP, Diogo built a strong foundation through 15 years of experience in the construction, industrial, and railway sectors. This hands-on industry background gives him a practical, results-driven perspective on technology, allowing him to bridge the gap between complex operational challenges and effective digital solutions.

tracks.name: Wero - European sovereignty in digital payments
tracks.speaker_line: Alfredo Prieto Rodrigo, Director Business Acceptance at EPI Company
tracks.description_text:
I’m reaching out to propose a speaking session at Odoo event in Belgium, on one of the most defining shifts currently underway in European payments: the rise of Wero and what it means for sovereignty, innovation, and competition in Belgium and across Europe.
As the European Payments Initiative brings Wero to market, we are moving from concept to reality, building a truly European alternative for account-to-account payments that is scalable, secure, and designed for everyday use cases from P2P to e-commerce and in-store transactions.
A session on Wero would resonate strongly with your audience, particularly in Belgium, where the market is at a pivotal moment between established domestic habits and the emergence of new pan-European solutions. The discussion would go beyond product, focusing on:
- How Europe can reduce reliance on non-European payment schemes
- What Wero changes for banks, merchants, and consumers
- The role of instant payments and account-based rails in shaping the future
- Practical implications for the Belgian ecosystem and time-to-market considerations
The goal would be to provide a clear, candid perspective: what’s real today, what’s coming next, and where the industry needs to collaborate to make it succeed.
I’m confident this would not only add strategic value to your agenda but also spark meaningful discussion among participants navigating this transition.
Happy to share more details or tailor the session to your audience.

speakers.name: Alfredo Prieto Rodrigo
speakers.biography_text: Alfredo Prieto Rodrigo is Director of Business Acceptance at EPI Company, where he leads the expansion of Wero, Europe’s emerging pan-European payment solution. Based in Brussels, he brings extensive experience in the payments and financial services industry, with a strong focus on merchant acceptance, business development, and digital commerce. Prior to EPI, he held roles at Bancontact Payconiq Company, FIS, and Euroclear, working across Europe, the Middle East, and Africa. Alfredo is passionate about driving innovation in payments and shaping the future of account-to-account and mobile transactions in Europe.

tracks.name: From CAD to Manufacturing: Connecting SOLIDWORKS, 3DEXPERIENCE and Odoo into One Digital Thread
tracks.speaker_line: Tero Salonen, Product Director at ATR Soft Oy
tracks.description_text:
Manufacturing companies often struggle with disconnected processes between engineering, purchasing, and production. Product data is created in CAD, PDM, or PLM systems, but turning that information into products, bills of materials, manufacturing orders, purchase requirements, and controlled product changes in ERP is still often manual, error-prone, and difficult to scale.
In this session, Tero Salonen from ATR Soft will show how manufacturers can connect SOLIDWORKS, SOLIDWORKS PDM, 3DEXPERIENCE, and Odoo into one practical digital thread from engineering to manufacturing. Building on ATR CustomTools’ experience from real-world Odoo–SOLIDWORKS integration projects, the presentation will go beyond simple import and export of product data. It will demonstrate how engineering information can be used in Odoo to create and update products and BOMs, support manufacturing order creation, enable purchase processes for buy components, and help manage engineering changes across systems.
The audience will learn how CAD and PLM data can support operational processes in Odoo, what to consider when planning an integration project, and how to avoid common pitfalls when connecting engineering and ERP systems. The session is especially valuable for manufacturing companies using Odoo together with SOLIDWORKS, SOLIDWORKS PDM, or 3DEXPERIENCE, as well as professionals working in engineering, production planning, purchasing, product data management, or business process development.
ATR CustomTools has been positioned around automating SOLIDWORKS and Odoo data flows, including product and BOM creation, previews, drawings, and comparison of changes between SOLIDWORKS and Odoo.

speakers.name: Tero Salonen
speakers.biography_text: Tero Salonen is Product Director at ATR Soft. He has worked at ATR Soft since 2000, starting as a software developer and later moving into product management and international integration projects. With a Master’s degree in Engineering and extensive experience in CAD, PDM, PLM, and ERP integrations, he helps manufacturing companies connect engineering systems such as SOLIDWORKS, SOLIDWORKS PDM, and 3DEXPERIENCE with business platforms like Odoo. Tero has previously presented ATR CustomTools and Odoo integration at Odoo Experience and regularly shares practical insights from real customer projects.

tracks.name: Consolidating the Stack: Replacing WooCommerce with Native Odoo Enterprise eCommerce Extensions
tracks.speaker_line: Tomás Van Loock, ERP Consultant at much. Consulting
tracks.description_text:
B2B2B hardware resellers frequently suffer from fragmented digital architectures, forcing them to maintain complex integrations between external platforms like WooCommerce and their core ERP system. For Cisco Meraki distributor Cloud Controlled, this ecosystem disconnect resulted in constant manual data synchronization, isolated product specifications, and a critical inability to track mandatory end-user data during the standard checkout process.
By migrating the entire operation to the Odoo Enterprise eCommerce and Website apps, we eliminated the WooCommerce middleware entirely and built directly on top of the native ERP data structure. We extended the core Odoo architecture to enable nested category inheritance for deep technical specifications, implemented dynamic real-time fetching of customer lead times directly from standard inventory models, and built a customized B2B2B checkout flow that captures required end-user delivery addresses for reseller compliance automatically.
This single Odoo environment permanently removed the need to sync separate platforms or update web catalogs by hand. Automatically pushing technical data to the storefront cut out hours of weekly admin work on lead times. It also reduced routine technical inquiries, meaning the sales team spent significantly less time answering basic hardware questions.
Key Points of this Talk:
- Removing WooCommerce: Replacing external web shop middleware with native Odoo Enterprise eCommerce apps.
- Smart Product Categories: Extending Odoo's category model so subcategories automatically inherit technical data.
- Live Lead Times: Automatically pulling real-time customer lead times from inventory straight to the website frontend.
- Strict B2B2B Checkout: Changing the regular Odoo eCommerce checkout flow to enforce mandatory end-user address tracking.
- Automatic Data Flow: Letting product specifications automatically pass through complex nested subcategories.
Key Learnings:
- Why you should eliminate external eCommerce integrations by leveraging native Odoo Website architecture.
- How to extend Odoo category models to propagate complex technical data automatically.
- How to dynamically expose backend inventory lead times to the frontend customer experience.
- How to customize the Odoo checkout process to capture multi-tier reseller data, incl. end user information.
Target Audience:
Technical Sales Leads, Solutions Architects, Senior Python Devs, and Technical Leads using Odoo Enterprise v18 and onwards.

speakers.name: Tomás Van Loock
speakers.biography_text: Tomás Van Loock is an AI & BI ERP Consultant at much. Consulting. Combining a background in Data Science and Management, he approaches Odoo Enterprise as a unified ecosystem rather than a collection of siloed applications. His implementation portfolio spans Manufacturing, Field Service, and eCommerce architectures. This broad horizontal system expertise allows him to bypass module constraints and map intricate business requirements into natively integrated Odoo frameworks.

tracks.name: Killing the 8 Wastes: A Functional Blueprint for Lean Manufacturing in Odoo Enterprise
tracks.speaker_line: Nuhash Kinzel, Senior Solutions Consultant at much. Consulting
tracks.description_text:
The "Hidden Factory"—the accumulation of non-value-added activities—accounts for up to 40% of operational costs in mid-sized manufacturing.
To remain competitive, companies must actively attack the eight Lean wastes (TIMWOODS). This talk provides a concrete implementation plan to weaponize Odoo Enterprise MRP and Inventory against these inefficiencies, transforming the shop floor from a cost center into a high-throughput engine.
We will outline how we used Odoo Enterprise Barcoding to eliminate unnecessary Motion and Transportation, alongside the Shop Floor App to resolve Waiting and Overprocessing through real-time Work Instructions. After, we will explore the "Skills" gap, showing how to restrict complex operations to certified personnel via Work Center logic. Finally, we will showcase how to expose "Hidden Waste" by extracting status-based transition data into an external BI Data Warehouse. By leveraging Odoo's native data structure, we demonstrate how one partner achieved a 20% reduction in lead times and a 15% increase in Overall Equipment Effectiveness (OEE) by identifying bottlenecks that standard ERP reporting often overlooks.
Key Points of this Talk:
- Inventory Waste: Implementing Make to Order (MTO) and Master Production Schedule (MPS) logic to eliminate overproduction and capital lock-up.
- Motion & Transportation: Deploying Odoo Barcoding to automate internal transfers and bin-to-bin movements.
- Defect Control: Integrating Quality Control Points (QCP) directly into the manufacturing routing sequence.
- Skill Management: Restricting Work Center access based on Employee Skill levels and certifications.
- Waiting Times: Using the Shop Floor Tablet interface for paperless, real-time job queuing.
- Waste Analytics: Exporting status-based Odoo data via Extract, Transform, Load (ETL) pipelines to Superset for bottleneck visualization.
Key Learnings:
- How to map the 8 TIMWOODS wastes to specific Odoo Enterprise functional settings.
- How to configure automated Quality Checks to prevent the "Flow of Defects."
- How to use Odoo Barcoding to reduce physical movement in high-volume warehouses.
- How to leverage Odoo Work Instructions to reduce the training period for new staff.
- How to identify "Waiting" waste by analyzing Work Order status transitions in BI.
Target Audience:
- Operations Managers looking to implement Lean methodologies.
- Production Planners using Odoo Enterprise MRP v18/v19.
- Functional Consultants designing complex manufacturing processes.

speakers.name: Nuhash Kinzel
speakers.biography_text: Nuhash Kinzel is a Senior Solutions Consultant at much. Consulting in Munich. With four years of experience at a leading Odoo Gold Partner, Nuhash has supported over 100 business transformation projects, specializing in the conceptualization and architectural planning of complex operations. He has personally supported the functional and technical setup of over 30 Odoo implementations, focusing on scaling manufacturing and logistics through data-driven Lean methodologies.

tracks.name: Beyond Serial Numbers: Automating High-Volume Software Licensing in Odoo Enterprise.
tracks.speaker_line: Lisa Adamy, ERP Consultant at much. Consulting
tracks.description_text:
Software distributors face a unique structural paradox in Odoo: they require the traceability of serial numbers without the overhead of physical inventory moves. Arina, a leading European provider of digital forensics tools, struggled with a fragmented "Order-to-Cash" flow where license keys were manually copy-pasted across Sales Orders, Purchase Orders, and Subscriptions, leading to significant data decay and renewal leakage. To solve this, a centralized license.key architecture was deployed, leveraging Odoo Enterprise Subscription logic to create a persistent digital asset thread.
By inheriting standard Enterprise methods such as _prepare_invoice_line and _get_renew_upsell_values, the system ensures that license keys persist automatically through the entire lifecycle - from the initial RFQ to annual upsells. This deep integration allows for "Back-to-Back" procurement, where purchase prices are secured before Sales Order confirmation, a critical requirement for high-margin software distribution. The result is a 80% reduction in administrative overhead, managing over 1,000 active subscriptions with zero manual data duplication between procurement and accounting.
In this talk, we will cover:
- Digital Asset Centralization: Why standard stock.production.lot fails for intangible goods and how to replace it.
- Subscription Persistence: Using license_key_ids to maintain traceability during Odoo Enterprise renewal and upsell cycles.
- Automated Procurement Flow: Triggering RFQs via custom product flags to secure margins before SO confirmation.
- The Mixin Architecture: Deploying license.key.mixin to unify headers and lines across SO, PO, and Invoicing.
- Reporting & Transparency: Dynamic injection of license data into PDF templates for quotes, invoices, and delivery slips.
- Order-to-Cash Efficiency: Reducing manual intervention by 70% for complex forensic software distribution.
You will learn:
- How to manage non-storable assets that require unique identifiers without triggering stock moves.
- How to extend Odoo Enterprise Subscription logic to carry custom relational data into upsell and renewal orders.
- How to automate the "Back-to-Back" vendor procurement process for services and digital goods.
- How to avoid data silos by using a single source of truth for license expiration and payment dates.
- How to architect a modular Mixin that ensures consistent data flow across all accounting documents.
Target Audience:
- Odoo Partners & Consultants managing software or SaaS distribution clients.
- CFOs & Operations Managers using Odoo Enterprise Subscriptions.
- Intermediate Developers interested in extending Subscription and Procurement logic (v18/v19).

speakers.name: Lisa Adamy
speakers.biography_text: As a Services ERP Consultant at much. Consulting, Lisa Adamy focuses on optimizing day-to-day operations for service organizations using Odoo Enterprise. She transforms complex business requirements into intuitive, highly automated digital architectures that drive sustainable growth.

tracks.name: From NetSuite to Odoo: How a 50-Year-Old Meat-Processing Equipment Maker Unified CPQ, Manufacturing and Inventory
tracks.speaker_line: Devang Mehta, Co-founder and Director of Operations at Aktiv Software
tracks.description_text:
Kentmaster has built meat-processing equipment for over 50 years, with operations across the United States, Australia, Ireland, South Africa, China, and Argentina. As the business scaled, NetSuite's rising licensing costs and limited flexibility became a real constraint, while quoting, manufacturing, and inventory ran across disconnected tools that slowed the business down.
This session walks through Kentmaster's migration from NetSuite to Odoo and the configure-to-order solution Aktiv built around it. We will cover the full journey: discovery and solution blueprinting, a large-scale data migration of thousands of products, variants, and complex BoMs with no disruption to operations, and a custom CPQ module tightly integrated with Sales and Manufacturing. The result is a single flow where a confirmed quote automatically generates the correct BoM and routes it to production, removing the rework and pricing inconsistencies that came from quoting outside the ERP.
Beyond CPQ, we will show how location-aware manufacturing, preferred-location inventory rules with serial traceability, and an automated order-to-cash flow came together into one connected system, giving leadership real-time visibility across multiple companies for the first time.
Attendees evaluating a migration from a costly proprietary ERP, or manufacturers struggling to connect quoting to production, will leave with a practical reference for how this is done on Odoo.
What attendees will learn:
- How to plan and execute a large-scale NetSuite-to-Odoo migration without disrupting live operations
- How CPQ can drive accurate quotes and automatic BoM creation straight into manufacturing
- How location-aware production and preferred-location inventory rules improve accuracy across multiple warehouses
- What a connected quote-to-production-to-invoice flow looks like in practice

speakers.name: Devang Mehta
speakers.biography_text: Devang Mehta is the Co-founder and Director of Operations at Aktiv Software, bringing over 15 years of experience in operations management and customer success. He oversees project delivery across teams, keeping timelines, quality, and communication aligned so that what a client signs up for is what they actually receive.

tracks.name: See how wholesaler Sempertex created a B2B webshop at scale with Odoo
tracks.speaker_line: Brett Eerdekens, Managing Partner at Dear Digital
tracks.description_text: See how balloon wholesaer Sempertex built a scalable B2B webshop fully integrated with Odoo, connecting sales, inventory, logistics, and customer data in one platform. We will share the key architectural and implementation decisions that enabled rapid growth without increasing operational complexity.

speakers.name: Brett Eerdekens

tracks.name: Multi-Company and Multi-Country Consolidations in Odoo 19
tracks.speaker_line: Cecilie Barreto, Director of Implementation at Sodexis, Inc.
tracks.description_text:
Are you struggling to manage financial consolidations across multiple entities and currencies?
Would you prefer a seamless, automated way to aggregate your financial data when closing the fiscal year across different countries, while ensuring compliance with varying local regulations?
Enter Odoo V19! Odoo’s latest localization and accounting enhancements enable seamless real-time data synchronization across borders, thereby solving the complex multi-company and multi-country consolidation problem for expanding businesses.
This technology eliminates the need for manual spreadsheets and tedious external reporting tools. Over the past years, our team has successfully streamlined complex international accounting structures, enabling financial departments to reduce their closing times. With Odoo 19’s advanced multi-currency revaluation and centralized dashboard, multi-national groups can now manage dozens of legal entities with full transparency and compliance.
Join this session to discover how growing enterprises have achieved remarkable efficiency in their global operations—and how Odoo 19’s newest consolidation features play a key role in reaching these milestones.
Representing Sodexis will be Cecilie Barreto, our Director of Implementation.
Since 2012, Sodexis has been a full-service Odoo Implementation Partner, with a Consulting and Development team focused on maximizing customers’ ROI and user experience. Sodexis is one of the longest-tenured implementation Odoo Partners in the US and also has a presence in Switzerland, France, and Austria. Sodexis brings a wealth of experience and valuable expertise to its clients, having successfully implemented over 150 projects and built hundreds of custom applications. More info:
https://sodexis.com/

speakers.name: Cecilie Barreto
speakers.biography_text: Cecilie Barreto earned her bachelor of science in computer engineering from the University of Central Florida in 2018. While pursuing her undergraduate education, she gained experience in construction project management, developing valuable skills in organization and analysis. After graduating, Cecilie dove headfirst into the world of Odoo, accumulating eight years of experience across ten different versions. Her niche expertise lies in accounting and process optimization, where her passion thrives. Cecilie is known for her ability to simplify complex accounting procedures and make them more accessible, contributing significantly to the businesses she collaborates with.

tracks.speaker_line: Carlos Rodríguez Saldaña, Direct Sales - Team Leader at Odoo Spain

Think you know our POS app inside and out? Think again! Join us for an eye-opening session to uncover the powerful, hidden features designed to slash your checkout times, customize your setup, and improve usability for you cashiers while delighting your customers.
Whether you're looking to shave seconds off a transaction or completely refresh your user experience, this talk will show you how to unlock the platform's full potential.

tracks.name: Empowering the Portal: Let Your Clients Self-Service and Save Your Team Time
tracks.speaker_line: Gin Yan, Business Advisor at Sodexis, Inc.
tracks.description_text:
Discover how to optimize Odoo’s customer portal to give your clients 24/7 access to their data, reducing administrative overhead and speeding up business cycles.
Your customer service and sales teams likely spend hours every week responding to routine emails. They are stuck sending copy-paste invoice PDFs, tracking down shipping numbers, or manually updating customers on order statuses. This back-and-forth slows your team down, and it forces your clients to wait on an email response just to get basic information about their own accounts.
We solve this bottleneck by leaning into Odoo’s native customer portal and tailoring it to act as a true self-service hub. Instead of treating the portal as an afterthought, we configure it so your clients can log in 24/7 to securely view their order history, download invoices, pay outstanding balances, and track shipments in real time. For businesses with recurring revenue models, we can even allow customers to manage their own subscriptions or submit support tickets directly through their dashboard, which automatically routes the data right into your Odoo backend.
Giving your clients direct access does not mean losing control. It simply removes the friction from the process. By shifting routine tasks to a secure self-service portal, you give your customers the instant answers they want while freeing up your team to focus on higher-value work.

speakers.name: Gin Yan
speakers.biography_text: After earning his Bachelor’s degree in Marketing and International Business from the State University of New York at Oswego, Gin built a formidable track record in the ERP industry. He spent several years within the manufacturing and distribution sectors to master the fundamentals of business operations. Bringing extensive retail and wholesale experience, he joined the Sodexis team in early 2025. He initially served as a Business Analyst to master the technical intricacies of Odoo implementations before stepping into his current leadership role. Today, Gin leads our US Sales Operations, combining deep technical analysis with sharp commercial expertise.

tracks.name: Automating 30,000 Members: Translating Complex NPO Fee Matrices into Odoo Enterprise Subscriptions
tracks.speaker_line: Nicolas Colsman, CEO at ZdoV GmbH
tracks.description_text:
Managing a 30,000-member association in Germany traditionally mandates heavy administrative overhead, particularly when membership dues are dictated by convoluted variables like academic degrees, membership tenure, and specialized research grants. Historically, processing these nested logic trees required legacy databases, fractured Excel sheets, and 2.5 full-time equivalents (FTEs) purely dedicated to billing and reconciliation.
To eliminate this bottleneck, ZdoV architected a centralized association framework utilizing Odoo Enterprise Contacts, Subscriptions, and Accounting. We developed custom calculation logic to inherit the intricate legacy fee matrix and map it directly onto dynamic Odoo subscription products. This architecture programmatically executes the entire financial lifecycle: it calculates the precise variable fee per member, automates recurring invoicing, processes high-volume SEPA Direct Debit mandates natively within the accounting module, and generates legally compliant German donation receipts (Spendenbescheinigungen) without manual intervention.
By replacing disconnected legacy systems with a unified Odoo Enterprise environment, the association fundamentally restructured its operational efficiency. The automated billing and SEPA reconciliation cycle reduced the required administrative overhead from 2.5 FTEs down to a 0.5 FTE workload, proving Odoo's capacity to handle massive, highly localized non-profit constraints.
Key Points of this Talk:
- Mapping legacy variable fee matrices (academic degrees, grants) to Odoo Subscriptions.
- Centralizing 30,000 member records within Odoo Enterprise Contacts to deprecate Excel.
- Executing high-volume SEPA Direct Debit mandates via Odoo Enterprise Accounting.
- Automating the generation of compliant German donation receipts (Spendenbescheinigungen).
- Reducing billing administration workload from 2.5 to 0.5 FTEs.
Key Learnings:
- How to translate intricate legacy calculation parameters into dynamic Odoo subscription products.
- How to configure Odoo Accounting for high-volume, automated SEPA reconciliation.
- How to structure Odoo Contacts to handle complex non-profit membership hierarchies.
Target Audience:
Functional Consultants, NPO Administrators, and Solution Architects using Odoo Enterprise.

speakers.name: Nicolas Colsman
speakers.biography_text: Nicolas Colsman (Spiegel Bestselling Author, expert for the digitalization of states, NGOs, and Faith-Based Organizations, and CEO of ZdoV - Zukunft digitale und offene Verwaltung GmbH

tracks.name: Retail & Distribution Reimagined: Driving Performance with Odoo
tracks.speaker_line: Clémentine Cailleau from Metrum
tracks.description_text:
Retail and distribution companies face increasing pressure: tighter margins, rising customer expectations, growing operational complexity and the need to make faster decisions.
Odoo can do much more than digitalize existing processes. When implemented with the right functional approach, enhanced with targeted custom developments and empowered by AI, it becomes a true performance platform that creates measurable competitive advantage.
In this live demonstration, we will follow the journey of a retail and distribution company through its entire value chain, showcasing how Odoo supports every key business process—from purchasing and warehouse operations to sales, customer service and management decision-making.
Rather than focusing on individual modules, we will demonstrate how standard Odoo, carefully selected customizations and AI-powered capabilities work together to:
Optimize purchasing and replenishment decisions
Improve warehouse productivity and inventory accuracy
Increase sales efficiency across channels
Automate repetitive operational tasks
Deliver actionable insights through AI
Support managers with real-time performance indicators
Create sustainable competitive advantages while keeping the solution scalable and maintainable
The session will also explain the methodology behind these choices: when to leverage standard Odoo, when customization creates real business value, and where AI delivers tangible ROI rather than unnecessary complexity.
Attendees will leave with a practical framework for designing high-performance retail and distribution solutions that combine functional excellence, technology and business impact.

speakers.name: Clémentine Cailleau
speakers.biography_text:
Clémentine Cailleau is the Odoo Functional Leader at Metrum, the Odoo Business Unit of the Resultance Group, where she leads the development of functional standards, implementation methodologies and project governance across the organization.
With nearly five years of experience in digital transformation and operational excellence, she specializes in designing business-driven Odoo solutions that help companies improve performance while keeping implementations scalable and maintainable.
Throughout her career, she has led and advised complex ERP transformation projects across industries including retail, distribution, manufacturing and services. Her expertise spans business process design, solution architecture, implementation strategy and change management, with a strong focus on maximizing the value of standard Odoo while identifying where targeted custom developments and AI can create sustainable competitive advantages.
Passionate about bridging business strategy and technology, Clémentine regularly supports project teams on complex functional decisions and contributes to the continuous evolution of implementation best practices within the Resultance Group.

tracks.name: Beyond borders: Scaling your eCommerce empire
tracks.speaker_line: Maxime Verheggen from Odoo
tracks.description_text:
Ready to take your online business global? Discover how Odoo 20 simplifies complex international eCommerce operations from a single database.
In this session, We will dive deep into:

tracks.name: Draw Your Ideas. Make Them Stick.
tracks.speaker_line: Dorbolo, SKETCHNOTING trainings at Pictobello.com - Denis Dorbolo
tracks.description_text:
Most business ideas are forgotten minutes after they're shared.
In this fast-paced and interactive session, you'll discover how simple sketches can make ideas clearer, conversations more engaging, and messages more memorable. Through a few playful exercises, you'll experience the power of sketchnoting for yourself—even if you think you can't draw.
Whether you're leading meetings, presenting to clients, brainstorming with a team, or simply looking for a fresh way to communicate, visual thinking can open new possibilities. This workshop offers a fun first step into the world of sketchnoting and visual communication.
You'll leave with a different perspective on how ideas can be shared, understood, and remembered—and perhaps with the surprising realization that drawing is far more accessible than you ever imagined.
Who should attend?
Entrepreneurs, managers, consultants, team leaders, trainers, and curious professionals who want to communicate with greater clarity and impact.

speakers.name: Dorbolo
speakers.biography_text: Denis Dorbolo is the founder of Pictobello, a visual communication and sketchnoting company based in Wallonia, Belgium. With more than 25 years of experience in adult learning, training, and coaching, he helps professionals transform complex ideas into simple visuals that improve understanding, engagement, and memory. Since 2019, thousands of participants have discovered visual thinking through his workshops, conferences, and training programs delivered across Belgium, France, and beyond. His mission is simple: prove that drawing is not a talent reserved for a few, but a communication skill accessible to everyone.

tracks.name: Building Freight Forwarding Depth on a Flexible Odoo ERP Foundation
tracks.speaker_line: Devashish Patyal, Deputy CEO at ICS Global
tracks.description_text:
Freight forwarding companies rarely struggle because they lack basic ERP features; they struggle because their operations require deeper control beyond standard sales, invoicing, accounting, and inventory flows. A freight business needs connected processes for enquiries, quotations, bookings, shipments, containers, House and Master Bills of Lading, buying and selling rates, margin visibility, document generation, customer updates, customs, manifests, and country-specific compliance.
This session will share how a flexible Odoo ERP foundation can be shaped into a freight forwarding operating platform by adding logistics-specific workflows, structured data models, operational checkpoints, integration readiness, and scalable controls. The presentation will cover the practical journey from generic business processes to domain-ready logistics operations, including shipment lifecycle management, rate management, documentation, invoicing, dashboards, and multi-country process design.
The key takeaways for the audience will include how to identify domain gaps during discovery, avoid unnecessary over-customization, design freight workflows with long-term scalability, and build industry depth while preserving the flexibility of the Odoo platform. This session will be valuable for Odoo consultants, ERP implementation teams, logistics companies, solution architects, and business leaders planning digital transformation in freight forwarding and logistics operations.

speakers.name: Devashish Patyal
speakers.biography_text: Devashish Patyal is the Deputy CEO at INTECH, with over 20 years of experience in business strategy, technology innovation, product vision, and enterprise transformation. He has worked across Ports & Terminals, Logistics, FMCG, and Retail, helping businesses convert complex operational challenges into scalable digital solutions. At INTECH, Devashish focuses on building strong teams, aligning technology with business outcomes, and driving future-ready platforms that improve efficiency, competitiveness, and customer success.

tracks.name: Populate, Odoo's new data generation framework
tracks.speaker_line: Victor Piryns, Performance Engineer at Odoo
tracks.description_text:
Generating realistic Odoo databases for development, demonstrations, and performance testing has traditionally required custom scripts and considerable maintenance.
Populate
introduces a new declarative framework for generating large, coherent datasets directly in Odoo. In this talk, we will explore how blueprints, generators, relationships, statistical distributions, scaling, and parallel execution work together to produce realistic data efficiently. We will also look behind the scenes at the framework’s architecture and see how developers can extend it for their own modules and use cases.

speakers.name: Victor Piryns
speakers.biography_text: Victor Piryns is a performance engineer at Odoo. He works on improving performance across both Odoo’s core framework and business applications, as well as on tools that help developers analyze and test performance.

tracks.name: How to recruit Gen Z (without being cringe)
tracks.speaker_line: Elise Derclaye & Kaat Goiris from Odoo
tracks.description_text:
Recruitment is a bit like dating.
You wouldn't propose on the first date. So why do companies expect students to commit before they've even had the chance to get to know them?
And just like dating, first impressions matter - but eventually, the real you has to show up.
At Odoo, we've been exploring what happens when recruitment starts long before the application : when students get the chance to meet the people, experience the culture, and make up their own minds about whether there could be a match.
Join us as we share what we've tried, what we've learned, and what happens when you stop trying to convince Gen Z - and start letting them discover you instead.

tracks.name: One CRM, one source of truth: How a publishing company consolidated a fragmented customer landscape on Odoo – and powered its print-to-digital shift
tracks.speaker_line: Lars Schymonski from Ruhrdot
tracks.description_text: media magneten, a publishing and advertising company in Essen, ran its sales on a fragmented landscape: SAP as the master-data backbone, a home-grown legacy system for orders and field service, and a scatter of point tools. Customer data lived everywhere and nowhere - no single view, constant manual re-entry between systems, and limited control over their own data. Together with ruhrdot., they made Odoo 19 the operational heart of the business: one CRM as the single source of truth for roughly 200,000 customer records, with SAP retained as the system of record. The result is a 360° customer view, sales workflows freed from manual re-entry and media breaks, advisor-specific marketing automation through Brevo, and trigger-based sales steering that tells advisors who to contact and when. Just as important, the project restored media magneten's sovereignty over its own customer data and laid the operational foundation for its strategic shift from print to digital. Instead of a big-bang cutover, ruhrdot. delivered a disciplined six-month MVP with a phased, pilot-first go-live. This talk shows how a mid-market company turns a CRM migration into a genuine business transformation.

tracks.name: Customer success story: Artel Rubber's Engineer-to-Order Transformation with Odoo
tracks.speaker_line: Giovanni Ughi, CEO at BRYO GmbH
tracks.description_text:
In this talk, the CEO of Bryo shares the story of the digital transformation at Artel Rubber, the UK’s leading manufacturer of silicon hoses for complex industrial applications. This is not a standard ERP implementation story, but a journey through complexity, failed attempts, and a breakthrough enabled by Odoo.
Artel Rubber operates in an engineer-to-order environment, where every product is designed and manufactured based on customer requirements. This creates a high level of complexity in one of the most critical business processes: designing, quoting and manufacturing custom products.
The key challenge is to define a new bill of materials within the ERP system for each new design. Each bill of materials includes different operations distributed across six work centres and consists of multiple components and raw materials.
For years, this challenge blocked migration to a modern ERP system. Operations were distributed across four custom legacy systems and paper-based processes dating back to the 1990s. A previous ERP migration project ran for four years, costing hundreds of thousands of euros, but failed.
By building on Odoo's standard manufacture-to-order workflows, Bryo delivered a fully integrated solution in just three months across all key modules: sales, manufacturing, shop floor, inventory, purchasing and invoicing. The key to this success was a deep understanding of the customers’ proprietary engineering tools and creating a simple connection to the Manufacturing module. This achieved a 20% efficiency gain in back-office operations within the first three months, alongside improved planning and delivery performance.
Attendees will learn how Odoo can successfully support complex engineer-to-order manufacturers, the importance of understanding customer-specific processes, and the implementation strategies that enabled a project previously considered too complex to become a successful digital transformation.
This session demonstrates how Odoo can become the backbone of even highly complex manufacturing operations when implemented with the right approach.

speakers.name: Giovanni Ughi
speakers.biography_text: Giovanni founded BRYO in 2023 to help manufacturers of complex industrial products transform their operations. Before BRYO, Giovanni was COO of a German manufacturing marketplace, supplying custom parts to leading OEMs like Schunk, Schuler and German Bionic.

tracks.name: From AI CPQ to Shop Floor: Connecting HIPE to Odoo for the Packaging Industry
tracks.speaker_line: Sébastien BOSSOUTROT, co-Founder and co-CEO at IROKOO
tracks.description_text:
In the packaging industry, every order is unique. Dimensions, materials, printing, finishing: nothing is a standard catalog product. Yet most converters still quote these orders either in spreadsheets or in legacy ERPs that were never designed to handle configurable products. Margin only becomes clear after production. The configurator, when there is one, lives outside the ERP, so the gap between what was sold and what is produced gets filled manually, slowly, and with costly errors.
This talk shows, live in Odoo 19 (20), how an AI-powered CPQ built for packaging (HIPE) connects directly to Odoo to close that gap, end to end. HIPE owns the front of the funnel, configuration and AI-assisted quoting. The moment a quote is won, Odoo takes over the entire ERP backbone: the sales order, the cascading bill of materials, the purchase needs for materials and subcontracting, the manufacturing order, inventory, accounting, and a reliable cost, with no double entry. We walk the full path: from the configured quote in HIPE, to procurement and the shop floor, to inventory and margin analysis in Odoo.
We also share what it takes to make this integration reliable in real operations: keeping both systems in sync, handling errors gracefully, and turning a complex configured product into an accurate, multi-level bill of materials. Key takeaway: a concrete blueprint to turn Odoo into the backbone of configure-to-order manufacturing, with packaging as the showcase but lessons that apply to any made-to-order business.

speakers.name: Sébastien BOSSOUTROT
speakers.biography_text:
Co-presented by Sébastien Bossoutrot (IROKOO) and Thomas Othax (HIPE / Packitoo).
Sébastien Bossoutrot is co-founder and Co-CEO of IROKOO, one of France's leading Odoo Gold Partners.
An engineer who spent years working inside the packaging industry, he knows the trade from the shop floor up. Before IROKOO, he spent five years as an ERP project manager and pre-sales lead on a product vertical built for the packaging sector, bridging operations, business needs and software. A certified Odoo expert (v14 to v19) and functional architect, he now helps organizations turn Odoo into the operating system of their business.
Thomas Othax is the founder and CEO of Packitoo, a French software editor that aims to improve sales operations in the packaging industry.
Packitoo has developed HIPE, the first CPQ (Configure, Price, Quote) solution designed for the packaging industry, and is today launching a platform dedicated to creating AI agents for this sector.
Started in 2017, Packitoo has joined BOBST Group since 2024, one of the world’s leading suppliers of substrate processing, printing and converting equipment and services for the label, flexible packaging, folding carton and corrugated board industries.

tracks.name: What's new in Shipping Methods?
tracks.speaker_line: Mykola Liebiediev, Customer Support Analyst at Odoo
tracks.description_text: In this talk we will have a summary of the developments and improvements we've been working on related to shipping.

tracks.name: Scaling a luxury retailer across five countries on Odoo
tracks.speaker_line: Ruben Van den broecke + Egbert Van Sande (DOL), Project manager at Dynapps
tracks.description_text:
How do you grow a premium lifestyle brand across five countries, with Cuban cigars in one window and online auctions in the next, all running on a single platform?
That is the bet Dominique London is making. What started as a small shop in Ghent has grown into a multi-country retailer spanning Belgium, the UK, Switzerland, Luxembourg and the Canary Islands, with physical boutiques, a B2C webshop, a POS network, and a UK-grown online auction business. To support that ambition, the company chose Odoo as the single backbone for commerce, POS, inventory and accounting.
In this session, Dominique London and Dynapps share what it takes to make that work in practice. We zoom in on the architectural choices behind a multi-company, multi-country setup where one Odoo website automatically serves the right prices, products, VAT treatment and currency based on the visitor's location. We look at how strict assortment rules are handled at storefront and checkout level.
We also share the lessons that won't make the brochure: where standard Odoo simply works, where it doesn't, and which compromises pay off when you are racing toward a growth target.
Whether you run a multi-brand retailer, are about to launch in a second country, or are skeptical that a single ERP can carry both a luxury experience and a complex backend, this session gives you a practical look at how it is done.

speakers.name: Ruben Van den broecke + Egbert Van Sande (DOL)
speakers.biography_text: Senior Project manager at Dynapps, leading complex Odoo implementations in the Belgian and international markets.

tracks.name: Into the Odoo Editor
tracks.speaker_line: Benoit Socias (bso) from Odoo
tracks.description_text:
Ever wanted to customize the Odoo editing experience but didn't know where to start? This talk is for you.
We will go 'Into the Odoo Editor' to demystify the html_editor addon and show you how to plug your own features into it.
We will explore the integration points, the extension mechanisms, and the best practices for developers.

tracks.name: From Sage, Satelix & PrestaShop to Odoo: How Toulet Medical Unified Its Distribution Business Across Stores & E-commerce
tracks.speaker_line: Séphora DAYNE MOREAU, CEO at GS CONSEILS
tracks.description_text:
Toulet Medical is one of the medical equipment distributors on Réunion Island, a French overseas territory located in the Indian Ocean. The company serves healthcare professionals, medical institutions, care facilities, and private customers through multiple physical stores, warehouses, and complementary e-commerce websites.
Before Odoo, Toulet Medical relied on several separate solutions, including Sage for business management and accounting, PrestaShop for e-commerce, and additional tools used to support daily operations. As the company continued to grow, managing sales, inventory, purchasing, logistics, customer service, and online sales across multiple systems became increasingly complex, time-consuming, and costly.
To support its development, Toulet Medical decided to centralize its operations within Odoo and transform its information system into a single integrated platform. Today, Odoo is used to manage sales, purchasing, inventory, logistics, accounting, customer service, physical stores, and the Toulet Medical and Couches & Co e-commerce websites.
During this session, we will share the company’s digital transformation journey and explain how Odoo became the backbone of its operations.
Attendees will discover how the company successfully migrated from multiple disconnected applications to a unified ERP platform while preparing for future growth.
The presentation will also highlight the specific challenges of operating a medical equipment distribution company on Réunion Island, including import lead times, stock availability, multi-site operations, managing two brands and two e-commerce websites within the same company, multi-company environments, retail store operations, and the high level of customer service required in the healthcare sector.
Key Takeaways
* Successfully migrating from Sage and PrestaShop to Odoo.
* Centralizing sales, purchasing, inventory, accounting, and e-commerce within a single platform.
* Managing multiple stores and warehouses efficiently.
* Operating multiple e-commerce websites from a single database.
* Improving inventory visibility and replenishment processes.
* Supporting business growth through standardized and scalable processes.
* Lessons learned from a real-world implementation project on Réunion Island.
Value for the Audience
This session will provide a practical and transparent customer success story from a real-life digital transformation project. Participants will gain insights into the challenges encountered, the benefits achieved, and the lessons learned while replacing multiple business applications with a fully integrated ERP system.
Attendees will leave with concrete ideas and best practices that can be applied to their own organizations, whether they manage distribution operations, retail networks, e-commerce businesses, or multi-site companies.
Target Audience
* Business owners and executives
* Operations managers
* Supply chain and logistics managers
* Purchasing managers
* E-commerce managers
* Finance and accounting managers
* IT managers
* Odoo partners and consultants
* Distribution and retail companies looking to centralize their operations within a single platform
Additional Information
The session would ideally be presented in French. Presentation materials can be provided in English if required, but presenting in French would allow the speakers to be more comfortable during discussions and audience Q&A sessions.

speakers.name: Séphora DAYNE MOREAU
speakers.biography_text: Séphora Dayne Moreau is an Odoo Certified Consultant, founder and CEO of GS Conseils. With a Master’s Degree in Information Systems Integration Management and more than 15 years of experience in website development and digital transformation, she is passionate about turning business challenges into practical digital solutions. Her expertise spans business analysis, project management, website creation, and Odoo implementation.

tracks.name: Lunch break
4 Lifestyle Brands, 7 E-commerce Channels, 1 Odoo: Migrating a Group off Sage Without Overselling
tracks.speaker_line: Nico Ziemski from ruhrdot GmbH
tracks.description_text: Zeitgeist GmbH runs four consumer lifestyle brands (the watch brands Detomaso, Yves Camani and Lilienthal plus Kooja) across direct-to-consumer Shopify stores and the Amazon and Otto marketplaces, with e-commerce as the group's core business. Their legacy Sage ERP modeled stock as components and bills of materials, which created a constant overselling risk and tied up a large block of component inventory that blocked a clean transition. ruhrdot. replaced Sage with a single Odoo 19 Enterprise instance for the entire group: two legal entities in one multi-company setup, a simplified single-SKU inventory model, and separate DATEV exports per entity for German accounting compliance. Odoo sits at the hub of the supply chain, orchestrating four Shopify stores through a custom connector, the Amazon and Otto channels through a middleware, and fulfillment through third-party logistics via a SOAP integration that also routes watch engraving. Instead of a big-bang cutover, we went live brand by brand, month by month, so learnings from the first brand fed the next. This talk shows how to design a multi-brand group ERP from day one, retire a risky legacy inventory model, and de-risk a large migration through phased go-lives.

tracks.name: Scaling Odoo for Complex Retail: Dreambaby’s Journey Across 30+ Stores, a Central DC and Tailor-made applications
tracks.speaker_line: Daan Sileghem, Founder, Managing Partner at Konu BV
tracks.description_text:
Dreambaby, the largest baby retail brand in Belgium, runs its core operation on Odoo. With more than 260 employees, 30+ physical stores (with additional stores planned for 2026), and a central warehouse, Odoo serves as the daily backbone for all core business processes.
The platform covers accounting, inventory, purchasing, sales, POS, HR, planning, attendance, customer service, and more, all within one centralised system. Despite numerous integrations with external systems, including marketing platforms, Shopify eCommerce, and Power BI, Odoo serves as the single source of truth (SSOT) for all operational and master data.
As Odoo partner Konu from Kortrijk, Belgium, we delivered the full implementation under a very ambitious timeline. Dreambaby migrated from SAP to Odoo and went live in just 8 months, followed by a hypercare phase of about 3 months, without disrupting ongoing operations.
While Odoo’s standard applications provided a strong foundation, Dreambaby’s retail-specific complexity required deep customisation across multiple core flows, including accounting, HR, POS, purchasing, sales, helpdesk, and more.
Inventory and logistics were heavily extended to match Dreambaby’s scale and complexity. Odoo manages 30+ stores in a multi-branch routing setup, with store replenishment driven by over one million replenishment rules. Store assortments are dynamically defined through a custom store range management application, powered by a bespoke sales forecasting tool. The platform supports advanced eCommerce flows, dynamic picking and prioritisation (for giftlists, online orders, and other channels), and online shipping directly from stores.
On top of the core platform, we developed a suite of custom-built applications tailored to Dreambaby’s business:
- A bespoke Giftlist (Birthlist) engine built in Odoo with a headless React frontend
- A custom loyalty program, deeply integrated with both POS and webshop
- A store replenishment engine with dynamic demand forecasting
- Automated shelf label printing driven by real-time pricing
- A dynamic price display system for managing in-store and online promotions
Today, we continue to support Dreambaby on a daily basis, driving its ongoing digital transformation with fast-paced improvements to the giftlist, loyalty program, and overall shop concept. This is an ongoing journey, part of a broader conceptual modernisation of the Dreambaby retail experience. The roadmap focuses on evolving the tailor-made applications and strengthening employee-facing tools and interfaces, with a clear emphasis on improving both customer and employee experiences.
This session offers an honest and practical account of the project: what worked well, where we encountered friction, and what we would approach differently. It is ideal for teams considering Odoo for full operational coverage in a complex retail environment.

speakers.name: Daan Sileghem
speakers.biography_text: Daan Sileghem is the founder and one of two managing partners at Konu, an Odoo Partner based in Kortrijk, Belgium. With a strong background in sales and marketing, he quickly realised that true commercial success hinges on operational excellence. Driven by this insight, he helps companies untangle inefficient systems and streamline their operations with Odoo, bridging the gap between business needs and technical solutions.

tracks.name: Scaling Agentic AI in Banking: A testimonial from BNP Paribas Fortis
tracks.speaker_line: Anthony Belpaire, Head of AI at BNP Paribas Fortis
tracks.description_text: As consumers begin turning to AI assistants for financial advice, banking models must evolve. Agentic AI is no longer a future concept—it is a current driver of massive productivity gains and shifting customer behaviors. In this session, we share a practical testimonial of how BNP Paribas Fortis is navigating this landscape. Discover the strategic choices, implementation challenges, and real-world outcomes of deploying Agentic AI within a major financial organization.

speakers.name: Anthony Belpaire

Anthony leads the AI transformation at BNP Paribas Fortis, heading a central AI team (Product managers, business analysts, data scientists, ML/MLOps engineers) delivering solutions for retail, private, and corporate banking.
Before joining the bank, he was CEO of scale-ups (Certipost, GlobalSign) and a business leader at Google and Alcatel-Lucent, consistently driving adoption of transformative technologies (AI, Cloud, Mobile, Internet).
He holds a Master’s in AI Engineering (Valencia/Ghent) and completed specialized courses at MIT.

tracks.name: From clicks to bricks: Create an omnichannel shopping experience with Odoo
tracks.speaker_line: Claire Almiñana San Felix from Odoo
tracks.description_text:
What if your online store, your physical checkout, your warehouse, and every sales channel you operate could all speak the same language, in real time?
In this talk, we'll walk through how modern retail is no longer about choosing between online and offline, but about building a unified shopping experience where every touchpoint feeds every other. We'll explore how Odoo connects your eCommerce storefront, Point of Sale, Inventory, and other sales channels into a single, living system, where a sale made in-store instantly updates your online stock, a product listed on Google Shopping reflects your latest pricing, and your warehouse always knows what to prepare next.
No more data silos. No more manual syncs. No more "sorry, that item shows available online but we're actually out."
Whether you're a retailer taking your first steps into digital, or a digital-native brand opening your first physical location, this session will show you what it really takes to deliver a seamless customer experience

tracks.name: Implementing your own Payroll

tracks.description_text: In this technical talk, you will learn how the payroll engine works and how to implement your own payroll localization from scratch with an example.

tracks.name: What's new in HR?
tracks.speaker_line: David Fagneray & Rana Abdelsattar from Odoo
tracks.description_text: During this talk, all the new features of the HR scopes will be presented.

speakers.name: David Fagneray & Rana Abdelsattar
speakers.biography_text:
Rana
has been with Odoo since 2021, starting as a Quickstart Consultant in the Dubai office. In 2024, she transitioned to the headquarters in Belgium to join the Expertise Team as an HR Expert. With a strong background in implementing Odoo projects across various industries, she is dedicated to enhancing HR solutions and providing top-notch support tailored to clients' needs. Over the years at Odoo, Rana has continually expanded her expertise and insights in HR practices, becoming a trusted advisor to both colleagues and clients.

tracks.name: Reconciled: Bridging the gap between your POS and Finance
tracks.speaker_line: Victor Lambert from Odoo

speakers.name: Victor Lambert
