tracks.name: Success story from the association Groupement des Campeurs Universitaires (GCU) on the migration from Odoo version 12 to Odoo version 18: a project that now enables the association to manage its 88 campgrounds—run by its volunteer members throughout France—in a unified, shared environment
tracks.speaker_line: MARTINEZ Philippe & Noémie Keller, Vice Président & Director of Operations
tracks.description_text:
Operating a campsite depends on many factors, and this challenge takes on a special
significance for the GCU, which has 88 campsites located throughout France, run by volunteer members, and requiring a coordinated organizational structure while preserving the autonomy of each campsite.
This project, presented jointly by the GCU and Sodexis, is a testament to their collaborative efforts toward a shared goal: to upgrade the GCU’s information system to better meet its needs while preserving the unique characteristics of its nonprofit model.
As part of the migration from Odoo v12 to Odoo v18, one of the major challenges was to make the most of Odoo’s native features in order to align more closely with the standard, while reducing dependence on the numerous custom developments that had been implemented in the previous version. The goal was not to replicate the existing system exactly, but to rethink the processes to find the best balance between Odoo’s capabilities, business needs, and the specific operational requirements of the GCU.
Sodexis supported the GCU in this process overhaul to optimize the processes and integrate them into Odoo v18. However, some existing workflows were closely tied to the GCU’s association-based operations and the autonomy granted to volunteers in the day-to-day management of the campsites. The project therefore required in-depth consideration to balance standardization and automation with respect for this human-centered, decentralized model. The project made it possible to rebuild the GCU’s main business workflows—from member enrollment to the multi-site self-management of reservations for campsites and rental units—while implementing specific connectors with external partners, notably insurance services (Xplorassur) and French payment solutions such as ANCV – Chèques-Vacances Connect.
The challenge was twofold: to ensure maximum accounting transparency and to enable the GCU to be fully operational on Odoo in time for the start of the 2026 season. Goal achieved. Today, the GCU’s Odoo platform has recorded more than 8,300 confirmed stay reservations, 300 insurance purchase orders, 4,000 support tickets resolved through a system that distributes requests among different teams, and 30,500 invoices generated directly in Odoo, with only a limited number of special cases or anomalies.
This case study illustrates Odoo’s ability to support a complex organizational model, while demonstrating that a successful migration depends as much on technology as it does on a thorough understanding of the organization’s workflows, processes, and specific characteristics.

speakers.name: MARTINEZ Philippe & Noémie Keller
speakers.biography_text:
Former IT Manager in the scientific sector, Philippe Martinez spent more than 40 years supporting researchers by providing IT solutions tailored to their needs. He is currently a volunteer Vice President of the GCU, in charge of Information Technology, where he contributes to the association's digital strategy. Working alongside a project team made up of employees, board members, and Sodexis, he contributed to the deployment of Odoo within the GCU. He enjoys sharing practical experience and lessons learned from real-world Odoo implementations.
Noémie (Nemo) originally completed her bachelor of science in Biomedical Engineering at the Johns Hopkins University in the USA. After her studies, she pivoted into IT Consulting with Deloitte in Washington D.C., USA. In 2022, she founded the Sodexis Switzerland office in Geneva to lead the expansion of Sodexis services in Europe. She is passionate about using technology to solve the world’s most pressing problems and aid businesses. With 10 years of experience in IT consulting and a strong engineering background, she is uniquely qualified to help organizations translate their business workflows into Odoo and reimagine their business operations.

tracks.name: Let's set-up your online store !
tracks.speaker_line: Clément Watthez from Odoo
tracks.description_text:

In just 20 minutes, we'll cover the essentials to get you started: enabling the eCommerce module, configuring your product catalog (including variants, pricing, and inventory), customizing your website with the drag-and-drop page builder, setting up payment and shipping methods, and managing your first orders.

tracks.name: Odev meets AI : Automating Odoo development end-to-end
tracks.speaker_line: Sébastien Andreatta from Odoo
tracks.description_text:
odev is the CLI Odoo developers already reach for daily: it spins up a database on any Odoo version, manages worktrees and git branches per task, handles venvs and dependencies, runs the server, runs the tests, and generally removes the boilerplate around working with Odoo source. What it didn't do — until now — is write the code for you.
This talk shows how we plugged AI agents (Claude Code, Gemini CLI, Copilot, OpenCode) directly into that existing workflow. Instead of bolting AI on as a separate tool, odev uses the environment it already manages — the right Odoo version, the right worktree, a running database — as the context an AI agent needs to actually get work done: analyzing a task, scaffolding the module, running it, testing it, and iterating against real failures instead of hallucinated ones.
We'll do a live, end-to-end demo: starting from a bare task description, watch odev set up the dev environment and hand it off to an AI agent that scaffolds, runs, and tests a real Odoo module — then talk through what worked, what broke, and the design decisions behind wiring AI into a tool developers already trust for the unglamorous plumbing of Odoo development.

's day-to-day activity is to carry out Odoo project implementations. tracks.name: Synchronizing Odoo instances in Crisis Zones: a distributed architecture supporting Emergency's mission
tracks.speaker_line: Andrea Colangelo, CTO at Andrea Colangelo
tracks.description_text:
Emergency operates in war zones and low-resource settings where internet connectivity is unreliable or absent. Yet, they need a robust information system to manage hospitals and field clinics efficiently. In this talk, we will present how we designed and implemented a distributed architecture to synchronize multiple local Odoo instances with a central server, ensuring data consistency while respecting the operational constraints of Emergency’s field missions.
We will cover the key architectural choices we made to handle connectivity dropouts, conflict resolution, and secure data transfer, as well as the practical challenges faced while deploying and maintaining Odoo in environments with frequent power outages and network instability.
Beyond the humanitarian context, this distributed architecture has valuable applications wherever reliable connectivity cannot be guaranteed—such as in remote construction sites, maritime operations, or mobile field services—demonstrating how Odoo can ensure operational continuity even in the most challenging conditions.
****
N.B.: This is the same talk I was supposed to give at Odoo Experience 2025, but had to skip due to a health issue and never delivered. The version I would like to present this year includes some updates based on how the project has evolved over the last 10 months.
***

You need external apps for everything, even basic features require third-party apps.
Once you edit your Shopify website, it no longer receives theme updates. In Odoo, customizations are just snippets, and updates can still be forced.
You can't just add a new feature. On Shopify, that often means hosting your own backend somewhere else and integrating it externally, which requires a developer. In Odoo, almost everything you need is already integrated.
Shopify's checkout isn't customizable at all, and it isn't even part of your actual website.
Return management is a pain, handled entirely by unofficial third-party apps. Here I'll showcase our new return management feature as the counterpoint.
Shopify takes a percentage of your sales. We don't.

tracks.name: Beyond the Website Builder: Building Headless and Custom Interfaces on Odoo
tracks.speaker_line: Guillaume Roisin, CEO at Sigmagency SRL
tracks.description_text:
Summary
Most companies treat Odoo as a back-office and stop there. But Odoo is also the backend behind every interface your customers, partners and field teams actually touch custom portals, headless web and mobile apps, even offline-first tools for people working with no connection.
For years these architectures were expensive and reserved for ambitious projects. AI just changed the economics: the plumbing is cheap now, so far more projects can justify a custom front-end on top of Odoo. But the hard part didn't disappear it moved. The challenge is no longer can you build it, it's can you architect it so your data stays trustworthy.
In this talk we'll show what's possible beyond the standard Odoo website, when to go custom versus when to stay standard, and the architecture rules that keep one source of truth no matter how custom the interface gets with real examples in production.
Description
The standard Odoo website is excellent, and for most projects it should be the default. But some businesses need more than a theme can deliver: a customer portal with bespoke workflows, a native mobile app, a public platform at scale, or a tool their field teams can use with no internet at all.
The usual reflex is to bolt on a separate system and instantly recreate the data silos and manual reconciliation everyone is trying to escape. There's a better way: keep Odoo as the single source of truth for orders, inventory, accounting and CRM, and build the interface as a headless front-end that talks to Odoo as its backend. The result is a best-in-class user experience and full operational integration, you no longer have to choose.
What's new in 2026 is the economics. AI collapses the cost of the plumbing: the boilerplate, the API glue, the type generation from Odoo models, the sync scaffolding. Projects that weren't viable two years ago are viable today, and the market for custom interfaces is expanding fast. But that's also the trap: far more teams will now attempt these architectures without knowing where the landmines are. AI answers "can you build it." It does not answer "can you architect it so the data stays reliable." That judgment is the whole game.
In clear, practical terms, we'll cover:
The decision framework : how to tell whether a project belongs on the standard Odoo website or warrants a custom/headless interface, and the honest trade-offs in cost, time and maintainability. Standard should win more often than you'd think.
Odoo as a backend, not just a back-office : treating Odoo's data and business logic as the API core for any interface, so there's one source of truth no matter how custom the front-end gets.
Three faces of the custom front-end, one Odoo backend : the customer-facing product at scale (a headless platform serving 200k+ catalog items on Odoo), the partner/bespoke portal (custom React front-ends), and the hardest one: the offline-first field tool, where agents work with no connection, with sync and conflict resolution feeding everything straight back into Odoo.
The rules that keep it sane : where business logic must live (in Odoo, never in the front-end), how to handle auth, performance, offline sync and data integrity. The exact rules AI makes more critical, not less.
What this unlocks for your business : bespoke customer and partner experiences, mobile and field operations, and ambitious digital products, while every transaction still flows straight into Odoo.
By the end, you'll know what Odoo is truly capable of as the backbone of any digital product, when to stay standard and when to go custom and why, in the AI era, the value has shifted from writing the code to architecting it right.

speakers.name: Guillaume Roisin

tracks.name: Good website design: The hidden keys to turn visitors into customers
tracks.speaker_line: Samuel Buccheri from Odoo
tracks.description_text:
Design is more than aesthetics.
Every design choice influences how users perceive, trust, and interact with your product. In this session, we'll explore how thoughtful design reduces friction, improves user experience, and ultimately increases conversions. Because great design doesn't just look good it delivers results.

tracks.name: From Coders to Architects: Why Software Developers are More Crucial Than Ever in the AI Era
tracks.speaker_line: Maureen O'Hare, Partnerships Manager at 42 Belgium
tracks.description_text: As AI transforms the way software is built, many predict the decline of the software developer. The reality is the opposite. In this session, we'll explore why AI is elevating—not replacing—the role of developers, shifting them from writing code to designing systems, making architectural decisions, and solving increasingly complex problems. Drawing on industry trends and real-world examples, we'll discuss how the most valuable developers of the future will combine technical expertise with critical thinking, collaboration, and adaptability, and why investing in this new generation of tech talent is more important than ever.

tracks.name: Is Odoo really good for SEO?
tracks.speaker_line: Sylwia Siemieniuk from Odoo
tracks.description_text: This session provides an introduction to SEO (Search Engine Optimization), its key pillars, and the growing importance of GEO (Generative Engine Optimization) for AI-powered search experiences. We will review a practical checklist for optimizing a website, covering technical performance, site structure, content quality, and keyword strategy. The session also highlights important considerations when migrating a website to preserve rankings and traffic, and explains how to monitor results and track improvements over time to ensure continuous SEO growth.

tracks.name: Odoolingo: Learn Odoo and Languages at the Same Time!
tracks.speaker_line: Javier Colmeiro Aznar, Software Engineer in Customer Care at Braintec
tracks.description_text:
What happens when you mix a passion for Odoo with the addictive learning mechanics of Duolingo? You get Odoolingo—a gamified learning app built entirely using Odoo’s OWL framework and native backend translation engines.
This talk showcases a unique pet project, "vibecoded" during spare time, that turns Odoo's massive localization dataset into an interactive educational tool. Users can configure custom "courses" by selecting a source and target language. The app then dynamically scrapes and structures terms directly from native Odoo menu items, main forms, and views to generate real-time, short quizzes.
Key takeaways from this session include:
Creative Data Use: How to leverage Odoo’s native translation architecture (ir.translation) for non-traditional, gamified use cases.
OWL in Action: Building a highly reactive, state-driven, interactive UI entirely within the OWL framework.
Rapid Prototyping: Lessons learned from "vibecoding" a fully functional proof-of-concept from scratch.
Come see how this project was brought to life, explore the versatility of OWL for standalone mini-apps, and discover how to unlock the hidden potential of Odoo's internal terms!

speakers.name: Javier Colmeiro Aznar
speakers.biography_text:
Based in sun-soaked Valencia, Spain, Javier Colmeiro is a 39-year-old father of two and a passionate mountain sports enthusiast. With a BSc in Telecommunications Engineering, he brings over a decade of hands-on experience in Odoo software development to the table.
He is currently spending his fifth year as a software engineer in Customer Care at braintec, where he acts as first point of contact with customers to help them grow and resolve day to day issues. Known for his sharp problem-solving mindset and relentless curiosity, Javier thrives on debugging the weirdest issues and tackling the toughest tech challenges—always with a helping hand for others.

tracks.name: Building custom Website and E-commerce with Odoo and why you should too
tracks.speaker_line: Guillaume Roisin, CEO at Sigmagency SRL
tracks.description_text:
SUMMARY
Most agencies build websites and e-commerce platforms disconnected from business operations, forcing companies to manage data in silos.
In this talk, we will explain why using Odoo as the backbone for websites and e-commerce ecosystems is the best way to scale while reducing manual work and operational complexity. We will share what this shift means for your business and how it can transform your digital presence into a growth engine.
DESCRIPTION
Your website should do more than just look good. It should connect seamlessly with your operations, eliminate manual processes, and help your business scale.
Most companies use separate systems for their website, e-commerce, CRM, and accounting, forcing teams to re-enter orders, manage inventory manually, and reconcile data across platforms. This fragmentation creates inefficiencies, errors, and wasted resources that slow growth.
Using Odoo as the backbone for your website and e-commerce changes the game. In this talk, we will explain in clear business terms:
Why building websites and e-commerce on Odoo reduces friction between sales, finance, and operations while delivering a seamless customer experience.
How using Odoo allows us to design beautiful, high-converting websites without sacrificing the operational power and reporting you need to grow.
How this approach automates order management, invoicing, inventory, and customer communication directly from your website or e-commerce portal.
Why an Odoo-based architecture makes scaling your online business easier while reducing dependency on costly integrations.
How headless and advanced UI/UX strategies can still be applied while keeping Odoo as your operational core.
At Sigmagency, we experienced this first-hand. As a web agency, we built high-converting websites, but our clients struggled with fragmented tools. This led us to transition into a full-stack Odoo partner, helping SMEs connect their websites, e-commerce, and back-office processes into a single, scalable ecosystem.
Throughout this talk, we will share concrete examples of SMEs that have scaled their online services by building Odoo-powered websites connected directly to their CRM, accounting, and inventory. These examples will show how integrated ecosystems help companies sell more while working less, demonstrating the unique advantage of leveraging Odoo’s full potential.
By the end of this session, you will understand how Odoo can align your online sales channels with your operations, enabling your company to scale sustainably while improving customer satisfaction.

speakers.name: Guillaume Roisin
speakers.biography_text: Guillaume Roisin is the founder of Sigmagency, a digital transformation partner specializing in Odoo and advanced web development. With a background as a civil engineer in applied mathematics, Guillaume combines deep technical expertise with a human-centered approach to digital projects. He started building websites as a freelancer in university and quickly expanded after graduating into Odoo to offer integrated, scalable solutions for SMEs looking to modernize their operations. Passionate about problem-solving and process optimization, Guillaume helps companies connect their ERP, websites, and custom applications into unified ecosystems that drive growth, efficiency, and innovation.

As the business expanded sales and distribution into Europe, that fragility became a growth blocker: no real-time visibility between the production entity and the European sales office, no traceability from farmer intake to finished export pallet, and reporting cycles that took days to consolidate across entities and currencies.
As the implementing Odoo partner, Aspire Softserv consolidated the company's farm-to-export chain onto Odoo: a multi-company architecture connecting the production and European sales entities, Manufacturing with full batch traceability and HACCP-aligned quality checkpoints, Inventory with cold-storage zone tracking, and Accounting handling multi-currency and VAT consolidation. Cross-entity financial reporting dropped from couple of days to few minutes, and the business gained full yield and waste visibility for the first time.

His focus is on complex, ERP architecture spanning different currencies, tax regimes, and regulatory environments—and on pairing traditional ERP with AI/ML to extend what these systems can do. He continues to lead Aspire's strategic direction on cross-border ERP projects and its broader European market expansion.

tracks.name: Vivre sa passion avant de la penser : comment on devient entrepreneur sans l’avoir décidé ?

tracks.name: Automated Data Exports and External Integrations
tracks.speaker_line: CRETU Victor, Business Analyst at Sodexis SAS
tracks.description_text:
For Map Space Coating, data fluidity between enterprise systems and external tools is crucial for effective project management. However, the daily routine of manually filtering, exporting, and distributing data files from their ERP was tedious and prone to delays. By implementing a tailored Automated Export solution within Odoo, Map Space Coating streamlined their data extraction process.
The Challenge: Friction in Data Portability
Before standardizing their automated export process, Map Space Coating faced several operational roadblocks:
- Manual Export Fatigue: Team members had to log into Odoo daily, navigate to specific modules, apply complex filters, and manually download files.
- External Tool Bottlenecks: Project managers heavily rely on specialized external tools for advanced analysis and planning. Delays in manually exporting data from Odoo meant delays in updating these crucial external systems.
- Inconsistent Data Retrieval: Depending on who was performing the export, different filters might be accidentally applied, leading to inconsistent datasets being shared with project managers.
The Odoo Solution
To eliminate these inefficiencies, a robust, scheduled export automation was developed within Odoo. The solution was designed to act as a reliable bridge between Odoo and external tools.
1. Advanced & Flexible Filtering
- Dynamic Filter Application: The automated export engine is programmed to respect and utilize Odoo's standard, by-default filters.
- "Favorites" Integration: More importantly, the system can seamlessly draw from "Favorite" (custom-saved) filters created by users. This means project managers can define their exact data requirements once via the Odoo UI, save it as a favorite, and the automated system will apply that precise logic to all future exports.
2. Daily Automated Scheduling
To ensure data is always fresh and ready for external tools, the manual click-to-export process was completely bypassed.
- Scheduled Actions (Cron Jobs): Odoo was configured with automated scheduled actions that trigger on a daily basis.
- Zero-Touch Generation: Without any human intervention, the system runs the pre-defined queries, compiles the data, and generates the necessary export files (e.g., CSV or Excel) formatted perfectly for Map Space Coating's external tools.
3. Direct Delivery to Project Managers
Generating the file automatically is only half the solution; delivering it is the other.
- Automated Routing: Once the daily file is generated, the Odoo solution automatically drafts an email and attaches the exported file.
- Targeted Communication: The email is instantly dispatched to the specific Project Manager overseeing that data set. When the PM starts their workday, the exact data they need to import into their external tools is already waiting in their inbox.
Key Benefits and Results
The implementation of this automated export feature delivered immediate value to Map Space Coating's daily operations:
- Significant Time Savings: Administrative staff and project managers no longer waste time on repetitive manual data extraction, freeing them up for higher-value tasks.
- Guaranteed Data Consistency: By relying on saved "favorite" filters, the exported data structure remains 100% consistent every single day, preventing errors during external tool imports.
- Seamless External Integration: Project managers now have a frictionless workflow. The daily delivery of precise data files ensures their external project management and analysis tools are always up-to-date.
Conclusion
By automating the file export process in Odoo, Map Space Coating has successfully broken down data silos between their ERP and external tools. This automated, daily routine ensures that project managers are consistently equipped with the accurate, up-to-date information they need, saving time and significantly boosting overall operational efficiency.

speakers.name: CRETU Victor
speakers.biography_text: Victor CRETU est business analyste et travaille chez Sodexis depuis 2 ans. Il a une expérience de 6 ans à l'utilisation de Odoo. Il a accompagné beaucoup d'entreprises de différentes tailles dans leur implémentation de Odoo.

tracks.name: Streamlining Freight Management and LTL Logistics with the Sodexis FreightView Connector for Odoo v19!
tracks.speaker_line: Suganthi Karunanithi, Director Of Development at Sodexis, Inc.
tracks.description_text:
Are you frustrated with logging into multiple carrier portals, balancing scattered spreadsheets, and manually requesting individual quotes just to manage your freight and Less-Than-Truckload (LTL) shipments? Would you prefer a unified logistics environment where you can compare real-time negotiated rates, book carriers, and track bulk shipments seamlessly from your ERP?
Enter the ultimate freight consolidation platform! Managing multi-carrier freight workflows requires centralized visibility and speed. By leveraging Sodexis' specialized FreightView Shipping Connector available on the Odoo Apps Store, businesses can eliminate administrative friction entirely. With a single click from an Odoo Delivery Order, the app securely transmits package weight, classification, and volume to FreightView—instantly returning your live spot quotes, API contract rates, and LTL options into a clear, comparative list directly inside your backend.
Over the past several years, this powerful integration has transformed shipping architectures for heavy-freight and multi-company distributors. Warehouse teams can compare competing carrier costs side-by-side, instantly tender shipments, generate compliant freight labels, and schedule carrier pickups without leaving Odoo. Once booked, tracking codes, shipment numbers, and final logistics costs automatically sync back to the delivery record—facilitating accurate landed cost calculations and frictionless vendor bill reconciliation. Thousands of operational hours have been saved, giving organizations full command over their supply chain profitability.
Sodexis has been a dedicated, full-service Odoo Implementation Partner since 2012, continuously innovating its development and optimization strategies to maximize customer ROI and user experience. With extensive expertise gained over 175+ successful projects and hundreds of custom applications, Sodexis developed the FreightView Connector to seamlessly extend Odoo Enterprise environments into robust, enterprise-grade freight management systems.
Join this session to discover how the Sodexis FreightView Shipping app can eliminate your freight bottlenecks, automate complex carrier quoting, and supercharge your LTL logistics engine—and how partnering with Odoo & Sodexis plays a key role in achieving your digital transformation goals.

tracks.name: Your ERP Has Data. But Not Intelligence.
tracks.speaker_line: Carlos Vazquez, CTO at INDIGO

Yet, months after implementation, leadership teams still rely on Excel exports, manual reports, disconnected dashboards, and lengthy meetings to understand what is happening in the business.

Through a live demonstration, attendees will discover how to connect sales, finance, inventory, projects, and operations into a unified decision-making environment using Odoo Spreadsheet, real-time dashboards, automation, and AI-powered insights.
Rather than focusing on reports, this talk focuses on business decisions. Participants will learn practical techniques to design executive dashboards that people actually use, identify the KPIs that matter most, and reduce dependence on spreadsheets by leveraging Odoo’s native capabilities.
The session also demonstrates how AI can enhance business visibility by identifying trends, highlighting operational risks, detecting anomalies, and helping executives make faster and better-informed decisions.
Whether you are an Odoo partner, consultant, or business leader, this presentation will provide practical ideas to help organizations move beyond simply collecting data and start turning it into operational intelligence that creates measurable business value.

Across these implementations, the approach has cut quoting time by roughly half and reduced configuration errors by up to 90% by removing manual rework.
With our live demonstration, attendees will learn how to:
- Configure complex products with dynamic pricing rules
- Handle complex scenarios with custom dimensions using Parametric Configuration
- Automate proposal generation and streamline approval workflows

speakers.biography_text:
Anissa Ratkovic
Outbound Business Developer at Odoo & Public Sector Digital Expert
Anissa brings a unique expertise to presente our talk about the Car Community Module.
Public Care & Social Sector Expert: Before mastering the Odoo ecosystem, Anissa managed major legislative and administrative digital platforms for Belgian public social services centers and nursing homes. This role gave her an intimate understanding of the strict operational day to day,  financial, and regulatory frameworks that local authorities and social care institutions navigate daily.
Odoo Functional Specialist: Today, as an Outbound Business Developer at Odoo, she translates complex business requirements into high-performing ERP realities. From standardizing financials to optimizing workflows.
Why listen to her session? In this presentation, she will introduce the
Industrie Care Community
module, actionable insights on how to digitalize complex social structures, master compliance, and seamlessly deploy Odoo SaaS solutions within the public and social care sectors.

tracks.name: From local complexity to global visibility: How Odoo helps international companies scale in Japan
tracks.speaker_line: Eri Nikaido & Stanislav Belooussov from Odoo
tracks.description_text:
Description:
While Japan offers immense business potential, breaking into the market presents distinct digital transformation challenges for global enterprises. Success requires harmonizing international ERP standards with Japan’s unique legal, linguistic, accounting, and logistics workflows. Through three successful Odoo implementation cases—Hachette Collections Japan, METER Japan, and Midokura Japan—this session showcases the critical role Odoo takes in bridging localized Japanese operations and global corporate management.

speakers.name: Eri Nikaido & Stanislav Belooussov
speakers.biography_text:
Eri Nikaido
, Team Leader Japan at Odoo Hong Kong
As the Indirect Team Leader, Eri spearheads Odoo’s expansion into Japan through building a robust local partner network. In 2026, Eri led a 150% increase in Odoo subscriptions in Japan. Passionate and goal-driven, she offers deep insights into pushing digital transformation with a unique localized perspective regarding Japan's distinct business culture. Drawing on 4 years of market experience, Eri offers a rare blend of global operational insight and local cultural fluency—helping Japanese businesses modernize their operations using international best practices tailored to their distinct needs.
Stanislav Belooussov,
Director of PortCities Japan K.K & Director of the Belgium Chamber of Commerce in Japan (BLCCJ)
Stanislav Belooussov is a digital transformation leader with 10 years of experience helping companies modernize their operations across Asia. As a Director at PortCities, he has supported businesses and managed teams across Japan, Indonesia, Malaysia, and Singapore, guiding organizations through ERP implementation, process optimization, and regional expansion.
He also serves on the Board of Directors of the Belgian-Luxembourg Chamber of Commerce in Japan (BLCCJ), where he contributes to strengthening business relations between Japan and the international community. Through his work, Stanislav helps foreign companies understand the Japanese market, navigate its business environment, and successfully establish and grow their operations in Japan.

tracks.name: LIMS in Odoo V20: New Features & Roadmap Preview
tracks.speaker_line: Camille Duchayne & Vincent Laurent, Project manager (Camille) & Managing Partner (Vincent) at Dynapps
tracks.description_text: Laboratories and quality-driven organizations face increasing pressure to digitize and standardize their processes. The Dynapps LIMS module, built natively on Odoo, answers this need by centralizing sample management, test results, and compliance workflows in a single platform. This session walks through the new features introduced in V20 and offers a first look at the upcoming roadmap, giving attendees a clear view of where the product is heading.

speakers.name: Camille Duchayne & Vincent Laurent
speakers.biography_text:
Camille
:  Project Manager at Dynapps since September 2025. Before joining Dynapps, I spent 8 years in the pharmaceutical industry working in quality control departments, giving me a strong understanding of the regulatory and laboratory requirements that LIMS implementations address.
Vincent
: Managing Partner at Dynapps and the creator of the Dynapps LIMS module. As LIMS designer and architect, he drives the product architecture and quality framework. He is also a certified ISO/IEC 17025 auditor, bringing both technical depth and regulatory expertise to every LIMS implementation.

tracks.name: How to rock your construction business with Odoo
tracks.speaker_line: Pablo Miravete, Business Analyst at Odoo
tracks.description_text:
As construction projects scale from simple builds to multi-story developments, flat spreadsheets and basic job management apps quickly fall apart. Coordinating complex project phases, managing unpredictable supplier pricing, and dealing with chaotic site logistics can easily wipe out a general contractor's margins before they even notice.
Building on the success of
Construction Builder
industry, this session introduces
Construction Developer
one, engineered for businesses tackling larger and more complex projects. We’ll skip the basic workflows and focus directly on solving your biggest operational headaches: quoting efficiently with the most up-to-date supplier prices, orchestrating heavy multi-vendor procurement, tracking inventory straight to the active job site, and protecting project profitability from unbilled change orders.
Come see how Odoo helps bridge the gap between your estimation desk and the field, giving your teams a clearer, unified view of logistics and costs throughout the project lifecycle.

speakers.name: Pablo Miravete
speakers.biography_text: Pablo embarked on his journey at Odoo three years ago as a Business Analyst. He has led different 360º implementation projects while simultaneously participating in R&D tasks to contribute directly to the Odoo Community.

tracks.name: CSS best practices to develop Odoo smoothly
tracks.speaker_line: Stefano Rigano (sri) from Odoo

tracks.name: Speed up your reporting with Paper-Muncher: A practical guide
tracks.speaker_line: Clémence Van Bossuyt from Odoo
tracks.description_text:
Following up on last year's architecture deep dive, this talk focuses on adoption: when to use Paper Muncher (currently in beta) over wkhtmltopdf, and how to enable it: for standard reports, accounting reports, or globally for testing.
We'll walk through a live performance comparison, share best practices for designing reports with Paper Muncher in mind, and highlight a few lesser-known features. We'll close with how to report issues as the tool matures.
Aimed at developers and implementers looking for a practical guide to making the switch.

tracks.name: Boost your website with marketing automation: emails & promotions
tracks.speaker_line: Alicia Pecheur, Business Analyst at Odoo
tracks.description_text:
Driving traffic to your website is one thing, converting visitors into customers is another. How do you transform simple interest into a purchase, 100% automatically?
Join this live demo to discover how to seamlessly orchestrate your Website & eCommerce apps with Marketing Automation and Discounts & Loyalty programs. From the initial engagement of your visitors to sending ultra-targeted coupons based on their behavior, learn how to set up a powerful conversion machine in just a few clicks.

tracks.name: Ticket Sales Done Right: A Practical Guide to Managing Events with Odoo
tracks.speaker_line: Vadim Rau, Senior Business Analyst at Sodexis Austria
tracks.description_text:
Organizing an event—whether it's an exclusive corporate seminar, a large-scale expo, or a community meetup—can quickly turn into a logistical headache if your ticketing, marketing, and on-site check-in systems are disconnected.
This talk provides a practical, step-by-step guide to unifying your entire event management process using the Odoo Events app. We will explore how to launch a fully functional, branded event website in minutes, enabling seamless online self-registration for your attendees.
Beyond just selling tickets, this session covers the complete attendee lifecycle. You will learn how to enforce venue capacity limits, automatically dispatch digital tickets, and set up automated pre-event reminders to reduce no-shows. Furthermore, we will demonstrate how to easily integrate sponsors into your event pages to give them the visibility they deserve, culminating in a live look at how to run a frictionless, professional on-site registration desk using Odoo's built-in QR code scanning.
Key Highlights
- Rapid Event Website Creation: Learn how to spin up an engaging, customized event landing page in minutes and easily send out invitations to your target audience.
- Seamless Self-Registration & Ticketing: See how to enable attendees to register online, select their ticket tiers, and automatically receive their digital tickets via email.
- Capacity & Attendee Management: Discover how to effectively manage your guest list and strictly enforce maximum attendee limits to prevent overbooking.
- Maximizing Sponsor Visibility: Explore native Event App tool to prominently feature and manage event sponsors, adding value to your partnerships directly on the event page.
- Automated Communication: Learn how to configure and trigger automatic email or SMS reminders leading up to the event to keep your attendees engaged and reduce no-shows.
- Frictionless On-Site Check-In: Watch a demonstration of how to speed up the door queues by registering attendees on-site using quick and reliable QR code scanning from their digital tickets.

speakers.name: Vadim Rau
speakers.biography_text:
Vadim Rau has a master’s degree in Supply Chain Management plus a rich 7-year tenure at Lufthansa Cargo Group, specializing in air freight and emergency logistics. Transitioning to the bicycle industry for nearly a decade, he honed his expertise in process and operations management. Since 2017, he’s adeptly worked with Odoo to enhance supply chain efficiencies, showcasing his ability to innovate across varied sectors. In the beginning of 2024, Vadim joined Sodexis, bringing his vast experience to support customers in the German-speaking market.
Since 2012, Sodexis has been a full-service Odoo Implementation Partner, with a Consulting and Development team focused on maximizing customers’ ROI and user experience.

tracks.name: Stop guessing who's in: Smart Leave & Attendance management
tracks.speaker_line: Nina Mildner, Business analyst - HR expertise at Odoo
tracks.description_text:
Other name of the talk: [HR] Streamlining Time Off & Leave Management
Demonstration of Time Off, the easiness to use the new gantt view, changes of ux, easy to take a day off and to see the balance.

tracks.name: How ENGIE Vianeo Runs EV Billing on Odoo
tracks.speaker_line: Vincent Vandenberge, Head of Digital at Engie
tracks.description_text:
ENGIE Vianeo runs its entire EV billing infrastructure on Odoo — from raw charging session data to compliant invoices, delivered in 16 weeks.
This session covers how ENGIE Vianeo and VS Digital built a production-ready billing engine on Odoo Enterprise: CDR ingestion, rule-based pricing (flat, kWh, time-based, hybrid), B2C and B2B invoicing, subscription management, pre-payment reconciliation, and SAP export.
Key takeaways: how to use Odoo as a financial sub-ledger for high-volume transactional data, how to integrate Salesforce, a mobile app, Okta SSO, and SAP in a single delivery, and how to make a fixed-price contract viable on a project of this complexity.

speakers.name: Vincent Vandenberge
speakers.biography_text: Vincent Vandenberge is Digital and IT Officer at ENGIE Vianeo, where he leads the digitalization of the company's electric vehicle charging operations. With over ten years at ENGIE, he previously headed Livin', ENGIE Digital's Smart City platform, and worked as a Manager at ENGIE Consulting. Vincent brings a rare combination of technical depth and business acumen to large-scale digital transformation programs, having overseen the end-to-end deployment of Odoo as ENGIE Vianeo's core billing and pricing infrastructure.

tracks.name: Ultra-endurance: What it inspires in entrepreneurs
tracks.speaker_line: Mathieu Blanchard
tracks.description_text: Through his journey as a professional ultra-trail runner and adventurer, Mathieu will share the lessons learned from the world’s most demanding environments. Moving beyond athletic performance, this keynote explores universal themes such as setting ambitious goals, resilience in the face of uncertainty, redefining failure, the power of finding your "why," and building sustainable performance. It is an invitation to discover how the lessons of high-level sport and adventure can fuel reflection and inspire entrepreneurs in their own challenges.

tracks.name: From NetSuite to Odoo: A CEO’s Journey to Simpler, Smarter ERP Adoption
tracks.speaker_line: Dr. Wong Kee Wei, Founder & Group CEO at Safety Ware
tracks.description_text:
In this customer success story, Dr. Wong Kee Wei, Founder and Group CEO of Safetyware Group, will share a practical CEO-level perspective on moving from Oracle NetSuite to Odoo. Safetyware Group is a Malaysian PPE and safety solutions company that grew from an SME into a public-listed group with manufacturing, trading, training, and technology-related operations.
As the company scaled, the team needed an ERP platform that could support better process discipline without becoming too costly, complex, or difficult for users to adopt. This session explains why Safetyware decided to migrate to Odoo, what the team learned during implementation, and how Odoo helped streamline daily operations, improve process visibility, reduce software-related costs, and gain stronger acceptance from employees due to its more intuitive interface and lower learning curve.
The talk will focus on lessons that business owners, CFOs, COOs, IT managers, and transformation leaders can apply when evaluating ERP options. Key takeaways include how to assess ERP fit beyond features, how to win user buy-in, how to manage migration risk, and why SMEs should treat ERP implementation as a business transformation project rather than a software project.
The audience will leave with a realistic reference point from an Asian growth company that has experienced both enterprise ERP and Odoo in real operations.

speakers.name: Dr. Wong Kee Wei
speakers.biography_text: Dr. Wong Kee Wei is the Founder and Group CEO of Safetyware Group, a Malaysian integrated safety solutions provider listed on Bursa Malaysia. Since founding the company in 2003, he has grown Safetyware from a small start-up into a regional group with manufacturing, trading, training, and technology-driven operations. He also leads Keyway Digital Labs, focusing on Odoo ERP, AI, and AIoT solutions for SMEs. Kee Wei is passionate about practical digital transformation, operational excellence, and helping SMEs scale through better systems and processes.

tracks.name: Automating Late Payment Fees with Odoo
tracks.speaker_line: Douae Amzir from Sodexis
tracks.description_text:
Title
Learn how to automate finance charges and late payment fees in Odoo to improve cash flow and reduce manual follow-up.
Description
Late payments are a common challenge for businesses of all sizes, impacting cash flow and increasing the administrative burden on accounting teams. Calculating and applying penalties manually is often time-consuming and prone to errors.
In this session, we will explore how the Finance Charge module enables organizations to automatically apply late payment fees to overdue invoices while maintaining transparency and consistency with customers.
Attendees will discover how to:
Configure finance charge rules and policies.
Define grace periods and penalty percentages.
Automatically generate finance charges on overdue invoices.
Notify customers and maintain clear communication.
Integrate finance charges seamlessly with Odoo Accounting.
Handle disputes and exceptional cases.
Improve collections and reduce Days Sales Outstanding (DSO).
Adapt the solution to different legal and business requirements.
Through practical examples and a live demonstration, we will show how Odoo can help businesses automate accounts receivable processes and encourage timely payments without increasing administrative overhead.
Whether you are an accountant, financial manager, consultant, or Odoo implementer, this session will provide practical guidance for building a more efficient and proactive credit management process.
Categories
Type: Customization
Edition: Entreprise
Form: Talk
Version: 19
Modules: Accounting, invoicing,
Describe briefly the démo if any:
The live demonstration will showcase:
Configuring finance charge policies.
Defining grace periods and charge percentages.
Creating customer invoices.
Simulating overdue payments.
Automatically generating finance charge invoices.
Managing exceptional cases and waiving charges when necessary.
Measuring the impact on the collection process and cash flow.

tracks.name: How Odoo solved a complex technical landscape of more than 7 tools and a wholesale webshop leading to a doubling in revenue for Sempertex
tracks.speaker_line: Brett Eerdekens, Managing Partner at dear digital
tracks.description_text: Discover how Sempertex replaced a fragmented landscape of more than seven disconnected tools and a custom webshop with one integrated Odoo platform. Learn how streamlined processes, connected data, and end-to-end automation helped double revenue while creating a scalable foundation for future growth.

speakers.name: Brett Eerdekens
speakers.biography_text: Brett is Managing Partner at dear digital, where he helps wholesale and manufacturing companies streamline their processes through ERP and digital transformation. With hands-on experience in complex implementations and migrations, he focuses on turning business processes into scalable, efficient systems.

tracks.name: From two weeks to infinity: Redesigning working schedules
tracks.speaker_line: Ziri Raha Ibnou-Cheikh & Mathias Lebel from Odoo
tracks.description_text: This presentation explores how we rebuilt working schedules in Odoo, moving from a rigid weekly pattern to recurring, date-based shifts. We'll go through a live demo of the new calendar and see how it simplifies payroll and time off workflows, plus what it took to keep overlapping recurrent shifts in check.

tracks.name: Ask Me Anything (AMA) - Fabien Pinckaers
tracks.speaker_line: Fabien Pinckaers from Odoo

tracks.name: Empowering Customers and Employees with Odoo eLearning
tracks.speaker_line: Douae Amzir from Sodexis
tracks.description_text:
Title
Discover how to build a complete learning platform in Odoo to train employees and customers by creating courses, managing access, and delivering engaging content.
Description
This talk demonstrates how Odoo's eLearning module can become a centralized platform for teaching and learning, enabling companies to create professional training programs for employees, partners, and customers.
Attendees will learn how to transform knowledge into structured courses and deliver training in a scalable and user-friendly way.
During this session, we will cover:
An overview of the Odoo eLearning module and its capabilities.
Creating and organizing courses into sections and lessons.
Uploading various types of content, including videos, documents, presentations, and quizzes.
Managing visibility and access rights for internal employees, portal users, and customers.
Publishing courses and controlling who can enroll.
Tracking learner progress and course completion.
Using certifications and quizzes to assess knowledge.
Best practices for onboarding new employees and educating customers.
By the end of the session, attendees will understand how to leverage Odoo eLearning to reduce training costs, improve knowledge sharing, and provide a better experience for both employees and customers.
Describe briefly the démo if any: A live demonstration will show:
Creating a new eLearning course.
Organizing content into sections and lessons.
Uploading videos, documents, and presentations.
Creating quizzes and certifications.
Configuring access rights for employees and customers.
Publishing courses on the website.
Enrolling users and tracking their progress.

tracks.name: From kitchen to delivery: Set up your restaurant and sell online with Odoo 20
tracks.speaker_line: Carlos Valverde & Lucas Van Uytvinck from Odoo
tracks.description_text: This talk explores a practical, small-scale implementation of an online reservation system integrated into a restaurant workflow. The goal is to show how digital tools can streamline the entire customer journey, from kitchen operations to delivery and reservation management.

tracks.name: Talent development & skills management: Elevate your workforce
tracks.speaker_line: Charlotte Trigaux from Odoo

tracks.name: How Odoo Spreadsheets kill your need for customization
tracks.speaker_line: Gert-Jan Ras, Business Analyst at dear digital
tracks.description_text:
Every customization request starts the same way: "Odoo can't do exactly what we need." Often it can, without a line of code. This talk works through real cases where Odoo Spreadsheets replaced custom development: calculating min and max stock levels automatically from sales data, running dynamic quality checks, and building price calculations that update themselves. We show how each one was built, what it would have cost as custom code, and where the spreadsheet approach has its limits. You leave able to tell, in your own projects, when to reach for a spreadsheet instead of a developer. Less custom work, less maintenance, more control.
This presentation is aimed at functional consultants, Odoo admins, and the power users who maintain Odoo in-house.
Key takeaways:
Concrete cases where Odoo Spreadsheets replace custom development
How to build min/max stock, quality checks, and dynamic pricing without code
Where the spreadsheet approach ends and real customization begins

speakers.name: Gert-Jan Ras
speakers.biography_text: Gert-Jan Ras is a Business Analyst at dear digital. His real expertise is Odoo for wholesale and production companies, translating the way a business actually works into a setup that fits it.

tracks.name: A Safe Blueprint to Migrate your SaaS Billing to Odoo
tracks.speaker_line: Tomás Van Loock, ERP Consultant at much. Consulting
tracks.description_text:
Fast-scaling B2B SaaS platforms often face a critical dilemma: their external subscription billing engine operates separately from their financial backbone, forcing accounting teams to manually reconcile thousands of fragmented transactions. If the business now reorganises internal processes, moving all at once to a new ERP system is risky. In that situation, consultants need to find a way to link the existing and new systems without disrupting everyday work.
Instead of forcing a high-risk immediate transition, we designed a phased integration strategy anchored directly in Odoo Accounting. y configuring a controlled, on-demand synchronization workflow via API, we bypassed the unpredictability of real-time webhooks, giving the finance team absolute control to pull, construct, and fully reconcile multi-currency invoices, payments, and credit notes securely within Odoo's standard accounting models.
This strategic phase-one deployment eliminated manual cross-system data entry entirely, guaranteeing absolute financial accuracy across the organization. As a direct result, the automated workflow instantly reduced the monthly financial close from 15 days down to 5, buying the client the operational stability required to systematically plan their eventual phase-two migration into native Odoo Subscriptions.
Key Points of this Talk:
- Executing a phased integration strategy to stabilize operations during internal organizational flux.
- Unifying external subscription billing data directly with Odoo Enterprise Accounting models.
- Automating multi-currency invoice creation and payment reconciliation to eliminate manual entry.
- Bypassing complex real-time webhooks in favor of highly controlled, on-demand financial synchronizations.
- Securing absolute accounting veridicality across disconnected systems before a full ERP migration.
- Reducing the financial close from 15 days to 5 days on the first execution.
Key Learnings:
- How to evaluate a phased custom integration strategy vs. an immediate full platform migration.
- How to map external subscription lifecycle states to standard Odoo Enterprise financial workflows.
- How to mitigate project risk by delivering immediate operational ROI before proposing system-wide migrations.
- How to give finance teams control over data synchronizations without relying on volatile push notifications.
- How to utilize temporary external connectors as a strategic stepping stone toward Odoo Subscriptions.
Target Audience:
Functional Consultants, Project Managers, and Finance Directors.

speakers.name: Tomás Van Loock
speakers.biography_text: Tomás Van Loock is an AI & BI ERP Consultant at much. Consulting. Combining a background in Data Science and Management, he approaches Odoo Enterprise as a unified ecosystem rather than a collection of siloed applications. His implementation portfolio spans Manufacturing, Field Service, and eCommerce architectures. This broad horizontal system expertise allows him to bypass module constraints and map intricate business requirements into natively integrated Odoo frameworks.

tracks.name: Beyond e-commerce: Sell experiences with Odoo Events & Appointments
tracks.speaker_line: Alice Vreven from Odoo
tracks.description_text:
Tired of double-bookings, manual scheduling, and disconnected calendars? Now is the time to master online bookings in Odoo! It will not only make the booking process more convenient for your customers, but also bring ultimate efficiency to your operations.
Through an end-to-end use case, we will follow a complete flow: booking an appointment, reserving a resource, and registering for the next crazy event. You’ll get a full overview of both the front-end seamless customer experience and the back-end setup.

tracks.name: From donations to memberships: Running a non-profit with Odoo Website
tracks.speaker_line: Camille Deceuninck from Odoo
tracks.description_text:
Are you part of a non-profit organization working with a limited budget? Do you want to efficiently manage your operations through your website while making it easy to collect donations and membership fees?
Join this webinar to discover how Odoo can support non-profits with powerful yet often overlooked features designed to simplify administration, improve fundraising, and streamline member management.
We’ll walk you through practical use cases and show you how to get the most out of Odoo for your organization.

speakers.name: Camille Deceuninck
speakers.biography_text: Camille has been a Business Analyst at Odoo for over three years, helping SMEs across Europe implement Odoo and accelerate their digital transformation. After specializing in Website and eCommerce projects, she developed a strong interest in digital customer journeys and online business optimization. Today, she leads the development of Odoo’s Appointment and Events applications, helping customers design effective booking and scheduling solutions that maximize the platform’s value.

tracks.name: Perfecting the custom fit: ETO best practices for Inventory & Projects with Manufacturing
tracks.speaker_line: Mirko Ancellotti, Business Analyst and MRP Expert at Odoo
tracks.description_text: In the fast-paced MRP world, efficient prototyping has become essential for companies looking to innovate quickly without disrupting standard production. This session breaks down how to master the complex Engineer-to-Order (ETO) workflow, featuring a first look at our new feature that completely eliminates double-entry in analytic accounting. You will walk away with best practices for managing project-specific inventory locations and leveraging advanced project reports to ensure total profitability and operational visibility.

speakers.name: Mirko Ancellotti
speakers.biography_text: Hi, I’m Mirko Ancellotti (no relation to Carlo!). I’m an Italian expat who has spent a significant portion of my life living and working overseas in France and Australia. Growing up on a dairy farm and later running a printing facility in Melbourne instilled in me a deep appreciation for the tangible side of production—which is exactly why I love the hands-on nature of MRP. When I'm not looking at production workflows, you'll find me watching football or in the kitchen, experimenting with global cooking techniques and discovering new culinary habits.

tracks.name: Speech-to-text transcription of live and phone and video calls
tracks.speaker_line: Andrzej Pietrusiak (pian), Software developer at Odoo

tracks.name: What the Odoo Community Association(OCA) can do for you
tracks.speaker_line: Julie LeBrun, Executive Director / Content Creator & Training Manager at OCA
tracks.description_text:
Discover the Odoo Community Association (OCA) and what it can do for you.
The Odoo Community Association (OCA) is a non-profit organization based in Switzerland forming a community for mutual support around the Odoo software providing thousands of Odoo modules under open source licenses and open upgrades.
Audience: Odoo developers, Odoo consultants, Odoo Customers, CEO, Project Manager, Techies, Functionals...

speakers.name: Julie LeBrun
speakers.function: Executive Director / Content Creator & Training Manager
speakers.biography_text: Julie LeBrun has been working as an Odoo Functional Consultant for 7 years, she is now the Executive Director, Content Creator and Training Manager at the OCA. Her love and passion for Odoo, Open source solutions and Training has made her a great OCA asset.

tracks.speaker_line: Nicolas Martinelli (nim) from Odoo

tracks.name: Odoo Has Eyes: Connecting Smart Cameras and Sensors to Your ERP
tracks.speaker_line: Alexander De Waele, Managing Partner at Konu BV
tracks.description_text:
Odoo is already a powerful platform for managing sales, inventory, accounting, POS, manufacturing and many other business processes. But in many companies, valuable operational data is still captured outside Odoo: by cameras, sensors, machines, counters or other external devices.
In this talk, we present Komeet, a project developed at Konu to connect intelligent cameras and external sensors with Odoo. The use case we will focus on is automatic visitor counting in a retail context. Instead of relying on manual estimates or separate analytics tools, a smart camera counts the number of visitors entering a store and sends that information to Odoo.
Using practical examples, we will show how this kind of integration can create value: combining visitor data with POS results, measuring conversion rates, improving staffing decisions, following up store performance or exploring similar use cases in logistics, manufacturing and service environments. The session is meant to inspire Odoo partners, developers and business users to think of Odoo as a platform connected to the physical world.

speakers.name: Alexander De Waele
speakers.biography_text:
Alexander De Waele has a Masters degree in electromechanics specialized in automation, with more than fifteen years of experience in operational management and technical management roles at several large companies.
He is now managing partner and co-owner of Konu, a Belgian Odoo partner focused on pragmatic ERP implementations for medium-sized and large companies, as well as ambitious startups and scale-ups that want to grow quickly and innovate.
His background in engineering and operational management gives him a practical view on ERP projects: not only how systems should be configured, but how they need to work in real daily operations. He is especially interested in using Odoo as a platform that connects business processes with external systems, hardware, operational data and real-world events.

tracks.name: Miniox & Odoo: One platform, 70,000 products, zero friction
tracks.speaker_line: François Tinel & Astrid Gerling, CEO & Business Analyst at Acsone
tracks.description_text:
Discover how Miniox, a Belgium leading expert in home decor and renovation, has used Odoo since January 2026 for its B2B and B2C operations. From multi-site showroom logistics and dynamic pricing to tracking real margins, dive into a concrete Odoo implementation.
In this real-world case study, we will show you:
- The Sales & POS Hybrid Flow: How to switch from the Point of Sale module with more than 70 000 products to the Sales module in just a few clicks.
- Pricing & Discounts: Mastering complex pricelists and discounts directly within the POS.
- Smart Showroom Logistics: Utilizing Odoo’s inventory routes to smoothly transfer stock between different showrooms and warehouses.
- Handling the Unexpected : Managing the sale of non-standard or custom items that automatically trigger Make-to-Order (MTO) procurement streams.
- Real-time Profitability: Generating bulletproof margin reports based directly on vendor invoice lines, providing the management team with perfect financial visibility.

speakers.name: François Tinel & Astrid Gerling
speakers.biography_text: Sera fournie dès confirmation du talk.

tracks.name: The Red Lions spirit: a winning culture and high team performance
tracks.speaker_line: Cedric Charlier, Olympic Champion I Keynote Speaker | Partner Manager Odoo
tracks.description_text:
18 years. 382 international matches. European, World and Olympic titles.
An 18-year journey at the highest level of international hockey, as part of the Belgian Red Lions and their historic transformation from a second-tier hockey nation into the world’s number one team.
This journey was about far more than sporting talent. It was about building a shared ambition, creating a strong team culture, developing trust and accountability, raising standards, embracing setbacks and learning how to perform together under pressure.
The Red Lions spirit: a winning culture and high team performance
How does a team transform from a second-tier nation into the number one team in the world?
This keynote takes the audience behind the Red Lions’ journey and explores the principles that enabled this transformation: a clear vision, a shared purpose, high standards, resilience, trust and collective accountability.
The lessons of elite sport go far beyond the hockey field. They provide powerful insights into leadership, teamwork, culture and sustainable performance — and into what it takes to turn ambition into consistent collective success.

speakers.function: Olympic Champion I Keynote Speaker | Partner Manager Odoo

tracks.name: Run your real estate business with Odoo
tracks.speaker_line: Emma Brandy from Odoo
tracks.description_text:
Real estate operations often stall when data must manually transition between disconnected tools during a property’s lifecycle. Fragmented systems complicate everything from vendor onboarding and automated buyer matching to fee calculations and rental contract management.
This session demonstrates how the Real Estate Agency and Property Management modules unify these steps into a single, continuous workflow.
We will explore how a new property listing automatically triggers subscriber matching, routes inbound marketplace leads into a structured nurturing pipeline equipped with visit scheduling and offer shortcuts, and seemlessly calculates commission fees. Finally, we will look at the back-office transition, converting a buyer into a property management client, and automating recurring rent invoicing directly inside the ERP.

speakers.name: Emma Brandy
speakers.biography_text: After three years in Odoo's Functional Support Team, Emma joined the Learning & Development team. Today, she coordinates the integration of monthly newcomers and oversees training for various departments. Furthermore, she partners with product owners on the Industry project to build internal documentation and align the team on new industry updates

tracks.speaker_line: Olivier Colson from Odoo
tracks.description_text: Odoo 20 introduces a new automatic snapshotting mechanism for accounting reports. This talk will explain how it works, what it does, and how to use it.

tracks.speaker_line: Geoffrey Margraff from Odoo
tracks.description_text: Free ask me anything session with the PO's

tracks.name: Measure, snap, quote, note: Digitize your field operations with Odoo
tracks.speaker_line: Mathieu Herbos from Odoo
tracks.description_text:
A large part of an SME's sales activity happens outside the office: at the client's home, in a showroom, on the road. The data created there is where deals are won or lost, but it often gets stuck between a notebook, a phone gallery and a WhatsApp thread before it ever reaches the CRM.
In this talk, we follow the real-life journey of a kitchen designer and fitter, from the first lead to the signed order. A prospect fills in a form on the website, a salesperson qualifies the lead and books a home visit, takes measurements and photos on site, builds the quotation on the tablet with product variants and options, and gets the client to sign on the spot.
Along the way, we'll show how CRM and Sales, combined with Odoo's mobile experience, help SMEs shorten their sales cycle, close deals on-site, and make sure no lead ever gets lost between the showroom and the field.

speakers.name: Mathieu Herbos
speakers.biography_text: Mathieu Herbos is a Business Development Representative at Odoo Belgium, where he helps SMEs from a wide range of industries digitize their operations. He works daily with sales and field teams to design workflows that fit real-life use cases.

tracks.name: Client Testimonial - Conti Lines chooses Odoo for their financial setup
tracks.speaker_line: Koen Desseyn, Director at Deloitte Consulting & Advisory
tracks.description_text: Conti-Lines Group wants to modernize their finance team creating a lean and efficient finance team that moved from input towards controlling and compliance. In addition, this brings opportunity to optimize the order to cash flow and to phase out legacy platforms (AS-400 / CODA) in the landscape. One of the complexity area’s during the transformation is the integration with Vessel Management Platform VESON, which is their core platform from operations side.

tracks.name: Integrate the multiple calendars in your Odoo apps
tracks.speaker_line: Noé Antoine (nan) from Odoo
tracks.description_text: Discover the various tools of the calendar application, and how we moved towards a system of multiple calendars, that can be shared between internal users. In addition, we will cover a few related challenges coming from the synchronization process with Google Calendar.
